      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="3d-OT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="3d-OT">3d-<wbr>OT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">3d-OT: a deep geometry-aware framework for heterogeneous slices alignment of spatial multi-omics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">3d-OT 将空间组学切片表示为二维点云：每个 spot 既有坐标，也有 RNA、染色质或蛋白特征。它先用 PointNet++ 风格的局部集合卷积学习同时保留空间几何和分子信号的表示，再用受空间候选约束的 Sinkhorn optimal transport 建立切片间软对应，由软对应重建目标坐标并形成 alignment flow。Chamfer、局部平滑和近零散度三项无监督损失共同约束该流，连续配准相邻切片即可构造三维或时空重建。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multi-omics technologies simultaneously measure transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic information at spatially resolved locations within tissue sections.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03034-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for 3d-OT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dbjzs/3d-OT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for 3d-OT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/3d-ot-e05ddc6c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：3d-OT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="aistats" data-journal-label="AISTATS" data-method="Adaptive_Coverage_Policies_Conformal_Prediction">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Adaptive_Coverage_Policies_Conformal_Prediction">Adaptive_<wbr>Coverage_<wbr>Policies_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Prediction</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Adaptive Coverage Policies in Conformal Prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">用 soft-rank e-value 构造 conformal set；把校准集逐个 leave-one-out，合成 n 个伪 conformal 任务；训练一个小神经网络最小化“预测集合大小 + \lambda × 失覆盖率”；再通过 bracket + bisection 选择 \lambda，使平均集合大小接近用户目标 M。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Classical conformal prediction requires a miscoverage level \alpha to be fixed before observing calibration and test data, even though different examples may need different coverage/size trade-offs.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>AISTATS · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2510.04318" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Adaptive_Coverage_Policies_Conformal_Prediction">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GauthierE/adaptive-coverage-policies" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Adaptive_Coverage_Policies_Conformal_Prediction">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/adaptive-coverage-policies-conformal-prediction-ebf3ed46/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Adaptive_Coverage_Policies_Conformal_Prediction">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="Aging Mouse Brain Epigenome">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Data Sources &amp; Technologies</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Aging Mouse Brain Epigenome">Aging Mouse Brain Epigenome</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cell-type-specific transposon demethylation and TAD remodeling in aging mouse brain</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">脑衰老会伴随 DNA 甲基化漂移、转座元件解除抑制、染色质三维结构变化和炎症反应，但以往研究通常只测一种组学、少数脑区或混合细胞。这样难以区分：变化是某一类细胞真正发生的，还是细胞组成改变造成的；同一种细胞在不同脑区是否以同样方式衰老；局部甲基化和三维接触变化能否解释年龄相关基因表达。 本研究建立跨年龄、脑区和模态的单核图谱，把 2、9、18 月龄小鼠作为连续时间点。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Aging is the primary risk factor for neurodegenerative diseases, yet the epigenetic mechanisms underlying brain aging remain poorly characterized at single-cell resolution.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2026.02.015" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Aging Mouse Brain Epigenome">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/rachelzeng98/aging-mouse-brain" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Aging Mouse Brain Epigenome">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/aging-mouse-brain-epigenome-4231a74e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Aging Mouse Brain Epigenome">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="bioactive-materials" data-journal-label="Bioactive Materials" data-method="AIVOs">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="AIVOs">AIVOs</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Artificial Intelligence Virtual Organoids (AIVOs)</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">AIVO（Artificial Intelligence Virtual Organoid，也称 virtual/silicon organoid）不是“用 AI 分析一次类器官数据”，而是一个持续维护的类器官尺度数字孪生：它把多模态、纵向实验与临床观测编码为虚拟细胞状态，再加入细胞间、细胞-基质、物质传输和力学耦合，通过“预测 -&gt; 实验测量 -&gt; 状态更新 -&gt; 下一轮干预”形成闭环（论文第 25-31、41-59、63-83 行）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Bai and Su propose Artificial Intelligence Virtual Organoids (AIVOs), also called virtual or silicon organoids, as persistent organoid-scale digital twins.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioactive Materials · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bioactmat.2025.12.030" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for AIVOs">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/aivos-924bedc5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：AIVOs">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="science" data-journal-label="Science" data-method="Alzheimers_3DGenome_Multiomics">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Alzheimers_3DGenome_Multiomics">Alzheimers_<wbr>3DGenome_<wbr>Multiomics</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell multiomics connects 3D genome and transcriptome alterations in Alzheimer&#x27;s disease</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">阿尔茨海默病（AD）的单细胞研究已经发现大量细胞类型特异的转录和染色质可及性变化，但仍缺少一个关键环节：同一个细胞中的三维基因组折叠是否也发生变化，并且这些变化是否与转录失调相联系？ 过去几类工作各自只覆盖问题的一部分： Mathys 等在 Nature 2019、Cell 2023 和 Nature 2024 的单细胞/单核转录组图谱解析了 AD 的细胞类型和基因表达变化，但没有在同一细胞测量 Hi-C。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell AD studies have cataloged transcriptional and accessibility changes, but they generally do not measure RNA and three-dimensional chromatin contacts in the same cell.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Aneuploidy_Driver_Genes_Breast_Cancer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Data Sources &amp; Technologies</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="Aneuploidy_Driver_Genes_Breast_Cancer">Aneuploidy_<wbr>Driver_<wbr>Genes_<wbr>Breast_<wbr>Cancer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Aneuploidy selects for the acquisition of driver genes in breast cancer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">基底样乳腺癌（BLBC）的染色体臂拷贝数改变（CNA）很常见，但一条染色体臂同时改变许多基因；仅凭复发频率不能判断究竟哪一个基因带来选择优势。本文先在 METABRIC、TCGA 和单细胞数据中找出 BLBC 特异的染色体臂改变，再在小鼠体内逐基因功能筛选。 CRISPR-KOALA 将同一类体内筛选做成双向操作： 敲除分支使用普通 20-bp sgRNA；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature (2026) study argues that recurrent chromosome-arm CNAs in basal-like breast cancer (BLBC) are selected because they alter particular driver genes, not merely because whole-arm aneuploidy is advantageous.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dpcook/blbc_cna" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Aneuploidy_Driver_Genes_Breast_Cancer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/aneuploidy-driver-genes-breast-cancer-fb4ab463/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Aneuploidy_Driver_Genes_Breast_Cancer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="ApexGO">

        <h2 aria-label="ApexGO">ApexGO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A generative artificial intelligence approach for peptide antibiotic optimization</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ApexGO 解决的不是“从零生成任意抗菌肽”，而是一个更接近药物研发后期的任务：给定一条已经有实验基础的模板肽 x0，在尽量保留其序列骨架的前提下，寻找抗菌活性更强的衍生肽 x。 论文把目标具体化为两个条件： APEX 预测的最低抑菌浓度（MIC）要尽可能低； 候选肽与模板的编辑相似度至少为 75%。 因此，ApexGO 是一个“受约束的模板局部优化器”，而不是普通的无条件生成模型。 监督学习抗生素发现方法通常在已有分子或序列库中打分。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Antimicrobial-peptide discovery has many candidate sequences, but lead optimization requires improving a known scaffold while preserving similarity, manufacturability and a useful activity profile.</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="Autonomous_navigation_of_intelligent_microrobotic_swarms">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Autonomous_navigation_of_intelligent_microrobotic_swarms">Autonomous_<wbr>navigation_<wbr>of_<wbr>intelligent_<wbr>microrobotic_<wbr>swarms</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Autonomous navigation of intelligent microrobotic swarms in unknown environments</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究的是一个典型的“部分可观测闭环控制”问题：磁驱动微机器人集群需要在未知环境中到达目标，同时避开静态或运动障碍物。控制器不能预先获得完整地图，只能看到当前局部视野；检测存在噪声，仿真动力学与真实系统不完全一致，视野还可能临时改变或丢失。 因此，控制器不能只回答“这一帧应该向哪里走”，还必须同时解决三个问题： 怎样把局部视觉检测转成稳定、固定长度的状态表示？ 怎样利用历史信息弥补当前观测的不足？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Magnetically actuated microrobotic swarms can reconfigure and carry out delivery or navigation tasks, but autonomous control in an unknown environment is difficult.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/seuwanglab/Intelligent-Microrobotic-Swarm-in-Unknown-Environments" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Autonomous_navigation_of_intelligent_microrobotic_swarms">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/autonomous-navigation-of-intelligent-microrobotic-swarms-2ff46380/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Autonomous_navigation_of_intelligent_microrobotic_swarms">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="Bamboomixer_extension">Bamboomixer_<wbr>extension</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reusability report: Exploring the utility and extensibility of an integrated modelling framework for liquid electrolyte design</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">本地可得的 Nature Machine Intelligence 文章是“可复用性报告”，HTML 正文主要包含摘要、图注和数据/代码可用性信息；没有完整方法章节、数据规模或编号公式。因此，下面把“论文明确说法”和“Zenodo 19048302 代码验证行为”分开。代码细节不能被误写成论文原文结论。 液态电解液设计需要同时处理分子结构、配方组成、温度和盐浓度。传统模型在数据分布改变、化学体系改变或目标属性扩展时，稳健性和迁移性不足。</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Betting_On_Equilibrium_Monitoring_Strategic_Behavior">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Betting_On_Equilibrium_Monitoring_Strategic_Behavior">Betting_<wbr>On_<wbr>Equilibrium_<wbr>Monitoring_<wbr>Strategic_<wbr>Behavior</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Anytime Detection of Strategic Deviations in Multi-Agent Systems</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">假设一个多智能体系统一直在运行：交易机器人持续博弈，自动驾驶车辆持续协调，或者多个学习智能体持续更新策略。我们希望在行为刚刚偏离约定规则时就报警，而不是先规定“收集 10,000 轮数据”，结束后再做一次离线检验。 难点在于：如果不断查看普通固定样本检验的结果，并在“看起来显著”时停止，就会积累假阳性。本文用 e-value / e-process（证据值/证据过程）解决这个问题。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multi-agent behavior is often evaluated after collecting a fixed dataset, but a deployed system needs to be monitored continuously. Repeatedly applying ordinary fixed-sample tests as more rounds arrive invalidates their error guarantees.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GauthierE/anytime-detection-deviation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Betting_On_Equilibrium_Monitoring_Strategic_Behavior">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/betting-on-equilibrium-monitoring-strategic-behavior-3acb5867/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Betting_On_Equilibrium_Monitoring_Strategic_Behavior">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Blackwell_Approachability_Gradient_Equilibrium_Equivalent">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Blackwell_Approachability_Gradient_Equilibrium_Equivalent">Blackwell_<wbr>Approachability_<wbr>Gradient_<wbr>Equilibrium_<wbr>Equivalent</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Blackwell Approachability and Gradient Equilibrium are Equivalent</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文证明：梯度均衡（gradient equilibrium, GEQ）与 Blackwell 可达性（Blackwell approachability, BA）虽然优化目标写法不同，但作为在线学习的“算法黑盒”具有同等能力。任意一个 BA 问题都能调用 GEQ oracle 来解；任意一个 GEQ 问题也能调用 BA oracle 来解；两边都只需每轮一次 oracle 查询，并保留原 oracle 的渐近误差阶。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GEQ generalizes offline first-order stationarity to online learning by asking the time-average of observed vector fields (plus normal-cone corrections for constrained decisions) to converge to zero.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2606.27315" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Blackwell_Approachability_Gradient_Equilibrium_Equivalent">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/blackwell-approachability-gradient-equilibrium-equivalent-64f6c1df/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Blackwell_Approachability_Gradient_Equilibrium_Equivalent">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="Brain-guided_LLM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="Brain-guided_LLM">Brain-<wbr>guided_<wbr>LLM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Beyond representational alignment with brain-guided language models for robust reasoning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作研究的不是通常意义上的“用脑数据预测文字”，而是两个更具体的问题： 大语言模型在做演绎推理时，内部表征能否预测人类推理相关脑区的任务态 fMRI？ 如果存在这种对应关系，脑信号能否从一种分析指标变成真正改善模型推理的训练或干预信号？ 以往的脑-模型研究大多停留在表征对齐：拟合一个映射，观察模型特征能预测多少脑活动。但相关性不等于功能等价。尤其是，人脑的语言系统和推理系统并不完全重合；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Language models can correlate with human neural activity, but correlation alone does not show whether neural signals contain useful guidance for model reasoning.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pkuxmq/Brain-guided_LLM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Brain-guided_LLM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/brain-guided-llm-c3ade8e0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Brain-guided_LLM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

        <h2 aria-label="BurstySchrodingerTrajectories">BurstySchrodingerTrajectories</h2>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文没有发明新的 Sinkhorn 算法。它改变的是 Sinkhorn 之前的“参考过程”：传统方法默认细胞在表达空间中近似扩散，本文则从一个含转录爆发和基因调控网络（GRN）的随机动力学模型出发，估计细胞从初态走到各个终态的概率，再寻找既接近该机制参考、又严格匹配两个观测时点边缘分布的耦合。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="C-COMPASS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="C-COMPASS">C-<wbr>COMPASS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">C-COMPASS: a user-friendly neural network tool profiles cell compartments at protein and lipid levels</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">细胞器分级实验会把蛋白质在多个离心组分中的丰度记录成一条“曲线”。传统分类器通常给每个蛋白一个细胞器标签，但约一半蛋白可能多定位，而且不同条件下还会重新定位。C-COMPASS 的目标是输出一个和为 1 的细胞器贡献向量，例如“线粒体 0.7、胞质 0.3”，并比较不同条件之间的变化。相同思路还能用于与蛋白质共同分级的脂质。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">C-COMPASS is a graphical, open-source spatial-omics tool that converts biochemical fractionation profiles into quantitative distributions over cellular compartments.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="acm-transactions-on-recommender-systems" data-journal-label="ACM Transactions on Recommender Systems" data-method="CAFL">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CAFL">CAFL</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Breaking Feedback Loops in Recommender Systems with Causal Inference</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">在线推荐系统不是在一份静态、随机采样的数据上训练。它通常不断重复： 于是模型会改变自己以后看到的数据。早期被推荐的物品更容易获得评分，这些评分又让类似物品继续被推荐。若直接把各轮数据合并、按普通独立样本训练，就会把推荐策略制造的选择偏差当成用户真实偏好。这可能降低评分预测和排序质量，也可能让不同用户看到的内容越来越相似。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Repeatedly retrained recommender systems create their own training distribution: recommendations determine which ratings are observed, those ratings update the preference model, and that model determines future recommendations.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ACM Transactions on Recommender Systems · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1145/3728372" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CAFL">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cafl-48264918/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CAFL">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="CalArena">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CalArena">CalArena</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CalArena: A Large-Scale Post-Hoc Calibration Benchmark</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">分类器不仅给类别，还给概率；但“预测 0.9”并不保证类似样本中真的有约 90% 属于该类。后处理校准是在不重训分类器的情况下，用独立校准集学习一个映射，把原始概率变成更可靠的概率。 难点不在于缺少方法，而在于方法太多、比较不公平：既有研究的数据规模小，ECE 等指标对分箱方式敏感，公开实现也不统一。同一个方法可能在不同论文中得到相反结论。CalArena 因而是一篇机器学习基准论文，目标是建立统一的“赛场”，不是提出某个生信算法。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Modern classifiers often output unreliable probabilities, but practitioners face dozens of post-hoc calibration methods evaluated on small, inconsistent benchmarks.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2605.30188" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CalArena">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/probkit/CalArena" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CalArena">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/calarena-0c387f79/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CalArena">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Calibeating_Made_Simple">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Calibeating_Made_Simple">Calibeating_<wbr>Made_<wbr>Simple</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Calibeating Made Simple</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇在线学习与概率预测校准理论论文，不是生物信息学论文。 设外部预测器每轮给出一个 K 类概率向量 qt\in\DeltaK。学习器看到它以后输出自己的概率 pt，随后真实类别 yt 才揭晓。一个好的后处理器不应只追求“校准”，因为在线随机策略即使不了解数据生成机制，也可能做到渐近校准。论文关心的是：能否在改善可靠性的同时，不损失外部预测器真正包含的信息？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Calibeating post-processes an external probabilistic forecaster so that the learner&#x27;s cumulative proper-scoring loss competes with the forecaster&#x27;s refinement score—its loss after removing within-forecast-bin calibration error.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2603.22167" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Calibeating_Made_Simple">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/calibeating-made-simple-333ebd51/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Calibeating_Made_Simple">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biomedical-engineering" data-journal-label="Nature Biomedical Engineering" data-method="CAML">

        <h2 aria-label="CAML">CAML</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Bridging the interpretability gap for medical artificial intelligence models using class-association manifold learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文关注的是医疗 AI 的“可解释性鸿沟”。很多现有方法只能给出局部热图，告诉你某一张图哪里可能重要，但很难总结整个模型到底学会了什么规则；另一类全局解释方法又往往太简单，解释性提高了，准确率却掉得很厉害。作者提出 CAML，希望把“全局规则”和“单个病例解释”统一到同一个低维流形里 。 作者认为，一张医疗图像里既有真正和疾病判别相关的模式，也有很多“个体背景信息”，比如位置、形态、亮度、背景差异等。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Bridging the interpretability gap for medical artificial intelligence models using class-association manifold learning introduces CAML, a generative explainability framework for medical AI.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biomedical Engineering · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41551-026-01676-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CAML">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xrt11/XAI-CAML" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CAML">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/caml-b0fa4a16/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CAML">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="Camyla">Camyla</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Camyla: Scaling Autonomous Research in Medical Image Segmentation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Camyla 的输出可以包含新网络，但 Camyla 本身是一个自主研究系统。输入是医学图像分割数据集和配置，系统负责建立强 baseline、检索文献、生成研究提案、编写候选网络、训练与评估、根据失败诊断继续搜索、对最终方法做消融，并生成可编译论文。 它要解决的不是单次代码生成，而是长达许多轮实验时的三个管理问题：有限 GPU 预算该投到哪个提案；大量日志怎样压缩而不遗忘关键经验；一个实验失败后怎样避免围绕同一个小修小补反复打转。</p>
        </div>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Medical image segmentation is a demanding scientific domain with well-defined benchmarks and strong automated baselines. Despite this, developing competitive new methods remains labor-intensive: generating hypotheses, writing and debugging…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="Casei">

        <h2 aria-label="Casei">Casei</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Decoding Condition-Specific Cellular Crosstalk in Spatial Omics via Bilinear Edge Classification</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间组学不仅记录“某个细胞是什么状态”，还记录“哪些细胞在组织中相邻”。疾病、衰老或外界暴露可能主要改变相邻细胞之间的组织方式，而不明显改变全局细胞状态分布。若只训练细胞级分类器，模型回答的是“哪个细胞像疾病样本”；Casei 则把问题改写成：空间邻接图中的哪一条边最能区分实验条件？ 这个改写很关键。例如论文的半合成实验只重新排列局部细胞位置或细胞类型邻接关系，同时保持整个组织的表达谱分布不变。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Casei targets condition-specific tissue reorganization in spatial omics. The paper argues that disease, fibrosis, aging, and environmental exposure can alter the relationships between neighboring cells even when individual cell states or ce…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Cell-JEPA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Cell-JEPA">Cell-<wbr>JEPA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cell-JEPA: Latent Representation Learning for Single-Cell Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序把每个细胞表示成一个跨越数万基因的表达向量，但这个向量既稀疏又嘈杂：分子捕获效率、测序深度和随机采样都会改变观测到的表达值。许多单细胞基础模型把“恢复被遮盖的基因或表达值”作为预训练任务。这样做能提供密集监督，却也可能迫使模型记住测量噪声，而不是只保留决定细胞身份和调控状态的稳定结构。 Cell-JEPA 的核心问题因此是：能否让模型从不完整的表达谱中预测完整细胞的潜在表示，同时仍保留必要的基因级信息？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell-JEPA addresses representation learning for sparse, noisy single-cell RNA-seq profiles. The paper argues that reconstruction-only objectives, used by models such as scGPT and Geneformer, can preserve sequencing-depth, capture-efficiency…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cell-jepa-09b2a6ed/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Cell-JEPA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="Cell-o1">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Cell-o1">Cell-<wbr>o1</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cell-o1: training LLMs to solve single-cell reasoning puzzles with reinforcement learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell-o1 解决的是单细胞 RNA-seq 的批次级别细胞类型注释问题。传统做法通常把每个细胞单独分类，但论文认为真实专家不会这样做；专家会把同一个 donor / sample 里的多个细胞放在一起，结合基因表达和上下文信息，统一决定谁对应哪一个细胞类型 (PAPERMD:60-68)。 因此作者先提出了一个新 benchmark: CellPuzzles。每个样本不是一个 cell，而是一组 8-15 个 cell。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell-o1 addresses batch-level cell type annotation for single-cell RNA-seq, where multiple cells from the same donor must be assigned unique labels jointly rather than independently.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btag208" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Cell-o1">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ncbi-nlp/cell-o1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Cell-o1">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cell-o1-f8eef957/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Cell-o1">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="npj-systems-biology-and-applications" data-journal-label="npj Systems Biology and Applications" data-method="CellFateTrajectories_npjSBA2026">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellFateTrajectories_npjSBA2026">CellFateTrajectories_<wbr>npjSBA2026</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deciphering cell-fate trajectories using spatiotemporal single-cell transcriptomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这不是提出单一新算法的原创方法论文，而是一篇方法综述。它把不同时间点采到的、彼此不配对的单细胞分布视为随时间演化的概率分布，并用“spatiotemporal Dynamical Generative Model（stDGM）”统一最优传输、Schrödinger bridge、流匹配、增长/死亡、空间对齐和细胞相互作用方法。 核心问题是：Day 2 与 Day 4 的细胞不是同一批细胞，如何从若干 snapshot 推断中间连续动力学。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multi-modal integration: Combining transcriptomic time series with epigenomic, proteomic, and imaging measurements for more comprehensive regulatory dynamics views.</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="CellFluxRL">

        <h2 aria-label="CellFluxRL">CellFluxRL</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellFluxRL: Biologically-Constrained Virtual Cell Modeling via Reinforcement Learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellFluxRL 不是从零训练新的虚拟细胞模型，而是在已训练的 CellFlux 流匹配模型上做奖励驱动的 RL 后训练：同一 control image 与药物条件生成多个候选，用七个生物/结构/形态评分挑出相对好的与差的样本，再让速度场提高高奖励样本、压低低奖励样本的生成倾向。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Image-based virtual cell models use generative models (flow matching, diffusion) to predict how cell morphology changes under chemical perturbations — aiming to replace expensive wet-lab drug screening.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2603.21743" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellFluxRL">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/yuhui-zh15/CellFlux" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellFluxRL">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellfluxrl-55a550f1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellFluxRL">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellRank 不负责从原始 counts 独立发现全部动力学，而是一个“转移矩阵后端”：先把 RNA velocity、pseudotime、CytoTRACE、实验时间/OT 或已有相似图转成细胞间转移概率，再用 GPCCA 把大规模 Markov chain 粗粒化成 macrostates，定义初始/终末状态，并计算每个细胞最终到达各终末状态的概率。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="deconvolution_mapping" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="CellRefiner">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellRefiner">CellRefiner</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reconstructing single-cell resolution from spatial transcriptomics with CellRefiner</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellRefiner 不从 Visium spot 中真正测出每个细胞的位置。它把配对的 scRNA-seq 细胞先分配到 spot，再把这些细胞当作粒子，在组织边界、细胞间距和表达相似性等约束下移动；随后可把每个细胞展开成多个亚细胞元素，得到用于接触图和配体–受体分析的预测几何。输出是模型重建，不是成像分割或实验测量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellRefiner 将配对 scRNA-seq 和 spot 级空间转录组重建为虚拟单细胞空间图：先用 FGW 将参考细胞分配到 spot，再以粒子力精修位置，最后可用亚细胞元素生成形状、接触图和接触型配体–受体信号。论文在多种由单细胞空间数据生成的 pseudo-Visium 基准上显示空间分布指标改善，并在 Visium 皮层、淋巴结和鳞癌中给出与组织学或先验知识一致的应用结果。 核心边界是：这些输出是模型预测而非实验测得的逐细胞坐标、轮廓或信号。</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-70090-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellRefiner">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/XiangyuKuang/cellrefiner" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellRefiner">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellrefiner-ab19725e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellRefiner">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="CellStream">CellStream</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellStream: Dynamical Optimal Transport Informed Embeddings for Reconstructing Cellular Trajectories from Snapshots Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellStream 面向多个离散时间点的单细胞快照。它不先做一个固定的 PCA/UMAP 再拟合轨迹，而是同时训练低维 autoencoder、速度场和生长/死亡率，使低维空间既能重构原始数据，又能让从最早时间点出发的粒子流匹配后续快照。 方法输出的是一个 dynamics-informed latent space，以及其中的连续速度场 v(t,z)、质量增长率 g(t,z) 和积分轨迹。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="CellVoyager">CellVoyager</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellVoyager: AI CompBio agent generates new insights by autonomously analyzing biological data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellVoyager 不是新的细胞表示模型或统计检验，而是一套“研究问题生成—代码执行—结果解释—动态重规划”的智能体工作流。它读取已处理的 .h5ad、研究背景和作者已经做过的分析，提出一个不重复的探索假设，在持续存在的 Jupyter kernel 中逐步运行代码，并依据输出决定下一步；一个分析完成后，它把摘要加入历史，避免后续假设重复。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA sequencing data harbors a vast space of possible analytical hypotheses, but researchers typically explore only a narrow subset constrained by time, expertise, and analytical preconceptions.</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="CLIM_TIME">CLIM_<wbr>TIME</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CLIM-TIME identifies metastatic microenvironment modulators for T cell therapy response</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Cell 论文提出的问题是：肿瘤抑制基因（TSG）缺失怎样改变转移灶的肿瘤微环境（TME），进而影响 T 细胞治疗效果。传统 CRISPR 筛选可以找到免疫调节基因，但通常缺少空间微环境信息；空间组学可以看微环境，但很难一次系统筛查数百个基因扰动。论文把这个缺口概括为：缺少能够在空间复杂 TME 中高通量解析“基因扰动-免疫状态-治疗反应”的方法。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CLIM-TIME studies how tumor suppressor gene (TSG) loss reshapes metastatic tumor microenvironments and changes T cell therapy response. The paper argues that standard CRISPR screens can find immune modulators but usually do not resolve spat…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="aaai" data-journal-label="AAAI" data-method="CLM-Access">

        <h2 aria-label="CLM-Access">CLM-<wbr>Access</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CLM-Access: A Specialized Foundation Model for High-Dimensional Single-Cell ATAC-Seq Analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scATAC-seq 每个细胞可对应约 115 万个统一 cCRE，数据极度稀疏、近似二值，而且不同实验的 peak 坐标缺少统一词表。传统方法常先筛掉大部分 peak，损失调控信息并限制规模。 CLM-Access 将按染色体位置排序后的 cCRE 划分为约 2,000 个固定 patch，每个 patch 约含 575 个 peak。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CLM-Access is a BERT-inspired foundation model for high-dimensional single-cell ATAC-seq. It addresses the million-scale cCRE vocabulary, extreme sparsity, binary counts, and lack of a universal peak annotation by mapping 2.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>AAAI · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/HIM-AIM/CLM-Access" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CLM-Access">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/clm-access-63d7b1fc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CLM-Access">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="clone2vec">

        <h2 aria-label="clone2vec">clone2vec</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Clonal embeddings allow exploratory analysis of lineage-resolved single-cell data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇工作关注的是带有谱系追踪信息的单细胞转录组数据。难点在于，大多数 clone 只被观测到很少几个细胞，而且 clone 大小分布很不均匀，所以如果直接用细胞类型比例、层次聚类，或者 OT / MMD 这类分布距离去比较 clone，经常会很不稳定。作者想要的是一种不依赖人工细胞类型标签、又能在稀疏采样下稳定描述 clone 行为差异的方法。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">clone2vec is a method for exploratory analysis of lineage-traced single-cell RNA-seq data that avoids hard dependence on discrete cell-type labels.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.30.720820" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for clone2vec">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kharchenkolab/clone2vec" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for clone2vec">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/clone2vec-c67fa657/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：clone2vec">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="CoCoGraph">

        <h2 aria-label="CoCoGraph">CoCoGraph</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A collaborative constrained graph diffusion model for the generation of realistic synthetic molecules</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">分子生成必须同时满足化学价态、连通性、新颖性和真实分子性质分布。早期 VAE、GAN、图生成器及离散扩散模型通常把化学规则交给网络学习，可能产生无效分子，或需要生成后过滤。CoCoGraph 的关键取舍是：把价态和连通性写进扩散转移，网络只学习真实分子的结构模式。 给定分子式，先建立含显式氢的价态有效图。一次双边交换（DES）选择两条边 (i,j)、(k,l)，删除它们并添加 (i,k)、(j,l)。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CoCoGraph is a constrained, collaborative discrete graph-diffusion generator for realistic synthetic molecules. It diffuses a formula-specific molecular graph with double-edge swaps that conserve every atom&#x27;s degree/valence, then uses a dif…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-026-01229-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CoCoGraph">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/manurubo/CoCoGraph" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CoCoGraph">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cocograph-4c49488d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CoCoGraph">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="CoMo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CoMo">CoMo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial multi-omics integration by cross-modal graph contrastive learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CoMo 接收同一批空间位置上配对的两种组学（例如 RNA+蛋白或 RNA+ATAC），分别从“物理邻近图”和“分子特征相似图”提取表示，再用跨模态注意力与 WNN 融合。第二阶段同时约束两种组学的簇语义一致，并让空间邻居在投影空间更接近，最终输出用于聚类、伪时序和差异分析的融合嵌入。 本解读依据本地论文 outputpapermd/PMC13092272/paper.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Spatial multi-omics integration by cross-modal graph contrastive learning Journal: Briefings in Bioinformatics 27(2), 2026-03 DOI: 10.1093/bib/bbag192 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbag192" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CoMo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Lab-Xu/CoMo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CoMo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/como-a9e058d1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CoMo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="COMPASS-PTM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="COMPASS-PTM">COMPASS-<wbr>PTM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Learning the PTM code through a coarse-to-fine mechanism-aware framework</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">COMPASS-PTM 把 PTM 预测拆成一个“先粗后细”的两阶段问题：第一阶段 MSPN 先在蛋白序列上预测哪些残基可能发生哪些 PTM，第二阶段 ESPS 再把这些候选 PTM 位点和可能的调控酶连接起来，形成 enzyme-resolved 的调控假设。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Post-translational modifications form combinatorial regulatory patterns, but many predictors score one PTM or one site at a time and do not connect predicted sites to the enzymes that write or erase them.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-73148-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for COMPASS-PTM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ZhangJJ26/COMPASS-PTM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for COMPASS-PTM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/compass-ptm-69278691/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：COMPASS-PTM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="CONCORD">CONCORD</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Revealing a coherent cell-state landscape across single-cell datasets with CONCORD</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CONCORD 旨在在多数据集单细胞场景下同时解决批次效应与细胞状态分辨率问题。方法输入为标准化后的单细胞表达矩阵（AnnData），输出是每个细胞的低维表示（adata.obsm[&#x27;Xconcord&#x27;]）以及可选的重建/分类头输出。核心思想是把“对比学习”中最容易被忽视的采样设计放在主位：通过单数据域内minibatch与难负例重加权，让网络在保留局部结构的同时消除批次伪差。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell transcriptomics can in principle map the full landscape of cellular states — discrete clusters, continuous trajectories, branching lineages, and cyclic programs — but three entangled challenges obstruct this goal in practice: Ba…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-025-02950-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CONCORD">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Gartner-Lab/Concord" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CONCORD">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/concord-d9499a24/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CONCORD">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Conditional_Coverage_Diagnostics_Conformal_Prediction">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="Conditional_Coverage_Diagnostics_Conformal_Prediction">Conditional_<wbr>Coverage_<wbr>Diagnostics_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Prediction</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Conditional Coverage Diagnostics for Conformal Prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">共形预测（conformal prediction, CP）可以构造预测集合 C\alpha(X)，并在交换性假设下保证总体覆盖率约为 1-\alpha。但“总体平均正确”不意味着每类样本都可靠：某些区域可能系统性欠覆盖，另一些区域则过度保守。 理想目标是 但在没有额外分布假设时，精确的条件覆盖通常不可能保证。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This statistical machine-learning paper introduces excess risk of target coverage (ERT), a family of diagnostics for asking whether conformal prediction sets cover equally well across feature values rather than only on average.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2512.11779" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Conditional_Coverage_Diagnostics_Conformal_Prediction">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ElSacho/Conditional_Coverage_Estimation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Conditional_Coverage_Diagnostics_Conformal_Prediction">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/conditional-coverage-diagnostics-conformal-prediction-5adf2987/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Conditional_Coverage_Diagnostics_Conformal_Prediction">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="ConfSeq">

        <h2 aria-label="ConfSeq">ConfSeq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Bridging three-dimensional molecular structures and artificial intelligence with a conformation description language</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ConfSeq 是一种面向三维分子构象的序列描述语言。论文的核心想法是：在保持 SMILES 紧凑、可读的同时，把二面角、键角和伪手性等内部坐标离散成 token，于是三维构象预测、从零生成和表示学习都可以改写成 Transformer 的序列建模问题。 需要注意证据范围：当前获取到的是 Nature 的订阅预览，包含摘要、六幅主图及图注、数据/代码可用性和参考文献，但没有完整 Methods、补充材料正文或图中所有数值。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SMILES are compact and readable but do not fully describe a molecule&#x27;s 3D conformation. ConfSeq addresses this representation gap by encoding molecular connectivity together with discrete internal-coordinate information so that 3D molecular…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-026-01250-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ConfSeq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jiachengxiong/ConfSeq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ConfSeq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/confseq-12480793/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ConfSeq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Connectome-seq">

        <h2 aria-label="Connectome-seq">Connectome-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Connectome-seq: high-throughput mapping of neuronal connectivity at single-synapse resolution via barcode sequencing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Connectome-seq 的真正价值不是“用测序替代所有 connectomics”，而是建立了一条可扩展的桥梁：把物理单突触中的成对 RNA 条形码，与两端神经元的单核转录组重新连接起来，从而在同一实验中同时获得连接关系和分子身份。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Connectome-seq is a 2026 Nature Methods technology for mapping long-range mammalian neuronal connections at single-synapse resolution while retaining the transcriptomic identities of the connected cells.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/BoxuanZhaoLab/connectome-seq-code" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Connectome-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/connectome-seq-14a115c0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Connectome-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="ContextFlow">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ContextFlow">ContextFlow</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ContextFlow: Context-Aware Flow Matching for Trajectory Inference from Spatial Omics Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ContextFlow 从多个时间点的空间转录组快照学习连续速度场。它的关键不是把空间坐标直接作为速度网络输入，而是在相邻时间点的 minibatch optimal transport（OT）配对中加入两类上下文：局部组织表达环境和 ligand–receptor（LR）通讯模式。由这些先验偏置出的跨时点细胞对，再监督 conditional flow matching。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Inferring cellular trajectories from longitudinal spatial transcriptomics data is essential for understanding tissue dynamics in development, regeneration, and disease.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2510.02952" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ContextFlow">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/santanurathod/ContextFlow" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ContextFlow">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/contextflow-72f8fd11/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ContextFlow">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CoPro">

        <h2 aria-label="CoPro">CoPro</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Dissecting the coordinated progression of cell states in spatial transcriptomics with CoPro</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组里常见的变化并不总是离散“区域”，而可能是几个重叠的连续梯度：例如结肠隐窝从底到顶的分化、局部炎症斑块、肝小叶分区，以及不同细胞类型沿同一组织轴发生的协同变化。CoPro 的目标是为每个细胞类型找到一个可解释的表达方向，使空间上相邻的不同类型细胞沿这些方向具有最大的协同变化。 它输出的是每种细胞类型的基因权重和逐细胞 co-progression score。这个 score 是空间协调轴，不等同于时间、谱系或因果方向；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Tissue function depends on spatially coordinated interactions between distinct cell types. In the intestinal crypt, epithelial differentiation along the base-to-tip axis is accompanied by parallel transcriptional transitions in adjacent fib…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.17.719309" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CoPro">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Zhen-Miao/CoPro" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CoPro">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/copro-dae56e1b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CoPro">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Correlated_cryo_EM_MSI_chemical_mapping">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Correlated_cryo_EM_MSI_chemical_mapping">Correlated_<wbr>cryo_<wbr>EM_<wbr>MSI_<wbr>chemical_<wbr>mapping</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Subcellular chemical mapping using correlated cryogenic electron and mass spectrometry imaging</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）能看清细胞膜、储存颗粒等超微结构，却通常不能直接判断某个密度由什么化学物质组成。成像质谱能检测元素或分子碎片的空间分布，但结构分辨率和形态信息较弱。本工作把两种模态串联在同一块玻璃化样品、同一区域上，使“结构在哪里”和“化学物质在哪里”能够相互解释。 作者建立了 cryo-EM-FIB-SIMS 流程：先记录不会被保留的高分辨结构信息，再用镓离子束逐像素溅射样品，并在每个像素采集飞行时间质谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Methods 2026 paper addresses a basic limitation of cryo-electron microscopy: cellular densities can be resolved structurally but are difficult to identify chemically.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lmb-mass-spec-compbio/BPAF_uptake_Caulobacter_crescentus_TMT_proteomics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Correlated_cryo_EM_MSI_chemical_mapping">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/correlated-cryo-em-msi-chemical-mapping-76e1c3d3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Correlated_cryo_EM_MSI_chemical_mapping">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="CoScientist">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="CoScientist">CoScientist</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Co-Scientist 是一个建立在 Gemini 2.0 上的复合多代理系统。科学家给出自然语言研究目标、已有证据、实验条件和约束，系统大量生成候选假说，反复审查、比较、演化，再把排序后的研究建议交回科学家选择和验证。它的产物是待检验的假说与实验计划，不是已经成立的科学结论。 论文的主要方法贡献不是新的基础模型或训练损失，而是把推理时计算组织成一个持续运行的“生成—批判—竞赛—改写”系统。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Co-Scientist tackles a problem that sits before ordinary model fitting: how to help scientists generate, critique, rank, and refine novel hypotheses for complex biomedical questions.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10644-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CoScientist">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/coscientist-325cd568/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CoScientist">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="CROCHET">CROCHET</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CROCHET: a versatile pipeline for automated analysis and visual atlas creation from single-cell spatialomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CROCHET（ChaRacterization Of Cellular HEterogeneity in Tissues）是一套面向单细胞分辨率空间组学的端到端流程。它把原始多轮荧光图像依次变成配准、分割和质控后的单细胞特征表，再用基于径向分布函数（RDF）的空间富集分数衡量“哪些标记或细胞类型在给定距离内共同出现”，最后生成细胞邻域、受体—配体 immunoprint 和相邻切片的 3D 图谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CSDE">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CSDE">CSDE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mitigating Bias in Spatial Transcriptomic Pipelines via Human Feedback</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CSDE 不试图重新画出“正确”的细胞边界，而是问一个更保守的问题：自动分割、定量和注释造成的错误，会把下游差异表达（DE）推偏多少？它用少量专家复核细胞估计这种偏差，再把大规模自动数据提供的低方差与人工数据提供的可信性结合起来。 论文是 2026 年 bioRxiv 预印本，尚未经同行评审。以下解释以本地论文正文、同文件中的补充材料、图注和 CSDEcode 源码为证据边界。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Mitigating Bias in Spatial Transcriptomic Pipelines via Human Feedback Method: CSDE (Corrected Spatial Differential Expression) Authors: Pierre Boyeau, Stephen Bates, Can Ergen, Michael I.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.01.15.699786" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CSDE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YosefLab/CSDE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CSDE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/csde-bfe0e1ea/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CSDE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Genetics" data-method="CytoSignal">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CytoSignal">CytoSignal</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CytoSignal detects locations and dynamics of ligand-receptor signaling at cellular resolution from spatial transcriptomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CytoSignal 解决的是空间转录组里的细胞间通讯定位问题：给定每个空间位置的表达量和坐标，方法希望判断某个配体-受体相互作用在哪些具体位置活跃，而不是只在“某类细胞到某类细胞”这种粗粒度层面做推断。论文强调既有方法的两个主要不足：很多单细胞通讯方法没有使用空间邻近信息；很多空间通讯方法依赖预定义细胞群，或者没有为每个 LR pair 在每个空间位置单独给出预测；同时，接触依赖型信号和可扩散配体信号不应使用同一种邻域模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CytoSignal is a Nature Genetics 2026 method for detecting where ligand-receptor (LR) signaling is active in spatial transcriptomic data and how that signaling changes over time.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-026-02624-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CytoSignal">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/welch-lab/CytoSignal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CytoSignal">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cytosignal-bfcda605/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CytoSignal">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="CytoTemporalCortex">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CytoTemporalCortex">CytoTemporalCortex</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Developmental gene expression patterns driving species-specific cortical features</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">人和小鼠的大脑皮层发育具有相同的基本谱系：放射状胶质细胞（RG）产生中间祖细胞（IP），再产生神经元（N）。但两者的发育速度、祖细胞扩增和神经元成熟时间不同。若直接按胚胎天数或孕周对齐，比较的常常不是相同发育状态。 HuMous 因此不把“物种差异”简化为某个时间点的差异表达，而是为每个基因构造一张二维表达景观：横轴表示从早到晚的发育年龄，纵轴表示从 RG 经 IP 到神经元的分化状态。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The cerebral cortex shows dramatic species-specific differences in size, progenitor diversity, and neuronal output — differences ultimately underlying human cognitive capacity. The source of these differences is poorly understood.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10491-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CytoTemporalCortex">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gomez-L/humous" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CytoTemporalCortex">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cytotemporalcortex-5f08222c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CytoTemporalCortex">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="DBiT-plus">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DBiT-plus">DBiT-<wbr>plus</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Integration of imaging-based and sequencing-based spatial omics mapping on the same tissue section via DBiTplus</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组测得的基因很多，但一个 25–50 μm 的 DBiT 点位通常含有多个细胞；多重免疫荧光可以看到单细胞，却只能测有限的蛋白标记。若分别在相邻切片上做两种实验，即使切片来自同一组织块，细胞组成和几何结构也不会完全一致。 DBiTplus 的核心思路是：在同一张组织切片上先做空间转录组，再做多重蛋白成像，并让图像中真正看到的细胞约束 RNA 点位的拆分。 因此它把“全转录组覆盖”和“成像的单细胞空间分辨率”接到了一起。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics measures many genes but at multicellular spot resolution; multiplexed imaging resolves individual cells but only for a selected protein panel.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02948-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DBiT-plus">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Janezjz/DBiT-plus" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DBiT-plus">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dbit-plus-652da08b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DBiT-plus">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="DecAlign">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DecAlign">DecAlign</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DecAlign: Hierarchical Cross-Modal Alignment for Decoupled Multimodal Representation Learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DecAlign 面向文本、语音和视觉的情感/情绪识别。它先把每种模态拆成两部分：模态特有表示 sm 与模态共同表示 cm；再对两种子空间使用不同的对齐原则——对特有表示，在原型层面用多边最优传输缓解分布差异；对共同表示，用统计矩和 MMD 逼近共享语义分布；最后把两条分支融合用于预测。 其核心判断是：“跨模态对齐”不是把所有特征强行压到同一空间。语调、面部微表情和词义有互补信息，过度对齐会抹掉差异；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multimodal representation learning must integrate heterogeneous signals (text, audio, visual) while preserving modality-specific characteristics.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2026</span>

        <h2 aria-label="DeChIC-seq">DeChIC-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Genome-wide profiling of histone modifications and transcription factor binding at single-cell resolution by DeChIC-seq</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">在单细胞层面定位组蛋白修饰和转录因子（TF）结合很困难。ChIP-seq、CUT&amp;RUN 与 CUT&amp;Tag 等技术依赖富集或片段化；TF 信号本身稀疏，低输入时尤为不利。DamID 类方法又受 GATC 位点分布限制，而直接读取甲基化的长读长方法通常需要较多 DNA。 DeChIC-seq 使用抗体识别目标组蛋白修饰或蛋白，再通过 protein A 把 pA-DddA 招募到该处。DddA 在邻近 DNA 上把 C 脱氨为 U；</p>

        <h2 aria-label="DECODE">DECODE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DECODE: deep learning-based common deconvolution framework for various omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DECODE 用带已知细胞比例的“伪组织”训练一个深度网络，把组织级转录组、蛋白组或代谢组向量映射成细胞类型/状态比例。它先用目标组织参与的对抗训练缩小 reference 与 target 的域差异，再用人工杂质细胞和注意力掩码学习相对去噪；推断时根据目标中是否可能含有 reference 未覆盖的细胞类型，选择绕过或经过 denoiser 的路径。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell-type deconvolution estimates cellular abundances from tissue-level (bulk) omics data using single-cell references. Existing methods are modality-specific: MuSiC (Nature Communications, 2019) and CIBERSORTx (Nature Biotechnology, 2019)…</p>
        </div>
