        <h2 aria-label="DeepDETAILS">DeepDETAILS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High-resolution reconstruction of cell-type-specific transcriptional regulatory processes from bulk sequencing samples</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">组织 bulk 测序把多个细胞类型的调控信号混在一起；而 PRO-cap、PRO-seq 与多种 ChIP-seq 往往没有可直接用于监督训练的单细胞真值。DeepDETAILS 用同类组织的 scATAC-seq/snATAC-seq 作为参考，把一个 bulk 信号分解为各细胞类型的碱基分辨率轨迹。训练时并不知道每个细胞类型的真实输出，只要求所有预测分支之和拟合 bulk 观测，因此是“准监督”而非普通监督学习。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Bulk regulatory assays average signals across cell types, while many assays remain difficult to collect at single-cell resolution. DeepDETAILS reconstructs base-pair-resolution, cell-type-specific transcription-initiation or histone-modific…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/haiyuan-yu-lab/DeepDETAILS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DeepDETAILS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/deepdetails-8ad1372a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DeepDETAILS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="DeepSpatial">DeepSpatial</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reconstructing True 3D Spatial Omics at Single-Cell Resolution</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeepSpatial 不是把相邻切片逐像素“补帧”，也不是把二维切片简单堆成 2.5D。它先用非平衡最优传输（UOT）在相邻切片之间建立软细胞对应，再训练一个 Gene Diffusion Transformer（GiT）学习细胞状态随深度连续变化的速度场，最后从上下两张真实切片出发求解 ODE，在任意中间深度生成带三维坐标、表达向量和细胞类型的虚拟细胞。 本工作区核对的是 bioRxiv 论文 10.1101/2026.04.28.</p>
        </div>

        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2026.04.28.721395" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DeepSpatial">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/yyh030806/DeepSpatial" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DeepSpatial">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/deepspatial-5882bdcf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DeepSpatial">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="DeLeakage">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="DeLeakage">DeLeakage</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Correcting spatial transcriptomics data affected by a prevalent transcript leakage problem across platforms, species, and tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组把转录本分配给分割出的细胞，但分到细胞 i 的信号并不一定都由 i 产生：相邻细胞的转录本可能扩散或在分割/分配时落入 i。这会让本应互斥的细胞类型 marker 同时出现，夸大不同细胞类型之间的相似性，并制造空间自相关假象。论文在 MERFISH、Xenium 与 Pixel-seq 中展示了这类现象。 已有的去卷积式去噪将一个细胞的观测表达看成多个细胞类型表达谱的混合（Fig. 3B）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeLeakage addresses transcript leakage in cell-resolved spatial transcriptomics: signal assigned to a cell may originate in nearby cells. The paper argues that this confounds marker specificity, cell-type separation, differential expression…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.06.13.732076" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DeLeakage">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Yip-Lab/DeLeakage" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DeLeakage">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/deleakage-b27e2305/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DeLeakage">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/perturbation_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="DepMap_NextGen_3D_Cancer_Models">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Perturbation Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DepMap_NextGen_3D_Cancer_Models">DepMap_<wbr>NextGen_<wbr>3D_<wbr>Cancer_<wbr>Models</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A dependency map enhanced with next-generation 3D cancer models</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统 DepMap 细胞系对部分癌症亚型覆盖不足，而且二维单层、含血清培养会改变基因依赖性。本文把患者来源的三维类器官和中枢神经系统肿瘤球体加入 DepMap，并用多组学与 CRISPR 筛选寻找更接近肿瘤状态的脆弱性。 研究包括 314 个 NextGen 模型、291 个 WGS、309 个 RNA-seq 和 147 个全基因组 CRISPR 筛选。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Traditional DepMap cell lines underrepresent cancer subtypes and can distort perturbation responses through monolayer, serum-containing culture. This study extends DepMap with patient-derived 3D organoids and CNS spheroids.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/broadinstitute/DepMap-NextGen-Public" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DepMap_NextGen_3D_Cancer_Models">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/depmap-nextgen-3d-cancer-models-fde49e83/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DepMap_NextGen_3D_Cancer_Models">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="DeSpotX">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DeSpotX">DeSpotX</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DeSpotX: Identifiability-Based Decontamination for Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeSpotX 的本质是：用 anchor genes 解决 ST 去污染中的不可辨识性，用跨簇空间邻居估计局部污染，用 diffusion prior 防止低表达真实信号被过度删除；公开代码很好地实现了核心模型和 CLI，但不包含完整论文 benchmark 与下游生物分析复现流程。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeSpotX addresses contamination in single-cell-resolution spatial transcriptomics (ST), where transcripts from one cell can be assigned to neighboring cells because of ambient diffusion, segmentation errors, or vertical overlap.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.12.724704" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DeSpotX">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Gentles-lab/DeSpotX" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DeSpotX">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/despotx-11ac2939/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DeSpotX">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Developing_Human_Brain_SingleCell_Proteome">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Developing_Human_Brain_SingleCell_Proteome">Developing_<wbr>Human_<wbr>Brain_<wbr>SingleCell_<wbr>Proteome</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell proteomic landscape of the developing human brain</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作把每个胎儿脑细胞单独送入一次液相色谱–质谱（LC–MS）分析，在 2,310 个通过质控的细胞中建立蛋白质图谱，再与同一批组织的单细胞 RNA 测序比较。它要回答的核心问题不是“哪些基因被转录”，而是“哪些蛋白真正出现、出现在哪类细胞、又如何随神经发生而变化”。 这不是一个单一机器学习模型，而是一条由实验技术、单细胞聚类、跨组学校正、伪时间和网络模块分析组成的完整流水线。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Wu et al. present a label-free single-cell mass-spectrometry workflow and prenatal human-brain proteome atlas. By dedicating one LC–MS run to each FACS-isolated cell, the study profiles 2,310 QC-passed cells from GW13, GW15 and GW19 tissue…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SingleCellProteomics/Brain" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Developing_Human_Brain_SingleCell_Proteome">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/developing-human-brain-singlecell-proteome-fb1e4ef9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Developing_Human_Brain_SingleCell_Proteome">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="Dexterous soft hand exoskeleton">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Dexterous soft hand exoskeleton">Dexterous soft hand exoskeleton</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A dexterous soft hand exoskeleton restores intentional grasping in individuals with severe hand impairment</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">严重手功能障碍患者往往不仅握力不足，而且无法主动完成抓握前的手型预塑和拇指定位。传统软手套多只提供手指屈伸，因此难以稳定抓取形状差异很大的日常物体。本文面向接近完全手瘫痪的 ALS 患者，并在脑卒中患者中验证其适用边界。 系统是可个体化的纺织气动手外骨骼，加入拇指对掌、拇指外展、腕背屈和手指协调驱动。它通过共同设计过程确定舒适、安全、独立性和可靠性等需求，再将这些需求变为机械结构与控制策略。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Machine Intelligence technology paper develops a high-dexterity textile pneumatic hand exoskeleton for severe to near-complete hand paralysis.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dexterous-soft-hand-exoskeleton-b105fb13/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Dexterous soft hand exoskeleton">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="DGAT">DGAT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DGAT: a dual-graph attention network for inferring spatial protein landscapes from transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DGAT 的关键思想是：用空间邻接图和分子相似图共同编码 mRNA/protein 的空间结构，在 paired spatial CITE-seq 上通过 alignment、reconstruction 和 cross-prediction 学到跨模态 latent space；部署时只用 mRNA encoder 加 protein decoder，就能给 transcriptomics-only ST 数据补出空间蛋白图谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics preserves tissue context and measures genome-wide mRNA, but it usually lacks direct protein measurements. DGAT targets this missing-modality problem by learning RNA-protein relationships from paired spatial CITE-seq…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-73114-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DGAT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/osmanbeyoglulab/DGAT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DGAT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dgat-282e4a00/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DGAT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="DiffuMeta">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DiffuMeta">DiffuMeta</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Algebraic language models for inverse design of metamaterials via diffusion transformers</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">三维壳状超材料的反向设计要求从目标力学响应反推出几何结构。这个映射既是强非线性的，又是一对多的：多个拓扑可能都接近同一条应力-应变曲线，而且屈曲和接触会改变响应。传统方法常在固定拓扑模板内优化，或使用高维体素/网格表示，难以同时覆盖丰富拓扑与生成多个候选解。 DiffuMeta 的关键想法是把壳结构写成代数语言。它不直接生成体素，而是生成一个隐式方程；该方程的零水平集就是周期性壳结构。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Inverse-designing three-dimensional shell metamaterials is difficult because mechanical response depends nonlinearly on geometry, buckling and contact, and many distinct structures can satisfy one target curve.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/li-zhengz/DiffusionMetamaterials" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DiffuMeta">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/diffumeta-cc774bfc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DiffuMeta">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Diffusion_Robust_Optimization_Over_Graphs">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Diffusion_Robust_Optimization_Over_Graphs">Diffusion_<wbr>Robust_<wbr>Optimization_<wbr>Over_<wbr>Graphs</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Diffusion-Robust Optimization over Graphs</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这不是生物信息学论文，而是一篇关于鲁棒优化、网络优化和计算复杂性的理论论文。 普通的鲁棒图优化通常把边权扰动写成一个盒子、范数球或有限情景集合。这样做容易计算，却没有表达“扰动只能沿网络相邻位置传播”这一事实。例如交通拥堵不会瞬间从一条街跳到完全不相邻的另一条街，而会通过路口逐段扩散。 本文的核心创新是：把不确定性建模为在有向图上流动的“扰动质量”，并要求它在节点处守恒。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This 2026 arXiv paper introduces a topology-aware uncertainty model for robust optimization on directed graphs. Instead of allowing edge-weight perturbations to move arbitrarily inside a norm ball or box, it treats uncertainty as conserved…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2605.30853" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Diffusion_Robust_Optimization_Over_Graphs">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/diffusion-robust-optimization-over-graphs-ca5f69bc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Diffusion_Robust_Optimization_Over_Graphs">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="DnD-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DnD-seq">DnD-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell mapping of regulatory DNA-protein interactions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">D&amp;D-seq（Docking and Deamination followed by sequencing）把一个胞嘧啶脱氨酶 DddA 通过抗体/纳米抗体定位到目标 TF 或 chromatin regulator 附近，让结合位点附近的 C 被编辑成 U，测序后表现为 C&gt;T 或互补链上的 G&gt;A 变异。这样，D&amp;D edit 的局部富集就可以作为 DNA-protein interaction 的分子足迹。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell methods can measure chromatin accessibility and gene expression, but direct mapping of transcription factor (TF) or chromatin-regulator binding remains difficult, especially for weak or transient protein-DNA interactions.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2026.05.014" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DnD-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/landau-lab/DnD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DnD-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dnd-seq-bff3bb81/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DnD-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="DriftingIslands">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DriftingIslands">DriftingIslands</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Limitations of cell embedding metrics assessed using drifting islands</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇工作故意训练了一个只追求细胞类型分类的模型 Islander：它能在主流单细胞嵌入指标上拿到最高分，却把连续的生物状态切成彼此孤立、位置随随机运行漂移的“细胞岛”。作者据此说明现有指标不完整，并提出 scGraph，用跨批次稳定的细胞类型几何关系来补充评价。 &gt; 重要定位：Islander 不是推荐用于生物发现的整合算法，而是一个用于“压力测试指标”的反例或 null algorithm。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell integration is commonly evaluated through two lenses: whether batches mix and whether cells sharing an annotation remain close. Those criteria are useful, but incomplete.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Genentech/Islander" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DriftingIslands">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/driftingislands-e779399d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DriftingIslands">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="DriftingModels">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DriftingModels">DriftingModels</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Generative Modeling via Drifting</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Drifting Models 不在推断时把噪声逐步搬运成图像，而是在训练过程中不断更新同一个生成器，使其输出分布沿一个“真实样本吸引、生成样本排斥”的向量场移动。训练结束后，生成仍然只是一次前向计算。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Diffusion and flow-matching models implement a distribution pushforward at inference time via many small steps, which makes sampling expensive (many network evaluations per sample).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.04770" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DriftingModels">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lambertae/drifting" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DriftingModels">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/driftingmodels-fe6047b0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DriftingModels">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="DS-snMultiome-Neocortex">DS-<wbr>snMultiome-<wbr>Neocortex</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A single-cell multiomic analysis identifies molecular and gene-regulatory mechanisms dysregulated in developing Down syndrome neocortex</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">唐氏综合征由 21 号染色体三体（Ts21）引起，但额外基因剂量如何在胎儿期改变神经发生、投射神经元命运和调控网络并不清楚。动物或成年脑数据难以重建人类妊娠中期的起始过程，因此作者对 GW13–23 的 26 名供体（13 Ctrl、13 Ts21）做 10x snMultiome，在同一细胞核中同时测 RNA 与 ATAC，保留 113,801 个高质量 nuclei。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Down syndrome (DS), caused by trisomy of chromosome 21 (Ts21), is the most common genetic cause of intellectual disability (1/700 live births).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aea1259" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DS-snMultiome-Neocortex">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ds-snmultiome-neocortex-df6f96c7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DS-snMultiome-Neocortex">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="DS_PFC_multiome">DS_<wbr>PFC_<wbr>multiome</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Molecular and cellular processes disrupted in the early postnatal Down syndrome prefrontal cortex</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">本研究询问：21 号染色体三体如何在 0–3 岁这一突触形成和髓鞘发育窗口改变人前额叶皮层。作者联合单核 RNA 与 ATAC，比较 Ctrl 和 Ts21，并用免疫染色验证关键胶质/免疫信号。它与妊娠中期 neocortex companion paper互补，关注出生后持续或新出现的异常。 QC 对 Ts21 使用适应性 UMI 阈值，避免额外 Chr21 剂量抬高 counts 后错误过滤。</p>

        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="Dual_memory_pathways">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Dual_memory_pathways">Dual_<wbr>memory_<wbr>pathways</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Algorithm-hardware co-design of neuromorphic networks with dual memory pathways</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">脉冲神经网络（SNN）适合事件驱动计算，但普通的 LIF 神经元只把输入保存在会衰减的膜电位中，因此很快忘记较早的证据。加入稠密循环连接可以延长记忆，却带来近似 O(N^2) 的参数和访存开销；可学习的轴突延迟则需要深的时间缓冲区以及每条连接的时序元数据。 这篇论文提出的问题是：能否用一个足够小、稳定、可在芯片上保存的状态来提供长时上下文，同时保留脉冲计算的稀疏性？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spiking neural networks are naturally sparse and event driven, but standard leaky integrate-and-fire neurons forget old evidence as their membrane state decays.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/sunpengfei1122/Dual_memory_pathways" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Dual_memory_pathways">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dual-memory-pathways-3e33b560/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Dual_memory_pathways">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="DyMo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DyMo">DyMo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inference-Time Dynamic Modality Selection for Incomplete Multimodal Classification</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DyMo 处理的是不完整多模态分类中的一个两难：缺失模态经过生成模型恢复后，全部丢弃会浪费有用信息，全部纳入又可能把恢复误差带进分类器。它不再把“是否相信恢复结果”设成全局固定规则，而是在每个样本的推理过程中，逐个估计候选恢复模态能否提高当前表示的任务相关质量，只保留正收益模态。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multimodal deep learning requires all modalities at inference, but real-world data frequently has missing modalities (sensor failures, different clinical protocols, transmission errors).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2601.22853" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DyMo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/siyi-wind/DyMo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DyMo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dymo-3049d281/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DyMo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Dynamic_Programming_Epistemic_Uncertainty_MDP">

        <h2 aria-label="DynamicAtlas">DynamicAtlas</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DynamicAtlas: a morphodynamic atlas for Drosophila development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统发育图谱主要由不同时间点的固定样本组成，能描述细胞命运和基因表达，却难以直接回答组织“怎样运动并形成形状”。DynamicAtlas 把活体电影与固定样本统一到同一空间坐标和同一“形态时间”上，从而让基因表达、组织流动和器官形变可以跨胚胎比较。 关键点是：实验室时钟不是发育时钟。两个胚胎即使采集时间相同，也可能处于不同形态阶段；因此方法用可观察的形态变化来定义时间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DynamicAtlas is a morphodynamic atlas that places live movies and fixed samples from 500 Drosophila embryos, including wild type and 18 mutants, into shared spatial coordinates and a common morphological timeline.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02897-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DynamicAtlas">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/npmitchell/dynamicAtlas" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DynamicAtlas">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dynamicatlas-0875f06b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DynamicAtlas">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

        <h2 aria-label="DynNet">DynNet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring stochastic dynamics by biophysical Neural ODE using single-cell transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">时间序列 scRNA-seq 在每个时点测到的是不同细胞，不能直接观察同一细胞的连续轨迹。DynNet 选择一小组驱动基因，把每个细胞表示为基因表达状态，并拟合一个随机微分方程（SDE），使模拟群体在终点稳定状态、比例和基因边缘分布上接近观测数据。 因此，DynNet 输出的是在所选基因、GRN 先验和损失假设下学到的随机动力系统。模拟轨迹、吸引子、势景和首次通过时间是模型推断，不是谱系追踪的直接观测；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DynNet targets the problem of inferring stochastic cell-fate dynamics from time-course scRNA-seq snapshots. Because scRNA-seq destroys cells, the data do not contain direct single-cell trajectories.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ERAST 并不是用一个更大的模型直接取代 BLAST。它把同源序列搜索拆成三个可分别优化的环节：先用已有生物学标签缩小或调整候选范围，再用序列语言模型向量做快速召回，最后用序列对分类器 EHSM 判断候选与查询属于同一家族、超家族、折叠，还是不同折叠。论文的核心工程主张是：昂贵的十亿级数据库向量可以保持不动，而较小的重排器可以随新数据更新。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="eSIG-Net">eSIG-<wbr>Net</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">eSIG-Net: an interaction language model that decodes the protein code of single mutations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">eSIG-Net 的方法价值在于把“突变是否改变某个具体 PPI”建模为一个显式的 WT-vs-mutant interaction difference learning 问题。它用 573 维序列特征表示 PPI，用 ESM-2 突变位点差异表示 mutation effect，再用 constrained discrepancy 和 discriminator 学习 interaction perturbation。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">eSIG-Net targets a specific variant-effect problem: given a wild-type protein, a single-mutant version of that protein, and an interaction partner, predict whether the mutation changes the protein-protein interaction (PPI) state.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Explaining_Preventing_Alignment_Collapse_Iterative_RLHF">Explaining_<wbr>Preventing_<wbr>Alignment_<wbr>Collapse_<wbr>Iterative_<wbr>RLHF</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Explaining and Preventing Alignment Collapse in Iterative RLHF</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇机器学习理论与 LLM 对齐方法论文，不是生物信息学论文。它研究的关键不是一次性的 reward hacking，而是迭代 RLHF 中的反馈环：策略产生新回答，这些回答又成为奖励模型（RM）的训练数据。因此策略不仅在“获得当前分数”，还会间接改变“未来怎么打分”。 常规 REINFORCE/PPO 更新把当前 RM 当成固定函数，只沿着当前代理奖励上升。作者证明，这样遗漏了策略对未来 RM 参数的影响；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This 2026 machine-learning theory/method paper studies a feedback loop specific to iterative RLHF: the policy generates the data used to retrain its reward model (RM), so policy actions affect both current reward and future RM parameters.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2605.04266" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Explaining_Preventing_Alignment_Collapse_Iterative_RLHF">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GauthierE/fpo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Explaining_Preventing_Alignment_Collapse_Iterative_RLHF">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/explaining-preventing-alignment-collapse-iterative-rlhf-4f5dd382/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Explaining_Preventing_Alignment_Collapse_Iterative_RLHF">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="transactions-on-machine-learning-research" data-journal-label="Transactions on Machine Learning Research" data-method="Explicit_Second_Order_Min_Max_Optimization">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Explicit_Second_Order_Min_Max_Optimization">Explicit_<wbr>Second_<wbr>Order_<wbr>Min_<wbr>Max_<wbr>Optimization</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Explicit Second-Order Min-Max Optimization: Practical Algorithms and Complexity Analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究无约束的凸–凹鞍点问题： 它假设全局鞍点存在，并且 f 的 Hessian 以常数 \rho Lipschitz 连续。这个问题属于连续优化、变分不等式和机器学习算法理论，并不是生物信息学论文。典型应用包括对抗学习、博弈、多智能体系统和 AUC 优化。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The target is a global saddle point of \min{\mathbf{x}}\max{\mathbf{y}}f(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}) when a saddle exists and the Hessian is \rho-Lipschitz. General first-order extragradient-type methods require O(\epsilon^{-1}) iterations.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Transactions on Machine Learning Research · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2210.12860" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Explicit_Second_Order_Min_Max_Optimization">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/tyDLin/NewtonMinMax" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Explicit_Second_Order_Min_Max_Optimization">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/explicit-second-order-min-max-optimization-23f96cab/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Explicit_Second_Order_Min_Max_Optimization">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="FBNO">

        <h2 aria-label="FBNO">FBNO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deep neural operator for free boundary problems</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">自由边界问题（FBP）里，未知量不只是物理场 u，还包括 u 所在的区域 \Omegat 与边界 \Gamma。例如 Stefan 融化问题中，温度决定冰水界面的移动，而温度又只定义在该移动界面限定的区域内。普通神经算子通常假定输出函数定义在预先给定的固定紧集上；FBP 的输出域事先未知，因此不能直接套用这一假设。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Free-boundary problems jointly determine a physical field and the domain on which it is defined. This violates the fixed-output-domain assumption behind standard neural-operator approximation theory .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ZongjiaLong/FBNO-Deep-neural-Operator-for-Free-Boundary-Problems" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FBNO">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/fbno-9df4415b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FBNO">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="FeatureMAP">FeatureMAP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Feature-preserving manifold approximation and projection to analyze single-cell data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FeatureMAP 不只问“哪些细胞彼此接近”，还在每个细胞邻域估计一个局部切空间，记录基因沿局部流形方向如何变化。它把这些信息拆成两个互补的二维图：GEX 保留细胞密度和聚类结构，GVA 保留基因变化模式和轨迹结构；随后用密度、曲率和介数中心性区分稳定核心态与过渡态，并用差异基因变化分析寻找可能驱动状态转换的基因。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="FlashSinkhorn">FlashSinkhorn</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">FlashSinkhorn: IO-Aware Entropic Optimal Transport on GPU</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">给定带权点云 X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d},a\in\Delta^n 与 Y\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},b\in\Delta^m，熵正则最优传输（EOT）寻找耦合 P，使运输代价和熵正则的 KL 项之和最小。平方欧氏代价为 C{ij}=\lVert xi-yj\rVert2^2。传统 GPU 实现往往显式保存 n\times m 的代价、分数或耦合矩阵；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Entropic optimal transport (EOT) is useful for point-cloud matching, OT dataset distance (OTDD), and OT-based optimization, but dense GPU implementations commonly create n\times m cost, score, or coupling intermediates.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.03067" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for FlashSinkhorn">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ot-triton-lab/flash-sinkhorn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FlashSinkhorn">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/flashsinkhorn-319130c8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FlashSinkhorn">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">Atlas-level single-cell integration and clustering-free differential expression analysis with GEDI 2.0</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GEDI 2.0 不是一个新统计模型，而是原始 GEDI 模型的高性能重实现。原模型把多样本单细胞表达分解为共享生物结构和样本特异偏移，从而同时得到整合表示、批次校正表达和无需先聚类的连续差异表达。2.0 版保持这套数学目标，主要重写了内存布局、稀疏矩阵处理、线性代数和样本级并行，使其能处理百万细胞。 本工作区核对 Bioinformatics 2026 论文 10.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GEDI 2.0 makes the original GEDI unified single-cell model practical at atlas scale. GEDI decomposes expression into shared biological axes and sample-specific distortions, enabling integration, batch-corrected expression, continuous cluste…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btag334" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GEDI 2.0">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/csglab/gedi2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GEDI 2.0">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gedi-2-0-4e7f9429/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GEDI 2.0">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="acm-conference-on-economics-and-computation-ec" data-journal-label="ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC)" data-method="General_Framework_Estimating_Preferences_Response_Time">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="General_Framework_Estimating_Preferences_Response_Time">General_<wbr>Framework_<wbr>Estimating_<wbr>Preferences_<wbr>Response_<wbr>Time</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A General Framework for Estimating Preferences Using Response Time Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇关于经济决策、统计学习和机器学习理论的论文，不是生物信息学论文。 传统经济学常把“偏好”直接等同于观察到的选择：面对 \bm{x} 和 \bm{y}，选择哪一个就表示偏好哪一个。但同一个选择可能来自不同的证据强度和犹豫程度。论文利用每次选择花费的时间，希望从 恢复共同的偏好参数 \bm w^。其中 zi\in\{-1,1\} 表示选择，ti\geq0 表示反应时间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The paper asks how to estimate economic preference parameters from paired alternatives, binary choices, and response times without committing to a full distribution for the joint choice-time process.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ACM Conference on Economics and Computation (EC) · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2507.20403" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for General_Framework_Estimating_Preferences_Response_Time">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/general-framework-estimating-preferences-response-time-687bc6c3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：General_Framework_Estimating_Preferences_Response_Time">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="manuscript" data-journal-label="Manuscript" data-method="GLEAM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GLEAM">GLEAM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GLEAM links single-cell 3D genome and cellular electrophysiology with calibrated uncertainty</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GLEAM 把单细胞缺失模态预测改写成异质图上的链接预测：细胞和基因、峰、染色质互作或电生理指标都是节点，已测量值是带权的 cell–feature 边；模型先借助跨模态相似细胞传播信息，再预测未观测 cell–feature 边是否存在以及边权是多少。它还用分裂保形预测给出零/非零预测集合和非零数值区间，使预测能进入带不确定性的下游分析。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞多组学（scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq、sn-m3C-seq、Patch-seq）可分析基因表达、染色质可及性、3D基因组构象、电生理和形态学，但多数实验仅测量一种模态。例如，Patch-seq需活细胞记录电位，sn-m3C-seq需核裂解，两者无法联合检测。现有方法（BABEL、CMOT、JAMIE、scButterfly、MIDAS、MultiVI、StabMap）存在三个关键缺陷：(1) 要求部分配对或辅助标签；</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Manuscript · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/keleslab/GLEAM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GLEAM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gleam-006a47f7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GLEAM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="GlioblastomaOV_TCellTrial">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Data Sources &amp; Technologies</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GlioblastomaOV_TCellTrial">GlioblastomaOV_<wbr>TCellTrial</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Persistent T cell activation and cytotoxicity against glioblastoma following single oncolytic virus treatment in a clinical trial</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Meylan 等人在 Cell（2026）中研究 CAN-3110（rQNestin34.5v.2）一期临床试验的复发性胶质母细胞瘤样本。论文并不是提出一个新的机器学习模型，而是把 CODEX 空间蛋白组、Xenium 空间转录组、bulk TCRβ 测序和病理学串成一条证据链：一次瘤内注射之后，原先已经存在于肿瘤中的 T 细胞克隆被扩增；其中一部分进入活肿瘤区，保持早期激活、组织驻留和细胞毒程序；病毒残留则主要局限于坏死区。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Glioblastoma (GBM) is refractory to immunotherapy primarily because it is a &quot;cold tumor&quot;: T cells infiltrate sparsely, localizing to perivascular spaces rather than tumor parenchyma.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2025.12.055" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GlioblastomaOV_TCellTrial">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/maximemeylan/GBM_CAN3110" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GlioblastomaOV_TCellTrial">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/glioblastomaov-tcelltrial-1fa45d96/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GlioblastomaOV_TCellTrial">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="GlobalCellStateGeneProgram">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GlobalCellStateGeneProgram">GlobalCellStateGeneProgram</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Global cell-state and gene-program representations reveal conserved and context-specific perturbation responses of cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文的核心问题是：如何把大量来源不同、物种不同、测序平台不同的单细胞转录组数据放到同一个“细胞状态空间”里，并进一步理解基因扰动如何驱动细胞状态变化。传统整合模型或单细胞大模型可以产生嵌入，但作者认为它们对扰动响应预测仍不够好，尤其难以区分“基因功能本身的保守效应”和“不同起始细胞状态下的上下文特异效应”。 因此，论文提出的框架分两层：第一层学习全局细胞状态流形；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The paper studies how to represent cell states and genetic perturbation responses in a shared coordinate system across heterogeneous single-cell datasets.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.16.725005" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GlobalCellStateGeneProgram">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xingjiepan/SCMG" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GlobalCellStateGeneProgram">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/globalcellstategeneprogram-b16af0b4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GlobalCellStateGeneProgram">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="GRAVITY">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GRAVITY">GRAVITY</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GRAVITY: Dynamic gene regulatory network-enhanced RNA velocity modeling for trajectory inference and biological discovery</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GRAVITY 是一个把 RNA velocity、基因动力学参数和动态基因调控网络放在同一个神经模型里学习的方法。它输入 unspliced/spliced RNA、二维细胞嵌入和先验 TF-target 网络，输出细胞速度、基因速度、\alpha,\beta,\gamma 动力学参数，以及基于 attention 的调控因子和调控模块解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GRAVITY addresses a structural weakness in RNA velocity. Classical and many neural velocity methods infer transcription, splicing, and degradation kinetics for each gene and then aggregate gene velocities into a cell-level direction.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.01.31.702983" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GRAVITY">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/CSUBioGroup/GRAVITY" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GRAVITY">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gravity-3a7a55fd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GRAVITY">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="GroupSparseAE">

        <h2 aria-label="GroupSparseAE">GroupSparseAE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Decomposing multimodal embedding spaces with group-sparse autoencoders</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CLIP、CLAP 已经把图像—文本或音频—文本对齐到同一稠密空间，但普通 TopK 稀疏自编码器常把两个模态拆成两套互不重叠的特征。论文的 GSAE 在配对样本的稀疏码上加入组稀疏约束，MGSAE 再让两个模态共享同一个随机候选 mask，迫使对应样本更多地激活同一批概念神经元。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful tool for decomposing neural network embeddings into interpretable concept directions, building on the Linear Representation Hypothesis.</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="HCMI_NextGen_Patient_Derived_Cancer_Models">

        <h2 aria-label="HCMI_NextGen_Patient_Derived_Cancer_Models">HCMI_<wbr>NextGen_<wbr>Patient_<wbr>Derived_<wbr>Cancer_<wbr>Models</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A compendium of next-generation patient-derived models for diverse cancers</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统癌细胞系资源促进了基因依赖性研究，但常缺少与原始肿瘤的系统配对验证、罕见癌种覆盖和临床治疗背景。本文建立 Human Cancer Models Initiative (HCMI)：665 个患者来源模型，覆盖 25 类恶性肿瘤，并将模型、亲本肿瘤、部分正常样本、临床信息和多组学表征连接起来。 模型包括 3D 类器官、3D 球体及 2D 贴壁培养；论文也记录治疗史、随访和人群信息。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature 2026 paper presents the Human Cancer Models Initiative (HCMI), a patient-derived cancer-model atlas created to address the limited diversity, uncertain fidelity and sparse clinical annotation of conventional cell-line collection…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="HDMA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Data Sources &amp; Technologies</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HDMA">HDMA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multiomics and deep learning dissect regulatory syntax in human development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HDMA（Human Development Multiomic Atlas）先用 SHARE-seq 在同一个细胞核中同时测量 RNA 与开放染色质，再为每一种细胞类型训练一个“DNA 序列 → ATAC 可及性”的 ChromBPNet 模型。研究者随后把模型当作可计算的实验系统：寻找真正影响预测的序列基序，把两个基序按不同距离和方向插回背景序列，并比较联合效应与独立效应，从而区分需要精确间距的“硬语法”和允许较宽松间距的“软语法”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">During human development, transcription factors (TFs) bind regulatory DNA to establish cell identity, but the rules governing how combinations of TF binding sites cooperate — their &quot;regulatory syntax&quot; — remained poorly defined.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>

        <h2 aria-label="HeartFailureMultiomics">HeartFailureMultiomics</h2>

        <h2 aria-label="HelixFold-S1">HelixFold-<wbr>S1</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reshaping biomolecular structure prediction through strategic conformational exploration with HelixFold-S1</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">复合物结构预测常通过生成大量候选构象来提高命中正确构象的机会，但盲目增加采样会带来高成本和大量冗余。HelixFold-S1 的摘要提出：先预测链间接触概率，再把计算资源投入到更可能、且较少重复的接触区域，从而指导复合物构象探索。 它不是把所有随机构象一视同仁地生成和筛选，而是把链间 token 对的概率图当作探索蓝图。每轮从候选界面中选择一个界面约束，运行结构模型；之后用已经采过的界面和预测置信度更新下一轮的选择。</p>

        </div>
        <footer>

        <h2 aria-label="HESpotEx">HESpotEx</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">HESpotEx: a dual-stream deep learning framework for spot-level gene expression prediction from histological images</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HESpotEx 是一个两阶段监督学习框架：第一阶段只看真实空间转录组（ST）表达与 spot 坐标，用 GATE/STAGATE 学习“分子—空间”嵌入；第二阶段把每个 spot 对应的 H&amp;E patch 编码成图像嵌入，要求它与第一阶段的 ST 嵌入相关，同时通过空间图解码器预测 spot 级基因表达。 它的输出是根据形态估计的表达，不是新的 RNA 测量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HESpotEx tackles spot-level gene expression prediction from routine H&amp;E histology. The biological motivation is practical: spatial transcriptomics reveals tissue molecular organization but is costly, while H&amp;E WSIs are abundant and clinical…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Computational Science · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-medicine" data-journal-label="Nature Medicine" data-method="HEX">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HEX">HEX</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">AI-enabled virtual spatial proteomics from histopathology for interpretable biomarker discovery in lung cancer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CODEX 等空间蛋白组技术可以在组织中同时测量很多蛋白，但成本高、流程复杂、需要专用仪器，难以直接进入常规临床流程。HEX 的目标是只用临床常规 H&amp;E 切片，预测空间化的蛋白表达图，而不是只预测一个样本的平均分子值。 论文用同一组织切片的 H&amp;E 与 40 重 CODEX 图像配准，切成约 50 微米的 tile。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CODEX-scale spatial proteomics is expensive, instrument-intensive and difficult to scale clinically. Earlier H&amp;E-to-molecular methods generally predicted bulk or a small number of markers, leaving intratumor spatial heterogeneity underused .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Medicine · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lilab-stanford/HEX" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for HEX">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/hex-ecf6f295/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：HEX">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="HFGPI">HFGPI</h2>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HFGPI 用蛋白 token 作为中间枢纽：先从基因 token 读取信息，再以蛋白语义选择并连接病理 patch，最后预测生存；这种层级设计有预测与可视化优势，但没有公开代码时，所有“调控”和“形态机制”都必须保留为模型关联而非因果结论。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cancer prognosis requires integrating heterogeneous data types that capture different aspects of tumor biology. Whole slide images (WSIs) capture tissue morphology and microenvironment but lack molecular resolution.</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/perturbation_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="High_MOI_screens">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Perturbation Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="High_MOI_screens">High_<wbr>MOI_<wbr>screens</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multiplexed perturbation enables scalable pooled screens</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Nature Methods 论文研究的是：在 pooled CRISPRi 筛选中，不再坚持“每个细胞只进一个 sgRNA”的低 MOI 设计，而是用中等偏高 MOI 让一个细胞携带多个 sgRNA，从而用更少细胞完成筛选。论文声称 MOI 2.5–10 在许多条件下可以保持筛选性能，并能显著减少细胞数需求；其中 MOI 2.5–5 是更稳妥的压缩区间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Pooled CRISPR screens need high guide representation, often requiring very large cell numbers. This is expensive and sometimes infeasible for primary cells, FACS sorting, drug treatment, or other resource-limited screens.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03095-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for High_MOI_screens">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mcmanuslab/High_MOI_screens" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for High_MOI_screens">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/high-moi-screens-95da830e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：High_MOI_screens">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="Hippocampal Neurogenesis Multiome">Hippocampal Neurogenesis Multiome</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Human hippocampal neurogenesis in adulthood, ageing and Alzheimer&#x27;s disease</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">成人海马是否持续产生新神经元长期存在争议。困难不只是“能否检测到某个标记”，而是成人脑中的神经干细胞（NSC）、神经母细胞和未成熟颗粒神经元数量极少，表达谱又分别接近星形胶质细胞、少突胶质细胞或成熟颗粒神经元。死后组织质量、取材是否真正包含齿状回、不同物种标记能否外推以及计算注释方式，都可能改变结论。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Adult hippocampal neurogenesis — the generation of new neurons from neural stem cells (NSCs) in the dentate gyrus — has been one of the most contentious topics in neuroscience.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="How_Sampling_Shapes_LLM_Alignment">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="How_Sampling_Shapes_LLM_Alignment">How_<wbr>Sampling_<wbr>Shapes_<wbr>LLM_<wbr>Alignment</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">How Sampling Shapes LLM Alignment: From One-Shot Optima to Iterative Dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇理论机器学习与 LLM 对齐论文，不是生物信息学文章。它关心一个常被当成工程细节的问题：做偏好学习时，我们究竟让人比较哪些候选回答？ 通常的直觉是，只要数据足够多，采样策略至多影响方差和训练速度，不该改变最终答案。本文指出：这个直觉只有在非常理想化的 Bradley--Terry（BT）偏好模型下才可能成立。真实偏好如果包含上下文依赖、循环偏好或无法用单一标量奖励表达的矛盾，采样分布本身会参与定义“最优策略”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Preference-optimization methods learn from sampled response pairs and usually regularize toward a reference policy. Prior analyses often treat the pair sampler and reference as fixed external choices.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.12180" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for How_Sampling_Shapes_LLM_Alignment">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/how-sampling-shapes-llm-alignment-8043bb47/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：How_Sampling_Shapes_LLM_Alignment">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="hPOP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="hPOP">hPOP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A comparison of deep multiomics profiles across ethnicity, geography, and age</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">hPOP 不是先提出一个新的预测模型，再用数据证明模型有效；它先在 322 名参与者、378 次采样中同时测量血液、尿液和粪便的多种分子层，然后用一组统计分析回答三个逐层深入的问题：哪些分子差异与年龄、性别、BMI 或族群相关；同一祖源的人生活在不同地区时，哪些差异会随环境改变；微生物、代谢物、宿主基因表达和生物年龄之间是否存在值得后续实验验证的中介链。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Human populations differ markedly in disease prevalence (cardiovascular disease, Alzheimer&#x27;s, type 2 diabetes), drug response, and lifespan, yet the molecular basis of these differences is poorly understood.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2026.04.032" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for hPOP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/nbararpo/hPOP_Multiomics-Across-Ethnicity-Geography-and-Age" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for hPOP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/hpop-ad8bcf12/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：hPOP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Human-liver-atlas">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Human-liver-atlas">Human-<wbr>liver-<wbr>atlas</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A spatial atlas of the healthy human liver from live donors</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文的关键贡献不只是“多测了几张肝脏切片”，而是先解决健康参照是否真的健康，再建立一条可计算的门管区—中央静脉空间坐标轴。作者从活体健康肝供者获得组织，用 Visium 测量每个空间点的转录本，再依据一组门管区和中央区标志基因把每个点放到 8 个肝小叶区带中；随后用 MERFISH、Visium HD、PhenoCycler 和单核 RNA 测序验证或扩展这个坐标系，并把它用于跨物种比较、非实质细胞分区和早期脂肪变性分析。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The liver is organized into hexagonal lobules with a porto-central axis that drives liver zonation — the spatial segregation of metabolic functions across the lobule radius.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10377-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Human-liver-atlas">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/OranYak/Human-liver" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Human-liver-atlas">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/human-liver-atlas-987490e1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Human-liver-atlas">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">Epigenetic and 3D genome reprogramming during the aging of the human hippocampus</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">以往研究知道衰老脑组织会出现炎症增强、突触功能下降，但很难回答：这些表达变化由哪些细胞产生，又是染色质开放、DNA 甲基化、增强子连接还是三维基因组折叠改变造成的？本文对 40 名 20–100 岁、性别与年龄段平衡的神经正常供体进行单细胞核多组学分析，把四层调控信息放进同一套细胞类型框架。 作者先按细胞类型汇总每个供体的表达、开放性和甲基化特征，再计算特征与年龄的 Pearson 相关，并用 FDR &lt; 0.1 筛选。</p>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">A 3D genome atlas of human tonsil and the role of loop extrusion in B cell somatic hypermutation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">体细胞高频突变（somatic hypermutation, SHM）通过 AID 在免疫球蛋白基因中引入点突变，是抗体亲和力成熟的基础。但 AID 也可能误伤其他基因，造成致癌突变和染色体易位。已有研究知道 SHM 与转录、增强子、拓扑关联结构域（TAD）和染色质接触有关，却仍有两个关键缺口： 在真实的人类生发中心组织中，从核内径向位置、染色体区室、TAD 到局部环等多个尺度，三维基因组结构如何共同影响 SHM 易感性？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Somatic hypermutation (SHM) enables antibody affinity maturation but can also mutate non-immunoglobulin loci and contribute to B-cell lymphoma.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FFPE 是临床病理最常见的保存形式，但固定会遮蔽表位，许多转录因子、免疫调节因子和衰老相关蛋白本来又很少。CODEX、CyCIF、IMC 等方法可以在同一切片上检测几十个蛋白，却主要依靠直接偶联抗体，灵敏度对低丰度抗原往往不够。TSA 利用 HRP 催化荧光酪胺在抗原附近沉积，可以放大信号，但沉积后的强荧光不容易被常规循环成像的温和漂白步骤去除，因此传统 TSA 面板通常难以继续扩展。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">iGOF-Perturb-seq 的核心是：用带条形码的 AAV 在活体星形胶质细胞中逐一过表达 TF，以单核转录组读出每次扰动，再把单 TF 的 DEG 汇聚为共同基因程序和疾病方向，最后用功能实验与 5XFAD 模型检验最重要的预测。 它最大的贡献既是 955 个 TF 的功能图谱，也是把“高通量状态预测”推进到“动物体内因果验证”的完整链条。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="Improved_Bayes_Risk_Reduced_Social_Welfare">

        <h2 aria-label="Improved_Bayes_Risk_Reduced_Social_Welfare">Improved_<wbr>Bayes_<wbr>Risk_<wbr>Reduced_<wbr>Social_<wbr>Welfare</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Improved Bayes Risk Can Yield Reduced Social Welfare Under Competition</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文研究的不是生物信息学，而是算法经济学与博弈论机器学习。它指出：当多个预测服务商为了争夺用户而调整模型时，更好的数据表示虽然能降低单个模型的 Bayes 风险，却可能让所有服务商的预测变得更相似，破坏原有的“分工覆盖”，从而提高用户在均衡中的总体预测损失。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Better predictive representations usually lower the risk of a model considered in isolation. This paper asks whether that improvement necessarily benefits users when several model providers strategically compete for market share.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2306.14670" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Improved_Bayes_Risk_Reduced_Social_Welfare">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mjagadeesan/competition-nonmonotonicity" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Improved_Bayes_Risk_Reduced_Social_Welfare">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/improved-bayes-risk-reduced-social-welfare-cd8749bd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Improved_Bayes_Risk_Reduced_Social_Welfare">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="INSPIRE">INSPIRE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable, flexible and spatially aware integration of multiple spatial transcriptomics datasets from diverse sources</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">INSPIRE 同时解决空间转录组多切片的三个问题：用图神经网络保留每张切片的空间邻域，用带截断的对抗学习去除切片或平台差异，再用共享的非负空间因子和基因载荷解释组织结构。输出既有适合聚类和轨迹分析的共享表示 Z，也有每个细胞的空间因子比例 \beta 与可解释基因程序 \mu。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies profile gene expression with spatial context, enabling mapping of tissue architecture, cell-type organization, and biological processes.</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="ISO">

        <h2 aria-label="ISO">ISO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ISO: An RLVR-Native Optimization Stack</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）已经广泛用于数学推理和代码能力训练，但优化层基本照搬预训练：直接对稠密权重 W 使用 AdamW、Muon 等优化器。ISO 问了一个更基础的问题： &gt; RLVR 学到新能力时，权重矩阵中的哪些部分必须改变，哪些部分可以直接继承基础模型？ 对每个二维权重矩阵做薄 SVD： \Sigma 表示每个奇异模态的尺度，U 和 V 分别表示输出侧和输入侧方向。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RLVR has advanced rapidly in objectives, data, and systems, but still usually inherits weight-space parameterizations and optimizers from pre-training.</p>
        </div>

          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>

        </footer>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ITEC 解决的是胚胎 3D+t 活体成像中的长期全胚胎细胞谱系重建问题。输入是一系列按时间排列的三维核标记显微图像，输出是细胞实例、跨帧连接、分裂关系和可用于命运图谱分析的 lineage graph。核心思想是把 tracking 结果反过来作为 segmentation 的纠错证据：如果图中出现跳帧连接、断裂 track 或一对多/多对一模式，就回到局部图像中补检漏掉的细胞或修正过分割/欠分割。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="Janus-Pro-CXR">Janus-<wbr>Pro-<wbr>CXR</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">From Bench to Bedside: A DeepSeek-Powered AI System for Automated Chest Radiograph Interpretation in Clinical Practice</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Janus-Pro-CXR 的输入是一张胸部 X 光片（临床试验阶段还把关键病史写入提示词），输出是包含 FINDINGS 与 IMPRESSION 的放射学报告。它不是只判断“有无肺炎”的分类器，而要同时完成病灶描述、解剖定位、诊断归纳和专业文本组织。 论文的重点也不只是提出一个模型：它把模型开发、回顾性评价和前瞻性人机协作串成一条证据链。Figure 1 展示了三层问题：先在 MIMIC-CXR 与中国 27 家医院数据上微调；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Radiologist shortages severely limit access to chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation globally — 1.9 per million in low-income countries vs. 97.9 in high-income countries.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/perturbation_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="KOLF2_1J_Perturbation_Cell_Atlas">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Perturbation Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="KOLF2_1J_Perturbation_Cell_Atlas">KOLF2_<wbr>1J_<wbr>Perturbation_<wbr>Cell_<wbr>Atlas</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A genome-scale CRISPRi perturbation atlas of human induced pluripotent stem cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）能分化成多种细胞类型，但我们仍不知道大多数基因在“维持多能性”这件事中承担什么功能。过去的大规模 Perturb-seq 多集中在癌细胞系；hiPSC 中既缺少覆盖全表达基因组、又有足够单细胞深度的功能图谱。 作者在参考细胞系 KOLF2.1J 中，用 CRISPRi 扰动 11,692 个表达基因，获得超过 250 万个质控后的单细胞，并同步测量细胞适应度。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Functional genomics in human induced pluripotent stem cells has lagged behind cancer-cell screens, leaving most gene functions and pluripotency-specific interactions unmapped.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/y-doctor/KOLF2.1J_Perturbation_Cell_Atlas" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for KOLF2_1J_Perturbation_Cell_Atlas">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/kolf2-1j-perturbation-cell-atlas-64d5f132/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：KOLF2_1J_Perturbation_Cell_Atlas">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="LAMBADA">LAMBADA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">The spatiotemporal dynamics of postnatal vascularization in the mouse brain</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">作者建立了 P3–P21 的发育脑三维图谱 LAMBADA，把透明脑光片成像、血管图、MRI、空间转录组和三维原位杂交统一到年龄匹配的坐标系中。结果显示，小鼠出生后脑血管不是匀速变密，而经历三个阶段：P3–P7 随脑体积等比例扩张，P7–P21 出现区域特异的快速增密与重塑，P21 后进入稳定和精修；驱动环境也从早期经典缺氧/血管生成信号转向神经元成熟与活动相关程序。 本地代码是通用 ClearMap 3.1 快照。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Authors: de Launoit E, Skriabine S, Doumazane E, Bizou M, ..., Dubrac A, Renier N Journal: Cell (2026) | DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2026.03.013 Code: ClearMap 3.1 — https://github.com/ClearAnatomics/ClearMap Atlas: LAMBADA — https://lambada.</p>

        <h2 aria-label="LazySlide">LazySlide</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">LazySlide: accessible and interoperable whole-slide image analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">LazySlide 的核心贡献是一套全切片图像（whole-slide image, WSI）分析软件框架。它把组织检测、切块、质量控制、特征提取、空间分析、细胞分割、图文检索和多组学关联统一到兼容 scverse 的数据与接口体系中。论文的创新重点因此不是提出一种新的神经网络损失函数，而是解决一个工程问题：不同厂商的超大病理图像、不同预训练模型和不同下游分析，怎样在同一份可追踪的数据对象上协同工作。 这一区分很重要。</p>

        </div>
