      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nucleic-acids-research" data-journal-label="Nucleic Acids Research" data-method="SCALE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCALE">SCALE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SCALE: unsupervised multiscale domain identification in spatial omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">常规空间聚类通常输出一张分区图，但真实组织常同时具有粗粒度和细粒度结构。例如脑组织在高层可以分为皮层、海马和丘脑，在低层又可继续分成皮层层次和海马亚区。SCALE（Spatial Clustering At multiple LEvels）要解决的不是“选唯一最佳聚类”，而是从许多空间图尺度与聚类分辨率中，找出一组稳定且近似嵌套的分区。 方法依赖三项假设：同一功能域附近的表达环境相似；有意义的域在某个观察尺度上具有空间连续性；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCALE identifies several nested spatial-domain resolutions rather than returning one manually tuned clustering. It builds spatial graphs over a grid of distance thresholds (or kNN sizes), trains a GATv2 encoder with adjacency- and expressio…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nucleic Acids Research · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaf1456" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SCALE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/imsb-uke/scale" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SCALE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scale-1de4796e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SCALE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="scAMVIB">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scAMVIB">scAMVIB</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Adaptive multi-view information bottleneck for multi-omics data clustering</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">同一细胞的 RNA、ATAC 或 ADT 既含共同的 cell-type 信号，也含模态特异信息与技术噪声。简单拼接会让高维模态支配距离，等权融合又假设每个模态同样可靠。scAMVIB 把每个组学视为一个 view，用 information bottleneck 将细胞压缩成离散 cluster T，同时尽量保存各 view 对 cluster 有用的信息；view 权重在迭代中自适应更新。 算法不是深度生成模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell multi-omics technologies (e.g., 10x Multiome, CITE-seq) profile multiple molecular layers — transcriptome, epigenome, proteome — from the same cells.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbaf717" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scAMVIB">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ZZUzy/scAMVIB" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scAMVIB">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scamvib-9bb16e6b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scAMVIB">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="scConcept">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scConcept">scConcept</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scConcept enables concept-level exploration of single-cell transcriptomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scConcept 先用神经主题模型从单细胞表达矩阵中提取若干加权基因程序，再让 GPT-5 对这些程序做过滤、合并和命名，形成“名称—描述—代表基因—来源主题”四元组；最后用概念基因在每个细胞中的标准化表达计算概念分数。它的核心价值不是再造一种低维坐标，而是在基因列表和细胞状态之间建立可读、可计算的中间层。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scConcept addresses a familiar gap in single-cell analysis: embeddings and clusters can separate cells, but they do not automatically explain the biological programs behind those separations.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.21.719959" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scConcept">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/li-lab-mcgill/scConcept" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scConcept">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scconcept-eee3727c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scConcept">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="scDiffusion-X">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scDiffusion-X">scDiffusion-<wbr>X</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multi-modal Diffusion Model with Dual-Cross-Attention for Multi-Omics Data Generation and Translation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scDiffusion-X 先用两个模态专属自编码器把 RNA 计数和二值 ATAC 峰压到各自 100 维潜空间，再在这两个潜变量上联合加噪和去噪；去噪网络的两条分支由三个双向交叉注意力模块（DCA）连接，使 RNA 在每个去噪阶段读取 ATAC 信息，同时 ATAC 也读取 RNA 信息。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paired single-cell multi-omics profiling (e.g., 10x Multiome capturing scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq in the same cell) provides unique opportunities to study gene regulation: which chromatin accessibility peaks control which genes in which cell ty…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-71744-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scDiffusion-X">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/EperLuo/scDiffusion-X" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scDiffusion-X">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scdiffusion-x-bd018331/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scDiffusion-X">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="sCellST">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="sCellST">sCellST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">sCellST predicts single-cell gene expression from H&amp;E images</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">sCellST 想解决的是：只有常规 H&amp;E 病理切片时，能不能预测到接近单细胞分辨率的基因表达？H&amp;E 图像便宜且常见，而空间转录组和 Xenium 等分子技术成本高、样本少。Visium 能给出每个 spot 的表达，但一个 spot 通常混合 10--20 个细胞，因此训练时没有真实的单细胞表达标签。 sCellST 把一个 Visium spot 看作一个 bag，把这个 spot 内的细胞图像看作多个 instances。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">sCellST addresses a practical gap between routine histology and molecular profiling: H&amp;E whole-slide images are abundant, but spatial transcriptomics (ST) and single-cell gene-expression assays are expensive and less accessible.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-67965-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for sCellST">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/loicchadoutaud/sCellST" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for sCellST">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scellst-bda03236/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：sCellST">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="scHiCAR">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scHiCAR">scHiCAR</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Trimodal single-cell profiling of transcriptome, epigenome and 3D genome in complex tissues with scHiCAR</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">基因表达不仅取决于启动子是否开放，还取决于远端增强子能否在三维空间接触启动子。过去的单细胞多组学通常只能同时测三者中的两个：RNA、开放染色质或染色质接触。把来自不同细胞的三张图计算对齐，会受到取样差异和整合模型影响。 scHiCAR 的目标是让同一个细胞核产生三种共享细胞身份的读出： RNA 文库：转录本； DNA R2：Tn5 标记的开放染色质； DNA 配对读段：开放位点与其空间邻近 DNA 的连接。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Gene regulation requires coordinated action among three genomic modalities: the transcriptome (what genes are active), the epigenome (where regulatory elements are accessible), and the 3D genome (which regulatory elements physically contact…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-026-03013-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scHiCAR">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/DiaoLab/scHiCAR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scHiCAR">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/schicar-5fcb526a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scHiCAR">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="scLLM-DSC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="scLLM-DSC">scLLM-<wbr>DSC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scLLM-DSC: LLM-Knowledge Enhanced Cross-Modal Deep Structural Clustering for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scLLM-DSC 解决的是单细胞 RNA 测序数据的无监督细胞聚类问题。输入是表达矩阵 \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times D}，其中 N 是细胞数、D 是基因数；输出是每个细胞的聚类标签 \mathbf{C}=\{c1,c2,\dots,cN\}。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scLLM-DSC targets unsupervised clustering of single-cell RNA-seq data. The paper argues that cell clustering is central to resolving tissue heterogeneity, but many clustering methods reduce genes to numerical indices and therefore miss expl…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2606.13007" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scLLM-DSC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/XPgogogo/scLLM-DSC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scLLM-DSC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scllm-dsc-02e546c1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scLLM-DSC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="scMAGCA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scMAGCA">scMAGCA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable modality-aware mapping of gene regulation in single-cell multiomics with scMAGCA</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scMAGCA 输入配对或多模态单细胞矩阵，先做 feature selection 和 normalization，拼接成 \mathbf{X}^{con}，再构建 cell-cell KNN 图 \mathbf{A}；GCN encoder 学出 latent embedding \mathbf{Z}；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scMAGCA is a graph-adversarial autoencoder for paired or multimodal single-cell data. It integrates RNA, ADT, ATAC, and related modalities by building a cell-cell graph from concatenated features, encoding the graph with GCN layers, modelin…</p>
        </div>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scMethCraft 面向单细胞 DNA 甲基化矩阵中大量“明确缺失值（NA）”的问题：它先用每个基因组区域的 DNA 序列、k-mer 和位置预测该区域在所有细胞中的甲基化水平，再学习细胞—细胞相似度对这些预测做加权修正。由此同一模型可以输出增强后的甲基化矩阵、细胞相似度和低维嵌入，并支持批次整合、标签转移和 DMR 候选筛选。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SCOPE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCOPE">SCOPE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SCOPE: Localizing fate-decision states and their regulatory drivers in single-cell differentiation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCOPE 不是重新推断一棵发育树，也不是给每个细胞强行指定一个终末类型。它接收已经给定的终末命运标签、伪时间和单细胞特征，从成熟端沿伪时间反向招募细胞，为每个细胞输出“仍然可能到达哪些终末命运”的集合。集合含多个命运且细胞状态密度高的区域被解释为分支前的候选决策状态；在配对 RNA/ATAC 数据中，ATAC 预测集合或增强子重要性若早于 RNA 收缩或达峰，则被解释为候选表观遗传预激窗口。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCOPE addresses a gap in single-cell differentiation analysis: existing methods can order cells along trajectories or estimate fate probabilities, but they often do not define discrete, statistically calibrated fate-decision states.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>

        </footer>
      </article>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scPiMS（single-cell proteoform imaging mass spectrometry）把稀疏铺在玻片上的单细胞逐个扫过 nano-DESI 液桥，直接提取并测量完整蛋白质形态（proteoform），再把稀疏的“细胞 × proteoform”信号聚合到生物通路层面，用无监督聚类区分大类海马细胞群。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Signaling_Data_Markets_Free_Samples">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Signaling_Data_Markets_Free_Samples">Signaling_<wbr>Data_<wbr>Markets_<wbr>Free_<wbr>Samples</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Signaling in Data Markets via Free Samples</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">设想一个买家想估计未知参数 \theta，市场上有 K 个数据卖家。每个卖家的数据都以 \theta 为均值，但噪声方差可能是较小的 \sigmaL^2 或较大的 \sigmaH^2；方差越小，数据质量越高。卖家知道自己的质量和单位样本成本，买家事前却不知道。 免费试用似乎能解决信息不对称：卖家先给几个样本，买家观察其样本方差，再决定向谁购买。但卖家未必愿意这样做。好质量一旦被识别，买家只需购买更少样本就能达到同样精度；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This theoretical paper asks when competing data sellers voluntarily provide free samples that let a buyer assess otherwise private data quality before procurement.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.16919" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Signaling_Data_Markets_Free_Samples">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/signaling-data-markets-free-samples-7ee8ac2b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Signaling_Data_Markets_Free_Samples">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="siibra">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="siibra">siibra</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Siibra: a software tool suite for realizing a Multilevel Human Brain Atlas from complex data resources</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">人脑数据横跨 MRI、连接组、组织学、细胞密度、受体密度和基因表达等尺度。真正困难的不是“有没有数据”，而是这些数据使用不同坐标空间、脑区术语、文件格式和云存储接口，并且解剖定位的可信度也不同。传统做法常把高分辨率数据降采样成宏观图，或在分析过程中丢失“这个数值属于哪个脑区/哪版图谱”的关系。 Siibra 的目标是建立一个可计算的多层次人脑图谱：保留数据的原始细节和来源，同时让研究者能够用统一的脑区或空间位置查询它们。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Modern brain data span macroscopic MRI, microscopic histology, connectivity, molecular measurements and gene expression, but differ in spatial scale, coordinate system, anatomical terminology, format and storage system.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03159-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for siibra">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/FZJ-INM1-BDA/siibra-python" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for siibra">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/siibra-c1dabd01/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：siibra">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Silhouette">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Silhouette">Silhouette</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Shortcomings of silhouette in single-cell integration benchmarking</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文的核心不是提出新的单细胞整合模型，而是指出：把 silhouette（轮廓系数）直接改造成单细胞整合评分，会系统性误判整合质量。 作者进一步提出 BRAS（batch-removal-adapted silhouette），通过让每个细胞同时“看见”所有其他批次，而不只看最近的批次，修复批次评测中的 nearest-cluster issue（最近簇盲区）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">For cell-type ASW, silhouette favors compact, spherical, well-separated label geometries even when alternative shapes are biologically equivalent.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/yoseflab/scib-metrics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Silhouette">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/silhouette-097cf781/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Silhouette">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="SkillOpt">SkillOpt</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SkillOpt 把 agent skill 文档当成可训练的外部状态，用“轨迹证据 + 结构化 edits + 文本学习率 + 验证集 gate + rejected buffer + slow/meta update”来优化它，从而在不改模型权重的情况下生成一个小型、可读、可迁移的 bestskill.md。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SkillOpt studies how to adapt frozen LLM agents without changing model weights. The paper argues that for tool-using agents, the reusable object is often not a single prompt but a procedural skill document: instructions for evidence gatheri…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Slide_recon">

        <h2 aria-label="Slide_recon">Slide_<wbr>recon</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable spatial transcriptomics through computational array reconstruction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文把“给珠子拍照定位”改成“让珠子之间交换可测量的分子信号，再从交换模式反推出位置”：邻近珠子接收到相似的扩散条形码，因此它们在高维交互矩阵中的向量也相似；UMAP 再把这种相似性压缩到二维，得到每个条形码的相对空间坐标。 论文发表于 Nature Biotechnology（在线发表于 2025 年，卷期年份 2026），DOI 为 10.1038/s41587-025-02612-0。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Biotechnology paper (online 2025; volume/issue 2026) introduces an imaging-free way to recover the positions of barcoded beads used by array-based spatial transcriptomics.</p>
        </div>

          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>

        </footer>

        <h2 aria-label="sm-PORE-cupine">sm-<wbr>PORE-<wbr>cupine</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Direct RNA sequencing and signal alignment reveal RNA structure ensembles in a eukaryotic cell</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">同一条 RNA 序列并不只有一个固定二级结构，而可能在多个构象之间形成“结构集合”。传统群体测量会把所有分子的信号平均，难以看出少数但可能有功能的构象。DREEM、DANCE-MaP、DRACO、Da Vinci 等单分子方法通常先化学探测，再逆转录成 cDNA；作者此前的 PORE-cupine 虽使用纳米孔直接 RNA 测序，但主要给出群体平均结构。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Bulk RNA-structure profiling averages molecules that may occupy different folds. Earlier single-molecule approaches such as DREEM, DANCE-MaP, DRACO and Da Vinci infer ensembles through chemical probing followed by cDNA sequencing, while the…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03069-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for sm-PORE-cupine">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YueLab-GIS-ASTAR/sm-PORE-cupine" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for sm-PORE-cupine">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sm-pore-cupine-71e66851/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：sm-PORE-cupine">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SMART">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SMART">SMART</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SMART: spatial multi-omic aggregation using graph neural networks and metric learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SMART 把每个空间 spot（或分割后的单细胞）视为图节点：GraphSAGE 沿空间近邻传播信息，MNN 三元组损失再把“空间上较远、分子特征却相似”的节点拉近。多个组学各自编码后拼接，并通过一个全连接层形成统一嵌入。SMART-MS 在此基础上先按切片做 Harmony 校正，再用跨切片 MNN 三元组连接对应结构。 本文的论文证据来自本工作区 outputpapermd/PMC13031631/paper.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multi-omics technologies simultaneously measure multiple molecular layers (transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics) with spatial coordinates, enabling unprecedented characterization of tissue microenvironments.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-70821-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SMART">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Xubin-s-Lab/SMART-main" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SMART">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/smart-2b13389b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SMART">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SmCseq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SmCseq">SmCseq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial 5mC-seq profiling of embryos and decidua after implantation in mammals</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SmC-seq 用正交微流控条形码把组织坐标写入 DNA，再以温和的酶学胞嘧啶转换读取每个像素的全基因组甲基化，从而揭示胚胎、滋养外胚层和母体蜕膜的空间表观遗传分工；它的实验创新清晰，但复现与解释必须正视 5mC/5hmC 合并信号、相邻切片、像素混合，以及公开代码与论文 Methods 在空间聚类和 DMR 统计上的实质差异。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: DNA methylation is a critical epigenetic regulator of embryonic development, yet its spatial organization within tissues was completely unknown.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03079-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SmCseq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/LiuLab888/spatial-5mC-project" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SmCseq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/smcseq-3a35155b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SmCseq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="gigascience" data-journal-label="GigaScience" data-method="SMIntegration">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="SMIntegration">SMIntegration</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SMIntegration: A web tool for comprehensive spatial metabolomics and transcriptomics integrated analysis and visualization</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SMIntegration 先让空间转录组和质谱成像在同一几何网格与预处理尺度上可比较，再以空间模式、拼接聚类、ROI 差异、相关网络和通路注释连接两种模态；它的价值在于可追踪的零代码分析链，主要风险则来自配准/插值、简单特征拼接、mass feature 身份不确定、空间伪重复以及隐藏的特征与像素抽样。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Integrating spatial transcriptomics with spatial metabolomics links gene regulation (genotype) to metabolic output (phenotype) within anatomically defined tissue microenvironments.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>GigaScience · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/gigascience/giag033" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SMIntegration">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mzlab-research/SMIntegration" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SMIntegration">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/smintegration-a51a3625/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SMIntegration">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="advanced-science" data-journal-label="Advanced Science" data-method="SMOReg">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SMOReg">SMOReg</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Decoding Spatial Heterogeneity and Multi-Omics Regulation with Hierarchical Graph Learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SMOReg 不只把 RNA 和蛋白拼在一起做空间聚类。它先在每个 spot 内，把基因和蛋白分别放进由生物先验定义的图，用图卷积去噪；再学习每个基因—蛋白对的亲和矩阵，让两种分子图交换信息；最后把每个 spot 的融合表示放入“分子相似邻域 + 物理空间邻域”的两层 GAT，并通过对比学习得到用于空间域聚类的表示。训练后保存的 spot 级亲和矩阵再被聚合和置换检验，用于提出域特异的基因—蛋白关系。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Full title: Decoding Spatial Heterogeneity and Multi-Omics Regulation with Hierarchical Graph Learning Journal: Advanced Science | Year: 2026 | DOI: 10.1002/advs.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Advanced Science · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.75574" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SMOReg">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ByGary/SMOReg" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SMOReg">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/smoreg-c9f5f737/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SMOReg">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="advanced-science" data-journal-label="Advanced Science" data-method="SOTMGF">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SOTMGF">SOTMGF</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Combining Spatial Multi-Omics Data to Decipher Spatial Domains and Elucidate Cell Heterogeneity Based on Self-Supervised Graph Learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SOTMGF 面向空间转录组、空间蛋白组以及推断得到的空间表观组数据。它认为仅用表达或物理邻接会漏掉两类信息：一个 spot 周围的细胞组成，以及分子之间的条件关联。方法因此把同一批空间观测表示成多个“视图图”，分别学习表示，再以注意力和自训练聚类融合。 输出是每个 spot/细胞的低维表示与预先指定数量的空间域。论文还在这些域上做空间伪表达（SPE）去噪、暗基因/暗蛋白发现、RNA velocity、配体–受体、转录因子和生存分析；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SOTMGF integrates molecular expression, physical proximity, inferred cellular microenvironment, and molecular-association information for spatial-domain clustering.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Advanced Science · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.75533" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SOTMGF">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Luyj6812/SOTMGF" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SOTMGF">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sotmgf-aa034768/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SOTMGF">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="SPAC-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SPAC-seq">SPAC-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Uncovering spatially resolved functional genomics with CRISPR screen sequencing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SPAC-seq 把 pooled CRISPR 扰动、全转录组和组织坐标同时测出来；TARDIS 再以非靶向 sgRNA（sgNTC）为参照，从“全组织位置改变”和“局部微环境富集”两个尺度给扰动排序，并连接空间生态位、基因程序和细胞互作。 论文为 Zhang 等发表于 Cell（2026），DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2026.04.049。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Pooled CRISPR screens reveal which genes affect fitness, and Perturb-seq (Cell, 2016) or CROP-seq (Nature Methods, 2017) adds single-cell transcriptomes, but these approaches lose tissue position.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/zenglab-pku/SPAC-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SPAC-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spac-seq-eadab746/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SPAC-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SpaceBar">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaceBar">SpaceBar</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpaceBar enables single-cell-resolution clone tracing with imaging-based spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">一个细胞为什么呈现某种表达状态，通常有两类来源： 内在/谱系来源：细胞从共同祖先继承了较稳定的遗传或表观遗传状态； 外在/空间来源：细胞因为处于肿瘤边缘、缺氧内部、血管附近等不同微环境而改变表达。 传统克隆追踪和成像型空间转录组很难同时测量这两件事。随机 DNA/RNA barcode 能提供很高的克隆多样性，但 seqFISH、MERFISH 一类方法依赖预先设计的探针面板，无法事先知道每个随机 barcode 的序列。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell state in a tissue reflects both ancestry and local environment, but those influences are difficult to measure together. Random-barcode clone tracing provides lineage labels but imaging-based spatial transcriptomics uses predetermined p…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/grantkinsler/SpatialBarcodes" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaceBar">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spacebar-f6d7ab81/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaceBar">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SpaceTracer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaceTracer">SpaceTracer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Detection of Somatic Point Mutations Directly from Spatial Transcriptomics Enables in vivo Spatiotemporal Lineage Tracing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaceTracer 的目标是利用自然积累的体细胞单核苷酸变异（SNV）作为克隆条形码，在不进行遗传工程标记的情况下重建组织谱系。它的输入是空间转录组比对 BAM、spot 坐标/聚类、参考基因组和群体变异资源；输出首先是高置信 somatic SNV 及其 spot-level genotype。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Detection of Somatic Point Mutations Directly from Spatial Transcriptomics Enables in vivo Spatiotemporal Lineage Tracing DOI: 10.64898/2026.02.04.</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SpaLP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaLP">SpaLP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A lightweight, ultrafast and general embedding framework for large-scale spatial omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaLP 把空间组学中的图卷积压缩成一个非常简单的自编码器：先用二维坐标为每个细胞保存固定数量的邻居编号，再一次性 gather 邻居分子特征，按特征通道计算注意力并求和，最后重构原始表达。它避免保存 N\times N 邻接矩阵，也不堆叠多层消息传递，因此能在单 GPU 上处理百万至千万级细胞。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">High-resolution spatial omics technologies (MERFISH, CosMx, Xenium, Visium HD, Stereo-seq, CODEX) now generate datasets containing millions of cells with spatially resolved molecular profiles.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.02.04.703814" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaLP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dbjzs/SpaLP" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaLP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spalp-fc1e2290/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaLP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Genetics" data-method="SpaMosaic">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaMosaic">SpaMosaic</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mosaic integration of spatial multi-omics with SpaMosaic</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaMosaic 处理的不是每个切片都同时测到所有组学的理想数据，而是更常见的马赛克式观测：有的切片有 RNA+ATAC，有的只有 RNA，有的有 RNA+蛋白，另一些又来自不同发育阶段或实验技术。目标是把这些切片放进同一个低维空间，同时保留空间邻域、消除切片批次差异，并给缺失模态提供可解释的邻居插补。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multi-omics technologies can profile RNA, chromatin accessibility, histone modifications, and proteins from tissue sections, but acquiring all modalities from a single section is technically challenging.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-026-02573-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaMosaic">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JinmiaoChenLab/SpaMosaic" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaMosaic">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spamosaic-504843a9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaMosaic">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SPanC-Lnc">

        <h2 aria-label="SPanC-Lnc">SPanC-<wbr>Lnc</h2>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SPanC-Lnc 是一个 pan-cancer lncRNA atlas/database。它把单细胞 RNA-seq 和空间转录组数据放在一起，用 TAR-scRNA-seq/HMM 流程先发现未注释的转录活跃区域，再把这些候选 lncRNA 放回癌种、细胞类型、空间位置和功能注释里解释。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SPanC-Lnc addresses the lack of cell-type and spatial context in lncRNA discovery. Existing lncRNA analyses are often annotation-dependent or bulk-tissue based; this paper uses single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to discover and…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-026-03071-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SPanC-Lnc">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GenomicsMachineLearning/SPanc_Lnc_PanCancer_LncRNA_Atlas" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SPanC-Lnc">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spanc-lnc-048c09fd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SPanC-Lnc">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Spatial-EV-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Spatial-EV-seq">Spatial-<wbr>EV-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatially resolved profiling of extracellular vesicles in tissues with Spatial-EV-seq</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统组织 EV 分析通常先把组织消化、离心并分离囊泡。这样虽然能测 EV，却丢掉“它原来位于组织哪里、附近是什么细胞、可能影响谁”的信息。Spatial-EV-seq 的目标是同时得到 EV 的空间坐标、单个可分辨 EV 的表面蛋白组合，以及邻近区域的细胞类型和转录状态。 它把三个技术环节连成一条链： 第一步保留大致空间位置；第二步把约百纳米的 EV 放大成可成像的 RCA “DNA 纳米花”；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Isolation-based extracellular-vesicle assays lose tissue location and weaken links between EV phenotype, parental cells and recipient-cell state.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-026-03192-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Spatial-EV-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/BuckyEv/Spatial-EV-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spatial-EV-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatial-ev-seq-54e0315d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spatial-EV-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Spatial-Human-Kidney-Map">

        <h2 aria-label="Spatial-Human-Kidney-Map">Spatial-<wbr>Human-<wbr>Kidney-<wbr>Map</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial atlas of diabetic kidney disease reveals a B cell-rich subgroup</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作不只是在肾组织里“数细胞”，而是要回答三个递进问题：健康与糖尿病肾病（DKD）的组织结构如何改变；哪些局部细胞组合与肾功能下降相连；能否从这些局部结构中找到具有临床风险意义的患者亚群。作者整合 48 份 CosMx 和 16 份 Xenium FFPE 样本，并以 150 位患者的单核 RNA 测序图谱作为参考，最终形成覆盖 200 多位患者、超过 500 万个细胞的统一图谱（论文 Results “Spatial atlas…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is the leading cause of end-stage renal failure and affects 40% of diabetic patients. Despite recent therapeutic advances (SGLT2 inhibitors, mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists), many pat…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10363-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Spatial-Human-Kidney-Map">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Woopsydaisy/Spatial-Human-Kidney-Map" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spatial-Human-Kidney-Map">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatial-human-kidney-map-5a8660ff/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spatial-Human-Kidney-Map">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SpatialCOC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatialCOC">SpatialCOC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpatialCOC: an integrative framework for spatial continuous mapping and cross-omics correction in spatial multi-omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间多组学的困难不只是“不同模态维数不同”。同一组织位置的 RNA、蛋白和 ATAC 既有共享生物结构，也有各自稀疏性、测量噪声和技术偏差。SpatialCOC 把任务拆成两步： Spatial Continuous Mapping（SCM）：把二维坐标当作顶层先验，分别学习每个模态从坐标到特征的连续函数；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multi-omics technologies co-profile two or more molecular layers (gene expression, chromatin accessibility, protein abundance) at spatially resolved spots in tissue sections.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-71882-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatialCOC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xjtu-omics/SpatialCOC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatialCOC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialcoc-91a22a5a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialCOC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="SpatialEcotypes">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatialEcotypes">SpatialEcotypes</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Non-invasive profiling of the tumour microenvironment with spatial ecotypes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇工作想回答两个连续的问题： 在不同患者、癌种和空间转录组平台中，能否发现反复出现的多细胞空间组织模式？ 如果这些模式确实存在，能否不再依赖组织活检，而是从血浆 cfDNA 甲基化中估计它们？ 作者把第一个问题交给 Spatial EcoTyper，把第二个问题交给 Liquid EcoTyper。两者不是同一个模型：前者从空间表达数据中定义“空间生态型”（spatial ecotype, SE）并建立表达参考；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial EcoTyper integrates cell-type-specific spatial expression networks across tumours to discover recurrent multicellular spatial ecotypes (SEs), and the paper&#x27;s separate Liquid EcoTyper model learns CpG sets that estimate those tissue-…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/digitalcytometry/spatialecotyper" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatialEcotypes">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialecotypes-3d0b8b4d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialEcotypes">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="cancer-cell" data-journal-label="Cancer Cell" data-method="SpatialOmics_Review_2026">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatialOmics_Review_2026">SpatialOmics_<wbr>Review_<wbr>2026</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial omics at the forefront: emerging technologies, analytical innovations, and clinical applications</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇综述，不是提出单一算法的原始研究。它试图把空间组学领域拆成一条连续证据链：先选择能回答问题的测量技术，再经过分割、质控、增强和细胞注释，把局部邻域组织成生态位、空间群落与肿瘤生态系统，最后讨论这些结构怎样用于早期演化、转移、微小残留病灶、疗效预测和功能验证。全文的核心不是“哪一个平台最好”，而是不同生物问题需要不同的空间尺度、分子覆盖度、样本兼容性和验证强度。 空间转录组可粗分为成像式和测序式两类。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Liu Y, Dai Y, Wang L. &quot;Spatial omics at the forefront: emerging technologies, analytical innovations, and clinical applications.&quot; Cancer Cell 44:24-49, 2026. DOI: 10.1016/j.ccell.2025.12.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cancer Cell · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ccell.2025.12.009" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatialOmics_Review_2026">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialomics-review-2026-6bff08d4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialOmics_Review_2026">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="SpatialQM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatialQM">SpatialQM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Standardized metrics for assessment and reproducibility of imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpatialQM 不是一个给样本打“合格/不合格”标签的模型，而是一套面向 Xenium、CosMx、MERSCOPE 等成像型空间转录组平台的多维质量度量体系：它把表达矩阵、转录本坐标、细胞分割、阴性探针和空间坐标转换为一组可解释指标，再结合组织、平台、探针面板和参考数据进行横向比较。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets are difficult to compare because measured quality depends on platform chemistry, panel size, tissue, field of view, sample handling and cell segmentation.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SpatialZ">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="SpatialZ">SpatialZ</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Bridging the dimensional gap from planar spatial transcriptomics to 3D cell atlases</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpatialZ 不是真的“测量”了切片之间的组织，而是把相邻真实切片看成两个端点，分别对细胞位置分布、细胞类型组成、局部生态位和基因表达做受约束的插值，生成中间虚拟切片，再把真实与虚拟切片堆叠成高密度的“伪三维”细胞图谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics usually produces isolated 2D tissue sections. Registration tools can stack these planes, but large unmeasured gaps remain along the z axis, so the result is still a sparse stack rather than a dense 3D cell atlas.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02969-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatialZ">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/senlin-lin/SpatialZ" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatialZ">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialz-c19be811/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialZ">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Spatio-DARLIN">

        <h2 aria-label="Spatio-DARLIN">Spatio-<wbr>DARLIN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatio-DARLIN enables robust and efficient in situ lineage tracing in mice at single-cell resolution</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatio-DARLIN 的目标是在同一张完整组织切片中同时读出三类信息： 细胞状态：空间单细胞转录组； 空间位置：细胞在组织中的二维坐标； 克隆谱系：DARLIN 条形码记录的共同祖先关系。 论文指出，传统荧光谱系追踪保留空间结构，但条形码容量低且不能直接给出细胞状态；高多样性遗传条形码结合单细胞 RNA-seq 可以获得分子状态和谱系，但需要组织解离，破坏原位空间结构；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatio-DARLIN is designed to recover cell state, spatial position and clonal ancestry in the same intact mouse tissue section. The paper argues that classical fluorescent lineage tracing keeps spatial context but has low barcode capacity an…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/LLi-Lab/spatio_DARLIN" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spatio-DARLIN">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatio-darlin-44ca59e3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spatio-DARLIN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SpatioCAD">

        <h2 aria-label="SpatioCAD">SpatioCAD</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpatioCAD: Context-aware graph diffusion model for pinpointing spatially variable genes in heterogeneous tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpatioCAD 不把 spot 中的基因计数直接当作可横向比较的“浓度”，而是用每个位置的总信号估计细胞密度，并让基因沿浓度差而不是绝对计数差在空间图上传播。真正有组织的空间图案需要较长时间才扩散到稳态，因此 characteristic diffusion time 越长，基因越靠前。 论文是 2026 年 bioRxiv 预印本，尚未经同行评审。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Identifying spatially variable genes (SVGs) in spatial transcriptomics data is essential for discovering region-specific molecular markers and understanding tissue architecture.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.06.708087" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatioCAD">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kotone-429/SpatioCAD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatioCAD">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatiocad-9429241b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatioCAD">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="spaVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="spaVelo">spaVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A dependency-aware deep generative model for inferring RNA velocity from spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity 需要利用未剪接 RNA（unspliced）和已剪接 RNA（spliced）的相对关系来推断表达变化方向。传统 scVelo、VeloVI、VeloVAE 和 Dynamo 主要面向解离的单细胞数据，把 spot/cell 当成相互独立的样本；TopoVelo 和 spVelo 虽然加入空间信息，但空间图的构建与动力学拟合是解耦的。spaVelo 的目标是让空间依赖和 RNA 动力学在同一个生成模型中联合学习。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics provides expression together with tissue coordinates, but most RNA-velocity models treat observations as independent.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btag270" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for spaVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/1062638515/spaVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for spaVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spavelo-f244aa78/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：spaVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="journal-of-chemical-information-and-modeling" data-journal-label="Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling" data-method="SpaVGMC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="SpaVGMC">SpaVGMC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpaVGMC: A Unified Representation Learning Framework via Structural and Semantic Alignment in Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaVGMC 解决的是空间转录组中的空间域识别问题：给定每个 spot/cell 的基因表达和空间坐标，学习一个既保留组织空间连续性、又能区分转录语义差异的低维表示，然后用于聚类、可视化、轨迹推断和差异表达分析 [outputpapermd/paper/hybridauto/paper.md:341-345]。 论文认为现有空间聚类方法有三类核心不足。第一，许多基于图的模型强调局部相似性，容易过度平滑，模糊真实的组织边界。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaVGMC addresses spatial transcriptomics domain identification, where methods must separate tissue domains while respecting both spatial continuity and transcriptional heterogeneity.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.jcim.6c01121" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaVGMC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/CDMBlab/SpaVGMC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaVGMC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spavgmc-1dcae91a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaVGMC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-research" data-journal-label="Genome Research" data-method="spCorr">

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组中，两个基因的表达关系可能随组织位置改变：在一个区域同向、另一个区域无关甚至反向。传统 SVG 方法只看单个基因的边缘表达，难以直接回答这个问题。已有的 scHOT（Genome Biology, 2020）、SpatialCorr（Nature Methods, 2022）和 SpatialDM（Nature Communications, 2023）可估计局部相关性，但论文指出它们通常不把相关性写成坐标的显式函数，协变量调…</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Xenium 给每个转录本一个空间坐标，再由分割边界把转录本归到“细胞”。一个分割对象中出现两种细胞类型的表达信号，至少有两种完全不同的解释： biological doublet：确实有两个完整细胞被当成一个对象； signal-level mixture：对象主体仍是一个细胞，但邻近细胞、z 轴重叠细胞或错误边界的转录本被分配进来。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="SR2P">SR2P</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SR2P: an efficient stacking method to predict protein abundance from gene expression in spatial transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SR2P 要解决的是空间转录组中的“缺失蛋白模态”问题：很多空间转录组数据只有 RNA 表达和空间坐标，没有同一位置的蛋白丰度测量。但在免疫微环境、肿瘤分型、治疗反应等问题中，蛋白尤其是细胞表面蛋白往往比 RNA 更直接反映细胞状态。论文强调，RNA 和蛋白之间存在转录后调控、翻译调控、蛋白降解等多层差异，空间微环境也会影响蛋白丰度，因此不能简单地把 RNA 当作蛋白的替代物 。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SR2P targets spatial transcriptomics datasets that have RNA expression and spatial coordinates but lack direct protein measurements. The paper argues that RNA-only spatial data miss protein-defined immune states and signaling, especially in…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="SSP">SSP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell spatial pharmacobiology identifies conserved stromal barriers to therapeutic antibody delivery in human solid tumors</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SSP（single-cell spatial pharmacobiology，单细胞空间药理生物学）把“临床给药后的抗体在哪里、碰到了哪些细胞、是否接触到靶点、又被哪些肿瘤微环境结构限制”这几个问题放在同一张组织切片里测量。本文用 panitumumab-IRDye800（pan800）作为带荧光的 EGFR 靶向抗体，在 HNSCC 和 PDAC 人源肿瘤样本中展示这个框架。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Therapeutic antibodies can fail in solid tumors even when the molecular target is present. Standard pharmacology measurements leave a spatial gap: plasma assays and PET/SPECT imaging can measure systemic or organ-level exposure, but they ca…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="STCell">STCell</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">When and Where: A Model Hippocampal Network Unifies Formation of Time Cells and Place Cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">海马 CA3 中的位置细胞在动物到达特定地点时放电，时间细胞则在两个事件之间依次激活。传统理论常把它们分开：位置细胞来自连续吸引子网络，时间细胞来自不同时间常数的单神经元积分器。STCell 提出另一种解释：两者可以是同一 recurrent network 在不同输入相关结构下形成的两种动力学状态。 这里的“STCell”不是单细胞转录组方法，也不涉及空间组学；它是计算神经科学模型。</p>

        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="stGP">stGP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Characterizing dynamic tissue architectures by identifying cell-type-specific spatiotemporal gene programs with stGP</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组如果在多个年龄、发育阶段或损伤时间点采样，同一种细胞的表达变化往往同时包含两件事：不同样本之间随时间改变的共同趋势，以及每张组织切片内部的解剖位置或局部微环境差异。传统 PCA、NMF 可以找低维因子，却不能告诉我们一个因子主要是时间变化、空间结构，还是二者叠加；</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="STimage">

        <h2 aria-label="STimage">STimage</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Robust and interpretable prediction of gene markers and cell types from spatial transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组能够在组织坐标上测量 RNA，但成本高、样本数量有限；常规 H&amp;E 切片便宜且广泛存在，却只能直接观察形态。STimage 用配对的 H&amp;E 图像与空间转录组计数训练模型，学习“一个空间 spot 周围的形态”与“该 spot 的基因表达”之间的统计关联。训练后，只需 H&amp;E 图像即可预测每个位置的基因表达、表达区间或细胞类型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) — platforms like 10x Visium — produces matched H&amp;E histology images and genome-wide gene expression for each spatial spot.</p>
        </div>

          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Stopping Rules for SGD via Anytime-Valid Confidence Sequences">

        <h2 aria-label="Stopping Rules for SGD via Anytime-Valid Confidence Sequences">Stopping Rules for SGD via Anytime-<wbr>Valid Confidence Sequences</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Stopping Rules for Stochastic Gradient Descent via Anytime-Valid Confidence Sequences</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统 SGD 理论通常预先固定迭代次数 T，然后回答“运行到 T 时误差多大”。但实际使用者会持续查看训练轨迹，并在指标看起来足够好时停止。把只对固定时刻成立的置信界反复检查，会产生多重检验问题，原有置信水平不再成立。固定预算、肉眼判断平台期或随意设定梯度阈值，也不能控制“过早停止”的概率。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Classical SGD theory usually answers a fixed-horizon question: after a prespecified number of iterations, how accurate is the result? Repeatedly inspecting such fixed-time bounds and stopping when they look favorable invalidates their nomin…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="STProtein">STProtein</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">STProtein: predicting spatial protein expression from multi-omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STProtein 关注空间多组学里的一个不平衡问题：空间转录组数据相对丰富，而空间蛋白组数据更少、更贵。因此，论文希望用已有的空间 RNA 表达和空间信息来预测未知的空间蛋白表达，并进一步做空间区域聚类和生物学解释。 论文把 STProtein 分成三部分：构建特征图、图注意力自编码器模块、上游和下游任务。论文记号中，X 是 RNA 表达，X&#x27; 是重构 RNA，Z 是模型学到的 embedding；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STProtein is a graph-neural-network framework for predicting spatial protein expression from spatial transcriptomics and paired spatial multi-omics training data.</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Strategic_Feature_Selection">

        <h2 aria-label="Strategic_Feature_Selection">Strategic_<wbr>Feature_<wbr>Selection</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Strategic Feature Selection</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">很多预测模型不仅“观察世界”，还会改变被预测者的行为。以 Medicare Advantage 为例，政府根据诊断编码预测患者风险并向保险公司付费；模型给某个诊断的系数越大，保险公司就越有动力通过补充或强化诊断编码来提高支付额。 战略分类（strategic classification）的经典思路是重新设计一个能够预见这种行为的预测器。但现实制度通常不允许彻底替换已有流程，决策者往往只能调整两个粗粒度杠杆： 删除一部分容易被操纵的特征；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Strategic prediction systems change the behavior of the organizations they evaluate. In Medicare Advantage, for example, payment coefficients create incentives to report additional or more severe diagnoses.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2606.18867" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Strategic_Feature_Selection">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jivatneet/strategic-feature-selection" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Strategic_Feature_Selection">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/strategic-feature-selection-06a566da/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Strategic_Feature_Selection">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="Structured Matrix Scaling">Structured Matrix Scaling</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Structured Matrix Scaling for Multi-Class Calibration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">分类器给出的 softmax 概率往往不等于真实事件发生概率。后校准用一小份带标签的校准集，在不重新训练原分类器的情况下修正这些概率。困难在于：校准样本通常很少，但类别数 k 可能很大。 温度缩放（TS，Guo 等，ICML 2017）只有一个参数，稳定但只能统一调节置信度； 向量缩放（VS）能为每类设置不同尺度和截距，但不能表达类别之间的相互影响；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Post-hoc calibration reserves labeled predictions to align reported class probabilities with observed outcomes. The calibration set is usually much smaller than the classifier&#x27;s training set, producing a sharp bias–variance tradeoff: temper…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="stVCR">

        <h2 aria-label="stVCR">stVCR</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">stVCR: spatiotemporal dynamics of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">stVCR 把不同时间的空间转录组细胞群放入共同的空间–表达状态，用刚体对齐消除坐标框架差异，用带生长质量的神经 ODE 和多时点 OT 匹配学习连续迁移、表达与增殖场，再从这个模型生成插值、谱系和局部敏感度；它重建的是受快照与先验约束的最可能动力学之一，而不是对单细胞真实历史的直接观测。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Peng, Q., Zhou, P. &amp; Li, T. stVCR: spatiotemporal dynamics of single cells. Nature Methods (2026). DOI: 10.1038/s41592-026-03010-3 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Super_Level_Set_Regression_Conditional_Quantiles">
