        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Super_Level_Set_Regression_Conditional_Quantiles">Super_<wbr>Level_<wbr>Set_<wbr>Regression_<wbr>Conditional_<wbr>Quantiles</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Super-Level-Set Regression: Conditional Quantiles via Volume Minimization</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">给定特征 X 和多维响应 Y，SLS 不先拟合完整的条件密度 p(y\mid X)，而是直接学习一条随 X 改变的几何边界，使边界内大约包含目标比例 \tau 的样本，同时尽可能缩小区域体积。 这是一篇统计机器学习方法论文，核心属于多元条件分位数回归、最小体积预测集合和共形预测，并非生物信息学文章。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">For multivariate regression, a useful prediction region should adapt to X, contain a target conditional probability \tau, and avoid wasting volume on low-density areas.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2605.06210" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Super_Level_Set_Regression_Conditional_Quantiles">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ElSacho/super_level_sets_regression" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Super_Level_Set_Regression_Conditional_Quantiles">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/super-level-set-regression-conditional-quantiles-ad2511a8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Super_Level_Set_Regression_Conditional_Quantiles">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="SuperMap">SuperMap</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Bridging unpaired single-cell multimodal data for integrative analyses with SuperMap</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SuperMap 要解决的是“对角整合”中最困难的情形：RNA、ATAC、蛋白或 DNA 甲基化分别测自不同细胞，既没有细胞一一对应，也没有相同特征空间。它不先猜哪两个细胞配对，而是把问题写成无链接回归：如果两个样本来自足够相似的生物系统，那么未观测的 ATAC 细胞 RNA 分布应与实际 RNA 样本分布相近；借助这种分布相等、变量间协方差和基因组先验，可以学习一个从 ATAC 特征到 RNA 特征的线性映射。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell genomics now routinely generates multiple measurement modalities — gene expression (scRNA-seq), chromatin accessibility (scATAC-seq), DNA methylation, and protein abundance — each capturing a distinct regulatory layer of cell bi…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="szKendall">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="szKendall">szKendall</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">szKendall: spatial-structural-zero-aware dissimilarity measures for subtype discovery using single cell Hi-C data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 Hi-C 接触矩阵极稀疏。零既可能是真正不存在接触的结构性零（SZ），也可能只是测序不足造成的 dropout。szKendall 不自己识别 SZ 或直接聚类，而是在已经给出 SZ/插补结果后计算细胞两两不相似度，供 PAM、层次聚类、UMAP/t-SNE 使用。 包把输入中所有零都视为 SZ。若 dropout 尚未插补，它也会被当成生物结构信号，因此结果直接依赖上游 HiCImpute/scHiCSRS 或其他 SZ 判别。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell Hi-C (scHi-C) measures the 3D chromatin organization of individual nuclei by capturing pairwise genomic contacts. Discovering cell subtypes from scHi-C data requires computing dissimilarity between cells&#x27; contact matrices.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-72186-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for szKendall">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/osu-stat-gen/szKendall" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for szKendall">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/szkendall-6390b2cf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：szKendall">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="T2Pdecoder">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="T2Pdecoder">T2Pdecoder</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">T2Pdecoder enables protein-centric analyses from transcriptomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA 测量很普遍，质谱蛋白组却昂贵且覆盖不足；更关键的是，RNA 丰度并不是蛋白丰度的可靠替身。现有 RNA→蛋白方法多针对单细胞，常只覆盖数百个蛋白，难以支撑 bulk 队列中的蛋白通路、分型和临床关联分析。T2Pdecoder 的目标不是宣称 RNA 能完全决定蛋白，而是在已有转录组的样本上预测 5,738 个蛋白的轮廓，从而获得可用于“蛋白质中心”分析的补充视角。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Mass-spectrometry proteomics is much less available than RNA sequencing, while RNA abundance is an imperfect proxy for protein abundance. Existing RNA-to-protein tools are largely single-cell oriented and commonly cover at most a few hundre…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-74209-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for T2Pdecoder">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Lucienxy/T2Pdecoder" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for T2Pdecoder">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/t2pdecoder-915f1f99/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：T2Pdecoder">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Test_Then_Punish_Statistical_Approach_Repeated_Games">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Test_Then_Punish_Statistical_Approach_Repeated_Games">Test_<wbr>Then_<wbr>Punish_<wbr>Statistical_<wbr>Approach_<wbr>Repeated_<wbr>Games</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Test-then-Punish: A Statistical Approach to Repeated Games</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究无限重复博弈中的一个现实困难：玩家约定采用某个合作混合策略，但其他人只能看到每轮实际抽到的纯动作，看不到背后的概率分布。因此，一次“异常动作”可能只是随机波动，不能像完全监控下的 grim-trigger 那样立刻判定有人背叛。 作者的核心想法是把“是否偏离合作策略”写成统计检验，再把拒绝原假设与永久惩罚连接起来。这是重复博弈、序贯检验和算法博弈论交叉的理论方法论文，不是生物信息学论文，也没有实验数据集。 共有 N 个玩家。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Classical trigger strategies assume deviations are directly observable. In this paper&#x27;s infinitely repeated games, players announce no mixed strategies: everyone sees only the pure actions sampled from them.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2603.05619" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Test_Then_Punish_Statistical_Approach_Repeated_Games">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/test-then-punish-statistical-approach-repeated-games-607e7a5c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Test_Then_Punish_Statistical_Approach_Repeated_Games">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="TopOmics">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TopOmics">TopOmics</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TopOmics: Topic Modelling for All Omics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TopOmics 解决的是单细胞和空间多组学中的一个常见矛盾：研究者需要能处理大规模、多模态、空间信息的数据模型，但又希望潜变量可解释。论文指出，主题模型本来很适合解释复杂数据，因为每个 latent direction 可以解释为一个“topic”；但已有单细胞/空间组学主题模型往往绑定在特定数据类型、特定噪声模型或特定估计算法上，互操作性和通用性不足。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TopOmics targets interpretable modeling of modern single-cell and spatial omics datasets that may contain multiple modalities per cell or spot.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.26.727810" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TopOmics">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/fcaretti/TopOmics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TopOmics">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/topomics-e271ec1f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TopOmics">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="TotalX">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="TotalX">TotalX</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable single-cell total RNA sequencing unifies coding and noncoding transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">常规液滴式单细胞 RNA 测序主要捕获带 poly(A) 尾的 mRNA，因此 miRNA、tRNA、snoRNA/scaRNA、部分 lncRNA 以及不带 poly(A) 尾的病毒 RNA 会被系统性漏掉。TotalX 在 10x Chromium 3′ v3.1 上加入少量酶学和计算步骤，使长、短、编码和非编码 RNA 可以在同一单细胞框架中测量。 细胞/细胞核在同一反应中进行 3′ poly(A) 化、5′ 加帽和逆转录；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TotalX is a scalable total-RNA single-cell protocol that extends a commercial 10x Chromium 3′ workflow to capture both polyadenylated and non-polyadenylated coding and noncoding transcripts.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/alinaisakova/TotalX" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TotalX">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/totalx-c52279df/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TotalX">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Towards_Anytime_Valid_Statistical_Watermarking">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Towards_Anytime_Valid_Statistical_Watermarking">Towards_<wbr>Anytime_<wbr>Valid_<wbr>Statistical_<wbr>Watermarking</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Towards Anytime-Valid Statistical Watermarking</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这不是生物信息学论文，而是一篇结合统计推断、信息论与大语言模型安全的理论方法论文。它研究的是：服务商如何在生成文本时嵌入一个不改变原始 token 分布的统计水印，并让检测者可以边读边检验，一旦证据足够就立即停止，同时仍严格控制误报率。 传统水印检测通常预先固定文本长度，再计算一个 p-value。如果检测者每读几个 token 就看一次 p-value，并在第一次显著时停止，重复查看会放大误报概率。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This 2026 arXiv preprint introduces Anchored E-Watermarking, a statistical watermark for autoregressive generators whose detector may continuously monitor text and stop early without losing Type-I error control.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2602.17608" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Towards_Anytime_Valid_Statistical_Watermarking">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/towards-anytime-valid-statistical-watermarking-ddee85e3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Towards_Anytime_Valid_Statistical_Watermarking">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial distribution of the proteome in the human body and in cancers</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">&gt; 先用 DDA 建立项目特异性光谱库，再用带诱捕序列的 DIA-NN 严格控制错误发现，得到统一蛋白丰度矩阵；随后分别做发育/病理轨迹、组织特异性、配对肿瘤混合模型和外部药物/依赖性数据整合，最后输出组织功能图谱、癌症差异蛋白和候选治疗靶点。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="TRACER">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TRACER">TRACER</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reconstructing biologically coherent cellular profiles from imaging-based spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Xenium、MERFISH 等成像型空间转录组直接给出每条 RNA 的基因名和三维坐标。常规流程先从核染色或膜染色得到二维细胞边界，再把落在边界内的转录本归给该细胞。但组织切片有厚度：一个核可能在当前焦平面内，邻近细胞的核却在平面外；两者的胞质和 RNA 在三维空间仍可能重叠。二维边界于是会把不同细胞的 RNA 混到一起，也会留下没有任何检测核可归属的 RNA。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics platforms (Xenium, MERFISH) acquire transcripts from tissue sections with non-negligible thickness (typically 5--10 \mum).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.03.08.710395" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TRACER">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/imlong4real/TRACER" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TRACER">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tracer-ae610f3b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TRACER">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="TrajCast">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TrajCast">TrajCast</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Force-free molecular dynamics through autoregressive equivariant networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统分子动力学（MD）每一步先计算原子间力，再以约 0.5-1 fs 的小时间步积分牛顿方程。即使机器学习势能面显著降低了力计算成本，积分步数仍然很大。TrajCast 的目标是直接学习“当前完整状态到下一完整状态”的映射，绕过逐步算力和数值积分。 输入是每个原子的元素 Zi、位置 \mathbf ri(t) 和速度 \mathbf vi(t)；输出是较大间隔 \Delta t 后的位置和速度。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TrajCast is an autoregressive O(3)-equivariant message-passing neural network for molecular dynamics. Instead of predicting forces and numerically integrating at sub-femtosecond steps, it receives atom types, positions, and velocities and d…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2026</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-026-01227-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TrajCast">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/IBM/trajcast" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TrajCast">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/trajcast-8fa1ae05/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TrajCast">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TumourDerivedOrganoidBiobank_2026">TumourDerivedOrganoidBiobank_<wbr>2026</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A tumour-derived organoid biobank maps cancer gene dependencies</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">癌症依赖图谱通常依赖二维细胞系，但细胞系可能经过长期体外适应，罕有与患者的临床资料、配对正常样本和原发肿瘤。这样会限制“某个基因型为何对应某个脆弱性”的解释。本文建立的是一个带患者背景的三维肿瘤类器官资源，并在这些模型上做全基因组 CRISPR-Cas9 筛选，而不是提出一个全新的机器学习模型。 研究从五类癌症获得患者肿瘤、正常/血液样本和临床资料，建立 256 个可冻存复苏的类器官。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature 2026 study establishes a renewable, clinically linked tumour-organoid atlas and uses genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screens to make a patient-derived map of cancer dependencies.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2026" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Variational_Estimator_Lp_Calibration_Errors">

        <h2 aria-label="Variational_Estimator_Lp_Calibration_Errors">Variational_<wbr>Estimator_<wbr>Lp_<wbr>Calibration_<wbr>Errors</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A Variational Estimator for L^p Calibration Errors</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">该方法把难以直接估计的 Lp 概率校准距离，改写成“原始预测与交叉拟合重校准预测之间的、随样本预测而变化的 proper-loss 风险差”，从而避免分箱，并在期望意义下控制过度估计。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Probability calibration asks whether a classifier&#x27;s stated probabilities match observed class frequencies. The natural Lp target, is hard to estimate because the conditional probability is unknown and f(X) is continuous.</p>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">VelOT: kinetic-free RNA velocity inference via optimal transport, flow-field smoothing, and VAMP coarse-graining of cellular dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VelOT 解决的是单细胞 RNA velocity 的一个核心痛点：很多数据集没有可靠的 spliced/unspliced 读数，或者不满足传统动力学模型的稳态、恒定速率、准确内含子注释等假设。scVelo、DeepVelo、UniTVelo、MultiVelo、veloVI 等方法虽然复杂程度不同，但仍然围绕转录、剪接、降解的动力学模型展开；论文认为这些假设在疾病样本、低覆盖样本、扰动样本、成熟组织或稀有细胞群中容易失效。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">轨迹推断通常从细胞在表达空间中的邻近关系出发，得到全局路径和伪时间；RNA velocity 则从每个基因的 unspliced/spliced 计数拟合瞬时转录动力学。前者擅长全局形状但缺少局部方向，后者有局部方向却容易受低表达、dropout 和动力学拟合误差影响。两条管线独立运行后再把 velocity 投影到轨迹上，可能掩盖原始速度与轨迹相互冲突的问题。</p>

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="VeloTree">VeloTree</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">VeloTree: Inferring single-cell trajectories from RNA velocity fields with varifold distances</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VeloTree 的核心不是直接比较两个细胞当前的表达或速度，而是先从每个细胞沿 RNA 速度场向过去回溯一条积分曲线，再用有向 varifold 距离比较两条曲线共享了多少历史、又从哪里开始分开，最后把两两距离交给 family-joining 重建分化树。 它的输入是每个细胞的表达向量 xi 与 RNA 速度 vi；输出是以观测细胞为节点的树拓扑，以及由树深度归一化得到的伪时间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Reconstructing differentiation trees from single-cell RNA sequencing data is a fundamental challenge in developmental biology.</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="VISTA">VISTA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">VISTA uncovers missing gene expression and spatial-induced information for spatial transcriptomic data analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">成像型或高分辨率空间转录组保留细胞位置，却常只测数百到数千个基因；scRNA-seq 没有原位坐标，却能覆盖更完整的转录组。VISTA 输入同一或相近组织的全转录组 scRNA-seq 参考 X^{N\times G} 和空间计数 X&#x27;^{N&#x27;\times G&#x27;}，其中 G&#x27;\subset G，目标是在每个空间细胞上预测 G-G&#x27;，同时给出基因级和细胞级不确定性排序。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="AA-CRC">AA-<wbr>CRC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Automatically Adaptive Conformal Risk Control</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通 conformal risk control（CRC）可以控制总体平均风险，但所有样本共用一个阈值。这样容易出现一种低效现象：简单样本的集合过大、假阳性过多，而困难样本又可能不够稳健。已有条件 conformal 方法通常要求研究者预先给出人群或条件函数；图像难度等连续因素很难靠人工分组表达。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Classical conformal prediction and conformal risk control (CRC) give distribution-free marginal guarantees, but can spend the error budget unevenly: easy samples may receive overly conservative sets while difficult regions remain poorly con…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="mathematical-programming" data-journal-label="Mathematical Programming" data-method="Accelerated_First_Order_Optimization_Nonlinear_Constraints">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>

        <h2 aria-label="Accelerated_First_Order_Optimization_Nonlinear_Constraints">Accelerated_<wbr>First_<wbr>Order_<wbr>Optimization_<wbr>Nonlinear_<wbr>Constraints</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Accelerated First-Order Optimization under Nonlinear Constraints</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文考虑 投影梯度法每一步都要把新位置投影回完整可行域；Frank–Wolfe 则要在完整可行域上解线性优化。当约束数量很多、结构复杂，甚至可行域非凸时，这两个操作可能很贵或没有闭式解。本文希望只用梯度和一个局部凸子问题，同时保留动量带来的加速效果。 在当前位置 x，作者构造 它是由线性半空间组成的局部速度集合。即使原始可行域是非凸的，固定 x 后的 V\alpha(x) 仍是凸集。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper develops accelerated first-order algorithms for smooth nonlinear constrained optimization without projecting positions onto the full feasible set.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Mathematical Programming · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1007/s10107-025-02224-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Accelerated_First_Order_Optimization_Nonlinear_Constraints">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/accelerated-first-order-optimization-nonlinear-constraints-2b3c93e4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Accelerated_First_Order_Optimization_Nonlinear_Constraints">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

        <h2 aria-label="ACE">ACE</h2>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">透明化脑组织的光片荧光显微镜（LSFM）能产生细胞分辨率、太体素规模的三维图像。困难不只是“找到细胞”：模型还要适应不同实验室、染色方式、分辨率和脑区；统计分析则要发现跨越传统脑区边界的局部或层状变化。 传统 ClearMap、MIRACL 等流程常按图谱 ROI 汇总细胞数，容易把 ROI 内部的局部效应平均掉。逐体素检验又面对海量多重比较。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Array-seq">

        <h2 aria-label="Array-seq">Array-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Repurposing large-format microarrays for scalable spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Array-seq 的核心不是提出新的机器学习模型，而是把成熟的定制寡核苷酸微阵列“改装”为大面积空间转录组芯片：先在已知坐标打印确定性的空间条形码，再通过片上延伸–连接反应补上 UMI 和 oligo(dT) 捕获端，最后用常规测序和空间分析流程得到“位置 × 基因”的表达矩阵。</p>

        <h2 aria-label="ATLAS">ATLAS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ATLAS: a rationally designed anterograde transsynaptic tracer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">神经环路既需要知道“谁给目标细胞输入”，也需要知道“目标细胞把信息传给谁”。改造狂犬病毒擅长单突触逆行示踪，即从起始细胞找到其上游输入；但缺少一个同等级、能从遗传学指定的起始细胞向下游进行单突触顺行示踪的工具。AAV1、黄热病毒等曾被用于顺行转神经元标记，但方向特异性、严格突触依赖性或起始细胞遗传选择能力不足。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ATLAS is a modular protein tracer that gives genetic access to neurons postsynaptic to a chosen starter population. It addresses a major directional gap in circuit mapping: modified rabies virus is powerful for monosynaptic retrograde traci…</p>

        <h2 aria-label="auto-cell">auto-<wbr>cell</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Automated cell annotation and classification on histopathology for spatial biomarker discovery</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统 H&amp;E 单细胞分类需要病理医师逐个标注细胞，成本高且对巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞等形态相近类型的一致性有限。auto-cell 的关键思想是把“人工看 H&amp;E 定义标签”替换成“同一组织切片上的多重免疫荧光（mIF）谱系标志物定义标签”。作者先在同一张 FFPE 切片上依次获取 mIF 与 H&amp;E 图像，把两者精确配准，再把 mIF 上的细胞类型转移给 H&amp;E 中对应细胞，从而建立大规模训练集。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">primarycategory: segmentationannotation papertype: method Motivation/Novelty (动机和创新性) 核心问题：传统病理图像单细胞分析依赖人工标注，存在严重缺陷： 人工标注效率低且容易出错（inter-observer variability） 对巨噬细胞等难识别细胞类型，病理学家间一致性仅约50% 现有方法标注细胞数量有限，不足以训练可靠的深度学习模型 创新突破： 首次使用多重免疫荧光(mIF)替代人工标…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="Backward_Conformal_Prediction">Backward_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Prediction</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Backward Conformal Prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通 conformal prediction 是“先定覆盖率，再看集合有多大”；Backward Conformal Prediction（BCP）把顺序反过来：先规定预测集合最多能有几个标签，再让算法自适应选择误覆盖水平，并估计这样做实际对应的边际可靠性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Backward Conformal Prediction (BCP) reverses the usual design of split conformal prediction. Rather than fixing a target miscoverage \alpha and accepting whatever prediction-set size results, it lets the practitioner specify a fixed or data…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Bayesian_Coordinate_Differential_Privacy">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Bayesian_Coordinate_Differential_Privacy">Bayesian_<wbr>Coordinate_<wbr>Differential_<wbr>Privacy</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Enhancing Feature-Specific Data Protection via Bayesian Coordinate Differential Privacy</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">局部差分隐私（LDP）通常对一整条高维记录使用同一个隐私预算。如果社会保障号需要很强保护，而普通偏好特征不需要同样强的保护，把最小预算用于所有维度会造成很大效用损失；但直接逐特征加噪又会忽略特征相关性，攻击者可能从弱保护特征反推出敏感特征。 BCDP 为每个坐标定义一个隐私参数 δi：在给定数据先验 π 时，观察机制输出以后，关于第 i 个特征的两种假设，其条件输出概率之比最多变化 e^{δi}。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This AISTATS 2025 paper introduces Bayesian Coordinate Differential Privacy (BCDP), a prior-aware way to quantify privacy separately for each feature of a locally released high-dimensional record.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2410.18404" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Bayesian_Coordinate_Differential_Privacy">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/syomantak/BCDP-CodeBase" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Bayesian_Coordinate_Differential_Privacy">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/bayesian-coordinate-differential-privacy-c7280676/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Bayesian_Coordinate_Differential_Privacy">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-reviews-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Reviews Genetics" data-method="BINN_review">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="BINN_review">BINN_<wbr>review</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Beyond the black box with biologically informed neural networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇两页的短篇观点型综述，而不是系统综述或新方法论文。它用一张架构图和十条参考文献说明 biologically informed neural networks（BINNs）的基本思想、代表应用与研究缺口。文章没有新数据、实验、方程、代码或性能基准，因此应把“BINN 往往表现更好”等表述理解为作者对已有文献的选择性综合，而不是本文重新验证的结论。 普通全连接神经网络的隐藏节点没有预先指定的生物含义。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Standardization: common benchmarks and tools for reproducibility and comparison. Rigorous evaluation: ablations that separate ontology information, sparsity and fusion, plus comparison with GNNs and classical machine learning.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Reviews Genetics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41576-025-00826-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for BINN_review">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/binn-review-9d91683d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：BINN_review">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文用 Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) 和 GeoMX spatial transcriptomics 研究卵巢 serous borderline tumor (SBT) 如何经过 micropapillary SBT (SBT-MP) 走向 invasive low-grade serous carcinoma (LGSC) 及其转移。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CAB-OLST">

        <h2 aria-label="CAB-OLST">CAB-<wbr>OLST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Confocal Airy beam oblique light-sheet tomography for brain-wide cell type distribution and morphology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">它的核心不是“从脑表面一直看穿到脑底”，而是： &gt; 每次只高质量成像当前的浅表组织，成像后切掉上方 300 μm，再成像新暴露的浅表面；最后用计算方法把所有块拼回完整全脑。 这相当于把困难的“深部光学成像”改写成大量较稳定的“浅层成像 + 全局重建”问题。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Brain-wide microscopy must cover centimeter-scale tissue while retaining the resolution and SNR needed to distinguish dense cell bodies, dendritic spines, axonal boutons, and continuous long-range axons.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02888-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CAB-OLST">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/coreyelowsky/OLSTv2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CAB-OLST">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cab-olst-013acc3e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CAB-OLST">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CAB-OLST">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CAB-OLST">CAB-<wbr>OLST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Confocal Airy beam oblique light-sheet tomography for brain-wide cell type distribution and morphology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">全脑成像既要覆盖厘米尺度，又要看清细胞、细轴突和树突棘。传统高斯光片扩大视野时会变厚，点扫描层析速度和信号积分受限，而物镜工作距离又限制成像深度。CAB-OLST 的核心目标是同时提高视野、分辨率、信噪比和通量。 用扫描 Airy 光束形成长景深薄光片，景深比扫描高斯光束提高十倍以上。 将 Airy 相位旋转 45°，使探测平面上的光片变直，从而可用相机滚动快门形成 13 μm 虚拟狭缝，抑制旁瓣和离焦背景。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CAB-OLST is a brain-wide imaging platform designed to escape the usual trade-off among field of view, axial resolution, signal-to-noise ratio and imaging depth.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/coreyelowsky/OLSTv2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CAB-OLST">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cab-olst-edea5647/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CAB-OLST">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CARTA">

        <h2 aria-label="CARTA">CARTA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring cell differentiation maps from lineage tracing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CARTA 的输入不是表达矩阵或 RNA velocity，而是一组末端细胞带有类型标签的 lineage trees。实验只观测到终点细胞，真正经历过的中间祖细胞往往未采样。CARTA 要反推出一个 cell differentiation map：节点是“能产生哪些终末类型”的 potency set，边表示潜能逐步丢失的分化关系。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">During development, cells differentiate from multipotent progenitors into specialized cell types through a series of intermediate states. Characterizing the full cell differentiation map — including unobserved transient progenitors — is a f…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02903-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CARTA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/CARTA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CARTA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/carta-25c4570b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CARTA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="kdd-2025" data-journal-label="KDD 2025" data-method="CausalGeD">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CausalGeD">CausalGeD</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CausalGeD: Blending Causality and Diffusion for Spatial Gene Expression Generation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CausalGeD 的任务是：已知 scRNA-seq reference 中较完整的基因表达，预测空间转录组 spots 上未测或被遮蔽的基因。它先用双输入头 VAE 把“每个基因在所有 ST spots 上的表达向量”和“该基因在所有 single cells 上的表达向量”映射到同一潜空间，再给 ST latent 加噪；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) platforms capture the spatial distribution of gene expression in tissue sections, but are fundamentally limited: imaging-based methods (MERFISH, seqFISH, STARmap) measure only a small panel of pre-selected genes…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>KDD 2025 · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2502.07751" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CausalGeD">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Rumi07/CausalGeD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CausalGeD">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/causalged-8aeb9849/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CausalGeD">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="cell2fate">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="cell2fate">cell2fate</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cell2fate infers RNA velocity modules to improve cell fate prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">标准 RNA velocity 对每个基因使用转录、剪接、降解方程，但常把转录率简化成一次开启、一次关闭。真实发育过程中，同一基因可能被多个程序在不同阶段反复增强或抑制。cell2fate 的核心思想是：把复杂的时间依赖转录率拆成多个可解析的“模块”，每个模块有自己的开启/关闭时间窗、基因载荷和接近目标转录率的速度。各模块的表达和 velocity 相加，既得到完整动力学，也得到一个带生化意义的低维分解。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity — the inference of transcriptional dynamics from spliced and unspliced RNA counts — enables reconstruction of cell fate trajectories from single-cell RNA-seq data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02608-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for cell2fate">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/BayraktarLab/cell2fate" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for cell2fate">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cell2fate-42d8efaf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：cell2fate">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="CellANOVA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellANOVA">CellANOVA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Recovery of biological signals lost in single-cell batch integration with CellANOVA</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞研究常常包含多个样本，而每个样本都可能受到组织处理、细胞解离、建库、测序平台、操作人员等因素影响。整合算法希望让“相同状态”的细胞跨样本对齐，但对齐越强，越可能把真实的疾病、治疗或时间效应一起抹掉。结果可能出现两类问题： 生物信号丢失：不同条件的细胞被过度混合； 数值失真：校正后的基因表达偏离原始数据，影响差异表达和通路分析。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell integration is usually tuned to mix samples, but aggressive alignment can erase real condition-specific variation and distort gene-level expression.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Janezjz/cellanova" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellANOVA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellanova-56978e0f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellANOVA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="CellBehaviorHypothesisGrammar">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="CellBehaviorHypothesisGrammar">CellBehaviorHypothesisGrammar</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Human interpretable grammar encodes multicellular systems biology models to democratize virtual cell laboratories</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell Behavior Hypothesis Grammar 把细胞行为假设从隐藏在 C++ 里的条件逻辑，提升为可读的 CSV 规则；这些规则通过 Hill 响应函数和 PhysiCell phenotype 更新机制变成可执行的多细胞 agent-based model，从而让生物假设更容易编写、审查、复用和扩展。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Human interpretable grammar encodes multicellular systems biology models to democratize virtual cell laboratories. This paper introduces a cell behavior hypothesis grammar for agent-based models: users write biological rules as contr…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2025.06.048" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellBehaviorHypothesisGrammar">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/physicell-models/grammar_samples" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellBehaviorHypothesisGrammar">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellbehaviorhypothesisgrammar-a62cf96d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellBehaviorHypothesisGrammar">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CellFlow">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellFlow">CellFlow</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellFlow enables generative single-cell phenotype modeling with flow matching</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellFlow 学习一个由实验条件控制的连续向量场，把对照细胞分布运输成扰动后的细胞分布。它的主要任务是未见条件下的单细胞表型生成；论文也展示发育时间插值和命运工程，但不能因此把模型输出理解为由谱系追踪直接验证的真实细胞轨迹。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellFlow is a generative framework for modeling single-cell phenotypes induced by complex perturbations using flow matching and optimal transport.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.04.11.648220" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellFlow">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/cellflow" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellFlow">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellflow-eca5e2a3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellFlow">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CellHermes">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellHermes">CellHermes</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Language may be all omics needs: Harmonizing multimodal data for omics understanding with CellHermes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞转录组是“每个细胞一行数值”的表格，PPI 是“基因—基因边”的图；常见方法往往为其中一种数据专门设计模型。论文认为，这会使不同模态、不同下游任务难以共用表示。CellHermes 的做法不是从头训练新的组学 Transformer，而是把它们写成自然语言的“指令 → 答案”，再用 LoRA 微调已有的 LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct（论文 30、34、40–46、189–203 行）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellHermes is a 2025 bioRxiv preprint that adapts LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA to learn from ranked single-cell gene lists and PPI graphs expressed as question–answer pairs.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.07.687322" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellHermes">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/CellHermes" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellHermes">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellhermes-29418647/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellHermes">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-immunology" data-journal-label="Nature Immunology" data-method="CellLENS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellLENS">CellLENS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellLENS enables cross-domain information fusion for enhanced cell population delineation in single-cell spatial omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellLENS 的核心不是直接把表达、坐标和像素拼接，而是先从表达建立粗粒度初始细胞群，再把每个细胞周围的群体组成当作自监督目标。LENS-CNN 学习“局部组织图像能否预测邻域组成”，LENS-GNN-duo 则让表达分支在表达相似图上传播、图像分支在空间近邻图上传播，两个分支合并后预测“初始身份 one-hot + 邻域组成”。训练多轮后拼接中间表示并做 SVD，得到用于无监督细胞群划分的稳定 embedding。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Delineating cell populations in their tissue context is fundamental to understanding immune function in health and disease. Spatial omics technologies such as CODEX (Cell Segmentation by the Oligonucleotide-directed Optical DEtection of ant…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Immunology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-025-02163-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellLENS">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/sggao/celllens" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellLENS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/celllens-8d7b8d11/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellLENS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="CellMentor">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellMentor">CellMentor</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellMentor: cell-type aware dimensionality reduction for single-cell RNA-sequencing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellMentor 是一个 supervised non-negative matrix factorization（NMF）方法。它不是让降维表示保留“总体最大方差”，而是利用参考数据的 cell-type labels，直接要求同类细胞在 latent space 中更紧、易混淆的不同类型更远。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Single-cell RNA sequencing generates high-dimensional gene expression profiles for thousands of individual cells. A critical step is dimensionality reduction — transforming 20,000+ gene dimensions into a compact represen…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-67088-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellMentor">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/petrenkokate/CellMentor" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellMentor">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellmentor-417b5aa9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellMentor">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CellNEST">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellNEST">CellNEST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellNEST reveals cell–cell relay networks using attention mechanisms on spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellNEST 面向空间转录组中的细胞间通信（cell–cell communication, CCC）推断。输入可以是细胞级数据，也可以是 Visium spot；输出不是笼统的“某两类细胞可能通信”，而是带空间位置、方向、配体–受体身份和强度排序的单细胞/单 spot 通信边，并进一步组合成两跳中继网络（relay network）。论文发表于 Nature Methods 2025，DOI 为 10.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most cell–cell communication (CCC) methods infer isolated ligand–receptor pairs, often at cell-type or cluster resolution, and many either ignore spatial position during inference or use it only after predictions have been made.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/schwartzlab-methods/CellNEST" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellNEST">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellnest-72bad038/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellNEST">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CelloType">

        <h2 aria-label="CelloType">CelloType</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CelloType: a unified model for segmentation and classification of tissue images</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CelloType 的真正创新点是把多通道组织图像中的“找对象、画边界、判类别、给置信度”变成一个共享查询和共享特征的联合学习问题；实验显示这种统一建模明显优于两阶段流水线，但分类迁移能力、训练数据需求和严格的全流程复现仍然是主要限制。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial-omics image analysis usually treats cell segmentation and cell-type annotation as two separate tasks. Errors from the first stage propagate into the second, classification cannot use the full image context, and two independent model…</p>
        </div>

          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CellScope">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellScope">CellScope</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellScope: High-Performance Cell Atlas Workflow with Tree-Structured Representation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellScope 是面向 scRNA-seq 的“特征选择 + 去噪 + 层次聚类 + 多层可视化”工作流。它先从局部高密度细胞中构造少量可靠小团体，用这些团体间的 ANOVA 挑出能区分潜在群体的基因；再把最低密度的细胞向附近高密度细胞轻度投影；最后在相似图上做平均连接层次聚类，并把多个聚类分辨率画成树。它不是轨迹推断模型，树的分叉表示聚类层级，不应直接解释为真实发育谱系或时间方向。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellScope is an innovative computational framework for constructing high-resolution, multi-scale cell atlases from single-cell RNA sequencing data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.02.15.638400" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellScope">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/zhigang-yao/CellScope" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellScope">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellscope-a4826332/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellScope">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="CellTransformer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellTransformer">CellTransformer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Data-driven fine-grained region discovery in the mouse brain with transformers</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellTransformer 不直接对整张组织切片建全局图。它以每个细胞为中心截取一个固定物理尺度的局部邻域，遮住中心细胞的表达，只保留它的细胞类型；模型必须用周围细胞的类型和表达预测中心细胞的基因计数。为了完成这个自监督任务，编码器把整个邻域压缩成一个 384 维“neighborhood representation”。训练后丢掉表达预测头，把每个中心细胞对应的邻域表示拿去做跨切片、跨动物的 k-means，得到空间域。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellTransformer 通过“遮住中心细胞表达、用局部邻域预测它”的自监督任务，把每个细胞周围的类型、表达和密度信息压缩成 384 维 neighborhood representation，再跨切片、跨动物用 k-means 得到用户指定粒度的空间域。局部 neighborhood mini-batching 避免建立全数据集距离矩阵，使模型能处理多百万细胞。 论文在 3.74M 细胞 Allen MERFISH、四动物约 5.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-64259-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellTransformer">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/abbasilab/celltransformer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellTransformer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/celltransformer-7ce430de/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellTransformer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="" data-journal-label="" data-method="CellTRIP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellTRIP">CellTRIP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring virtual cell environments using multi-agent reinforcement learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞测序通常给出的是“快照”：每个细胞只在某个时间或空间位置被观测一次。轨迹推断可以把细胞排成一条发展路径，但往往不显式描述细胞如何相互作用，也难以回答“敲低某个基因后，整群细胞会怎样移动或改变表达”。CellTRIP 的目标更像构造一个可运行的模拟器：把每个细胞视作一个智能体，让它们在低维环境空间里移动；只要这个空间仍能保留原始表达、空间坐标或时间阶段的信息，就给予正奖励。 因此，CellTRIP 的输出不是一条唯一的真实生物轨迹。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single cells continuously interact to form dynamic cell environments that drive biological processes like development, differentiation, and spatial organization.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Oafish1/CellTRIP" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellTRIP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/celltrip-9f75c317/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellTRIP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-genomics" data-journal-label="Cell Genomics" data-method="CellWalker2">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="CellWalker2">CellWalker2</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellWalker2: Multi-omic discovery using hierarchical cell type relationships</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellWalker2 把层级标签、不同模态细胞和 bulk 注释放入同一异构图，以随机游走整合跨边证据，再用置换空分布校正结构偏差；它擅长输出层级化的统计关联，但结论依赖 marker、树、图构造、默认参数和置换稳定性，不能被解释为直接的谱系或因果机制。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell genomics generates high-resolution cell-type annotations, but three persistent gaps limit cross-study integration: Cell types are treated as discrete labels: Existing methods (Seurat [Cell 2021], Signac [Nat Methods 2021], ArchR…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Genomics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xgen.2025.100886" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellWalker2">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/PFPrzytycki/CellWalkR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellWalker2">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellwalker2-621b47dc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellWalker2">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="CellWhisperer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellWhisperer">CellWhisperer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multimodal learning enables chat-based exploration of single-cell data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞数据常需要聚类、标注、差异分析等多步操作；研究者还必须把生物学问题翻译成具体工具的输入。CellWhisperer 把“转录组”和“文字描述”放进同一空间：既可以输入“具有免疫功能的结构细胞”来找细胞，也可以在选中细胞后直接提问。论文将其定位为交互式探索工具，而不是取代实验验证的自动注释裁判。 第一部分是 CLIP 风格的双编码器。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellWhisperer connects RNA expression profiles to natural-language descriptions, so a user can search cells with text and chat about selected cells.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/epigen/cellwhisperer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellWhisperer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellwhisperer-6d989db7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellWhisperer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="CFGen">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CFGen">CFGen</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multi-Modal and Multi-Attribute Generation of Single Cells with CFGen</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CFGen 是条件单细胞生成与批次校正模型，不是轨迹/命运推断方法。它生成 RNA counts，或成对 RNA 与 ATAC，并按细胞类型、供体、组织、批次等属性控制；dynamicsfatetrajectory 是历史归档位置，不代表模型输出发育轨迹。 第一阶段训练自动编码器。各模态编码到潜空间，可选 joint layers 融合。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Reproducibility Rating: 3/5 CFGen (Conditional Flow Generation) introduces latent flow matching with discrete likelihood decoders for generating realistic single-cell RNA-seq and multi-modal (RNA + ATAC) data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2407.11734" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CFGen">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/CFGen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CFGen">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cfgen-d8967848/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CFGen">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="ChAIR">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="ChAIR">ChAIR</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Tri-omic single-cell mapping of the 3D epigenome and transcriptome in whole mouse brains throughout the lifespan</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ChAIR 是一种单细胞三组学技术：在同一个细胞里同时测量 RNA 表达、开放染色质和染色质相互作用，从而把“调控元件是否开放”“它是否与启动子接触”“基因是否表达”放在同一条证据链上。 论文发表于 Nature Methods（2025），DOI 为 10.1038/s41592-025-02658-7。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most knowledge about how 3D genome folding and chromatin state regulate transcription comes from bulk or separately measured single-cell modalities.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/fengchuiguo1994/ChAIR-PIPE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ChAIR">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/chair-e47b46c4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ChAIR">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="Chip-Tip">Chip-<wbr>Tip</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Enhanced sensitivity and scalability with a Chip-Tip workflow enables deep single-cell proteomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Chip-Tip 不是一个数学模型，而是一套端到端的单细胞蛋白质组技术：它用 cellenONE 挑选并分配单个细胞，在 proteoCHIP EVO 96 中以 300 nl 体积完成油层覆盖的一锅式裂解和酶切，再把芯片直接倒扣到 Evotip 上离心转移，最后通过 Evosep One 快速液相、Orbitrap Astral 和窄窗口 DIA（nDIA）完成无标记定量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell proteomics measures functional molecules and post-translational modifications that mRNA cannot directly capture, but extremely small input makes peptide loss, evaporation, contamination, sequence depth, throughput and reproducib…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/chip-tip-0606b739/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Chip-Tip">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="" data-journal-label="" data-method="ChromFound">
