        <h2 aria-label="ChromFound">ChromFound</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ChromFound: Towards A Universal Foundation Model for Single-Cell Chromatin Accessibility Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ChromFound 是面向单细胞染色质可及性数据的基础模型。它不把固定的 peak 集合当作词表，而是把每个开放染色质区域（OCR）作为一个带有连续可及性数值、染色体编号、起点和终点坐标的 token。这使不同组织或新出现的 OCR 仍可被表示，避免固定 peak 词表造成的对齐缺失。 每个 OCR 的表示由四部分相加：染色体可学习 embedding、起点位置的正弦位置编码、终点位置的正弦位置编码，以及可及性数值的线性投影。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ChromFound is a scATAC-seq foundation model that treats each open chromatin region as a continuous, genome-aware token rather than selecting a fixed peak vocabulary.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JohnsonKlose/ChromFound" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ChromFound">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/chromfound-4c221f2b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ChromFound">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="chronODE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="chronODE">chronODE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">The chronODE framework for modelling multi-omic time series with ordinary differential equations and machine learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">发育时间序列中的基因表达和染色质开放度常只有少数时间点。样条或高阶多项式可以把点连成曲线，但系数通常不对应明确的生物过程。chronODE 用广义 logistic 常微分方程描述“早期协同加速、后期逐渐饱和”的信号，把每个动态基因或 cCRE 压缩成两个主要量：变化速率 k 和饱和水平 b。随后它根据拐点相对实验窗口的位置，将单调信号分为 accelerator、switcher、decelerator；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">During organismal development, gene activation and repression must occur with precise timing — aberrant temporal regulation drives diseases from cancer to neurodegeneration.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61921-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for chronODE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gersteinlab/chronODE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for chronODE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/chronode-04c6d636/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：chronODE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="CLADES">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CLADES">CLADES</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CLADES: a hybrid NeuralODE-Gillespie approach for unveiling clonal cell fate and differentiation dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CLADES 用带时间点和克隆条形码的单细胞数据估计“每个 meta-clone 中，各细胞群以多快速度增殖、死亡或转向其他群体”，再把这些连续时间速率交给 Gillespie 随机模拟，生成单细胞分裂树与终末命运概率。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) are heterogeneous: individual clones from the same stem cell pool can produce vastly different proportions of downstream blood cell types (erythroid, myeloid, DC, mast cell lineages) at different rates.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-63150-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CLADES">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/StatBiomed/clonaltrans" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CLADES">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/clades-d16a7353/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CLADES">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Clonalscope">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Clonalscope">Clonalscope</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cancer subclone detection based on DNA copy number in single-cell and spatial omic sequencing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Clonalscope 的目标不是把表达相似的细胞分群，而是从 scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq 或空间转录组这类“没有直接测 DNA”的数据中，尽量恢复由 DNA 拷贝数改变（CNA）定义的癌症亚克隆。 它先把高维、噪声很大的基因计数压缩为“细胞/spot × 基因组区段”的相对覆盖度矩阵，再用嵌套 Chinese Restaurant Process（CRP）同时决定：应该有多少个亚克隆、每个细胞属于哪个亚克隆，以及新亚克隆…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Clonalscope is a CNA-based cancer subclone detection method for scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq and spatial transcriptomics (ST). It converts noisy gene- or accessibility-level counts into segment-level relative coverage, then uses nonparametric Baye…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/seasoncloud/Clonalscope" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Clonalscope">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/clonalscope-b5f65896/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Clonalscope">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="journal-of-computational-biology" data-journal-label="Journal of Computational Biology" data-method="ClusterDE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ClusterDE">ClusterDE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ClusterDE: A Statistical Software Package for Removing Double-Dipping Bias in Post-Clustering Differential Expression Analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ClusterDE 处理的是单细胞 RNA-seq 和空间转录组分析里很常见的一个问题：先用同一份表达矩阵做聚类，再用同一份表达矩阵在聚类之间做差异表达检验。这样会产生 double-dipping bias，也就是“用同一份数据先发现结构、再验证结构”。如果聚类算法把一个本来同质的细胞群或一个平滑空间区域过度切成两个簇，普通 DE 检验仍然可能给出显著 marker gene，造成假阳性和错误注释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ClusterDE is an R package for reducing double-dipping bias in post-clustering differential expression analysis. The problem is that common single-cell and spatial transcriptomics workflows use the same data to create clusters and then test…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Computational Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1177/15578666251383562" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ClusterDE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SONGDONGYUAN1994/ClusterDE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ClusterDE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/clusterde-bafcc087/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ClusterDE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="Conformal_Prediction_Levy_Prokhorov_Shifts">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Conformal_Prediction_Levy_Prokhorov_Shifts">Conformal_<wbr>Prediction_<wbr>Levy_<wbr>Prokhorov_<wbr>Shifts</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Conformal Prediction under Lévy–Prokhorov Distribution Shifts: Robustness to Local and Global Perturbations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">标准 split conformal prediction 依赖校准样本与测试样本的可交换性。一旦测试分布变了，用训练/校准分布得到的分位数就可能太小，预测集合因而欠覆盖。本文研究的是一个更具体的问题：如果测试分布位于训练分布周围的 Lévy–Prokhorov（LP）模糊集中，怎样构造仍具有有限样本边际覆盖保证的预测集合？ 这是一篇统计机器学习方法论文，不是生信专用方法。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper develops finite-sample conformal prediction for train–test shifts modeled by a Lévy–Prokhorov (LP) ambiguity set. The LP model unifies two qualitatively different changes: every observation may move locally by at most \varepsilon…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2502.14105" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Conformal_Prediction_Levy_Prokhorov_Shifts">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/olivrw/LP-robust-conformal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Conformal_Prediction_Levy_Prokhorov_Shifts">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/conformal-prediction-levy-prokhorov-shifts-71ef4a69/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Conformal_Prediction_Levy_Prokhorov_Shifts">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Conformal_Prediction_Trust_Scores_Conditional_Coverage">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Conformal_Prediction_Trust_Scores_Conditional_Coverage">Conformal_<wbr>Prediction_<wbr>Trust_<wbr>Scores_<wbr>Conditional_<wbr>Coverage</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Conformal Prediction Sets with Improved Conditional Coverage using Trust Scores</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">标准 split conformal prediction 能保证 但这是对所有测试样本平均后的边际覆盖率。例如，90% 的简单样本全部覆盖、10% 的困难样本全部漏掉，整体仍然可以达到 90%。真正理想的是对每个 X=x 都覆盖，但有限样本下不可能同时获得非平凡、分布无关的精确 X-条件覆盖。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Standard split conformal prediction can guarantee that a prediction set contains the true class with probability at least 1-\alpha on average, while still failing systematically on the cases where uncertainty matters most.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jivatneet/conditional-conformal-trust" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Conformal_Prediction_Trust_Scores_Conditional_Coverage">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/conformal-prediction-trust-scores-conditional-coverage-19348009/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Conformal_Prediction_Trust_Scores_Conditional_Coverage">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Connectivity_Type">

        <h2 aria-label="Connectivity_Type">Connectivity_<wbr>Type</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Connectivity of single neurons classifies cell subtypes in mouse brains</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">神经元通常按胞体所在脑区、形态、电生理或转录组分类，但这些属性并不直接描述它“可能连接到哪里”。电子显微镜可以识别真实突触，却还难以覆盖整个小鼠脑。本文提出一个折中方案：把已经配准到统一脑图谱的轴突和树突形态转成“潜在连接”特征，再用它区分神经元类型和亚型。 这里的连接不是实测突触。它表示单个神经元的轴突空间与群体树突区域发生重叠，因此更准确的名称是“潜在连接”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Methods 2025 study introduces a whole-brain framework for classifying mouse neurons by potential connectivity. It aggregates 20,158 CCFv3-registered neuron reconstructions, learns population-level dendritic arbor domains, and re…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YunZhixi98/Connectivity_Type" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Connectivity_Type">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/connectivity-type-13ac550a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Connectivity_Type">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="COSMOS">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="COSMOS">COSMOS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cooperative integration of spatially resolved multi-omics data with COSMOS</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">COSMOS 面向同一批 spot/细胞上同时测得的两种空间组学。它在共享空间邻接图上为两个模态各建一个 GCN encoder，用 Deep Graph Infomax（DGI）让局部节点表示保留全局组织信息；训练中途从两个模态表示计算每个细胞自己的 WNN 权重，将两路表示加权合成。论文还加入空间距离—嵌入距离正则，使空间相近的细胞倾向在联合表示中接近。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">COSMOS addresses paired spatial multi-omics data, where two molecular assays are measured at the same spatial positions. Existing spatial methods such as SpaGCN (Nature Methods, 2021) and SpaceFlow (Nature Communications, 2022) focus on sin…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-55204-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for COSMOS">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Lin-Xu-lab/COSMOS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for COSMOS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cosmos-1006fbb5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：COSMOS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="CoVarNet">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CoVarNet">CoVarNet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cross-tissue multicellular coordination and its rewiring in cancer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CoVarNet 的关键贡献是把“细胞亚群丰度的共变模式”转化为可解释的多细胞网络：NMF 给出可能一起出现的节点，特异相关性给出可信的边，最终得到可用于组织空间验证、表型关联和癌症重塑分析的 cellular modules。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cross-tissue multicellular coordination and its rewiring in cancer. Nature 2025. DOI: 10.1038/s41586-025-09053-4. The paper studies how diverse cell types coordinate across human tissues and how those multicellular organizations change in c…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="CRAFTseq">

        <h2 aria-label="CRAFTseq">CRAFTseq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Precisely defining disease variant effects in CRISPR-edited single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CRISPR base editing 后，同一培养孔里通常只有一部分细胞获得目标编辑，其余细胞可能未编辑、杂合编辑、双等位编辑或带旁观者/indel。若以“加入了 guide”代替真实 genotype，会把这些细胞混在一起；同时 edited cells 分泌的 cytokine 和共同培养应激会影响未编辑邻居，使 condition-level comparison 把共享环境效应错当成 variant effect。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Large-scale GWAS has catalogued thousands of non-coding disease variants, but most have no proven causal function. Pinning function to a specific SNP requires introducing it into the right cell type and measuring the downstream effect.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09313-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CRAFTseq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/immunogenomics/craft-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CRAFTseq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/craftseq-c12c0246/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CRAFTseq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="CraniofacialSpatiotemporalAtlas">CraniofacialSpatiotemporalAtlas</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High-resolution spatial transcriptomics and cell lineage analysis reveal spatiotemporal cell fate determination during craniofacial development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">颅神经嵴细胞（CNCC）迁移到上颌突后形成骨、牙、肌周支持组织、腭中线及其他结缔组织。关键争议是：这些细胞在进入腭原基前是否已经带有谱系偏向，还是到 E12.5 之后才被局部环境诱导分化。 本文把三种证据串在一起：五个胚胎阶段的 scRNA-seq 提供细胞类型和时间分布；三个阶段的 94 基因 seqFISH 将这些状态放回组织空间；</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Journal: Nature Communications 16 (2025-05-12) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-59206-2 Lab: Chai Lab, University of Southern California Type: Technology application / multi-omics atlas paper Biological problem: Cranial neural crest cells (CNCCs) mi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="CRISPR-StAR">

        <h2 aria-label="CRISPR-StAR">CRISPR-<wbr>StAR</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CRISPR-StAR enables high-resolution genetic screening in complex in vivo models</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CRISPR-StAR 的关键不是发明更复杂的统计模型，而是改变比较对象：不再用经历不同瓶颈的起始库和终点肿瘤比较，而是在同一个已经植入的 UMI 克隆内部，用 inactive 后代作为 active 敲除后代的配对对照。</p>
        </div>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CRISPR-StAR enables high-resolution genetic screening in complex in vivo models introduces CRISPR-StAR (Stochastic Activation by Recombination), an internally controlled pooled CRISPR screening platform.</p>

        <h2 aria-label="CRISPRmap">CRISPRmap</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping multimodal phenotypes to perturbations in cells and tissue with CRISPRmap</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">pooled CRISPR 筛选的核心任务，是把“这个细胞受到了哪个遗传扰动”与“这个细胞呈现了什么表型”对应起来。 Perturb-seq（Cell, 2016）和 CROP-seq（Nature Methods, 2017）把 CRISPR 扰动与单细胞转录组连接起来，能看到大量 RNA 变化，但需要分离并裂解细胞，因此会丢失细胞形态、蛋白质亚细胞定位、邻近细胞关系和组织结构。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Pooled CRISPR screens need to connect each cell&#x27;s perturbation with its phenotype. Perturb-seq (Cell, 2016) and CROP-seq (Nature Methods, 2017) provide rich single-cell transcriptomic readouts, but cell isolation and lysis remove morphology…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Cross-Validated Causal Inference">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Cross-Validated Causal Inference">Cross-<wbr>Validated Causal Inference</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cross-Validated Causal Inference: a Modern Method to Combine Experimental and Observational Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">目标是估计实验人群中的平均处理效应（ATE）： 实验数据有随机化或条件无混杂与 overlap，因此可以识别这个目标；但实验昂贵，样本量通常较小。观察数据便宜、量大，却可能有未测混杂、模型设错、协变量分布漂移，甚至与实验人群有不同的处理效应。论文要回答的是：能否在不把观察数据误当成可信因果证据的前提下，用它降低估计方差？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper develops Cross-Validated Causal Inference (CVCI), a loss-based method for estimating the average treatment effect in an experimental population while using potentially biased observational data for precision.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2511.00727" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Cross-Validated Causal Inference">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xyang23/cross_validated_causal" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Cross-Validated Causal Inference">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cross-validated-causal-inference-63bf8fac/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Cross-Validated Causal Inference">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="cSplotch">cSplotch</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Tissue and cellular spatiotemporal dynamics in colon aging</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">结肠同时沿三条轴变化：近端到远端的解剖轴、隐窝底到顶端的组织轴，以及出生到衰老的时间轴。空间转录组保留位置，但每个 spot 混合多个细胞；单核 RNA 测序能分辨细胞类型，却丢失组织位置。本文建立覆盖约 1,500 个小鼠结肠空间切片和约 40 万个单核转录组的图谱，并提出 cSplotch，把 H&amp;E 形态、snRNA-seq 参考、spot 细胞组成和多层实验条件联合起来，估计“某个基因在某种细胞、某个组织区室和某个年龄/区域条件…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Tissue and cellular spatiotemporal dynamics in colon aging Journal: Nature Biotechnology Year: 2025 DOI: 10.1038/s41587-025-02830-6 Code: https://github.</p>

        <h2 aria-label="CuRVE/eFLASH">CuRVE/eFLASH</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Uniform volumetric single-cell processing for organ-scale molecular phenotyping</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇工作解决的不是“抗体能不能进入组织”，而是更严格的问题：在抗体进入厘米尺度完整组织的过程中，怎样让表面细胞和深部细胞始终经历近似相同的化学处理历史。 作者提出 CuRVE（Continuous Redispersion of Volumetric Equilibrium，体积平衡连续再分散）：不要一开始就让反应全速发生，而是把反应强度从“几乎被抑制”缓慢扫到“正常”，每次只改变一点，使运输来得及把不均匀分布的分子重新铺平。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Intact-organ single-cell analysis preserves anatomy and connectivity, but dense tissues create a reaction–transport imbalance: antibodies enter slowly, bind rapidly near the surface and are depleted before the core experiences the same chem…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CytoTRACE2">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CytoTRACE2">CytoTRACE2</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Improved reconstruction of single-cell developmental potential with CytoTRACE 2</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CytoTRACE 2 从单细胞转录组预测“发育潜能”：一方面给出六类标签（分化、单能、寡能、多能、多潜能、全能），另一方面给出 0–1 连续分数，其中 1 更接近全能、0 更接近终末分化。它学习的是由人工整理的潜能标签所定义的绝对标尺，而不是从一批细胞中无监督重建分支、方向或真实谱系。 与 CytoTRACE 1 的数据集内相对排序不同，CytoTRACE 2 试图让不同组织、平台和物种的分数可比较。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">All cells in multicellular organisms are hierarchically organized by developmental potential (potency) — the capacity to differentiate into other cell types.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02857-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CytoTRACE2">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/digitalcytometry/cytotrace2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CytoTRACE2">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cytotrace2-cace9414/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CytoTRACE2">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CytoVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CytoVI">CytoVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CytoVI: Deep generative modeling of antibody-based single cell technologies</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CytoVI 用带 batch/协变量条件的概率 VAE 把不同抗体技术和 panel 投到共享 latent，通过 backbone-only encoder、全 marker decoder 和 masked likelihood 学习缺失蛋白分布，并以 posterior uncertainty 支持插补与临床迁移；结果强度取决于预处理、panel overlap、参考覆盖和批次–生物混杂。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Flow cytometry, mass cytometry (CyTOF), and CITE-seq collectively constitute the most widely used quantitative profiling technologies in immunology, generating billions of single-cell measurements across thousands of patients and studies.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.07.674699" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CytoVI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YosefLab/cytovi-reference-implementation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CytoVI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cytovi-3e097ce5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CytoVI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="DAF-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DAF-seq">DAF-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping single-cell diploid chromatin fiber architectures using DAF-seq</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DAF-seq 的关键想法是：先用双链 DNA 胞嘧啶脱氨酶 SsDddA 给“暴露在外”的胞嘧啶做化学标记，再通过 PCR/WGA 把这些标记永久转换成可测序的 C→T 或 G→A 变化。这样，同一条长 DNA 分子既保留遗传序列，也携带蛋白质占据、核小体保护和染色质开放状态的信息；在单细胞版本 scDAF-seq 中，这些随机标记还可以帮助把扩增产生的重叠读段重新拼回父系/母系、正链/负链四种原始模板。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Gene regulation occurs on individual chromatin fibers within diploid cells, but existing assays generally trade off molecular length, footprint resolution, sequencing depth and single-cell coverage.</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="Deep-STARmap and Deep-RIBOmap">Deep-<wbr>STARmap and Deep-<wbr>RIBOmap</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable spatial single-cell transcriptomics and translatomics in 3D thick tissue blocks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Deep-STARmap 与 Deep-RIBOmap 的真正创新，是用“通用低成本锚定 + RCA 扩增团二次水凝胶加固 + 六轮 SEDAL 解码”把靶向式三维原位转录/转译测量扩展到厚组织和数十万细胞；论文与源码足以支持平台原理和核心图像处理链，但完整复现仍需要研究专用配置、原始图像与下游分析脚本。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most image-based spatial transcriptomics methods are optimized for thin sections, while earlier intact-tissue implementations generally measured relatively small targeted panels, covered restricted fields of view or lacked a matched readout…</p>

        <h2 aria-label="DEFND-seq">DEFND-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable co-sequencing of RNA and DNA from individual nuclei</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">肿瘤中的“细胞状态”和“基因组状态”通常由两套实验分别测量：单细胞 RNA 测序告诉我们细胞正在表达什么，单细胞 DNA 测序告诉我们细胞携带哪些拷贝数变异（CNV）或单核苷酸变异（SNV）。如果两种数据来自不同细胞，就只能在群体层面猜测某个基因组亚克隆对应什么转录表型；理想情况是对同一个细胞同时测 RNA 和 DNA。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA sequencing identifies cell state, whereas single-cell DNA sequencing identifies genomic alterations. Studying both in the same cell is especially valuable in heterogeneous tumors, where a rare genetic subclone may correspond…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="DeST_OT">DeST_<wbr>OT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DeST-OT: Alignment of Spatiotemporal Transcriptomics Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeST-OT 的核心不是“把两张空间图刚性叠起来”，而是在晚期质量必须被解释、早期质量允许增减的约束下，同时权衡跨时间表达相似、分叉/汇聚结构与切片内表达—空间几何。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeST-OT uses semi-relaxed optimal transport with a development-aware objective (doublet + triplet + quartet terms over merged feature-spatial matrices) to align spatial transcriptomics slices across time points, enabling unsupervised infere…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Discovering_State_of_the_Art_Reinforcement_Learning_Algorithms">

        <h2 aria-label="Discovering_State_of_the_Art_Reinforcement_Learning_Algorithms">Discovering_<wbr>State_<wbr>of_<wbr>the_<wbr>Art_<wbr>Reinforcement_<wbr>Learning_<wbr>Algorithms</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Discovering state-of-the-art reinforcement learning algorithms</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统强化学习（RL）通常由人手工决定：智能体应该预测什么、预测目标是什么、策略如何更新，以及不同损失如何组合。已有的自动发现方法往往只搜索少量超参数或局部损失，在简单环境中元学习，容易过拟合，难以替代复杂的手工 RL 系统。本文的目标是让机器直接从大量智能体在复杂环境中的交互经验中，发现一条可以迁移到新环境的 RL 更新规则。 DiscoRL 不让元网络输出一个标量损失，而是让它根据轨迹生成“智能体应该靠近的目标”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most RL algorithms are manually designed: researchers choose prediction semantics, targets, losses, and update schedules. Earlier automated approaches generally searched hyperparameters or a narrow policy-loss space, used small/simple envir…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/google-deepmind/disco_rl" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Discovering_State_of_the_Art_Reinforcement_Learning_Algorithms">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/discovering-state-of-the-art-reinforcement-learning-algorithms-5040af45/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Discovering_State_of_the_Art_Reinforcement_Learning_Algorithms">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="DreaMS">DreaMS</h2>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">LC–MS/MS 每分钟产生大量 tandem mass spectra，但通常不到 10% 能可靠匹配分子结构。传统学习方法主要依赖 MoNA、NIST20 等 annotated libraries，覆盖的分子空间远小于公共仓库中积累的 unannotated spectra。</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="Droplet-Hi-C">Droplet-<wbr>Hi-<wbr>C</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Droplet Hi-C enables scalable, single-cell profiling of chromatin architecture in heterogeneous tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Droplet Hi-C 把传统的原位 Hi-C 近邻连接化学，接到成熟的 10x Genomics 液滴微流控平台上，从而一次测量数万细胞的染色质三维接触；在此基础上，论文又构建了面向正常组织的细胞类型/染色质结构分析，以及面向肿瘤的 CNV、SV、ecDNA 和同细胞 RNA 联合分析。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Chromatin conformation is difficult to measure in heterogeneous tissues at both high throughput and useful per-cell coverage. Bulk Hi-C averages across cell types and tumor clones.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Xieeeee/Droplet-Hi-C" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Droplet-Hi-C">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/droplet-hi-c-20de05df/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Droplet-Hi-C">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="aaai" data-journal-label="AAAI" data-method="DUSTED">

        <h2 aria-label="DUSTED">DUSTED</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DUSTED: Dual-Attention Enhanced Spatial Transcriptomics Denoiser</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DUSTED 先在整张切片上学习每个基因的通道门控，再沿空间邻接图用 GAT 融合 spot 信息，以 NB/ZINB raw-count likelihood 训练均值、离散度和额外零三个输出头，并把经 library-size 校准的预测均值作为去噪表达；算法设计清楚，但当前公开 commit 仍需修复运行 blocker 和补齐外部依赖才能严格复现。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatially Resolved Transcriptomics (SRT) data suffer from technical noise (dropout events, PCR amplification bias, library size variation) that produces sparse gene expression matrices and blurs spatial patterns.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>AAAI · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1609/aaai.v39i1.32110" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DUSTED">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Lifeomics/DUSTED" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DUSTED">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dusted-e44990d9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DUSTED">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 2025 年发表于 Entropy 的文章是一篇综述。它不提出一个名为“DynamicalSystemsscRNAseq”的可运行模型，也没有配套代码。它的贡献是建立一张方法地图：先按数据是否有真实时间、是否有空间坐标分类，再按动力学是离散还是连续、是否随机、是否允许细胞增殖和死亡分类。 因此，下文的公式是统一语言和方法族的代表形式。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="DynaVelo">

        <h2 aria-label="DynaVelo">DynaVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deep dynamical models of single-cell multiomic velocities predict loss-of-function and rescue perturbations in B cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DynaVelo 可以理解为一个面向 single-cell multiome 数据的动态模型：它把同一个细胞里的 RNA 表达和 TF motif accessibility 放进同一个 latent neural ODE 里，学习一个连续的细胞状态变化方向场，然后从这个方向场里导出 RNA velocity、motif velocity、latent time、动态调控网络和扰动预测。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DynaVelo addresses a central limitation of single-cell trajectory analysis: RNA-only velocity estimates are noisy, available for only a subset of genes, and miss chromatin-level TF activity that can drive fate decisions before expression ch…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="E_Values_Expand_Scope_Conformal_Prediction">E_<wbr>Values_<wbr>Expand_<wbr>Scope_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Prediction</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">E-Values Expand the Scope of Conformal Prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统共形预测通常把新样本的 nonconformity score 与校准分数做排序，从而得到 p-value 和固定错误率 \alpha 下的预测集合。这套方法在标准的“一个交换样本、一个预先确定的覆盖率”场景中很好用，但本文关注三个超出这个模板的问题： 数据按批次持续到达，批次之间允许分布变化，而且不知道何时停止；需要所有时间点同时有效，而不只是每一批分别有效。 实际决策只能容纳最多 C 个候选标签；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This 2025 arXiv method paper develops conformal e-prediction as a flexible alternative to conventional rank/p-value conformal prediction. Its key observation is that a normalized positive nonconformity score is an e-variable under exchangea…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2503.13050" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for E_Values_Expand_Scope_Conformal_Prediction">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GauthierE/evalues-expand-cp" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for E_Values_Expand_Scope_Conformal_Prediction">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/e-values-expand-scope-conformal-prediction-f4311c84/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：E_Values_Expand_Scope_Conformal_Prediction">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="EdgeSetAttention">EdgeSetAttention</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">An end-to-end attention-based approach for learning on graphs</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ESA 不把“节点”当作 Transformer token，而把每条边写成一个 token；相邻边（共享端点）先通过带图结构掩码的注意力交换信息，再用无掩码自注意力补充全局联系，最后由一组可学习查询向量把可变长边集合汇总成图级表示。论文的核心不是发明新的注意力公式，而是把图结构变成注意力掩码，并把局部结构先验与全局注意力纵向组合。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Graph neural networks (GNNs) dominate structured data learning but rely on message passing — an iterative, neighbourhood-aggregation scheme — that suffers from over-smoothing (representations blur with depth), over-squashing (information co…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-60252-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for EdgeSetAttention">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/davidbuterez/edge-set-attention" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for EdgeSetAttention">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/edgesetattention-05398b6b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：EdgeSetAttention">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="ESPRESSO">

        <h2 aria-label="ESPRESSO">ESPRESSO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ESPRESSO: spatiotemporal omics based on organelle phenotyping</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ESPRESSO 不是把 RNA、蛋白或代谢物直接测出来，而是把活细胞内四类细胞器的形态、空间关系和功能敏感荧光强度编码成每个细胞的 3,328 维“细胞器表型”，再在连续成像中追踪这些表型如何随空间、时间和处理条件变化。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell and spatial omics provide high-dimensional snapshots but generally do not follow the same living cells through rapid biological transitions.</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="EVA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="EVA">EVA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">EVA: a Foundation Model Advancing Translational Drug Development in Immuno-Inflammation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">免疫与炎症（I&amp;I）药物开发面临一个典型的转化难题：进入临床试验之前，研究者通常只有很少的细胞或动物实验数据，却要判断药物在人类患者中是否有效。论文指出，单个候选药物的临床前队列往往只有 5-10 个个体，而且动物与人类之间存在明显的分布差异（论文第 82-86 行）。 传统的基因调控网络（GRN）和定量系统药理学（QSP）方法需要针对每一种“药物-疾病”组合反复查阅文献、建立机制模型并由专家调参，难以规模化；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">EVA addresses a translational drug-development problem in immune-mediated inflammatory (I&amp;I) diseases: can scarce preclinical perturbation data be used to forecast human treatment effects before expensive phase II/III trials?</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/eva-1ee91643/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：EVA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Extended2DGastruloids">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Extended2DGastruloids">Extended2DGastruloids</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Extended culture of 2D gastruloids to model human mesoderm development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">经典 BMP4 微图案二维 gastruloid 的优点是简单、重复性高，适合活细胞成像和定量扰动；缺点是以往通常只观察到约 42–48 小时，之后组织结构容易失序。因此，我们很难在同一可控体系中研究原条样区域之后的中胚层迁移、分化和空间组织。 本文把培养延长到 10 天，并把实验平台与三类计算分析结合：三维单细胞图像定量、活细胞轨迹分析、单细胞转录组及胚胎参考映射。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Human 2D gastruloids are simple, reproducible, and compatible with quantitative live imaging, but earlier protocols were generally studied only through about two days because organization deteriorated later.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02669-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Extended2DGastruloids">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/idse/extendedgastruloid" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Extended2DGastruloids">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/extended2dgastruloids-f4312eeb/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Extended2DGastruloids">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="acm-ims-journal-of-data-science" data-journal-label="ACM / IMS Journal of Data Science" data-method="Finding_Local_Nash_Equilibria_Zero_Sum_Games">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Finding_Local_Nash_Equilibria_Zero_Sum_Games">Finding_<wbr>Local_<wbr>Nash_<wbr>Equilibria_<wbr>Zero_<wbr>Sum_<wbr>Games</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">On Finding Local Nash Equilibria (and Only Local Nash Equilibria) in Zero-Sum Games</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究的是光滑、但可以非凸–非凹的双人零和连续博弈。玩家 1 调整 x 以最小化 f(x,y)，玩家 2 调整 y 以最大化同一个函数。最自然的算法是同时梯度下降–上升： 其中 z=(x,y)。 问题是，“动力系统稳定”不等于“博弈意义上正确”。一个微分 Nash 均衡需要 也就是每个玩家沿自己的变量方向都没有单边改进空间。然而，普通梯度动力学可能把一个不满足这些二阶条件的驻点变成吸引子。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Gradient descent–ascent in a smooth two-player zero-sum game can converge to a stationary point that is dynamically stable but is not locally optimal for both players.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ACM / IMS Journal of Data Science · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1145/3728479" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Finding_Local_Nash_Equilibria_Zero_Sum_Games">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/finding-local-nash-equilibria-zero-sum-games-cb318dee/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Finding_Local_Nash_Equilibria_Zero_Sum_Games">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="FISHnet">

        <h2 aria-label="FISHnet">FISHnet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">FISHnet: detecting chromatin domains in single-cell sequential Oligopaints imaging data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FISHnet 不是在单一阈值上寻找一条“最佳边界”，而是在多个物理距离尺度上反复做图社区发现，并用随机重复共识 + 相邻阈值平台稳定性筛出可信的多尺度结构域区间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sequential Oligopaints imaging measures genome folding at single-allele resolution and produces pairwise physical-distance matrices between ordered genomic loci.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/RohanpatelUpenn/FISHnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FISHnet">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/fishnet-303ee55b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FISHnet">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="deconvolution_mapping" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="FlashDeconv">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Deconvolution</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="FlashDeconv">FlashDeconv</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">FlashDeconv enables atlas-scale, multi-resolution spatial deconvolution via structure-preserving sketching</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FlashDeconv 要回答的是：每个空间测量 bin 中，各细胞类型分别占多少。它先从空间数据和单细胞参考中挑出有用基因，再把数千个基因随机压缩到默认 512 个特征，在压缩空间中求带空间平滑和稀疏约束的非负回归。关键卖点不是一种新的概率生成模型，而是用 leverage score 加权 CountSketch 与稀疏邻接图，把主要计算量做成对 bin 数 N 近似线性增长。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FlashDeconv 是面向超大空间转录组的参考型细胞组成解卷积：它以 HVG 与参考 marker 选基因，以 leverage 加权 CountSketch 压缩基因轴，再用稀疏空间图正则化的非负回归估计每个 bin 的连续细胞类型比例。固定细胞类型数、邻居数和 sketch 维度时，迭代成本随 bin 数近似线性。 论文在 Spotless 合成基准中报告平均 Pearson 0.944，并在 M2 Max 上报告百万级 bin 的分钟级运行；</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.12.22.696108" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for FlashDeconv">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cafferychen777/flashdeconv" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FlashDeconv">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/flashdeconv-6d553648/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FlashDeconv">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="Functional_Protein_Mining_Conformal_Guarantees">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Functional_Protein_Mining_Conformal_Guarantees">Functional_<wbr>Protein_<wbr>Mining_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Guarantees</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Functional protein mining with conformal guarantees</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Protein-Vec、CLEAN、Foldseek 等模型能够给蛋白对打分，但“分数很高”不等于“功能一定相同”，更不能告诉实验人员应该保留多少候选。本文的核心不是训练一个新蛋白模型，而是在任意现有打分模型之后增加一个校准与风险控制层：用户先指定可以接受的错误，例如 10% 假发现率，再由独立校准集自动求出阈值。 输入：查询蛋白 Q、检索数据库 D、模型分数 S{ij}、带真实标签的校准查询，以及风险容忍度 \alpha。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Protein embedding and structure-search systems can rank millions of candidates quickly, but their raw scores do not tell a biologist which proteins are safe to characterize or how much error a returned set contains. Boger et al.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-55676-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Functional_Protein_Mining_Conformal_Guarantees">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ronboger/conformal-protein-retrieval" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Functional_Protein_Mining_Conformal_Guarantees">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/functional-protein-mining-conformal-guarantees-dc2d7df8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Functional_Protein_Mining_Conformal_Guarantees">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="FX-Cell">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="FX-Cell">FX-<wbr>Cell</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">FX-Cell: a method for single-cell RNA sequencing on difficult-to-digest and cryopreserved plant samples</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FX-Cell 的核心不是“把传统原生质体法的温度调高”，而是先用 Farmer’s solution 固定植物组织，让细胞在更强的机械扰动和更高效的细胞壁消化条件下仍保持形态；再通过 GMP-Sepharose/agarose 去除消化酶中的真菌 RNase，并用 tRNA 与 tri-GMP 继续保护 RNA，最终得到可用于 scRNA-seq 的固定单细胞悬液。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Plant scRNA-seq normally requires live protoplasts, but many cell walls resist enzymatic digestion. Fresh protoplasting also ties sampling to an equipped laboratory and takes 1–2 h, long enough to induce wound/stress transcription.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02900-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for FX-Cell">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/WangLab-CEMPS/Xin_Ming_FX_Cell" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FX-Cell">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/fx-cell-41e26bf1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FX-Cell">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="GASTON">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GASTON">GASTON</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping the topography of spatial gene expression with interpretable deep learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GASTON 从空间坐标预测低维表达特征，并强制网络中间只有一个标量瓶颈 d(x,y)。这个标量叫 isodepth：它像地形图的海拔，同一等值线上的远距离位置可以共享相似表达状态。随后方法沿 isodepth 用动态规划切出空间域，再为每个基因在每个域内拟合 Poisson 分段线性函数，从而同时描述域边界处的跳变和域内部的连续梯度。 本文依据本地论文 outputpapermd/paper/auto/paper.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">本文档基于 outputpapermd/paper/auto/paper.md 中的论文正文，以及本地 GASTON/ 源码整理。论文题目为 Mapping the topography of spatial gene expression with interpretable deep learning，发表于 Nature Methods (2025)。</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02503-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GASTON">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/GASTON" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GASTON">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gaston-926d25d7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GASTON">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="GASTON-Mix">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GASTON-Mix">GASTON-<wbr>Mix</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GASTON-Mix: a unified model of spatial gradients and domains using spatial mixture-of-experts</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GASTON-Mix 不再要求整张组织共享一把“深度尺”。它先用空间门控网络把每个位置分给一个区域，再让每个区域的专家网络学习自己的标量等深度 dp(x,y)；区域内每个基因只需沿这把局部深度尺做线性变化。这样，区域边界与区域内连续梯度可以在同一个模型中联合表示。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Tissues are spatially organized at two levels simultaneously: Discrete spatial domains — regions with distinct cell type composition (e.g., brain anatomical regions, tumor clones).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btaf254" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GASTON-Mix">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/GASTON-Mix" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GASTON-Mix">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gaston-mix-928475bd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GASTON-Mix">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="GeneAgent">

        <h2 aria-label="GeneAgent">GeneAgent</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GeneAgent: self-verification language agent for gene-set analysis using domain databases</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">基因集分析的目标，是给一组看起来共同发挥作用的基因找到一个合适的生物学功能解释。传统的 GSEA 等富集分析依赖 GO、MSigDB 等人工整理数据库，优点是证据清楚，缺点是常常只能返回已有的数据库术语；如果一个基因集只和已知功能弱相关，传统方法就不容易给出新的、可解释的功能命名。普通 LLM 可以根据背景知识生成更自然的功能名称和分析文字，但也可能编造看似合理、实际没有证据支持的内容，即 hallucination。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GeneAgent addresses a common problem in gene-set analysis: LLMs can produce useful biological process names and explanatory narratives, but they may also hallucinate plausible claims that are not supported by curated biological knowledge.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02748-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GeneAgent">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/idekerlab/llm_evaluation_for_gene_set_interpretation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GeneAgent">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/geneagent-8f530d74/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GeneAgent">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="GeneJepa">

        <h2 aria-label="GeneJepa">GeneJepa</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GeneJepa: A Predictive World Model of the Transcriptome</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序把一个细胞表示成高维、稀疏、带有大量技术噪声的基因表达向量。许多单细胞基础模型沿用语言模型思路：把基因和离散化后的表达量变成 token，再通过掩码重建或生成目标学习表示。论文认为这种做法存在三个结构性问题： 精确重建 count 会让模型过度关注 dropout、测序深度和实验批次等低层统计； 一个细胞中表达的基因本质上是集合，不存在自然的单词顺序； 表达量分箱会损失连续定量信息。</p>
        </div>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GeneJepa is a 2025 bioRxiv preprint proposing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) pretraining for single-cell RNA sequencing. Instead of reconstructing noisy counts or predicting masked gene tokens, it predicts the latent represe…</p>
        </div>

        </footer>

        <h2 aria-label="GeneMamba">GeneMamba</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GeneMamba: An Efficient and Effective Foundation Model on Single Cell Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序把每个细胞表示成一个高维、稀疏的基因表达向量。基于 Transformer 的模型在长基因序列上有二次复杂度；单向序列模型又只能看到一个方向的上下文。GeneMamba 的目标是用线性扩展的状态空间模型处理长序列，同时保留基因之间的生物学关系。 论文把“细胞”看作句子，把“基因”看作 token。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq foundation models must represent thousands of sparse gene measurements per cell while retaining biological relationships and scaling to tens of millions of cells.</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="Generalization_Hallucination_Out_of_Context_Reasoning_Transformers">Generalization_<wbr>Hallucination_<wbr>Out_<wbr>of_<wbr>Context_<wbr>Reasoning_<wbr>Transformers</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Generalization or Hallucination? Understanding Out-of-Context Reasoning in Transformers</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">给模型注入一条新事实后，它有时能推出正确的新结论，有时却会生成看似合理但错误的关联。这篇论文把二者统一为 out-of-context reasoning（OCR，上下文外推理）：模型从若干“桥接实体”学到两个关系之间的对应，再把这个对应迁移到只见过第一个关系的新实体上。 例如，训练中出现 Alice–法国、Alice–法语，以及 Raul–法国，模型回答 Raul–法语，是有现实依据的泛化；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Factual fine-tuning can make a language model infer useful consequences of new facts, but it can also produce confident false associations. This NeurIPS 2025 paper unifies both effects as out-of-context reasoning (OCR): transferring a relat…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="Glimmer">

        <h2 aria-label="Glimmer">Glimmer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Energy-Regularized Graph Learning for Multiscale Spatial Representation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Glimmer 不直接训练一个深度网络去“生成”空间表示，而是在物理空间的 k 近邻骨架上，为每个点的每条邻边学习权重，再用这些权重平滑原始分子特征。它试图在两种失败之间找到可调的中间态：只看表达会产生空间上破碎的“椒盐”聚类，只看距离又会把相邻但功能不同的细胞过度混合。 论文把这一框架用于两个尺度：组织尺度的空间区域识别，以及把 Xenium 转录本先聚合为小空间 bin、再做细胞尺度聚类的“无预先分割”分析。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Glimmer is an unsupervised spatial-omics representation method that learns edge weights on a physical k-nearest-neighbor scaffold. It targets the trade-off between expression-only embeddings, which can fragment tissue into spatially incoher…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="GNN_singlecell_review">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GNN_singlecell_review">GNN_<wbr>singlecell_<wbr>review</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Graph neural networks for single-cell omics data: a review of approaches and applications</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇综述收集了 107 篇 GNN 单细胞应用，覆盖六类变体、五类组学和 77 个常用公开数据集。最重要的主线不是背诵 100 多个方法名，而是回答三个问题： 什么被当作节点？细胞、基因、peak、空间 spot、蛋白还是多种对象？ 什么关系被画成边？相似性、空间邻接、共表达、PPI、GRN、配体–受体还是跨组学先验？ 消息传播后的表示用来做什么？插补、聚类、注释、网络推断、整合或预测？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">本文系统整理图神经网络在单细胞组学中的应用，覆盖 107 篇方法论文、六类常见 GNN 变体和 77 个常用公开数据集。范围横跨单细胞表观组、转录组、空间转录组、蛋白组及多组学，任务包括插补、降维、聚类/注释、空间域识别、调控与细胞通讯推断、扰动预测、解卷积和跨模态整合。 综述最有价值的洞见不是“GNN 普遍优于非 GNN”，而是图构建本身就是模型假设：kNN 相似图、空间邻接、PPI/GRN/配体–受体先验或异构 guidance graph 会决定信息能传播到哪里。</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbaf109" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GNN_singlecell_review">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gnn-singlecell-review-555e64bc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GNN_singlecell_review">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="deconvolution_mapping" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="gnSPADE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Deconvolution</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="gnSPADE">gnSPADE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">gnSPADE: a reference-free deconvolution method incorporating gene network structures in spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">gnSPADE 把空间转录组的每个 spot 当成一篇“文档”、把 UMI count 展开成重复出现的“基因词元”，用 LDA topic 表示潜在细胞类型；它在 Gibbs 采样条件概率中再乘一个基因网络 MRF 项，鼓励同一 spot 内互为网络邻居的基因被分到同一 topic。输出的 spot×topic 矩阵解释为细胞类型比例，topic×gene 矩阵解释为潜在细胞类型的表达谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies such as 10x Visium and DBiT-seq profile gene expression at multicellular resolution, where each captured spot contains a mixture of cell types.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.08.26.672457" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for gnSPADE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Cui-STT-Lab/gnSPADE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for gnSPADE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gnspade-5acc37a9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：gnSPADE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="journal-of-machine-learning-research-26-305-1-68" data-journal-label="Journal of Machine Learning Research 26(305):1-68" data-method="Gradient_Equilibrium_Online_Learning_Theory_Applications">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Gradient_Equilibrium_Online_Learning_Theory_Applications">Gradient_<wbr>Equilibrium_<wbr>Online_<wbr>Learning_<wbr>Theory_<wbr>Applications</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Gradient Equilibrium in Online Learning: Theory and Applications</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统在线学习通常问“累计损失相对最佳固定决策是否具有次线性遗憾”。这篇论文提出另一条轴线：沿实际更新轨迹观察到的梯度，长期平均后能否相互抵消？作者称之为梯度均衡（gradient equilibrium, GEQ）： GEQ 与无遗憾并不互相蕴含。它关注的是一阶平衡条件，而不是累计损失最优性，因此特别适合把“无偏”“覆盖率正确”“分组残差为零”等统计目标写成在线算法的直接保证。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This JMLR 2025 method paper introduces gradient equilibrium (GEQ) as an online-learning target: the average gradient evaluated along the learner&#x27;s actual iterates converges to zero.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Machine Learning Research 26(305):1-68 · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/aangelopoulos/gradient-equilibrium" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Gradient_Equilibrium_Online_Learning_Theory_Applications">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gradient-equilibrium-online-learning-theory-applications-929b044c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Gradient_Equilibrium_Online_Learning_Theory_Applications">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Graph ODEs and Beyond">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
