        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Graph ODEs and Beyond">Graph ODEs and Beyond</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Graph ODEs and Beyond: A Comprehensive Survey on Integrating Differential Equations with Graph Neural Networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇 Graph Neural Differential Equations（Graph NDEs）综述，不提出单一新模型。它把“图神经网络怎样与 ODE、PDE、SDE 结合”整理成一张选择地图：任务是什么、图如何随空间/时间构造、微分方程描述哪种动力学、GNN 在系统中扮演什么角色，以及不同组合解决哪些困难。 Graph NDE 的共同形式是让图上状态 H(t) 沿连续变量演化： t 可以是真实时间，也可以是连续化的网络深度。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The review identifies five directions: discovering explicit graph differential equations, handling sparsity and sporadic observations, scaling to large dynamic graphs, modeling continuously changing graph topology, and integrating multi-sca…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2503.23167" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Graph ODEs and Beyond">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Emory-Melody/Awesome-Graph-NDEs" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Graph ODEs and Beyond">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/graph-odes-and-beyond-5295276d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Graph ODEs and Beyond">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="GraphVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GraphVelo">GraphVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GraphVelo allows for accurate inference of multimodal velocities and molecular mechanisms for single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GraphVelo 学到的不是一个全局神经网络，而是每个细胞在局部邻居位移基上的速度系数；它用流形几何约束修正上游 RNA velocity，再在共享邻域结构的其他表示中复用这组系数。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity — estimating the rate of gene expression change from spliced/unspliced transcript ratios — enables reconstruction of cellular dynamics from snapshot single-cell data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-62784-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GraphVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xing-lab-pitt/GraphVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GraphVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/graphvelo-befedfce/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GraphVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="gsMap">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="gsMap">gsMap</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatially resolved mapping of cells associated with human complex traits</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">gsMap 先用空间图与表达学习同质微域，以 rank 聚合得到每个位置的基因特异性，再把这些空间变化的基因权重映射到 SNP 和 LD score，最后用条件 S-LDSC 判断哪个 spot 富集某性状的遗传信号，并用 Cauchy 组合汇总区域证据。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Spatially resolved mapping of cells associated with human complex traits Authors: Liyang Song, Wenhao Chen, Junren Hou, Minmin Guo &amp; Jian Yang Journal: Nature (2025) DOI: https://doi.org/10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-08757-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for gsMap">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JianYang-Lab/gsMap" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for gsMap">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gsmap-647b1248/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：gsMap">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="deconvolution_mapping" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nucleic-acids-research" data-journal-label="Nucleic Acids Research" data-method="gwSPADE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Deconvolution</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="gwSPADE">gwSPADE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">gwSPADE: gene frequency-weighted reference-free deconvolution in spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">gwSPADE 把一个空间 spot 看作多种潜在细胞类型的混合，把基因看作主题模型中的“词”。它与普通 LDA 的关键区别不是增加空间邻接关系，也不是引入单细胞参考，而是先计算基因权重，再让这些权重改变 Gibbs 采样时的计数：广泛、高频但区分度低的基因影响减弱，集中于少数潜在类型的基因影响增强。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies such as 10x Visium capture gene expression at multicellular resolution, where each spatial spot contains a mixture of 5–50 cells of potentially different types.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nucleic Acids Research · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaf966" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for gwSPADE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Cui-STT-Lab/gwSPADE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for gwSPADE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gwspade-e5df30fc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：gwSPADE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="HEtoSGEBench">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HEtoSGEBench">HEtoSGEBench</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Benchmarking the translational potential of spatial gene expression prediction from histology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HEtoSGEBench 的重要信息是：H&amp;E 图像确实包含可用于预测部分空间基因表达的信息，但复杂模型并不天然更好；论文指出包含更多组件的复杂 deep-learning 架构并未在整体上优于简单方法，并且存在过拟合到染色/非生物图像模式的风险。因此，未来方法不仅要提高 spot-level accuracy，还要证明跨数据泛化、临床效用、可复现性和可用性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Communications paper benchmarks whether spatial gene expression (SGE) can be predicted from routine H&amp;E histology with enough reliability to be useful beyond the original spatial-transcriptomics experiments.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-56618-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for HEtoSGEBench">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SydneyBioX/HEtoSGEBench" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for HEtoSGEBench">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/hetosgebench-57faa887/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：HEtoSGEBench">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="HiRef">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HiRef">HiRef</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Hierarchical Refinement: Optimal Transport to Infinity and Beyond</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HiRef（Hierarchical Refinement）用一连串小规模低秩最优传输问题，逐层把两个等大小点集切成互相对应的块，直到每个块只剩一对点，从而得到一对一的 Monge 映射。它避免保存完整的 n\times n 代价或耦合矩阵，在适用的代价分解与秩计划下实现线性空间和近 O(n\log n) 时间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Optimal transport is a principled method for aligning cell populations across time points, conditions, or biological replicates in single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2503.03025" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for HiRef">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/HiRef" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for HiRef">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/hiref-a4e077a3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：HiRef">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="HM-OT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HM-OT">HM-<wbr>OT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Learning Latent Trajectories in Developmental Time Series with Hidden-Markov Optimal Transport</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">多时间点单细胞或空间转录组给出的是不同细胞群的快照。传统流程常先在每个时间点独立聚类，再对相邻时间点做 cell-to-cell optimal transport，最后把细胞耦合汇总成 cluster transitions。这样会有两个问题：每个时间点的聚类没有利用前后时间信息；单独得到的相邻耦合也不保证形成一致的长时间轨迹。 HM-OT 把两件事放进同一个目标： 每个时间点的细胞属于哪些 latent cell types；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">A central challenge in developmental biology is reconstructing the Waddington differentiation landscape: which cell types exist at each developmental stage, and which cell type at time t gives rise to which cell type at time t+1?</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="HuBMAP_3D_Human_Reference_Atlas">

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">人体图谱并不只是“收集很多单细胞数据”。真正困难的是：不同团队研究不同器官、采用不同实验技术、使用不同细胞命名和空间坐标，得到的数据彼此难以对齐。已有参考系往往只覆盖单个器官，例如 Waxholm Space 是发表于 Nature Methods 2023 的脑三维图谱；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Human tissue atlases often use organ- or project-specific coordinates, vocabularies and processing pipelines. Waxholm Space, for example, is a 3D brain atlas reported in Nature Methods (2023), while colon work has used a one-dimensional dis…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="HumanEarlyEmbryoReference">HumanEarlyEmbryoReference</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A comprehensive human embryo reference tool using single-cell RNA-sequencing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作把多个稀缺的人类早期胚胎单细胞数据集整理成稳定参考，并通过“邻域聚合 + 重复 MNN + 固定参考投射 + 20D SVM + 多重拒识”把新数据映射到该参考，从而以全转录组证据审查胚胎模型的谱系身份和发育阶段，同时明确保留对参考缺失、稀有群体和混淆谱系的不确定性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Stem-cell-derived embryo models are increasingly used to study stages of human development that are difficult to access experimentally. Their value depends on whether the cells they produce genuinely resemble in vivo embryonic lineages and…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-immunology" data-journal-label="Nature Immunology" data-method="HumanImmuneAging_Atlas">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HumanImmuneAging_Atlas">HumanImmuneAging_<wbr>Atlas</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multimodal profiling reveals tissue-directed signatures of human immune cells altered with age</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项研究用 CITE-seq 同时测量同一免疫细胞的 RNA 和 127 种表面蛋白，在 24 位器官捐献者、14 个组织部位中建立 128 万细胞的图谱。分析先用多模态标志物精细区分免疫亚群，再用配对供体的跨组织设计把“组织效应”与“年龄效应”分开，最后通过 pseudobulk 混合模型、基因程序分解和 MrVI 反事实预测，定位只在特定组织和细胞状态中出现的衰老变化。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: The mammalian immune system is distributed across blood and multiple tissue sites (lymphoid organs, mucosal barriers), yet most human immunology studies focus on peripheral blood.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Immunology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41590-025-02241-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for HumanImmuneAging_Atlas">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YosefLab/CZI-Immuneaging" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for HumanImmuneAging_Atlas">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/humanimmuneaging-atlas-f67a65e0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：HumanImmuneAging_Atlas">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="IDA-Bench">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="IDA-Bench">IDA-<wbr>Bench</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">IDA-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Interactive Guided Data Analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">IDA-Bench 研究的不是“LLM 能不能一次写出一段正确代码”，而是更接近真实数据分析的问题：当领域专家根据中间结果逐步提供知识、修改要求或纠正方向时，LLM Agent 能否持续记住上下文、正确执行代码、服从新指导，并最终交付合格的分析结果。 这不是生物信息学论文。它属于通用 LLM Agent 与数据分析 benchmark，任务涉及制造、商业、心理、天气、传统 NLP 等多种表格预测场景。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most data-science benchmarks give an agent one static task, even though real analysis is iterative: experts inspect intermediate results, reveal domain knowledge, revise feature choices, and correct the analyst as the workflow develops.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2505.18223" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for IDA-Bench">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lhydave/IDA-Bench" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for IDA-Bench">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ida-bench-998236ce/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：IDA-Bench">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cancer-discovery" data-journal-label="Cancer Discovery" data-method="IN-DEPTH">

        <h2 aria-label="IN-DEPTH">IN-<wbr>DEPTH</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Same-Slide Spatial Multi-Omics Integration with IN-DEPTH Reveals Tumor Virus-Linked Spatial Reorganization of the Tumor Microenvironment</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">IN-DEPTH（IN-situ DEtailed Phenotyping To High-resolution transcriptomics）不是一种新的测序仪，而是一套“先在同一张 FFPE 切片上做高通量空间蛋白成像，再在原切片上做空间转录组”的实验与分析框架。它首先用蛋白标记确定细胞身份和组织结构，再把这些空间信息传递给 GeoMx、Visium HD、CosMx 或 Xenium 等转录组平台；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Tissues are spatially organized ecosystems where cell composition, neighbor identity, and position jointly determine function. While spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics have each individually transformed tissue biology, combining…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cancer Discovery · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1158/2159-8290.CD-25-0775" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for IN-DEPTH">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SizunJiangLab/IN-DEPTH" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for IN-DEPTH">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/in-depth-3114145d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：IN-DEPTH">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="IndiSeek">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="IndiSeek">IndiSeek</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">IndiSeek learns information-guided disentangled representations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">IndiSeek 用对方模态的 shared 表示来清除本模态 specific 表示中的公共信息，再用本模态 shared+specific 重建防止信息被删光；它改善了独立性—完整性权衡，但没有公开代码时，优化细节和统计可识别性必须保持为复现边界。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell multi-omics technologies like CITE-seq (Stoeckius et al., 2017, Nature Methods, 14:865) simultaneously measure multiple molecular readouts per cell — RNA (transcriptome) and ADT (surface proteins) in the CITE-seq case.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2509.21584" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for IndiSeek">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/indiseek-f1e34ccf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：IndiSeek">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="InfMasking">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="InfMasking">InfMasking</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">InfMasking: Unleashing Synergistic Information by Contrastive Multimodal Interactions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">InfMasking 是一种面向多模态“协同信息”的对比学习方法：它不只要求图像、文本、音频等单模态表示彼此一致，而是反复遮住融合 token 的大部分内容，让完整融合表示与许多不同残缺视图保持可辨认的对应关系。有限数量的 masked views 用来估计均值与协方差，再通过 Gaussian 矩母函数得到可训练的近似损失。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multimodal learning methods like CLIP [ICML 2021] and ALIGN [ICML 2021] rely on the multi-view redundancy assumption: each modality independently contains all task-relevant information, so maximizing their agreement suffices.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2509.25270" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for InfMasking">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/brightest66/InfMasking" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for InfMasking">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/infmasking-066099b0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：InfMasking">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="journal-of-machine-learning-research" data-journal-label="Journal of Machine Learning Research" data-method="Instability_Computational_Efficiency_Statistical_Accuracy">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Instability_Computational_Efficiency_Statistical_Accuracy">Instability_<wbr>Computational_<wbr>Efficiency_<wbr>Statistical_<wbr>Accuracy</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Instability, Computational Efficiency and Statistical Accuracy</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">许多统计估计量不是一次算出来的，而是反复应用样本算子 Fn： 总体算子 F 表示无限样本时的理想更新，\theta^\star 是其不动点。有限样本使 Fn 偏离 F。论文关心两个问题：迭代多少次才能到达统计误差下限？一个对样本扰动“不稳定”的算法，是否仍可能比稳定算法更值得使用？ 第一轴是总体算法的收敛速度：FAST(\kappa) 表示几何收敛，误差近似按 \kappa^t 下降；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This JMLR 2025 theory paper studies iterative statistical estimators as empirical fixed-point maps Fn. Standard population-to-sample analyses mainly cover stable algorithms.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Machine Learning Research · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2005.11411" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Instability_Computational_Efficiency_Statistical_Accuracy">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/instability-computational-efficiency-statistical-accuracy-18b58cdb/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Instability_Computational_Efficiency_Statistical_Accuracy">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="InterVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="InterVelo">InterVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">InterVelo: a mutually enhancing model for estimating pseudotime and RNA velocity in multi-omic single-cell data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">InterVelo 用一条潜在 neural-ODE 轨迹给全部基因提供共享的细胞时间，再用可变转录率的剪接动力学和 Euler 重建将 velocity 信息反馈给排序；它的强项是时间—速度共学习，而主要边界是单轨迹/batch ODE 近似、事后方向选择和若干纸—码损失差异。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: InterVelo: a mutually enhancing model for estimating pseudotime and RNA velocity in multi-omic single-cell data Journal: Bioinformatics 41(10), 2025 DOI: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btaf500 GitHub: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btaf500" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for InterVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/yurouwang-rosie/InterVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for InterVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/intervelo-1f1f2849/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：InterVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/perturbation_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="InVivoMultimodalPerturbation">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Perturbation Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="InVivoMultimodalPerturbation">InVivoMultimodalPerturbation</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Perturb-Multimodal: A platform for pooled genetic screens with imaging and sequencing in intact mammalian tissue</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Perturb-Multimodal（Perturb-Multi）要解决的是一个功能基因组学中的核心问题：在真实组织环境里，一个基因扰动到底如何改变细胞的转录状态、蛋白/RNA 强度、亚细胞形态和空间位置关系？ 传统 Perturb-seq 可以用单细胞测序大规模读出扰动后的转录组变化，但通常需要把组织解离成细胞悬液，因此会丢失空间结构、细胞形态和蛋白定位信息。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Perturb-Multimodal, or Perturb-Multi, addresses the problem of measuring how genetic perturbations alter cell state inside intact tissue. Standard pooled perturbation screens can scale through sequencing, but they usually lose spatial organ…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2025.05.022" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for InVivoMultimodalPerturbation">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/weallen/InVivoMultimodalPerturbation" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for InVivoMultimodalPerturbation">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/invivomultimodalperturbation-b00746cc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：InVivoMultimodalPerturbation">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="iSCALE">

        <h2 aria-label="iSCALE">iSCALE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scaling up spatial transcriptomics for large-sized tissues: uncovering cellular-level tissue architecture beyond conventional platforms with iSCALE</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">iSCALE 用少量、局部测量的空间转录组子区域作为训练数据，再借助整张大组织的 H&amp;E 图像，把基因表达预测扩展到未测量区域，最终得到整张切片上约细胞尺度（8 μm × 8 μm）的表达图、组织分区和细胞类型注释。 论文：Scaling up spatial transcriptomics for large-sized tissues: uncovering cellular-level tissue architecture be…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics platforms directly measure only limited tissue areas. Standard Visium provides whole-transcriptome coverage but uses spot-level measurements and a 6.5 mm × 6.</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="JDRnet">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="JDRnet">JDRnet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Gene regulatory network integration with multi-omics data enhances survival predictions in cancer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">JDRnet 不是一种新的 GRN 推断器，也不是一种新的生存模型。它是一条组合式分析流程：先用 PANDA–LIONESS 为每位患者构建转录因子到靶基因的加权网络，把整张网络压缩成基因入度和转录因子出度，再把这两类网络特征连同表达、甲基化和 miRNA 一起送入 MOFA+，最后比较加入网络前后是否出现更显著、且可解释的生存相关潜因子。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;Gene regulatory network integration with multi-omics data enhances survival predictions in cancer&quot; Authors: Romana T. Pop, Ping-Han Hsieh, Tatiana Belova, Anthony Mathelier, Marieke L.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbaf315" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for JDRnet">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kuijjerlab/JDRnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for JDRnet">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/jdrnet-6ffcd8a3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：JDRnet">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Krakencoder">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Krakencoder">Krakencoder</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Krakencoder: a unified brain connectome translation and fusion tool</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">同一个人的脑连接组会因为模态（结构 SC、功能 FC）、脑区模板、纤维追踪算法、去噪方式和相关性估计方法而形成许多不同“口味”。传统方法通常只学习一个方向，例如 SC→FC，或只处理固定模板，难以在研究间转换，也无法把多种观测融合成统一表征。 Krakencoder 的核心假设是：这些连接组是同一潜在脑网络的不同视角。因此，每种口味拥有独立编码器和解码器，但共享一个 128 维潜在空间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Krakencoder is a joint translation and fusion model for brain connectomes. It addresses the fact that structural versus functional imaging, atlas choice, tractography, denoising, and connectivity estimator all produce incompatible “flavors…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kjamison/krakencoder" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Krakencoder">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/krakencoder-8ee2bcbc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Krakencoder">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="the-annals-of-applied-statistics" data-journal-label="The Annals of Applied Statistics" data-method="Learn_Then_Test_Risk_Control">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Learn_Then_Test_Risk_Control">Learn_<wbr>Then_<wbr>Test_<wbr>Risk_<wbr>Control</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Learn then test: Calibrating predictive algorithms to achieve risk control</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">一个已经训练好的模型通常还需要设置阈值：分类器何时拒答、预测集合放多少标签、分割掩膜从什么概率开始保留。直接在验证集上选表现最好的阈值，只能说明样本内效果好，不能保证部署后的总体错误率一定低于用户指定的上限。 Learn Then Test（LTT）在不重新训练基础模型的情况下，用一份独立同分布的校准数据，为这些后处理参数提供显式的有限样本风险保证。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Modern predictors often expose post-processing choices—classification thresholds, abstention rules, prediction-set sizes, mask thresholds—but ordinary validation does not certify that the chosen setting obeys an explicit population risk lim…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>The Annals of Applied Statistics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1214/24-AOAS1998" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Learn_Then_Test_Risk_Control">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/aangelopoulos/ltt" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Learn_Then_Test_Risk_Control">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/learn-then-test-risk-control-feb2efd7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Learn_Then_Test_Risk_Control">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="LifetimeHematopoiesis">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="LifetimeHematopoiesis">LifetimeHematopoiesis</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">The dynamics of hematopoiesis over the human lifespan</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文最重要的认识是：人类 HSC 在一生中并不是简单地从“多能”线性走向“髓系偏向”，而是在“偏向某一条谱系的强度”和“同时访问全部谱系程序的总程度”两个不同维度上重排；胎儿 HSC 总体程序开放、单谱系偏向较弱，老年 HSC 总体预激活较低、但单谱系偏向更强。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Human hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells (HSPCs) must change their lineage output as physiological demands shift from fetal development through childhood, adulthood and aging.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/lifetimehematopoiesis-36d0d4ea/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：LifetimeHematopoiesis">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="LSGI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="LSGI">LSGI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">LSGI: interpretable spatial gradient analysis for spatial transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">LSGI（Local Spatial Gradient Inference）把组织切成大量重叠的局部邻域，在每个邻域内用空间坐标解释一个基因程序的活性。如果局部线性回归的 R^2 足够高，就认为该处存在空间转录梯度；两个坐标系数则组成一支指向程序活性升高方向的箭头。 它回答三个问题：梯度在哪里、指向哪里、由什么分子程序解释。它不是空间域聚类，也不是从一个全局轴推断连续轨迹。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Tumor tissues display spatial transcriptional gradients (STGs): cells at different tissue locations express different gene programs due to local microenvironmental signals (oxygen gradients, pH, metabolites, cell-cell signaling).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03716-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for LSGI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/qingnanl/LSGI" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for LSGI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/lsgi-02c9689a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：LSGI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Genetics" data-method="LymphomaSpatial">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="LymphomaSpatial">LymphomaSpatial</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multi-modal spatial characterization of tumor immune microenvironments identifies targetable inflammatory niches in diffuse large B cell lymphoma</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Nature Genetics 2025 论文研究弥漫性大 B 细胞淋巴瘤（DLBCL）的肿瘤免疫微环境如何在组织空间中组织起来，以及这种空间组织如何影响 T 细胞、肿瘤 B 细胞和细胞间通讯。论文分析了 78 个大 B 细胞淋巴瘤样本和 5 个正常对照，结合 CosMx 单细胞空间转录组、CODEX 空间蛋白组、全外显子测序和 bulk RNA-seq [paper.md:1-12], [paper.md:33-44]。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Genetics 2025 study uses multimodal spatial profiling to map diffuse large B cell lymphoma (DLBCL) tumor immune microenvironments.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02353-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for LymphomaSpatial">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Coolgenome/Lymphoma-spatial" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for LymphomaSpatial">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/lymphomaspatial-2999e2bd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：LymphomaSpatial">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Macaca30TissueAging">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Macaca30TissueAging">Macaca30TissueAging</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A multi-omics molecular landscape of 30 tissues in aging female rhesus macaques</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">人体衰老并不是所有器官同步发生，但很难从同一个人获得几十种组织，因此人类全身组织衰老规律一直缺少系统证据。以往非人灵长类研究也大多局限于单个组织或单一组学。本文利用 17 只 3–27 岁的雌性恒河猴，采集 30 种实体组织，同时测量转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组，目标是回答：哪些衰老信号跨组织共享，哪些组织衰老更快，以及这种差异是否与翻译后调控有关。 输入是四个年龄阶段的横断面样本：幼年 5 只、青年 5 只、中年 3 只、老年 4 只。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Human tissue aging is difficult to study systematically because matched samples from many organs across a wide age range are rarely available. Earlier nonhuman-primate studies generally focused on one tissue or one omics layer.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02912-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Macaca30TissueAging">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GonghuaLi/Macaca_30tissue_aging" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Macaca30TissueAging">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/macaca30tissueaging-220106dd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Macaca30TissueAging">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="MAIL">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MAIL">MAIL</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Online Decision-Making in Tree-Like Multi-Agent Games with Transfers</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究一棵“层层委托”的树：每个节点既是上级的代理人，又是下级的委托人；每轮都要选择一个 bandit 动作。节点的收益取决于自己和直接子节点的动作，但每个节点只最大化自己的收益，所以局部理性一般不会自动最大化整棵树的社会福利。 作者证明，只允许父节点向子节点提供一次性、动作条件化的转移支付，就可以逐层对齐激励。它属于在线学习、算法契约/机制设计与多智能体博弈，而不是生信论文；联邦学习和分层数据收集只是动机示例。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This theoretical online-learning paper asks whether self-interested learners arranged in a principal-agent tree can be driven toward the action profile maximizing total reward, without a central coordinator.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2501.19388" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MAIL">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mail-10d7f718/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MAIL">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MAPIT-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MAPIT-seq">MAPIT-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Co-profiling of in situ RNA-protein interactions and transcriptome in single cells and tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MAPIT-seq 是一种把内源 RBP-RNA 近邻关系转化为 RNA 编辑信号的实验与计算联合平台。它用抗体把携带 rAPOBEC1 和 hADAR2dd 的 pAG-deaminase 招募到目标 RBP 附近，在原位产生 C-to-U 和 A-to-G 编辑；随后同一份测序数据既能读出转录组表达，也能读出 RBP 附近的编辑信号。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MAPIT-seq addresses the difficulty of profiling endogenous RBP-RNA interactions in native cellular context while also measuring transcript abundance from the same sample.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02774-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MAPIT-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/WangLabPKU/MAPIT-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MAPIT-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mapit-seq-f641ce9b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MAPIT-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Marketplace Operator Competition">

        <h2 aria-label="Marketplace Operator Competition">Marketplace Operator Competition</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Marketplace Operators Can Induce Competitive Pricing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">电商平台既可以向第三方卖家收取佣金，也可以用自营商品进入同一市场。论文研究一个反直觉问题：平台是否可以不靠限价或行政管制，而是通过自己报出低价并准备一定库存，迫使原本具有垄断地位的第三方卖家降价？这里的平台不仅关心当期利润，还关心顾客能否买到商品，因为一次满意交易可能提高复购和平台长期价值。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper studies a hybrid marketplace in which the platform operator both collects a referral fee from an independent seller and may enter as a seller itself.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2503.06582" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Marketplace Operator Competition">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/marketplace-operator-competition-d39da33f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Marketplace Operator Competition">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="MechanoTranscriptomics">MechanoTranscriptomics</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A computational pipeline for spatial mechano-transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文把空间转录组和图像力学连接起来：先从膜染色得到细胞轮廓，用 VMSI 从弯曲的细胞连接推断相对压力、连接张力和细胞应力，再把这些力学量与同一细胞的基因表达、细胞类型和空间位置联合建模。 论文发表于 Nature Methods（2025），DOI 为 10.1038/s41592-025-02618-1。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics can locate molecular programs in tissue, but most analysis treats cell morphology as a local, cell-autonomous feature and does not recover mechanically coupled quantities such as cell–cell junction tension, intracell…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MethylTree">

        <h2 aria-label="MethylTree">MethylTree</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High-resolution, noninvasive single-cell lineage tracing in mice and humans based on DNA methylation epimutations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MethylTree 用单细胞甲基化数据中自然积累的随机表观突变（epimutation）推断细胞之间的谱系关系。它面向无法进行遗传条形码标记的场景，尤其是人体样本、原位组织以及需要同时读取转录或染色质状态的实验。 传统路线各有明显限制。Mitchell 等（Nature, 2022）和 Fabre 等（Nature, 2022）的体细胞核基因组突变谱系研究通常依赖单细胞克隆扩增与深度全基因组测序，成本高、通量低，而且难以同时保留原始细…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MethylTree is a computational framework for reconstructing single-cell lineage relationships from naturally accumulated DNA-methylation epimutations.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ShouWenWang-Lab/MethylTree" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MethylTree">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/methyltree-c42605f8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MethylTree">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
