      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="MGW">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MGW">MGW</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Riemannian Metric Learning for Alignment of Spatial Multiomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MGW（Manifold Gromov-Wasserstein）解决的是这样一个问题：两张空间组学切片都带有二维坐标，但一个测量转录本、另一个可能测量代谢物，特征维数、单位和数值几何完全不同，不能直接计算“一个 RNA 点与一个代谢点的特征距离”。MGW 不强行把两种特征相加，而是分别学习“分子特征沿组织空间如何变化”的局部几何，再用 Gromov–Wasserstein（GW）最优传输匹配两个几何结构。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multiomics technologies — Visium, Xenium, Stereo-Seq (transcriptomics), MALDI-MSI/AFADESI-MSI (metabolomics), spatial ATAC-Seq (epigenomics) — each profile a different molecular layer of the same tissue.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.12.09.693237" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MGW">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/MGW" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MGW">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mgw-b1e0d976/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MGW">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="micro-sam">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="micro-sam">micro-<wbr>sam</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Segment Anything for Microscopy</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">显微图像分割的困难不只是“把细胞圈出来”，而是成像模态、目标形态和数据维度差异很大：光学显微镜（LM）与电子显微镜（EM）不同，二维图像、三维体数据和时间序列也需要不同操作。CellPose、StarDist 等专用方法在接近训练分布的数据上很强，但遇到新条件时性能会下降；重新训练又需要大量人工标注。原始 SAM 虽然能用点或框交互分割，但它主要在自然图像上训练，对显微镜中的密集、相邻或细小目标并不稳定。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">μSAM adapts the Segment Anything Model to microscopy and packages interactive segmentation, automatic instance segmentation, multidimensional annotation, tracking and user fine-tuning into one napari-centered system.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for micro-sam">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/micro-sam-aaf07c18/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：micro-sam">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MISO">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MISO">MISO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Resolving tissue complexity by multimodal spatial omics modeling with MISO</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">多模态空间组学在同一批组织位置上同时测量多种信息，例如 RNA、蛋白质、染色质可及性、代谢物和 H&amp;E 组织学图像。真正困难的部分不是分别聚类每一种数据，而是把这些模态整合成一个共同表示，使最终空间区域同时反映分子状态和组织形态。 论文指出，已有方法通常存在几类限制：有些忽略空间相关信息；有些只针对两个模态或特定实验类型；有些需要较多超参数调节；有些容易受低质量模态影响。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multimodal spatial assays measure aligned molecular and image information, but useful spatial domains may be defined jointly by several modalities rather than by any one data type.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kpcoleman/miso" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MISO">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/miso-5c7d9451/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MISO">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MISO_cryo_EM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MISO_cryo_EM">MISO_<wbr>cryo_<wbr>EM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">MISO: microfluidic protein isolation enables single-particle cryo-EM structure determination from a single cell colony</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MISO 通过“微型层析 + 在线荧光定位 + 毛细管直连网格 + 自动 blot/plunge”，把约 1 μl 的蛋白洗脱峰直接变成多张冷冻电镜网格，并在多个约 1–2 μg 输入的示例中得到 2.2–3.5 Å 结构；论文充分证明了平台的可行性，但完整复现仍依赖定制硬件和当前仓库中不可读或缺失的 LabVIEW 主控逻辑。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MISO is an integrated experimental platform that connects microfluidic protein purification, fluorescence-guided fraction selection, nanoliter deposition on cryo-EM grids, blotting, and plunge freezing.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/EfremovLab/MISO" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MISO_cryo_EM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/miso-cryo-em-bd11e64f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MISO_cryo_EM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="mLLMCelltype">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="mLLMCelltype">mLLMCelltype</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Large Language Model Consensus Substantially Improves the Cell Type Annotation Accuracy for scRNA-seq Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">mLLMCelltype 接收已经聚类的单细胞数据所产生的 marker gene 列表、物种和组织背景，让多个大语言模型分别注释各 cluster；对意见一致的 cluster 直接输出，对有争议者进行最多三轮、按 Toulmin 论证结构组织的讨论，再用共识比例和 Shannon entropy 报告模型间一致程度。 它不是从原始表达矩阵学习分类器，也不负责归一化、降维、聚类和差异表达。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Large Language Model Consensus Substantially Improves the Cell Type Annotation Accuracy for scRNA-seq Data Authors: Chen Yang, Xianyang Zhang, Jun Chen Preprint: bioRxiv 10.1101/2025.04.10.647852 (April 2025) Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.04.10.647852" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for mLLMCelltype">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cafferychen777/mLLMCelltype" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for mLLMCelltype">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mllmcelltype-413beedd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：mLLMCelltype">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="MMFM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MMFM">MMFM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Modeling Complex System Dynamics with Flow Matching Across Time and Conditions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MMFM 的全名是 Multi-Marginal Flow Matching，论文标题为 Modeling Complex System Dynamics with Flow Matching Across Time and Conditions，发表于 ICLR 2025。论文关注的是一种很常见但困难的动态建模场景：我们有多个时间点、多个实验条件下的群体快照数据，但同一个个体不能被连续追踪，而且很多条件-时间组合没有被测量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Drug development requires characterizing how cells respond to hundreds of perturbations over time. Single-cell RNA-seq provides rich snapshots, but each cell is measured once.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2402.14935" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MMFM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Genentech/MMFM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MMFM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mmfm-365414f2/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MMFM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="MMFM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MMFM">MMFM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Modeling Complex System Dynamics with Flow Matching Across Time and Conditions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MMFM（Multi-Marginal Flow Matching）面对的是同一类系统在多个时间点、多个实验条件下采集的群体分布快照。以单细胞药物实验为例，0、24、48、72 小时测到的是不同细胞；某些药物—时间组合还可能完全缺失。模型需要从这些未配对分布中学习连续向量场，补出缺失时间点，并借其他条件的信息改善稀疏条件。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Modeling Complex System Dynamics with Flow Matching Across Time and Conditions (ICLR 2025). MMFM learns a condition-aware neural vector field from unpaired population snapshots observed at multiple, potentially irregular time points.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Genentech/MMFM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MMFM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mmfm-9df85fcf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MMFM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="information-fusion" data-journal-label="Information Fusion" data-method="modalnext">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="modalnext">modalnext</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Modal-NexT: Towards unified heterogeneous cellular data integration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Modal-NexT 的出发点是：RNA 基因、ATAC 峰、蛋白、细胞和空间邻居虽然类型不同，但都可以表示为图中的实体与关系。只要把观测矩阵转换成“某个细胞以某种强度连接某个特征”的关系边，就能用同一套图嵌入框架处理配对多组学、未配对多组学、空间多组学和同模态多来源数据。 本解读以本地原始 PDF/OCR Markdown、Figure 1–6，以及官方 GitHub 仓库代码为证据。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Citation: Tang, Z., Chen, G., Chen, S., He, H., Huang, J., Dong, T., Zhou, J., Zhao, L., You, L., &amp; Chen, C.Y.-C. (2025). Modal-NexT: Towards unified heterogeneous cellular data integration. Information Fusion, 103479.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Information Fusion · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.inffus.2025.103479" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for modalnext">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/shapsider/modalnext" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for modalnext">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/modalnext-dbfcfb5a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：modalnext">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Monod">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Monod">Monod</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Monod: model-based discovery and integration through fitting stochastic transcriptional dynamics to single-cell sequencing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Monod 的核心是把 nascent/mature 计数的整个联合分布视为生物转录过程与技术捕获过程共同生成的观测，通过显式模型比较将“均值不同”扩展为“哪种随机转录机制可能不同”；结果应被视为经拟合优度、边界和不确定性审查后的机制假设。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most single-cell RNA-seq workflows treat noise as a nuisance to normalize, transform, and compress away. Monod argues that low-copy stochastic variation is often the biological signal of interest.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02832-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Monod">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pachterlab/monod" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Monod">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/monod-56973e8d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Monod">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="MorphLink">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MorphLink">MorphLink</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Bridging cell morphological behaviors and molecular dynamics in multi-modal spatial omics with MorphLink</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MorphLink 的目标不是把 H&amp;E 图像和空间组学数据压进同一个黑箱嵌入，而是先从图像中提取可命名、可度量的结构特征，再用 Curve-based Pattern Similarity Index（CPSI）判断某个形态特征与某个基因、蛋白或其他分子测量是否具有相似的局部空间变化。最终结果是“什么组织结构发生了怎样的形态变化，并与哪种分子动态同位出现”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multi-modal spatial omics data provides both morphological (H&amp;E histology images) and molecular (gene expression, protein abundance, chromatin accessibility) perspectives on cellular behavior.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61142-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MorphLink">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jianhuupenn/MorphLink" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MorphLink">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/morphlink-d51e8229/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MorphLink">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="moscot">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="moscot">moscot</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping cells through time and space with moscot</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">moscot 解决的不是“把所有细胞排成一条确定轨迹”，而是：给定两个无法逐细胞配对的群体，寻找一个概率耦合矩阵，说明每个源细胞的概率质量应如何分配给目标细胞。时间、空间映射、空间切片对齐和时空发育都可写成这个核心问题的不同几何版本，再通过同一套 prepare → solve → push/pull API 求解和解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MOSCOT is a scalable optimal transport framework for mapping single cells across temporal, spatial, and multimodal dimensions. The method addresses three critical limitations of prior OT tools: (1) lack of multimodal support, (2) quadratic/…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-08453-2" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for moscot">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/moscot" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for moscot">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/moscot-7f3ebb08/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：moscot">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="MouseDevVIS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MouseDevVIS">MouseDevVIS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Continuous cell-type diversification in mouse visual cortex development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MouseDevVIS 不是只给成年细胞类型拍一张“终点照片”，而是用从胚胎 E11.5 到成年 P56 的密集单细胞时间序列，把成年视觉皮层类型逐步向早期追溯。研究先校正个体发育速度，随后在相邻年龄间转移标签、计算 k 近邻连接并构建轨迹树，再叠加多组学染色质、MERFISH 空间位置、基因表达曲线和 TF–peak–gene 网络，得到“细胞类型从胚胎到出生后持续分叉”的图谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The mammalian cortex contains 100 transcriptomic cell types per area, hierarchically organized into classes and subclasses, yet when and how these types emerge during development remains poorly understood.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09644-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MouseDevVIS">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/AllenInstitute/MouseDevVIS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MouseDevVIS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mousedevvis-f09776c2/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MouseDevVIS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MrVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MrVI">MrVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deep generative modeling of sample-level heterogeneity in single-cell genomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">多样本单细胞研究通常先把细胞聚类，再比较各簇的比例或平均表达。这种流程隐含了一个强假设：真正的疾病、个体或药物效应恰好与预先划定的细胞簇一致。若效应只发生在某个连续状态区域、某个簇中的少数细胞，或不同细胞亚群给出不同的样本分组，先聚类再汇总就会稀释信号。 MrVI（multi-resolution variational inference）把问题改写为：对每个细胞状态，如果把样本身份替换成另一个样本，它的表示和表达会怎样变化？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Large-scale single-cell genomics studies now profile hundreds to thousands of human samples, creating cohorts for clinical research (COVID-19 patients, IBD cases, cancer samples) and pharmaceutical screening (hundreds of drug perturbations).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02808-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MrVI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YosefLab/mrvi" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MrVI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mrvi-8a2376d6/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MrVI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MSnLib">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MSnLib">MSnLib</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">MS^n^Lib: efficient generation of open multi-stage fragmentation mass spectral libraries</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MSnLib 不是一个新的预测模型，而是一个面向 untargeted metabolomics 的开放 MS^n^ 光谱资源和生成流程。它把化合物标准品、元数据清洗、正/负离子模式的高通量 Orbitrap MS^n^ 采集、mzmine 自动处理和开放数据发布串成一条流程，输出可用于小分子注释和机器学习训练的多级碎裂光谱库。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MSnLib tackles a practical bottleneck in untargeted metabolomics: compound identification depends on reference spectra, but open resources contain abundant MS2 spectra and very limited public multi-stage fragmentation (MS^n^, n &gt; 2) data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02813-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MSnLib">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/corinnabrungs/msn_tree_library" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MSnLib">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/msnlib-3d437f82/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MSnLib">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MultiCell">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MultiCell">MultiCell</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">MultiCell: geometric learning in multicellular development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MultiCell 把发育中的果蝇胚胎表面表示成图：细胞是节点、相邻细胞是边，细胞形状放在节点特征中，连接处的几何放在边特征中。Graph Transformer 通过多层邻域信息聚合，为每个细胞生成隐藏表示；随后按任务把隐藏表示汇总到整个胚胎、单个细胞或一对相邻细胞，分别预测发育时间、距未来事件的时间或细胞连接是否会消失。 它预测的是基于当前及前一帧几何的统计结果，并不是从力学方程模拟胚胎，也没有直接输入基因表达或细胞命运标签。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">&gt; MultiCell: geometric learning in multicellular development &gt; Yang, H., Roy, G., Nguyen, A.Q., Bi, D., Stern, T., Buehler, M.J. &amp; Guo, M. &gt; Nature Methods (2025). DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02983-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MultiCell">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/HaiqianYang-MechE/MultiCell" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MultiCell">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multicell-7a481b7a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MultiCell">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="multigrate">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="multigrate">multigrate</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Integration and querying of multimodal single-cell data with PoE-VAE</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multigrate 是一个面向多模态单细胞数据的条件变分自编码器（cVAE）。每种模态有独立编码器，将可用证据变成高斯后验；Product-of-Experts（PoE）按精度合并这些后验，得到同一个细胞的联合潜变量；各模态解码器再从联合潜变量重建 RNA、蛋白、染色质或代谢物。缺失模态不参与 PoE，但仍可由对应解码器预测，因此同一模型可以处理配对、mosaic、单模态 query 和缺失模态插补。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;Integration and querying of multimodal single-cell data with PoE-VAE&quot; Authors: Anastasia Litinetskaya, Maiia Schulman, Fabiola Curion, Artur Szalata, Alireza Omidi, Mohammad Lotfollahi, Fabian Theis Repository: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2022.03.16.484643" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for multigrate">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/multigrate" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for multigrate">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multigrate-9eff4560/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：multigrate">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="MultiPerturb-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MultiPerturb-seq">MultiPerturb-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Pooled CRISPR screens with joint single-nucleus chromatin accessibility and transcriptome profiling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 pooled CRISPR screen 的目标，是给大量细胞施加不同遗传扰动，再观察每个扰动改变了什么。经典 Perturb-seq（Cell, 2016）主要读取 RNA；CRISPR-sciATAC 等方法主要读取染色质开放性。两类读出各有盲点：RNA 能看见细胞状态，但往往是调控变化的下游结果；ATAC 能看见潜在调控元件和表观状态，但不能保证这些变化已经转化成基因表达。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Pooled single-cell CRISPR screens had generally measured either gene expression or chromatin accessibility, making it difficult to connect regulatory changes, transcriptional consequences and perturbation identity in the same cell.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-024-02475-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MultiPerturb-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://gitlab.com/sanjanalab/mps" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MultiPerturb-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multiperturb-seq-2e987b4b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MultiPerturb-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Multivariate_Conformal_Prediction_Gaussian_Scoring">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Multivariate_Conformal_Prediction_Gaussian_Scoring">Multivariate_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Prediction_<wbr>Gaussian_<wbr>Scoring</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multivariate Standardized Residuals for Conformal Prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通 split conformal prediction 能保证总体平均意义上的边际覆盖率，但它使用一个全局校准阈值：对于噪声较小的输入，集合可能太大；对于噪声较大的输入，集合可能太小。多输出回归还要面对不同输出之间的相关性。本文不属于生物信息学，而是一篇统计机器学习与不确定性量化方法论文。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Split conformal prediction gives finite-sample marginal coverage, but a single global residual scale can under-cover uncertain inputs and over-cover easy ones.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2507.20941" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Multivariate_Conformal_Prediction_Gaussian_Scoring">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ElSacho/Multivariate_Standardized_Residuals" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Multivariate_Conformal_Prediction_Gaussian_Scoring">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multivariate-conformal-prediction-gaussian-scoring-83467ee1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Multivariate_Conformal_Prediction_Gaussian_Scoring">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="MultiVeloVAE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MultiVeloVAE">MultiVeloVAE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring differential dynamics from multi-lineage, multi-omic, and multi-sample single-cell data with MultiVeloVAE</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity 用未剪接 RNA u 与已剪接 RNA s 的时间滞后估计表达变化方向。传统方法常逐基因设定开/关阶段，难以同时处理多分支、多样本、RNA+ATAC 以及组间动力学检验。MultiVeloVAE 将这些问题放入一个带机械 ODE decoder 的条件变分自编码器中。 输入可以是 RNA 的平滑未剪接/已剪接矩阵，也可以再加入每个基因附近的染色质可及性 c。多个样本通过 batch 标签共同训练；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity uses the ratio of unspliced (nascent) to spliced (mature) RNA to infer the direction and magnitude of transcriptional changes, providing a snapshot-to-dynamics approach for single-cell data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-66287-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MultiVeloVAE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/welch-lab/MultiVeloVAE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MultiVeloVAE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multivelovae-f1a335ea/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MultiVeloVAE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="NicheFlow">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="NicheFlow">NicheFlow</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Modeling Microenvironment Trajectories on Spatial Transcriptomics with NicheFlow</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">时序空间转录组通常在不同发育阶段切取不同组织，测量是破坏性的，因此 t0 与 t1 没有同一个细胞可直接追踪。许多方法把每个细胞单独作为运输单位，只预测“这个细胞的后代可能在哪里”。NicheFlow 的核心改变是把一个中心细胞周围的局部邻域视为整体 microenvironment（niche），同时生成其中所有细胞的表达状态和空间坐标。 论文是 NeurIPS 2025 / arXiv:2511.00977v2 的方法论文。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Understanding the evolution of cellular microenvironments in spatiotemporal data is essential for deciphering tissue development and disease progression.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/nicheflow-58c892d3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：NicheFlow">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Nimbus">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Nimbus">Nimbus</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Automated classification of cellular expression in multiplexed imaging data with Nimbus</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Nimbus 不直接猜“这个细胞是什么类型”，而是对每个抗体通道分别回答：“这个细胞是否真的表达该标记？”它利用原始图像中的亚细胞形态和邻域背景，把容易受串色、边界和亮度影响的 integrated expression，转换成更适合聚类的细胞 × 标记阳性分数矩阵。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell phenotyping in multiplexed tissue images usually starts by averaging each marker&#x27;s intensity inside every segmented cell. This integrated-expression scalar discards subcellular shape and local context, so it is vulnerable to spillover…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/angelolab/Nimbus-Inference" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Nimbus">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/nimbus-11e54d21/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Nimbus">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="NIS-Seq">

        <h2 aria-label="NIS-Seq">NIS-<wbr>Seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">NIS-Seq enables cell-type-agnostic optical perturbation screening</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">池化 CRISPR 筛选的目标，是建立“基因扰动 → 细胞表型”的对应关系。传统富集式筛选通常先按生长、FACS 等方式挑出一群细胞，再对群体中的 sgRNA 做测序；这种方案规模大，但会丢失单细胞的空间结构、亚细胞定位和快速动态过程。 光学池化筛选则先用显微镜记录每个活细胞的表型，再在原位读出该细胞携带的 sgRNA。Feldman 等人在 Cell 2019 年发表的方法通过细胞质中的条形码 mRNA 来识别扰动。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Optical pooled CRISPR screening links a microscopy phenotype to the perturbation carried by each cell. The established Feldman et al. method (Cell, 2019) sequences barcoded mRNA in the cytosol, which works best in large, transcriptionally a…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/schmid-burgk/NIS-Seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for NIS-Seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/nis-seq-e260eb17/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：NIS-Seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="NSCLC_SpatialOmics">NSCLC_<wbr>SpatialOmics</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial signatures for predicting immunotherapy outcomes using multi-omics in non-small cell lung cancer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">NSCLCSpatialOmics 研究的是：在 PD-1/PD-L1 免疫治疗前，非小细胞肺癌组织里的空间免疫微环境能否预测患者的无进展生存期。论文把 PCF/CODEX 空间蛋白组用于发现与耐药或响应相关的细胞状态，再把这些细胞状态转译成 DSP-GeoMx 空间转录组中的紧凑基因签名。最终输出不是一张空间图，而是患者级别的 resistance score 和 response score。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PD-1-based immunotherapy has changed advanced NSCLC treatment, but patient selection remains imperfect. Tumor PD-L1 staining alone misses important cases: some patients resist treatment despite high PD-L1, and others may experience toxicity…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02351-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for NSCLC_SpatialOmics">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/tznaung/NSCLC_SpatialOmics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for NSCLC_SpatialOmics">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/nsclc-spatialomics-dac75d87/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：NSCLC_SpatialOmics">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Nullstrap-DE">

        <h2 aria-label="Nullstrap-DE">Nullstrap-<wbr>DE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Nullstrap-DE: A General Framework for Calibrating FDR and Preserving Power in Differential Expression Methods, with Adaptivity to DESeq2 and edgeR</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA-seq 差异表达分析的目标，是在成千上万个基因里找出不同生物条件之间表达量显著不同的基因。核心难点是同时兼顾两件事： FDR 控制：不能把太多非差异基因误判为差异基因。 统计功效：真正有差异的基因不能被漏掉太多。 论文指出，DESeq2 和 edgeR 这类参数方法通常功效较高，也能处理较复杂的实验设计；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Nullstrap-DE targets false-discovery-rate (FDR) calibration in RNA-seq differential-expression analysis. The paper argues that widely used parametric methods such as DESeq2 and edgeR are powerful but can become anti-conservative because the…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>

        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Genetics" data-method="OASIS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="OASIS">OASIS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deciphering state-dependent immune features from multi-layer omics data at single-cell resolution</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">OASIS 的核心问题是：免疫细胞中的遗传效应、体细胞突变效应、微生物组影响和疾病风险评分，很多并不是固定地作用在“某一种细胞类型”上，而是会随连续的细胞状态改变。传统 bulk mQTL 或离散细胞类型分析容易把这种状态依赖性平均掉。论文因此构建了一个面向日本人群的多组学单细胞免疫图谱，把 PBMC 单细胞转录组、scVDJ、宿主遗传、血浆蛋白组、肠道宏基因组和体细胞事件投射到同一套免疫细胞状态框架中。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most molecular QTL resources are bulk-resolution and underrepresent non-European populations. OASIS addresses this by building a multi-layer immune atlas in Japanese individuals and asking how germline variants, HLA/repertoire variation, PR…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-025-02266-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for OASIS">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/REdahiro/OASIS_project" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for OASIS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/oasis-1b1049f0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：OASIS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="Odyssey">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Odyssey">Odyssey</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Odyssey: reconstructing evolution through emergent consensus in the global proteome</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Odyssey 把蛋白序列和离散结构当作共同去噪的 source，用局部矩阵共识在残基邻域传播信息，并通过离散扩散完成联合生成；其数学与计算实验描述丰富，但在没有公开代码、权重、数据清单和湿实验验证时，最强结论仍应限定为 paper-reported computational evidence。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Odyssey targets multimodal protein generation: designing or editing proteins while jointly modeling amino-acid sequence, 3D structure, and functional context. The paper argues that proteins should not be treated as text alone.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.10.15.682677" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Odyssey">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/odyssey-c018e9b3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Odyssey">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="OLS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="OLS">OLS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Oblique line scan illumination enables expansive, accurate and sensitive single-protein measurements in solution and in living cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统单分子追踪常在“视野与通量”和“背景抑制、定位精度、时间分辨率”之间取舍。OLS（oblique line scan，倾斜线扫描）把单物镜倾斜光片、线扫描和相机滚动快门同步起来，在约 250 × 190 µm² 的大视野内实现最高 1,250 Hz 采集，从而同时观察许多细胞及快速扩散蛋白。 检测在 11 × 11 像素窗口中进行；细胞 SMT 与溶液 isSMT 的阈值分别为 14 和 16。轨迹连接限制为细胞中 1.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-molecule tracking usually trades field of view and throughput against background rejection, localization quality and temporal resolution.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ols-1c535dad/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：OLS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="OpenProblemsSingleCell">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="OpenProblemsSingleCell">OpenProblemsSingleCell</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Defining and benchmarking open problems in single-cell analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">《Defining and benchmarking open problems in single-cell analysis》是 Nature Biotechnology 的 Correspondence / perspective，而不是提出一个新的预测算法。它总结单细胞分析中仍未解决的任务，并提出 Open Problems 平台作为持续更新的 benchmark 基础设施。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">&quot;Defining and benchmarking open problems in single-cell analysis&quot; presents Open Problems as a living benchmark platform for single-cell analysis.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">考虑因子模型 其中 X\in\mathbb R^{p\times n} 是 n 个样本的 p 维观测，\Lambda\in\mathbb R^{p\times r} 是载荷矩阵，Z\in\mathbb R^{r\times n} 是潜在因子，E 是噪声。 PCA 能较好地估计由 \Lambda 张成的 r 维子空间，却不能唯一决定子空间中的坐标轴：对任意正交矩阵 Q，\Lambda Q 张成同一子空间、解释同样的方差。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="OrganoidMultiplexing">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="OrganoidMultiplexing">OrganoidMultiplexing</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multiplexing cortical brain organoids for the longitudinal dissection of developmental traits at single-cell resolution</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">如果希望比较几十乃至上百个供体的皮层脑类器官，最直接的做法是为每个供体分别建系、培养、取样和测序。但这种方案同时放大了培养批次、人工操作和测序成本，而且不同细胞系的增殖速度并不相同：有的供体会逐渐占据混合物，有的则可能在后期几乎消失。 这篇论文的核心思想是：把多个遗传背景放进同一个实验流程，再利用天然遗传变异把每个单细胞“认领”回供体。这样，供体身份不再依赖物理分孔，而由测序读段中的 SNP 提供内部条形码。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Longitudinal organoid experiments are expensive and vulnerable to line-to-line culture variability. Growing every donor separately increases handling and batch burden, but mixing donors creates a second problem: each sequenced cell must be…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GiuseppeTestaLab/organoidMultiplexing_release" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for OrganoidMultiplexing">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/organoidmultiplexing-6dffd64a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：OrganoidMultiplexing">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="plos-computational-biology" data-journal-label="PLOS Computational Biology" data-method="OTVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="OTVelo">OTVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Optimal transport reveals dynamic gene regulatory networks via gene velocity estimation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">OTVelo 解决的是动态基因调控网络（dynamic gene regulatory network, dynamic GRN）推断问题。输入是多个时间点采集的单细胞 RNA-seq 表达矩阵，输出是基因之间的有向、带符号、可随时间变化的调控关系。 难点在于：单细胞测序是破坏性测量，同一个细胞不能在多个时间点重复观测。因此，虽然我们有不同时间点的细胞群体，却没有真实的单细胞轨迹。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">OTVelo targets dynamic gene regulatory network (GRN) inference from time-stamped single-cell gene expression data. The central difficulty is that scRNA-seq destroys cells during measurement, so expression cannot be tracked in the same cell…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PLOS Computational Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1012476" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for OTVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/sandstede-lab/OT-Velocity" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for OTVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/otvelo-de7021f6/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：OTVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Paired-Damage-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Paired-Damage-seq">Paired-<wbr>Damage-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell parallel analysis of DNA damage and transcriptome reveals selective genome vulnerability</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paired-Damage-seq 先把细胞核里的氧化 DNA 损伤“修复式标记”为生物素信号，再用抗体引导的 pA-Tn5 把损伤附近的 DNA 切下并加上条形码；与此同时，它在同一个细胞核中做带相同条形码的逆转录。这样，研究者既能看到“这个细胞是什么类型、处于什么状态”，又能看到“这类细胞的哪些基因组区域更容易出现损伤”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Oxidative DNA lesions are nonrandomly distributed, but bulk sequencing averages across heterogeneous cell types and damage-only single-cell measurements are dominated by sparse, stochastic signal.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/czhulab/Paired-Damage-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Paired-Damage-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/paired-damage-seq-95027d6b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Paired-Damage-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="ieee-transactions-on-pattern-analysis-and-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence" data-method="PAMT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PAMT">PAMT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Pathway-Aware Multimodal Transformer (PAMT): Integrating Pathological Image and Gene Expression for Interpretable Cancer Survival Analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PAMT 把 bulk 表达先重组为有语义的通路 token，再让这些通路作为 query 从 WSI patch 中检索形态证据，同时用生存目标学习患者风险；它的解释性来自“通路—patch”这一可读中间关系，但解释仍是模型关联，而且公开代码的默认训练设置与论文完整方法存在若干可影响复现的差异。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Cancer survival prediction benefits from combining two key data modalities — pathological images (phenotype) and gene expression (genotype).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1109/TPAMI.2025.3611531" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PAMT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YANRUI121/PAMT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PAMT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pamt-e7c6f999/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PAMT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="PASTA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PASTA">PASTA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Accurate imputation of pathway-specific gene expression in spatial transcriptomics with PASTA</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">成像型空间转录组可以在单细胞分辨率保留组织坐标，但通常只测一个预选基因面板。PASTA（PAthway-oriented Spatial gene impuTAtion）借助全转录组 scRNA-seq 参考，将未测基因投影回空间。它与多数逐基因补全方法的区别是：训练时就指定一个通路，用该通路中已测基因、细胞类型和同类型空间邻域约束映射，最终直接输出每个空间细胞的通路总表达。 PASTA 的核心假设有三条。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Targeted spatial transcriptomics platforms (Xenium, MERFISH, CosMx, ISS) measure only a pre-selected panel of hundreds to thousands of genes, missing the majority of the transcriptome.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-67421-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PASTA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/rx-li/PASTA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PASTA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pasta-d43c0039/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PASTA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Patho-AgenticRAG">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="Patho-AgenticRAG">Patho-<wbr>AgenticRAG</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Patho-AgenticRAG: Towards Multimodal Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Pathology VLMs via Reinforcement Learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Patho-AgenticRAG 的贡献不是把更多文本塞给病理 VLM，而是学习一条条件化工具路径：必要时把问题拆成候选诊断查询，在器官分区的图文教材页中先召回再用尖峰相似度重排，多轮汇总证据后交给 Patho-R1；核心推理 demo 与 fusion 代码可查，但强化学习训练和大规模知识库仍是明确的复现缺口。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Pathology diagnosis requires matching visual evidence (cellular morphology, staining patterns, tissue architecture in H&amp;E/IHC slides) against structured diagnostic knowledge from textbooks.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2508.02258" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Patho-AgenticRAG">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Wenchuan-Zhang/Patho-AgenticRAG" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Patho-AgenticRAG">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/patho-agenticrag-2bf47c94/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Patho-AgenticRAG">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="science-advances" data-journal-label="Science Advances" data-method="PepPrCLIP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PepPrCLIP">PepPrCLIP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">De novo design of peptide binders to conformationally diverse targets with contrastive language modeling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PepPrCLIP 只要求输入目标蛋白的氨基酸序列。它先在 ESM-2 的肽表示附近加高斯扰动，产生大量短肽；再用一个仿照 CLIP 的双编码器，把候选肽与目标蛋白投影到同一空间，用余弦相似度排序。生成器回答“哪些序列像可行的天然短肽”，判别器回答“这些肽里哪一些更像当前目标的配对肽”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Over 80% of pathogenic proteins are &quot;undruggable&quot; — they lack stable binding pockets required by small-molecule inhibitors. Existing computational binder design methods like RFDiffusion (Nature, 2023) require 3D structural information, excl…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science Advances · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.adr8638" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PepPrCLIP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SuhaasBhat/PepPrCLIP" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PepPrCLIP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pepprclip-56a227c9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PepPrCLIP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PERISCOPE">

        <h2 aria-label="PERISCOPE">PERISCOPE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A genome-wide atlas of human cell morphology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PERISCOPE 的核心是：在同一个细胞里，一边用 Cell Painting 拍到丰富的细胞形态，一边用原位测序读出这个细胞携带的 CRISPR guide；随后把同一基因的许多细胞聚合成“形态指纹”，用于筛选命中基因、比较通路关系并提出新的功能假设。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PERISCOPE combines pooled CRISPR knockout, Cell Painting, and in situ guide-barcode sequencing to build genome-wide, compartment-resolved morphology profiles that recover known biological organization, reveal environmental dependence, and g…</p>
        </div>

          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/perturbation_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="pertpy">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Perturbation Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="pertpy">pertpy</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Pertpy: an end-to-end framework for perturbation analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">pertpy 不是提出一个单一的新统计模型，而是把单细胞扰动实验中原本分散的步骤——数据获取、元数据补充、gRNA 指派、扰动质量控制、扰动空间构建、距离计算、差异丰度、组成分析、多细胞程序、因果效应和差异表达——统一到 AnnData/MuData 与 scverse 生态中的框架。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell perturbation experiments have grown rapidly in scale and complexity — from early CRISPR screens to genome-scale Perturb-seq datasets with millions of cells and thousands of perturbations.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02909-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for pertpy">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/scverse/pertpy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for pertpy">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pertpy-c365b3cb/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：pertpy">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">Simultaneous CRISPR screening and spatial transcriptomics reveal intracellular, intercellular, and functional transcriptional circuits</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Cell 2025 论文提出 Perturb-FISH：一种把 pooled CRISPR 扰动、原位 guide RNA 读取、MERFISH 空间转录组和可选功能成像放到同一单细胞体系里的技术平台（PAPERMD:1-5, PAPERMD:13-17）。 传统 Perturb-seq 这类单细胞 CRISPR 筛选可以把“哪个基因被扰动”和“细胞表达谱如何变化”连接起来，但细胞需要被解离，因此失去空间邻近关系。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">光学混池筛选（optical pooled screening, OPS）的目标，是在同一个细胞里建立两种信息的对应关系： 显微成像得到的表型，例如蛋白定位、细胞形态、RNA FISH 信号； 这个细胞携带的 CRISPR 扰动，即 sgRNA 条形码。 传统 OPS 的代表工作是 Feldman 等发表于 Cell（2019）的 “Optical pooled screens in human cells”，其标准化协议发表于 Nat…</p>
