      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="science" data-journal-label="Science" data-method="PEtracer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PEtracer">PEtracer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High-resolution spatial mapping of cell state and lineage dynamics in vivo with PEtracer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PEtracer 不是根据转录组相似性猜谱系，而是让细胞在分裂过程中持续积累可遗传的 prime-editing 标记，再在实验终点同时读取这些标记、细胞转录状态和组织空间位置。标记提供“共同祖先”的证据，MERFISH 或 scRNA-seq 提供“现在是什么状态”的证据，二者联合后才能研究一个状态究竟更像长期遗传结果，还是局部环境诱导的短暂反应。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Charting how cells divide, differentiate, and migrate over time — and how this history shapes tissue organization in disease — is a fundamental challenge in biology.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adx3800" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PEtracer">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jweissmanlab/PEtracer-2025" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PEtracer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/petracer-7d3de11b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PEtracer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PHLOWER">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PHLOWER">PHLOWER</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">PHLOWER leverages single-cell multimodal data to infer complex, multi-branching cell differentiation trajectories</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PHLOWER 的独特之处不是简单地把细胞放进另一个低维空间，而是把“细胞到细胞的潜在分化事件”视为图上的有向边，再用一阶 Hodge Laplacian 的调和特征向量给边和整条随机游走路径建立坐标。路径在该空间中聚类后，算法再利用累计坐标随 pseudotime 的分离位置组装多分支树。 它适合单根、树形且分支较多的过程。它需要用户给 root，依赖上游嵌入和人为构造的 simplicial complex，并且计算与内存开销较高。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell differentiation produces elaborate trees of cell fates. In kidney organoids, for example, iPSC progenitors give rise to podocytes, tubular epithelial cells, stromal cells, and — undesirably — neuronal and muscle &quot;off-target&quot; cells.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02870-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PHLOWER">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/CostaLab/phlower" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PHLOWER">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/phlower-eacd53ab/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PHLOWER">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="PHOTON">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PHOTON">PHOTON</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Subcellular level spatial transcriptomics with PHOTON</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PHOTON（photoselection of transcriptome over nanoscale）先在固定样本的所有 RNA 上原位合成“被光锁住”的 cDNA，再用荧光图像找到目标细胞或亚细胞区域，以 405 nm 激光只解锁这些区域中的 cDNA。后续连接、扩增和测序只能通过已解锁的分子，因此显微镜中的空间选择被转换成一份可测序的 ROI 转录组。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Method: PHOTON (PHotoselection of Transcriptome over Nanoscale) Type: Experimental sequencing technology Paper: Rajachandran S et al., Nature Communications 16, 2025 DOI: 10.1038/s41467-025-59801-3 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-59801-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PHOTON">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/HaiqiChenLab/PHOTON" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PHOTON">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/photon-76ed4124/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PHOTON">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PolymerScreen">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PolymerScreen">PolymerScreen</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A proteome-wide quantitative platform for nanoscale spatially resolved extraction of membrane proteins into native nanodiscs</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">膜蛋白的构象、复合体和功能受到周围脂质环境影响。传统去污剂虽然提取效率高，却常把这层环境破坏掉。膜活性聚合物（MAP）可以直接从细胞膜中“挖出”含膜蛋白的原生纳米盘，但不同聚合物对不同蛋白和细胞器膜的效果差异很大，不能靠一种固定配方解决。 PolymerScreen 的核心贡献是把“选哪种聚合物”变成一个可量化、可查询的问题：作者测量 11 种聚合物条件下 2,065 个膜蛋白的相对提取效率，并为每个蛋白给出最优条件。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Methods technology paper addresses a central membrane-protein problem: detergents often extract proteins efficiently but disrupt their native lipid context, whereas native-nanodisc-forming polymers vary unpredictably by protein…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/polymerscreen-6d8f143f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PolymerScreen">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="preprint" data-journal-label="preprint" data-method="POPARI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="POPARI">POPARI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">POPARI: Modeling multisample variation in spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">多样本空间转录组常需要比较疾病与对照、不同年龄或不同患者。许多整合方法重点消除批次或对齐坐标，但 POPARI 的问题不同：是否能找到一组可解释的共享基因程序，并量化这些程序在每个样本中如何相邻、共现或分隔。 输入是多个样本的表达矩阵、二维坐标和样本分组；空间实体可以是成像平台的细胞，也可以是测序平台的 spots。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">POPARI is an interpretable multisample spatial-transcriptomics model built from nonnegative matrix factorization and a spatial hidden Markov random field.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>preprint · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/alam-shahul/popari" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for POPARI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/popari-6557e5f3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：POPARI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="PoPE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PoPE">PoPE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Decoupling the &quot;What&quot; and &quot;Where&quot; With Polar Coordinate Positional Embedding</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">对位置 t 的 query 和位置 s 的 key，RoPE 把每两个实数维度组成一个二维向量。写成极坐标后，注意力分量为 幅值携带内容，但内容向量自身的相位 \phik-\phiq 又移动了最佳相对位置。也就是说，同一个特征既决定“匹配什么”，又改变“匹配在哪里”。当任务要求独立做内容匹配与相对位移时，这种耦合可能妨碍学习。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological/Technical Problem: Transformer attention must jointly encode what a token represents (content) and where it appears (position). The dominant solution, RoPE (Su et al.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2509.10534" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PoPE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lucidrains/PoPE-pytorch" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PoPE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pope-68b2a50a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PoPE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Prediction_Aware_Learning_Multi_Agent_Systems">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Prediction_Aware_Learning_Multi_Agent_Systems">Prediction_<wbr>Aware_<wbr>Learning_<wbr>Multi_<wbr>Agent_<wbr>Systems</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Prediction-Aware Learning in Multi-Agent Systems</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇在线学习与博弈论论文，并非生物信息学文章。它研究多个理性主体在一个随环境状态变化的博弈中反复行动：例如交通网络中，天气或道路状况改变每条路线的成本，而参与者在行动前只能预测当前状态。 已有时变博弈方法常用“相邻时刻收益函数变化了多少”来控制 regret。这个指标有一个明显缺陷：即使变化很大，只要变化规律容易预测，主体本来应该能应对；但传统界仍可能是线性的。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Online-learning analyses of time-varying games usually charge how much the payoff functions or equilibria move over calendar time. Those bounds can become linear even when the variation follows an easy-to-predict pattern.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2501.19144" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Prediction_Aware_Learning_Multi_Agent_Systems">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/prediction-aware-learning-multi-agent-systems-45656750/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Prediction_Aware_Learning_Multi_Agent_Systems">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PreimplantationEmbryoModels">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PreimplantationEmbryoModels">PreimplantationEmbryoModels</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deep learning-based models for preimplantation mouse and human embryos based on single-cell RNA sequencing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">植入前胚胎发育经历合子、卵裂、桑椹胚、内细胞团（ICM）、上胚层（EPI）、原始内胚层（PrE）和滋养外胚层（TE）等连续状态。单细胞 RNA 测序已经积累了许多数据集，但这些数据很难直接合并：样本数量小、测序技术和深度不同、批次效应明显、细胞标签不统一，而且人胚材料稀缺并严重偏向 TE。 传统分析通常先聚类，再由专家根据少数经典 marker 手工命名。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Proks, Salehin, and Brickman assemble a dynamic scRNA-seq reference for mouse and human preimplantation development. The resource integrates many small, heterogeneous embryo datasets, learns developmental cell states, explains which genes s…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="PRISM">PRISM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High-plex spatial RNA imaging in one round with conventional microscopes using color-intensity barcodes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">最关键的工程思想是：RCA 纳米球大小不同，会让所有通道一起变亮或变暗；这种变化主要沿着颜色空间中的“半径”方向。PRISM 不把绝对亮度当作身份，而是用归一化后的方向和第四通道层级来识别条形码。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Conventional fluorescence microscopes distinguish only a few spectral channels. Imaging-based spatial transcriptomics therefore commonly increases multiplexity through repeated labeling, imaging, and stripping cycles or through specialized…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="ProBASS">

        <h2 aria-label="ProBASS">ProBASS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ProBASS---a language model with sequence and structural features for predicting the effect of mutations on binding affinity</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ProBASS 将 ESM-2 的 mutant-minus-WT 全链平均差分与 ESM-IF1 的 WT 复合体平均结构向量拼成 1792 维特征，再用实验标签训练 CatBoost。它的核心推理代码可以核查，但高性能强依赖数据划分，结构分支不随突变变化，完整 benchmark 与 final training 配置尚未公开复现。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ProBASS addresses a practical bottleneck in protein engineering and disease-variant interpretation: predicting how mutations change protein-protein binding affinity.</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Proseg">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Proseg">Proseg</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cell simulation as cell segmentation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">成像型空间转录组给出每条 RNA 的基因名和三维坐标。分析前必须把 RNA 归入细胞，但仅依赖核/膜图像的边界常会把相邻细胞的 RNA 混在一起，或留下大量未分配 RNA。由于高转录细胞向低转录细胞“溢出”几个分子就可能改变后者的细胞类型与差异表达，错误不是简单随机噪声，而会把空间邻近和基因表达系统性混淆。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics technologies promise to revolutionize our understanding of tissue organization by preserving spatial relationships between cells while measuring gene expression.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02697-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Proseg">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dcjones/proseg" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Proseg">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/proseg-1b2ab5b2/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Proseg">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="deconvolution_mapping" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="advanced-science" data-journal-label="Advanced Science" data-method="ProteomicsCellTypeAbundanceGNN">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Deconvolution</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ProteomicsCellTypeAbundanceGNN">ProteomicsCellTypeAbundanceGNN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deciphering Cell Type Abundance in Proteomics Data Through Graph Neural Networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文研究的是蛋白组数据中的细胞类型比例反卷积。 bulk proteomics 和 spatial proteomics 测到的是多个细胞混在一起后的蛋白丰度信号，因此研究者希望从一个混合样本中估计不同细胞类型的比例。论文指出，许多已有反卷积方法主要为转录组设计，常依赖转录本计数分布或高维基因表达特性，这些假设不适合连续强度值、维度更低且噪声/批次效应更明显的蛋白组数据。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Deciphering Cell Type Abundance in Proteomics Data Through Graph Neural Networks introduces GraphDEC, a graph neural network method for estimating cell-type proportions from bulk and spatial proteomics data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Advanced Science · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.202502987" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ProteomicsCellTypeAbundanceGNN">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/TencentAILabHealthcare/scpDeconv" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ProteomicsCellTypeAbundanceGNN">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/proteomicscelltypeabundancegnn-1ab76b59/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ProteomicsCellTypeAbundanceGNN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="ProTrek">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ProTrek">ProTrek</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A trimodal protein language model enables advanced protein searches</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ProTrek 为同一个蛋白构造三种表示：氨基酸序列、由 Foldseek 压缩出的 3Di 结构序列、自然语言功能描述。训练时让同一蛋白的三种表示互相靠近、不同蛋白的表示分开。得到统一向量空间后，任意一种模态都能查询另外两种模态，也能进行同模态近邻搜索，因此形成序列、结构、文字之间的九种检索方向。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Proteins are the cell&#x27;s principal molecular machines. Understanding the sequence–structure–function (SSF) relationship is a central goal of molecular biology.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-025-02836-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ProTrek">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/westlake-repl/ProTrek" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ProTrek">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/protrek-64af8c40/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ProTrek">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="PseudodynamicsPlus">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PseudodynamicsPlus">PseudodynamicsPlus</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Pseudodynamics+: Reconstructing Population Dynamics from Time-Resolved Single Cell Landscapes with Physics Informed Neural Networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">时间序列 scRNA-seq 给出不同时间点的细胞状态快照，但每次捕获的细胞数通常由实验采样深度决定，并不等于组织中的真实细胞总数。如果某个状态在后期占比增加，至少有三种解释：该状态内细胞增殖、其他状态向它分化，或随机扩散使密度进入该区域。只看归一化后的单细胞比例无法区分这些机制。 Pseudodynamics+ 的输入因此有两部分： 每个时间点的单细胞状态坐标 \mathbf s 与时间标签 t；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Pseudodynamics+ addresses a gap in time-resolved single-cell analysis: scRNA-seq snapshots describe relative cell-state composition, but not the true tissue-scale number of cells flowing through the landscape.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.11.30.691399" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PseudodynamicsPlus">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Gottgens-lab/pseudodynamics_plus" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PseudodynamicsPlus">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pseudodynamicsplus-808717ce/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PseudodynamicsPlus">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="PTSDsnDLPFC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PTSDsnDLPFC">PTSDsnDLPFC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell transcriptomic and chromatin dynamics of the human brain in PTSD</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇工作研究创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）中，哪些细胞类型、表达程序、染色质调控关系和细胞间信号发生了变化，以及这些变化能否与 PTSD 遗传风险位点连接起来。它不是单一的“差异表达研究”，而是把四类测量放在同一框架中：单核 RNA 测序描述转录状态，单核 ATAC 测序描述染色质可及性，单核 multiome 在同一细胞核中连接 RNA 与 ATAC，Xenium 空间转录组验证候选信号在组织中的位置。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is a polygenic psychiatric disorder (heritability 24-40%) that occurs in 6-8% of the general population after severe trauma.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09083-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PTSDsnDLPFC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mjgirgenti/PTSDsnDLPFC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PTSDsnDLPFC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ptsdsndlpfc-3a5ca6ed/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PTSDsnDLPFC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PUPS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PUPS">PUPS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Prediction of protein subcellular localization in single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PUPS 把蛋白亚细胞定位从“给蛋白打一个细胞器标签”改写成“给定某条蛋白序列和某个具体细胞的地标染色图，生成该蛋白在这个细胞中的荧光图像”。蛋白序列回答“要预测的是谁”，细胞图像回答“它要被放进怎样的细胞环境”，因此模型可以同时处理未见蛋白、未见细胞系和同一细胞系内的单细胞差异。 论文发表于 Nature Methods（2025），DOI：10.1038/s41592-025-02696-1。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Protein localization is functionally important and disease-associated, but existing atlases cover only a small fraction of possible protein–cell-line pairs.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/uhlerlab/PUPS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PUPS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pups-c0ceeef2/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PUPS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="quantum" data-journal-label="Quantum" data-method="Quadratic_Speedup_Nash_Equilibria_Quantum_Zero_Sum_Games">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Quadratic_Speedup_Nash_Equilibria_Quantum_Zero_Sum_Games">Quadratic_<wbr>Speedup_<wbr>Nash_<wbr>Equilibria_<wbr>Quantum_<wbr>Zero_<wbr>Sum_<wbr>Games</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A Quadratic Speedup in Finding Nash Equilibria of Quantum Zero-Sum Games</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">双方分别选择未纠缠的密度矩阵 \alpha 与 \beta，联合状态为 \alpha\otimes\beta；Alice 最大化 \operatorname{Tr}[U^\dagger(\alpha\otimes\beta)]，Bob 最小化它。目标是在有限维 spectraplex 上找到平均迭代意义下的 \epsilon-纳什均衡。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper studies how to compute approximate Nash equilibria in finite two-player quantum zero-sum games whose strategies are unentangled density matrices.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Quantum · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.22331/q-2025-05-20-1737" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Quadratic_Speedup_Nash_Equilibria_Quantum_Zero_Sum_Games">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/FranciscaVasconcelos/qzsg" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Quadratic_Speedup_Nash_Equilibria_Quantum_Zero_Sum_Games">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/quadratic-speedup-nash-equilibria-quantum-zero-sum-games-f5f78bca/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Quadratic_Speedup_Nash_Equilibria_Quantum_Zero_Sum_Games">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="REDCAT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="REDCAT">REDCAT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">All-Optical Multimodal Mapping of Single Cell-Type-Specific Metabolic Activities via REDCAT</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">REDCAT 是一个同一张组织切片上的全光学多模态成像流程，用 TPEF/SRS/SHG 直接测量红氧、脂质、蛋白、胶原和光谱化学状态，再用 CODEX 给细胞身份做高通量蛋白标注。它的核心不是新的深度学习模型，而是把光学代谢信号、细胞分割、配准、聚类和细胞类型注释串成单细胞/亚细胞尺度的组织代谢图谱。</p>
        </div>

        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="ReLiC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ReLiC">ReLiC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Decoding post-transcriptional regulatory networks by RNA-linked CRISPR screening in human cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">细胞中有两千多个 RNA 相关蛋白参与剪接、翻译、定位和降解。传统交联实验能告诉我们“哪个蛋白接触哪条 RNA”，却不一定说明这种接触让 RNA 过程增强还是减弱。常规 CRISPR 筛选多依赖细胞生长或荧光等间接表型；Perturb-seq 一类单细胞方法虽然覆盖面广，但成本高、规模受限，而且更容易观测高表达 RNA。 ReLiC（RNA-linked CRISPR）把每个 CRISPR 扰动与可测序的 RNA 条形码绑定。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Thousands of RNA-associated proteins regulate splicing, translation and decay, but interaction assays do not reveal functional consequences.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02702-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ReLiC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/rasilab/nugent_2024" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ReLiC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/relic-331f01d0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ReLiC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="proceedings-of-the-acm-on-web-conference-2025" data-journal-label="Proceedings of the ACM on Web Conference 2025" data-method="Relying_Metrics_Evaluated_Agents">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Relying_Metrics_Evaluated_Agents">Relying_<wbr>Metrics_<wbr>Evaluated_<wbr>Agents</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Relying on the Metrics of Evaluated Agents</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">平台或监管者可能有很强的数据收集能力，却不知道“应该收集哪个变量”。真正执行任务的被评估者反而知道一个与成本相关的指标 X。论文研究的不是“看到 X 的取值后是否报告”，而是被评估者在取值实现之前，是否告诉委托人这个变量存在且可观测。 代理人付出二元努力，成本为 C；完成任务后委托人获得价值 b。如果隐藏 X，委托人只能给统一报酬 p： 如果公开 X，委托人可按 x 设置报酬 \rho(x)，并使用条件成本分布 Fx 优化每一类的价格。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Online platforms and regulators often evaluate agents with metrics, yet the evaluated agents may know relevant variables that the evaluator does not even know exist.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Proceedings of the ACM on Web Conference 2025 · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1145/3696410.3714864" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Relying_Metrics_Evaluated_Agents">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/relying-metrics-evaluated-agents-83591fb8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Relying_Metrics_Evaluated_Agents">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Revisiting_Mean_Estimation_Lp_Balls">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Revisiting_Mean_Estimation_Lp_Balls">Revisiting_<wbr>Mean_<wbr>Estimation_<wbr>Lp_<wbr>Balls</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Revisiting mean estimation over ℓp balls: Is the MLE optimal?</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">观测模型是 目标是在平方 \ell2 损失下估计未知均值 \theta^\star。这里 p 控制参数空间的几何形状：小 p 对应稀疏或弱稀疏结构，较大的 p 限制坐标整体幅度。论文问的是：把观测点直接投影到 \ellp 球上的最大似然估计（MLE），能否达到 minimax 最优速率？ 在高斯噪声下，MLE 等价于欧氏投影： 它看起来很自然：利用了参数空间本身的几何结构，是非线性估计器，而且不需要输入噪声强度 \sigma。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This theoretical statistics paper asks whether the constrained Gaussian maximum-likelihood estimator is minimax rate-optimal when the unknown mean lies in an \ellp ball.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2506.10354" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Revisiting_Mean_Estimation_Lp_Balls">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/revisiting-mean-estimation-lp-balls-8e4cdfd6/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Revisiting_Mean_Estimation_Lp_Balls">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="RingDeconvolutionMicroscopy">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="RingDeconvolutionMicroscopy">RingDeconvolutionMicroscopy</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Ring deconvolution microscopy: exploiting symmetry for efficient spatially varying aberration correction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通反卷积默认整幅视野使用同一个点扩散函数（PSF）。但真实显微镜的像差通常随视野位置变化：中心处测得的 PSF 用到边缘时会失配，造成低对比度、噪声放大或错误结构。若在每个位置都标定 PSF，标定量和计算量又会迅速失控。 RDM 的关键观察是：多数显微镜和相机围绕光轴具有旋转对称性。位于相同半径、不同角度的点源，其 PSF 形状相同，只是绕中心旋转。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Ring deconvolution microscopy (RDM) corrects spatially varying microscope aberrations without calibrating a PSF at every image location. It exploits rotational symmetry: PSFs at the same field radius share a shape and differ only by rotatio…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/apsk14/rdmpy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for RingDeconvolutionMicroscopy">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ringdeconvolutionmicroscopy-645bf2c0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：RingDeconvolutionMicroscopy">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="RNA_velocity_review_bbaf339">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="RNA_velocity_review_bbaf339">RNA_<wbr>velocity_<wbr>review_<wbr>bbaf339</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Paradigms, innovations, and biological applications of RNA velocity: a comprehensive review</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇综述把 RNA velocity 理解为“从 unspliced/spliced RNA 计数推断细胞转录动态向量场”的问题，并用三类范式组织现有方法：稳态方法简单可解释但假设强，轨迹方法更灵活但优化复杂，状态外推方法能捕捉局部异质动力学但依赖邻域选择。研究者应把 velocity 结果当作模型假设驱动的动态证据，并结合数据质量、模型假设、可视化检查和生物学验证来解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paradigms, innovations, and biological applications of RNA velocity: a comprehensive review — Wang et al., Briefings in Bioinformatics 26(4), 2025. DOI: 10.1093/bib/bbaf339.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbaf339" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for RNA_velocity_review_bbaf339">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/rna-velocity-review-bbaf339-858c4c7b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：RNA_velocity_review_bbaf339">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="science" data-journal-label="Science" data-method="RoseTTAFold2-PPI">

        <h2 aria-label="RoseTTAFold2-PPI">RoseTTAFold2-<wbr>PPI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Predicting protein-protein interactions in the human proteome</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作不是把任意两个蛋白交给 AlphaFold 再看结构是否“像一个复合物”，而是先从更深的跨物种序列数据中寻找共同进化信号，再用专门训练的快速网络 RF2-PPI 做大规模筛选，最后只对候选对运行 AlphaFold2。这样把约 1.91 亿个组合逐层缩小到可计算、可解释的高置信候选。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The human interactome (estimated 74,000-200,000 PPIs among 200 million protein pairs) remains largely uncharacterized. Experimental methods (Y2H, AP-MS) have limited coverage and high false-positive rates — only 3,988 PPIs are confidently s…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="ROSIE">

        <h2 aria-label="ROSIE">ROSIE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ROSIE: AI generation of multiplex immunofluorescence staining from histopathology images</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ROSIE 把一张 H&amp;E 图像切成带有局部组织上下文的 128\times128 像素块，用 ImageNet 预训练的 ConvNeXt-Small 一次回归 50 个蛋白标志物在中心 8\times8 区域的平均表达；推断时按 8 像素步长铺满组织并拼回多通道图像，再可借助细胞分割把像素级预测汇总为单细胞表达。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="pnas" data-journal-label="PNAS" data-method="Safety_Performance_Multi_Objective_Learning_Market_Entry">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Safety_Performance_Multi_Objective_Learning_Market_Entry">Safety_<wbr>Performance_<wbr>Multi_<wbr>Objective_<wbr>Learning_<wbr>Market_<wbr>Entry</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Safety versus performance: How multi-objective learning reduces barriers to market entry</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这不是生信论文，也不是用真实公司数据做的产业实证。它是一篇结合机器学习理论与市场竞争问题的模型论文：当大公司受到更严格的安全审查、而小公司受到的审查较弱时，大公司拥有的数据优势是否仍然构成不可逾越的进入壁垒？ 论文给出的答案是：未必。严格的安全约束会迫使在位公司牺牲一部分性能；进入者若可以更偏向性能目标，就可能用远少于在位公司的数据达到更高性能。不过，这一优势正来自更宽松的安全标准，所以“更容易进入市场”不等于“社会福利一定更高”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Large machine-learning providers can accumulate far more data than prospective entrants, which appears to create a self-reinforcing barrier to entry.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PNAS · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2510004122" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Safety_Performance_Multi_Objective_Learning_Market_Entry">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/safety-performance-multi-objective-learning-market-entry-f2aa925e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Safety_Performance_Multi_Objective_Learning_Market_Entry">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="SaProt">

        <h2 aria-label="SaProt">SaProt</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Democratizing protein language model training, sharing and collaboration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SaProt 的关键不是另造一种三维神经网络，而是先用 Foldseek 把每个残基周围的局部几何环境离散成一个 3Di 字母，再把“氨基酸字母”和“结构字母”合成一个 token。这样，普通双向 Transformer 读一条一维序列时，就能同时看到序列身份和结构环境。2025 年正式论文又在这个模型之上加入 ColabSaprot 和 SaprotHub，让非机器学习用户通过轻量 adapter 训练、分享、续训和聚合任务模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Proteins are central to virtually all biological processes, yet deciphering protein structure–function relationships remains challenging. While protein language models (PLMs) have driven advances in function prediction, leveraging these mod…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-025-02859-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SaProt">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/westlake-repl/Saprot" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SaProt">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/saprot-21516ea4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SaProt">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="scATAC" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="scAGDE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">scATAC — Single-Cell Chromatin &amp; DNA Methylation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scAGDE">scAGDE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Topological identification and interpretation for single-cell epigenetic regulation elucidation in multi-tasks using scAGDE</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scAGDE 不是只对稀疏的 scATAC 峰矩阵做一次降维。它先用普通变分自编码器找出能区分细胞的峰并建立细胞近邻图，再用图卷积变分自编码器同时重建“哪些细胞彼此相邻”和“每个峰是否开放”，最后用软聚类和高置信伪标签继续收紧潜空间。输出因此兼顾细胞嵌入、聚类、峰筛选和开放概率插补。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell ATAC-seq measures chromatin accessibility at single-cell resolution, but the resulting cell-by-peak matrix is sparse, high-dimensional, and nearly binary.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-57027-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scAGDE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Hgy1014/scAGDE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scAGDE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scagde-ff46fee6/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scAGDE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

        <h2 aria-label="Scale_adaptive_uncertainty_aware_downscaling">Scale_<wbr>adaptive_<wbr>uncertainty_<wbr>aware_<wbr>downscaling</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Fast, scale-adaptive and uncertainty-aware downscaling of Earth system model fields with generative machine learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">地球系统模式（ESM）的全球模拟分辨率通常只有 10-100 km，难以刻画局地降水，尤其是极端降水。直接把网格插值放大，只会得到更密但仍然过于平滑的场，不会补回缺失的小尺度间歇性结构。 这个任务还有一个关键困难：ESM 和 ERA5 再分析资料通常是非配对样本。由于天气系统具有混沌性，同一天的 ESM 模拟与观测并不会呈现相同的具体天气轨迹，因此不能把问题简单处理成“低分辨率图像到同日高分辨率真值”的监督回归。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Earth system models (ESMs) are too coarse and biased for many local climate-impact questions, particularly for precipitation extremes. Downscaling is difficult because historical observations and ESM fields are unpaired: their chaotic weath…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/p-hss/consistency-climate-downscaling" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Scale_adaptive_uncertainty_aware_downscaling">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scale-adaptive-uncertainty-aware-downscaling-624182b1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Scale_adaptive_uncertainty_aware_downscaling">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞图谱越来越大，但“大”并不等于“可以直接合并”。不同研究往往来自不同实验室、测序批次、组织、疾病条件和样本处理流程，因此原始表达矩阵同时混合了两类变化： 希望保留的生物学变化，例如初始、记忆、效应、耗竭等 CD8^+ T 细胞状态； 希望消除的技术或队列变化，例如 atlas、study、sample 等多层批次效应。 跨图谱分析还有第二个困难：不同图谱的细胞亚型命名和注释粒度并不一致。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="scDiffEq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scDiffEq">scDiffEq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Learning cell dynamics with neural differential equations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scDiffEq 不把单细胞时间序列理解为“每个早期细胞都有一个可观测的后继细胞”，而把每个时间点的细胞看成一个群体分布：从早期群体采样细胞，在低维表达空间中用神经随机微分方程（neural SDE）向前模拟，再让模拟群体逼近后续时点的真实群体。模型同时学习确定性的漂移 f(z) 与依赖细胞状态的扩散 g(z)，因此既能表示分化的平均方向，也能表示同一祖细胞附近可能产生多种结局的随机性。 这个区分是论文的核心。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell fate decisions combine directional regulatory programs with stochastic fluctuations. In haematopoiesis, a progenitor&#x27;s future cannot be measured continuously because scRNA-seq destroys the sampled cell, so methods must infer dynamics f…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-025-01150-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scDiffEq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/scDiffEq/scDiffEq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scDiffEq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scdiffeq-63006658/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scDiffEq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell multi-omic detection of DNA methylation and histone modifications reconstructs the dynamics of epigenomic maintenance</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scEpi²-seq 把“抗体定位的组蛋白修饰片段”和“同一片段上的 CpG 甲基化”装进同一个单细胞、单分子读出中，并额外利用片段起点间距推断核小体周期结构。它的关键价值不是简单叠加两种组学，而是能在同一批细胞中讨论复制时序、染色质环境与甲基化维持速度之间的关系。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序数据通常是“细胞 × 基因”的表格。VAE 很适合处理这种表格，但传统 scVI（Nature Methods, 2018）主要学习细胞表示，不能自然地产生可用于基因分析的表示；siVAE（Genome Biology, 2023）可以同时学习细胞和基因表示，但基因编码器的输入宽度随细胞数增长。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCimilarity 用重构保持表达细节，用 Cell Ontology 约束的 triplet learning 学习可迁移的细胞距离，再用近邻索引把这个距离扩展成数千万细胞的搜索、注释与解释系统；公开代码实现了核心算法，但完整 atlas、模型资产和论文实验仍属于外部复现边界。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCimilarity&#x27;s central contribution is a reusable cell-state metric rather than a one-task predictor: reconstruction retains subtle transcriptomic state, ontology-aware metric learning makes distance transferable across studies, and a large…</p>

        <h2 aria-label="ScIsoX">ScIsoX</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">ScIsoX: a multidimensional framework for measuring isoform-level transcriptomic complexity in single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ScIsoX 是一个用于单细胞 isoform/transcript 水平分析的描述性框架。它输入 gene count、transcript/isoform count、转录本注释和可选的细胞类型标签，输出每个基因的 7 个 isoform 复杂度指标、阈值分类、可视化和共表达结果。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">ScIsoX addresses a gap in single-cell isoform analysis: isoform-resolved sequencing can measure transcript diversity inside individual cells, but common analysis workflows still treat expression as either gene-by-cell or transcript-by-cell…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03758-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ScIsoX">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ThaddeusWu/ScIsoX" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ScIsoX">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scisox-b39e607e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ScIsoX">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
