      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="scITD">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scITD">scITD</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Coordinated, multicellular patterns of transcriptional variation that stratify patient cohorts are revealed by tensor decomposition</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scITD 把多供体单细胞数据压缩为一组可解释的多细胞因子：每个因子同时告诉研究者“哪些人沿这个过程不同”以及“哪些基因在每种细胞中共同构成这个过程”，再用临床关联、通路、独立队列和遗传证据逐层解释这些无监督轴。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Population-scale scRNA-seq makes it possible to ask how expression states in different cell types covary across people. Standard PCA can find donor axes within one cell type, but matching separate cell-type PCs is ambiguous.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kharchenkolab/scITD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scITD">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scitd-a4fd1c54/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scITD">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="scLDM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scLDM">scLDM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable Single-Cell Gene Expression Generation with Latent Diffusion Models</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scLDM 的关键不是简单地“把扩散模型用于单细胞”，而是先用交叉注意力把无序、稀疏、计数型基因集合变成固定长度的潜在 token，再让 DiT 在这个结构正确的潜空间里学习细胞分布与联合条件响应，最后通过基因 ID 查询和计数似然还原到原始表达空间。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell expression profiles are high-dimensional, sparse count data in which gene order has no biological meaning. Many generative models nevertheless use fixed-position vectors, restrict analysis to highly variable genes, or model norm…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/czi-ai/scldm" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scLDM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scldm-ddbebc35/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scLDM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-genomics" data-journal-label="Cell Genomics" data-method="scMeFormer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scMeFormer">scMeFormer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deep learning imputes DNA methylation states in single cells and enhances the detection of epigenetic alterations in schizophrenia</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">对一个待预测的 CpG 位点，scMeFormer 同时读取其上下约 2 kb DNA 序列，以及前后邻近 CpG 在多个细胞簇中的甲基化模式；两条 CNN–Transformer 分支分别提取序列和群体甲基化上下文，融合后一次输出该 CpG 在所有细胞中的甲基化预测。只有真实测到的“CpG—细胞”标签参与训练损失，未测位置不会被错误当成未甲基化。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell DNA methylation assays can reveal cell-type regulatory states at cytosine resolution, but each nucleus covers only a small fraction of CpG sites.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Genomics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xgen.2025.100774" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scMeFormer">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/LieberInstitute/scMeformer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scMeFormer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scmeformer-bf8728a0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scMeFormer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SCMMI Benchmark">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCMMI Benchmark">SCMMI Benchmark</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Benchmarking single-cell multi-modal data integrations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCMMI Benchmark 不是一个新的整合模型，而是一个用于选择单细胞多模态整合方法的基准框架：它把不同数据设定拆成多个任务，统一运行或汇总方法输出，再用共享指标做任务条件下的推荐。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell multimodal integration methods are used across RNA+ATAC, RNA+protein, spatial multiomics, unpaired, and mosaic data designs, but method papers usually evaluate different datasets and metrics.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02737-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SCMMI Benchmark">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/bm2-lab/SCMMI_Benchmark" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SCMMI Benchmark">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scmmi-benchmark-e8719d98/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SCMMI Benchmark">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="scMODAL">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scMODAL">scMODAL</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scMODAL: a general deep learning framework for comprehensive single-cell multi-omics data alignment with feature links</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scMODAL 面向的是未配对单细胞多组学：两个数据集的细胞不同、特征也不同，但研究者知道少量正相关的跨模态特征链接，例如 RNA 基因表达与 ATAC gene activity，或蛋白丰度与其编码基因表达。方法不是只在这些共有特征上整合，而是让各模态编码器读取自己的完整高变特征，同时只用链接特征寻找跨模态锚点。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell multi-omics technologies enable measuring transcriptomics, epigenomics, and proteomics from different cells in different experiments — but these datasets cannot simply be merged because they share no common cells and often no co…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-60333-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scMODAL">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gefeiwang/scMODAL" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scMODAL">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scmodal-db9960fe/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scMODAL">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scMultiBench">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scMultiBench">scMultiBench</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multitask benchmarking of single-cell multimodal omics integration methods</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scMultiBench 的价值是把方法选择改写为一个有条件的问题：输入结构决定可用方法，任务决定该看哪些指标，数据和指标共同决定相对排名；任何脱离这些条件的“全局最佳方法”都超出了论文证据。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Benchmark paper (Registered Report) — not a new computational method. scMultiBench provides a systematic categorization and comprehensive benchmarking of existing single-cell multimodal omics integration methods.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02856-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scMultiBench">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/PYangLab/scMultiBench" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scMultiBench">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scmultibench-1476a178/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scMultiBench">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scMultiSim">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scMultiSim">scMultiSim</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scMultiSim: simulation of single-cell multi-omics and spatial data guided by gene regulatory networks and cell-cell interactions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scMultiSim 不是从参考数据中拟合一个黑箱生成器，而是让用户先给出细胞分化树，并可选提供基因调控网络（GRN）和细胞间相互作用（CCI），再把细胞身份、调控、染色质可及性和空间邻域逐层写入转录动力学参数，最终同时输出 RNA、ATAC、RNA velocity、空间位置及其真值。它的主要用途不是复刻某一个真实样本，而是构造“因素已知且强度可调”的数据来检验分析方法。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;scMultiSim: simulation of single-cell multi-omics and spatial data guided by gene regulatory networks and cell-cell interactions&quot; Journal: Nature Methods (April 2025) DOI: 10.1038/s41592-025-02651-0 Code Repository: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02651-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scMultiSim">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ZhangLabGT/scMultiSim" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scMultiSim">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scmultisim-f6974adb/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scMultiSim">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scNET">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scNET">scNET</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scNET: learning context-specific gene and cell embeddings by integrating single-cell gene expression data with protein-protein interactions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scRNA-seq 中的零值和噪声会削弱基因相关性，而通用 PPI 网络又缺少具体组织、细胞状态和条件信息。scNET 的目标是把两者互补起来：PPI 告诉模型哪些蛋白可能相互作用，当前数据集的表达和细胞邻域告诉模型这些关系在本条件下怎样呈现。 最终一次训练同时给出四类产物：gene embedding、cell embedding、重构表达矩阵和经过注意力筛选的 cell KNN 图。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA sequencing captures cellular heterogeneity but suffers from severe zero inflation (&gt;90% zero values) — a mix of technical dropout and true biological absence.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02627-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scNET">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/madilabcode/scNET" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scNET">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scnet-6a314449/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scNET">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="SCP-Nano">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCP-Nano">SCP-<wbr>Nano</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Nanocarrier imaging at single-cell resolution across entire mouse bodies with deep learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">纳米载体（LNP、脂质体、聚合物复合物、DNA origami、AAV 等）是否真正到达目标细胞、是否在低水平下进入非目标器官，是药物递送安全性和有效性的核心问题。PET、CT、MRI 和常规活体光学成像能观察全身，但通常只能达到器官尺度，在低剂量下也可能缺乏灵敏度；传统组织学能看到单细胞，却只能检查预先选择的二维切片，容易产生抽样偏差。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Nanocarrier development needs whole-organism measurements that resolve individual targeted cells and weak off-target sites. PET, CT, MRI and conventional optical imaging provide longitudinal or organ-scale information but lack the required…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/erturklab/SCP-Nano" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SCP-Nano">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scp-nano-9989a54e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SCP-Nano">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nar-genomics-and-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics" data-method="scPN">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scPN">scPN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Simultaneously infer cell pseudotime, velocity field, and gene interaction from multi-branch scRNA-seq data with scPN</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scPN 把细胞看成一个 gene interaction network 在未知时间点的静态快照，用分段线性 ODE 同时推断 pseudotime、velocity-like dynamics 和 gene-gene interaction matrix。它的核心不是先排时间再算速度，也不是先算速度再排时间，而是在“给定矩阵排细胞”和“给定细胞顺序拟合矩阵”之间交替更新。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scPN 解决的是一个耦合推断问题：在只有静态 scRNA-seq 表达矩阵、没有真实采样时间的情况下，同时恢复细胞 pseudotime、速度场和基因相互作用矩阵。论文认为，传统 trajectory 方法通常先根据表达相似性排序，RNA velocity 方法通常先估计速度再推 pseudotime，GRN 方法又多偏静态，因此三者之间容易出现不一致。scPN 的建模入口是把每个细胞看成基因网络动态系统中的无序快照，再通过分段 ODE 将多分支轨迹分到不同局部线性系统中。</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/nargab/lqaf144" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scPN">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ZHOUZHEN2002/scPN" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scPN">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scpn-cee56a1f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scPN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="scProto">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scProto">scProto</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable Self-Supervised Prototype Learning for Single-Cell Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统 metacell 方法在原始 KNN 图上聚合相似细胞，能降低噪声，却容易把 batch effect 一起保留下来。scProto 的想法是：先用自监督学习得到 batch-corrected latent space，再在其中学习一组 prototype；每个 prototype 聚合许多相近细胞，并且能通过条件 VAE decoder 还原为基因表达，因此可解释为 metacell。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Reproducibility Rating: 4/5 scProto presents a self-supervised framework for learning interpretable metacells from single-cell transcriptomic data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scproto-6bdd679f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scProto">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="science" data-journal-label="Science" data-method="scProtVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scProtVelo">scProtVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping early human blood cell differentiation using single-cell proteomics and transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scProtVelo 的关键不是把 RNA velocity 的标签换成“蛋白”，而是用共同潜在空间连接非同细胞的 RNA 与蛋白测量，以 mRNA 驱动蛋白的解析动力学和四状态概率混合解释翻译延迟，再把 \kappa r-\delta p 投影为局部细胞转移方向；它提供了蛋白层面的动态视角，但结论强度受跨模态配对、轨迹分段、尺度变换和恒速率假设共同限制。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Mapping early human blood cell differentiation using single-cell proteomics and transcriptomics Journal: Science, 2025 DOI: 10.1126/science.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adr8785" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scProtVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/scProtVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scProtVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scprotvelo-711235c3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scProtVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="scientific-reports" data-journal-label="Scientific Reports" data-method="scRDEN">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scRDEN">scRDEN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scRDEN: single-cell dynamic gene rank differential expression network and robust trajectory inference</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scRDEN 面向单细胞 RNA-seq 的细胞亚群识别、拟时序轨迹推断和动态基因网络分析。文章的基本判断是：直接使用单个基因的表达量做轨迹推断容易受 dropout、噪声、细胞异质性和复杂分支结构影响；相对而言，细胞内基因对的表达排序关系更稳定，适合用来构造更鲁棒的轨迹特征。这个动机在摘要、引言和 Fig.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scRDEN: single-cell dynamic gene rank differential expression network and robust trajectory inference was published in Scientific Reports in 2025.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Scientific Reports · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-01969-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scRDEN">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scrden-662f0c91/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scRDEN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="npj-systems-biology-and-applications" data-journal-label="npj Systems Biology and Applications" data-method="scTEL">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scTEL">scTEL</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A joint analysis of single cell transcriptomics and proteomics using transformer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scTEL 面向 CITE-seq 和 scRNA-seq 的联合分析。CITE-seq 可以在同一个细胞内同时测 RNA 和表面蛋白，但论文指出它成本高、抗体面板有限，而且 RNA 与蛋白表达之间常常不是简单强相关关系，因此只靠 RNA 或只靠已有蛋白面板都不够 。 论文的核心目标是：用已有 CITE-seq 数据学习从 RNA 表达到蛋白表达的映射，这样在只有 scRNA-seq 或蛋白面板不完整的场景中，也能预测或补全蛋白表达 。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">A joint analysis of single cell transcriptomics and proteomics using transformer introduces scTEL, a deep-learning framework for CITE-seq/scRNA-seq analysis. The paper appeared in npj Systems Biology and Applications in 2025 with DOI 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>npj Systems Biology and Applications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41540-024-00484-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scTEL">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/142857cyy/scTEL" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scTEL">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sctel-93f2bd9b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scTEL">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scvi-hub">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scvi-hub">scvi-<wbr>hub</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scvi-hub: an actionable repository for model-driven single-cell analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scvi-hub 解决的不是“怎样再设计一个 scVI 变体”，而是一个更靠后的基础设施问题：一个实验室训练好的 scVI、scANVI、totalVI 或 DestVI 模型，怎样连同必要的数据表示、元数据和质量证据交给另一个实验室复用。 论文把模型共享拆成两侧。贡献者训练参考模型，检查模型是否复现了原数据的重要统计结构，把大数据压缩成可随模型分发的表示，再上传模型与模型卡；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The explosion of single-cell omics atlases (10s of millions of cells) has created a reuse bottleneck: raw reference datasets are too large to download (HLCA: several GB; CZI Census: 500 GB), require specialized HPC to process, and rely on e…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02799-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scvi-hub">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YosefLab/scvi-hub-reproducibility" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scvi-hub">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scvi-hub-de26fd19/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scvi-hub">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="scVIVA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scVIVA">scVIVA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scVIVA: A Probabilistic Framework for Representation of Cells and Their Environments in Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scVIVA 处理一个很具体的问题：空间转录组里的细胞既有自身表达状态，也处在由其他细胞组成的微环境中。如果直接把邻域特征拼到细胞表达上，模型可能连与该细胞无关的空间结构也记住；如果完全忽略空间，又会错过由生态位诱导的细胞状态。scVIVA 的折中是：从细胞自身表达编码潜变量，再要求这个潜变量同时预测细胞表达和邻域摘要。因此，邻域只有在能够由该细胞的转录组预测时，才会进入表示。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Full title: scVIVA: A Probabilistic Framework for Representation of Cells and Their Environments in Spatial Transcriptomics Authors: Nathan Levy, Florian Ingelfinger, Artemii Bakulin, Giacomo Cinnirella, Pierre Boyeau, Boaz Nadler, Can Erge…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.06.01.657182" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scVIVA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/LevyNat/scVIVA-reproducibility" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scVIVA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scviva-e1e22aa3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scVIVA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="manuscript" data-journal-label="Manuscript" data-method="SDELight">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="SDELight">SDELight</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SDELight: Adversarial Learning and Gromov-Wasserstein Distance for Multi-Modal Integration of Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SDELight 面向多张空间转录组切片，串联三个阶段： Deconvolution：结合 H&amp;E、scRNA-seq 参考和 spot-level ST，估计每个 spot 的细胞类型组成； Integration：把细胞组成加入表达特征，用 GCN 与域对抗训练减弱切片批次效应，并得到跨切片可聚类的生物 embedding；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SDELight tackles fundamental challenges in spatial transcriptomics analysis: Multi-resolution integration: Spatial transcriptomics technologies like 10x Visium (55µm resolution) cannot achieve single-cell resolution, requiring deconvolution…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Manuscript · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sdelight-d823a981/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SDELight">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SDR-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SDR-seq">SDR-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Functional phenotyping of genomic variants using joint multiomic single-cell DNA–RNA sequencing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SDR-seq（single-cell DNA–RNA sequencing）把“这一个细胞在目标位点是什么基因型”和“这一个细胞的目标基因表达多少”放进同一次液滴多重 PCR 测量。它不依赖 gRNA 身份猜测编辑结果，而是直接测内源 gDNA；同时用原位逆转录和 UMI 测量目标 RNA，因此能把 REF/HET/ALT 基因型与表达表型在细胞级连接起来。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Understanding how genetic variants — particularly the &gt;90% located in noncoding regions — impact gene expression requires simultaneously profiling genotype and transcriptome in single cells.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02805-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SDR-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/hawkjo/SDRranger" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SDR-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sdr-seq-3762e9e8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SDR-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SG-NEx">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SG-NEx">SG-<wbr>NEx</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A systematic benchmark of Nanopore long-read RNA sequencing for transcript-level analysis in human cell lines</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">一个基因往往对应多个高度相似的转录本。短读长 RNA-seq 能稳定估计基因总表达量，却经常无法判断一条短片段究竟来自哪个异构体，尤其难以同时连接多个剪接位点。已有长读长数据集又常受样本少、重复不足、协议单一或测序深度有限的影响，因此很难公平比较技术差异。 SG-NEx 的目标不是提出一个新的预测模型，而是建立一个可复用、带匹配样本和对照的技术基准，回答：不同 RNA-seq 协议怎样影响读长、覆盖、基因表达、转录本定量和主要异构体判断？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Gene-level RNA abundance is often robust, but transcript-level abundance is hard to estimate because isoforms share exons and short reads rarely preserve long-range splice-junction linkage.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02623-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SG-NEx">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GoekeLab/sg-nex-data" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SG-NEx">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sg-nex-024c619d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SG-NEx">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SIMO">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SIMO">SIMO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial integration of multi-omics single-cell data with SIMO</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SIMO 先用共享表达和图结构把 scRNA 细胞定位到 ST，再以这些已定位 RNA 细胞为中介，把其他单细胞组学按簇级相关与簇内几何接入空间；它能处理正相关和反相关模态并支持空间调控模块分析，但坐标和调控关系都是顺序模型推断，强烈依赖注释、桥接特征、参数和上游预处理。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Current spatial omics technologies primarily capture a single modality — mainly transcriptome or proteome — on tissue sections. Single-cell multi-omics methods (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, snmC-seq) provide rich multi-modal profiles but destroy…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-56523-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SIMO">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ZJUFanLab/SIMO" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SIMO">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/simo-6581635b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SIMO">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SIMVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SIMVI">SIMVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SIMVI disentangles intrinsic and spatial-induced cellular states in spatial omics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间组学数据里，一个细胞的表达模式通常同时受两类因素影响： 细胞内在状态：例如细胞类型、细胞周期、分化阶段等。 空间诱导状态：例如空间梯度、邻近细胞互作、局部微环境信号等。 难点在于，这两类因素经常纠缠在一起。比如同一种细胞类型本来就可能聚集在组织的某个区域；如果一个模型直接使用空间邻域信息学习嵌入，就可能把“细胞类型本身的空间分布”误当成“空间微环境造成的表达改变”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SIMVI (Spatial Interaction Modeling using Variational Inference) is a deep variational framework for spatial omics that separates cell-intrinsic variation from spatial-induced variation.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-58089-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SIMVI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/KlugerLab/SIMVI" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SIMVI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/simvi-35534bbc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SIMVI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SLOPER">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SLOPER">SLOPER</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping spatial gradients in spatial transcriptomics data with score matching</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SLOPER（Score-based Learning Of Poisson-modeled Expression Rates）处理的不是普通的空间聚类问题。它先为每个基因学习一个二维向量场：在组织内任一点，这个向量指出该基因的相对表达强度朝哪个方向上升、上升有多快。这个向量场随后既可作为空间模式本身，也可驱动 Langevin 采样，把稀疏、扩散的观测计数重排成空间上更集中的“增强表达”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies measure gene expression at thousands of locations in a 2D tissue slice. A central challenge is characterizing spatial variation in gene expression — not just which genes are expressed where, but in…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.24.690257" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SLOPER">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/chitra-lab/SLOPER" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SLOPER">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sloper-6ea9a2ae/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SLOPER">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="SMOPCA">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SMOPCA">SMOPCA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SMOPCA: spatially aware dimension reduction integrating multi-omics improves the efficiency of spatial domain detection</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SMOPCA 同时接收多个模态的“特征 × 空间位点”矩阵和位点坐标，用一个共享低维矩阵解释各模态，再用空间核约束相邻位点的低维表示应当相关。模型输出连续嵌入；论文中的空间域标签是随后在该嵌入上运行 K-means 得到的，并不是 SMOPCA 类自身学习的结果。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Full title: SMOPCA: spatially aware dimension reduction integrating multi-omics improves the efficiency of spatial domain detection Authors: Mo Chen, Ruihua Cheng, Jianuo He, Jun Chen, Jie Zhang Journal: Genome Biology (2025) | DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03576-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SMOPCA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cmhimself/SMOPCA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SMOPCA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/smopca-eefac3b2/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SMOPCA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SpaIM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaIM">SpaIM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpaIM: single-cell spatial transcriptomics imputation via style transfer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaIM 不直接把单细胞映射到空间位置。它把每个基因当成一个训练样本：scRNA-seq 侧用该基因在 K 个细胞类型中的平均表达作为“content”，ST 侧用同一基因在全部空间位置的表达向量作为“style/目标”。一个 ST autoencoder 从已测共同基因学习 ST 风格，另一个 ST generator 把同样的风格施加到 scRNA-seq content 上；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) platforms have two compounding limitations: data sparsity (high dropout rates due to molecular capture inefficiency) and restricted gene coverage (imaging-based platforms like NanoString CosMx measure only hundr…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-63185-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaIM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/QSong-github/SpaIM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaIM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spaim-b994709e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaIM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="spaLLM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="spaLLM">spaLLM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">spaLLM: enhancing spatial domain analysis in multi-omics data through large language model integration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">spaLLM 把空间多组学的两个数值模态与 scGPT 生成的 RNA spot embedding 放进多张图中传播，再通过三级注意力汇合为 64 维表示，最后用 mclust 等聚类器划分空间域。这里的“LLM”是冻结 scGPT 的预计算表示，不是训练或提示一个聊天模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">spaLLM is a spatial multi-omics domain-identification method that supplements RNA and a second omics modality with a frozen scGPT spot embedding.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbaf304" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for spaLLM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/liiilongyi/spaLLM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for spaLLM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spallm-f88a3096/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：spaLLM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SpaMV">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaMV">SpaMV</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable spatial multi-omics data integration and dimension reduction with SpaMV</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">同一个空间位置可以同时测到转录组、表观组、蛋白组或代谢组。传统整合常把所有模态压到一个统一表示里，这适合找共同组织结构，却可能把只在某个模态中清楚的生物信号当成噪声。SpaMV 的核心假设是：每个 spot 的观测由一部分跨模态共享状态和每个模态自己的私有状态共同产生。 因此，对第 i 个模态 xi，模型学习一个共享变量 zs 和一个私有变量 z{pi}。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multi-omics data measure multiple molecular layers at the same tissue locations, but many integration methods compress all modalities into a single shared latent space.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.08.02.668264" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaMV">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ericcombiolab/SpaMV" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaMV">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spamv-7eed7182/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaMV">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="research-square-preprint" data-journal-label="Research Square preprint" data-method="SpaMV">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaMV">SpaMV</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable spatial multi-omics data integration and dimension reduction with SpaMV</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaMV 不把多个空间组学层强行压进一个共同嵌入，而是假设每个模态都由“跨模态共享状态”与“该模态私有状态”共同生成；它用每个模态各自的共享/私有 GAT 编码器、自重建和交叉重建、跨模态 measurement model，以及第二阶段 HSIC 独立性约束，尽量把两类信息分开，并提供空间域聚类和可解释 topic 两种输出模式。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Interpretable spatial multi-omics data integration and dimension reduction with SpaMV Authors: Yang Liu, Kexin Ma, Haoran Xu, et al. Affiliations: Hong Kong Baptist University, Sichuan University, Vanderbilt University, City Universi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Research Square preprint · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-7396454/v1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaMV">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ericcombiolab/SpaMV" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaMV">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spamv-766765d3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaMV">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="SpaNorm">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaNorm">SpaNorm</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpaNorm: spatially-aware normalization for spatial transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaNorm 可以理解为“空间负二项 GLM 归一化”：对每个基因同时拟合空间 biology 和空间 library-size 效应，然后在生成 PAC/logPAC 时只保留 biology-only 均值，从而尽量去掉区域性 library-size bias，同时保留空间 domain 和 SVG 信号。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics data often have library sizes that vary by tissue region. Standard single-cell-style normalization methods typically apply global library-size correction and can remove biological spatial-domain signals when library…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03565-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaNorm">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spanorm-7b050e82/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaNorm">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="science" data-journal-label="Science" data-method="SPARK-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Data Sources &amp; Technologies</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SPARK-seq">SPARK-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SPARK-seq: A high-throughput platform for aptamer discovery and kinetic profiling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SPARK-seq（Science, 2025）把 CRISPR 靶基因、细胞转录组和细胞表面结合的适配体同时读到同一个单细胞条形码下：如果敲除某个膜蛋白后，一组适配体在这些细胞上的结合量系统性下降，这组适配体就可能直接结合该蛋白。配套的 SPARTA 分析把序列聚成家族、比较敲除组与对照组的结合差异、筛选靶标，再用深度学习预测结合序列并生成新变体。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell surface proteins constitute the targets of &gt;60% of therapeutic drugs, yet high-throughput aptamer discovery against these proteins in native cellular environments has been impossible.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1126/science.adv6127" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SPARK-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/fuyboo/sparta" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SPARK-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spark-seq-d999ec25/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SPARK-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="SpaSEG">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaSEG">SpaSEG</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpaSEG: unsupervised deep learning for multi-task analysis of spatially resolved transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaSEG 面向空间转录组数据的多任务分析。空间转录组不仅有基因表达矩阵，还有每个 spot 或细胞在组织切片上的空间坐标。论文关心的核心问题包括：如何识别连续、边界清楚、具有生物意义的空间结构域；如何把相邻切片整合成一致的三维组织结构；如何在空间结构域内发现空间变异基因；以及如何在组织空间背景下分析配体-受体相互作用和细胞共定位。 已有方法的不足主要有三类。第一，普通聚类方法如 Leiden 主要看表达相似性，空间连续性不足；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaSEG targets spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) analysis, where researchers need to identify coherent tissue domains, integrate adjacent sections, find spatially variable genes (SVGs), and infer spatial cell-cell interactions from g…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03697-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaSEG">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/y-bai/SpaSEG" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaSEG">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spaseg-c0e96ffe/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaSEG">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-reviews-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Reviews Genetics" data-method="spatial-architecture-dev-disease">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="spatial-architecture-dev-disease">spatial-<wbr>architecture-<wbr>dev-<wbr>disease</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial architecture of development and disease</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇文章不是介绍一种新仪器、算法或数据集，而是提出一套阅读空间组学研究的生物学框架：组织中的分子和细胞不仅“有哪些”，还以梯度、区域、邻域、克隆边界和跨器官模式组织起来。疾病可能改变这些空间关系，而空间位置也可能反过来塑造细胞状态和疾病进程。 作者把不同器官、疾病和技术得到的结果归入四个通用层级： 异常分子梯度与空间模式； 发育或疾病相关细胞状态的空间追踪； 作为疾病枢纽的多细胞生态位； 疾病的器官内和器官间空间异质性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Harmonization across datasets: Spatial relationships neglected by current tools; CCFs fail for pathological morphologies Segmentation errors: Major source of technical noise; segmentation-free paradigm emerging Temporal dimension: Most plat…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Reviews Genetics · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Spatial-brain-development">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Spatial-brain-development">Spatial-<wbr>brain-<wbr>development</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial dynamics of brain development and neuroinflammation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作开发了两种 DBiT 空间三组学技术，在同一张组织切片、同一个空间像素内联合测量表观层、转录层和蛋白层；再用时空回归把“随年龄变化”“随解剖位置变化”和“时间与位置共同变化”分开。由此发现，脑发育中染色质开放常早于或晚于 RNA，胼胝体髓鞘化具有双向空间顺序，而局灶脱髓鞘还能沿白质束诱发远端小胶质细胞反应。 论文同时包含技术平台、发育图谱和炎症机制三条主线。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Understanding mammalian brain development requires simultaneous spatial mapping of the epigenome, transcriptome, and proteome — the three layers of the central dogma — within intact tissue.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09663-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Spatial-brain-development">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/di-0579/spatial_tri-omics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spatial-brain-development">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatial-brain-development-0121cc65/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spatial-brain-development">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="spatial-DMT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="spatial-DMT">spatial-<wbr>DMT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial joint profiling of DNA methylome and transcriptome in tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial-DMT 的核心不是把两张独立切片事后配准，而是在同一张固定组织切片、同一个二维条形码像素中同时给基因组 DNA 和 cDNA 加上空间坐标；随后再把二者物理分开，分别建立 EM-seq 甲基化文库和 RNA 文库。这样，每个像素最终对应两张矩阵：基因表达矩阵和 DNA 甲基化矩阵，可通过加权最近邻（WNN）联合分析。 论文为 Lee 等发表于 Nature（2025），DOI 10.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DNA methylation is a canonical epigenetic mark that modulates gene expression across cell types, developmental stages, and disease states. Its spatial organization within tissues — which regions of the genome are methylated in which anatomi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-09478-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for spatial-DMT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/zhou-lab/Spatial-DMT-2024" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for spatial-DMT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatial-dmt-83a8b863/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：spatial-DMT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="spatial-Mux-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="spatial-Mux-seq">spatial-<wbr>Mux-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multiplexed spatial mapping of chromatin features, transcriptome and proteins in tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">spatial-Mux-seq 把普通 Tn5、携带不同连接序列的 nanobody–Tn5、带 poly(A) DNA 标签的蛋白抗体和带生物素的 poly(dT) 逆转录引物放到同一张组织切片上，再用两轮正交微流控条形码给所有分子写入共同空间坐标。反交联后，gDNA 与 cDNA/抗体标签被物理分开，各自建库；计算端再按像素整合 ATAC、两种组蛋白修饰、RNA 和蛋白。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Multiplexed spatial mapping of chromatin features, transcriptome and proteins in tissues Authors: Pengfei Guo, Liran Mao, Yufan Chen, Chin Nien Lee, Angelysia Cardilla, Mingyao Li, Marek Bartosovic, Yanxiang Deng Published: Nature Me…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02576-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for spatial-Mux-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/liranmao/Spatial_multi_omics" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for spatial-Mux-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatial-mux-seq-3a22fb22/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：spatial-Mux-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SpatialEx">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatialEx">SpatialEx</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High-parameter spatial multi-omics through histology-anchored integration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">高参数空间多组学常遇到一个实验限制：相邻组织切片可以来自同一组织块，却只测了不同分子面板或不同模态。例如切片 1 测 panel A，切片 2 测 panel B；若把细胞×分子矩阵排成表格，已测值只落在对角块，其余两块缺失。直接用坐标配准仍不能得到同一个细胞的完整分子谱，因为连续切片不是完全相同的细胞集合。 SpatialEx 的入口是一个更稳定的共同视图：两张切片都有 H&amp;E 形态图像。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial omics technologies face fundamental trade-offs between resolution, throughput, and the number of measurable features. High-resolution platforms like 10x Xenium can profile 300 genes per section, but biological understanding demands…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02926-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatialEx">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/KEAML-JLU/SpatialEx" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatialEx">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialex-43739a01/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialEx">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SpatialMETA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatialMETA">SpatialMETA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Integrating cross-sample and cross-modal data for spatial transcriptomics and metabolomics with SpatialMETA</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpatialMETA 面向一类特殊而困难的数据：空间转录组（ST）给出离散基因计数，空间代谢组（SM）给出连续质谱强度；二者往往来自相邻而非同一张组织切片，分辨率、坐标和组织形状也不同。它的任务不是简单拼接两个矩阵，而是依次解决几何对齐、分辨率统一、跨模态整合和跨样本批次校正，最后提供空间聚类、模态贡献、代谢物注释和空间网络分析。 本解读以 PMC 正文、主图 1–4、补充 PDF papersupp1.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: The tumor microenvironment (TME) is shaped by both gene expression programs (transcriptomics) and metabolic states. Spatial transcriptomics (ST) captures the former; spatial metabolomics (SM) via mass spectrometry imagin…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-63915-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatialMETA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/WanluLiuLab/SpatialMETA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatialMETA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialmeta-8e89ce68/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialMETA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SpaTopic">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaTopic">SpaTopic</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable topic modelling decodes spatial tissue architecture for large-scale multiplexed imaging analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaTopic 不读取原始表达矩阵，而把每个细胞的类型当作“词”、局部空间区域当作“文档”、组织微环境当作“主题”。它通过锚点近邻和折叠 Gibbs 采样，同时推断每个细胞属于哪个空间区域、哪个主题，从而在多张图像中共享一套可解释的细胞类型组成。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multiplexed tissue imaging platforms (CODEX, mIF, IMC, Nanostring CosMx, 10× Xenium) generate spatial maps of millions of single cells profiled for tens to thousands of markers.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61821-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaTopic">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xiyupeng/SpaTopic" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaTopic">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatopic-a950d2a3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaTopic">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SpaTranslator">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaTranslator">SpaTranslator</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpaTranslator: A deep generative framework for universal spatial multi-omics cross-modality translation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaTranslator 先用空间图和 MNN 三元组把参考与目标切片的已观测模态放到同一个批次校正空间，再用参考切片的配对数据训练一个带自重建、交叉重建、KL 正则和对抗对齐的双向翻译器，最后把目标切片的对齐表示解码成缺失模态。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paired spatial multi-omics assays are costly and sparse, while single-modality spatial datasets are increasingly abundant. SpaTranslator uses a paired reference slice to generate a missing modality for another slice, aiming to synthesize pa…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/donghongyu2020/SpaTranslator" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaTranslator">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatranslator-9141fece/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaTranslator">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="spCLUE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="spCLUE">spCLUE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">spCLUE: a contrastive learning approach to unified spatial transcriptomics analysis across single-slice and multi-slice data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间相邻 spot 往往属于同一区域，但表达相似的 spot 也可能跨越物理距离。spCLUE 分别构建空间 KNN 图与表达相关性 KNN 图，用共享 GCN 编码两视图，再以实例级和簇级对比损失对齐。输出是 spot 嵌入；论文最终空间域来自外部 mclust 和可选邻域多数投票，不是网络伪簇头直接给出的标签。 输入是 spot×gene 计数及 adata.obsm[&quot;spatial&quot;]。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">spCLUE addresses spatial domain identification in single-slice and multi-slice spatial transcriptomics. The motivating problem is that spatial proximity and expression similarity are both useful but can disagree.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03636-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for spCLUE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/EnchantedJoy/spCLUE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for spCLUE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spclue-d987999b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：spCLUE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="SPHENIC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SPHENIC">SPHENIC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SPHENIC: Topology-Aware Multi-View Clustering for Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组的空间域识别需要同时满足两件事：同一区域的 spots 在表达上相似，并且在组织切片上连续。普通表达聚类可能切断相邻组织；GCN 能利用邻接图，却主要依赖局部边，少量错误边也可能传播噪声。SPHENIC 的设想是用扩展持久同调提取跨尺度拓扑，再用空间约束显式修正最终嵌入。 这里分析的是测量 spot，而不是逐细胞真值。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SPHENIC is a 2025 arXiv paper proposing topology-aware spatial-domain clustering for spatial transcriptomics. It combines two graph views (physical coordinates and gene expression), extended persistent homology (EPH), modality-specific and…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sphenic-ec6fb59e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SPHENIC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="SPOmiAlign">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SPOmiAlign">SPOmiAlign</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SPOmiAlign: A modality-agnostic framework for robust and scalable spatial multimodal alignment via feature matching</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">相邻组织切片上的转录组、蛋白组、代谢组或组织学图像通常没有共享分子特征，而且会有旋转、尺度变化、局部撕裂和不同采样分辨率。SPOmiAlign 的关键选择不是在基因空间里强行寻找共同维度，而是把问题改写成图像配准： 将空间组学渲染为空间结构图（spatial structural image, SSI），或直接使用配对 H&amp;E/荧光图像； 用预训练 RoMa 稠密匹配模型寻找像素对应及置信度； 用高置信匹配估计全局与非刚性变换；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial multi-omics technologies enable joint profiling of transcriptomics, proteomics, and metabolomics across tissue sections, but integrative analysis requires precise spatial alignment of data generated from adjacent sections on differe…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="aaai" data-journal-label="AAAI" data-method="SpotDiff">

        <h2 aria-label="SpotDiff">SpotDiff</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpotDiff: Spatial Gene Expression Imputation Diffusion with Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data Integration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpotDiff 用条件扩散模型补全空间转录组（ST）表达。它先准备三类条件：被遮蔽的 ST 数值、由基因名和表达值构造的文本表示、同组织 scRNA-seq 经对齐与聚合后的表示；再让 DiT 风格网络预测扩散噪声并恢复表达矩阵。 本工作区是 paper-only：有论文 PDF、OCR 和论文图，但没有作者代码快照，也没有独立补充材料。所以下文解释的是论文写出的计算合同，不能确认实际张量、网络层级与超参数。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics captures gene expression with spatial context but suffers from severe sparsity due to low mRNA capture rates. Existing imputation methods face fundamental limitations: traditional statistical approaches (KNN, matrix…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>AAAI · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spotdiff-34755e12/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpotDiff">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
