      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Spotiphy">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Spotiphy">Spotiphy</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spotiphy enables single-cell spatial whole transcriptomics across an entire section</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">可以把一个 spot 想成一碗混合汤： scRNA 参考告诉我们每种“原料”通常是什么味道； spot 表达告诉我们整碗汤里有哪些分子、各有多少； H&amp;E 图像告诉我们碗里大约有几颗“细胞”； Spotiphy 先估计每种细胞类型贡献了多少分子，再把每个基因的 spot 计数按这些贡献拆开，最后把拆出的类型标签随机放到图像中的细胞核上。 因此，输出是受约束的推断，不是对每个真实细胞重新测序。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics measures thousands of genes across whole sections but pools multiple cells in each capture spot and leaves noncapture gaps.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jyyulab/Spotiphy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spotiphy">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spotiphy-49b5c3e1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spotiphy">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SpotSweeper">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpotSweeper">SpotSweeper</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpotSweeper: spatially aware quality control for spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组不仅测量表达量，还保留每个 spot 或细胞在组织中的位置。传统 QC 往往直接沿用单细胞 RNA 测序流程，例如固定阈值、全样本 MAD 阈值，以及 miQC（PLOS Computational Biology, 2021）。这些方法隐含地把整张组织切片当成同质样本：总 UMI 少、检测基因少或线粒体比例高，就更可能被判为低质量。 但在真实组织中，这些差异可能正是生物学。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Standard spatial transcriptomics QC commonly reuses single-cell rules: fixed cutoffs, whole-sample MAD thresholds or models such as miQC (PLOS Computational Biology, 2021).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/boyiguo1/Manuscript-SpotSweeper" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpotSweeper">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spotsweeper-d70eacfd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpotSweeper">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="spVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="spVelo">spVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">spVelo: RNA velocity inference for multi-batch spatial transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">spVelo 解决的是多批次空间转录组中的 RNA velocity 推断问题：输入 spliced/unspliced 表达、空间坐标和批次信息，输出细胞/spot-by-gene 的 velocity、潜在时间、状态概率和下游生物学解释。核心思想是在 VAE 式 RNA 动力学模型中加入空间 kNN 和跨批次 MNN/OT 图，再用 GAT 和 MMD 让 velocity 场同时利用组织邻域和跨样本对应关系。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">spVelo addresses RNA velocity inference for multi-batch spatial transcriptomics. Existing RNA velocity methods can model spliced/unspliced dynamics, but they usually do not jointly use spatial coordinates and cross-batch tissue corresponden…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-025-03701-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for spVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/VivLon/spVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for spVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spvelo-cc747c38/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：spVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="STANCE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STANCE">STANCE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">STANCE: A Unified Statistical Model to Detect Cell-Type-Specific Spatially Variable Genes in Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组的一个 spot 往往混有多种细胞。某个基因在组织上呈现空间梯度，可能只是因为不同区域的细胞类型比例不同，也可能因为同一种细胞在不同位置真的改变了表达。传统 SVG 检验通常只能回答“这个基因整体上是否具有空间结构”，不能稳定地区分这两种来源。 STANCE 的目标是：给定基因表达、spot 坐标和每个 spot 的细胞类型比例，同时检验整体空间变异与每一种细胞类型内部的空间变异。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies (10x Visium, Slide-Seq, MERFISH) enable profiling the transcriptome at spatial resolution. A key challenge is detecting spatially variable genes (SVGs) — genes whose expression displays non-random s…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-57117-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STANCE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Cui-STT-Lab/STANCE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STANCE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stance-088bcd57/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STANCE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Statistical_Collusion_Collectives_Learning_Platforms">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Statistical_Collusion_Collectives_Learning_Platforms">Statistical_<wbr>Collusion_<wbr>Collectives_<wbr>Learning_<wbr>Platforms</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Statistical Collusion by Collectives on Learning Platforms</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究的不是生物信息学，而是机器学习平台中的集体行动与数据投毒。平台用 N 个用户提交的数据训练分类器，其中 n 个用户形成集体。他们想统一修改自己的特征或标签，让平台在特定输入上给出期望的预测，但行动本身可能有风险，因此需要在行动前回答：凭集体自己汇总的数据，能否计算一个可信的成功率下界？ 集体只知道自身样本和总样本量 N。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This ICML 2025 paper studies how a coordinated group can change submitted training data to influence a learning platform while using only pooled local observations and the platform&#x27;s total sample size.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2502.04879" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Statistical_Collusion_Collectives_Learning_Platforms">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GauthierE/statistical-collusion" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Statistical_Collusion_Collectives_Learning_Platforms">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/statistical-collusion-collectives-learning-platforms-a8dc20df/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Statistical_Collusion_Collectives_Learning_Platforms">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Statistical_Fairness_Accuracy_Frontier">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Statistical_Fairness_Accuracy_Frontier">Statistical_<wbr>Fairness_<wbr>Accuracy_<wbr>Frontier</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">The Statistical Fairness–Accuracy Frontier</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">假设政策制定者必须给两个群体使用同一个预测模型。两个群体的数据规律不同，因此一个模型不可能同时对两者都达到各自的最优误差。制定者不仅关心总体预测是否准确，也关心误差如何分配给两个群体。 已有的公平—准确性（fairness–accuracy, FA）前沿主要研究一个理想问题：如果完整的人群分布已知，哪些群体误差组合是不可被同时改进的？这篇论文研究更现实的有限样本版本： 从两组有限数据估计目标前沿点会损失多少福利？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">A policymaker often has to deploy one predictor across heterogeneous groups while caring both about total predictive error and how that error is distributed.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2508.17622" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Statistical_Fairness_Accuracy_Frontier">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/statistical-fairness-accuracy-frontier-e0d7a440/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Statistical_Fairness_Accuracy_Frontier">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-computational-science" data-journal-label="Nature Computational Science" data-method="STCase">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="STCase">STCase</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable niche-based cell-cell communication inference using multi-view graph neural networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STCase 的关键思想是：先把空间距离、配体-受体表达和 downstream TF activation 融合成 single-cell/spot-level CCC matrices，再把每个 LRP 的 CCC matrix 当作一个 GNN view，让模型学习哪些 LRPs 对目标细胞类型的 niche/subtype 区分最重要。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STCase addresses niche-level cell-cell communication (CCC) inference in spatial transcriptomics. The paper&#x27;s starting point is that cells/spots of the same annotated type can occupy different niches and therefore participate in different CC…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Computational Science · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s43588-025-00809-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STCase">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/STCaser/STCase" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STCase">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stcase-07977147/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STCase">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="STcompare">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STcompare">STcompare</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">STcompare: comparative spatial transcriptomics data analysis of structurally matched tissues to characterize differentially spatially patterned genes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STcompare 用于比较两张结构对应的组织切片。它先要求两张切片在同一像素网格上对齐，然后为每个基因提供两个互补量：空间相关检验判断图案方向是否保持或反转；空间 fold-change 相似度判断对应位置的表达量是否仍在给定倍数范围内。 论文是 2025 年 bioRxiv 预印本，尚未经同行评审。以下解读以本地 51 页论文 PDF/OCR、主图与补充内容、以及 commit 6b27d1d... 的 R 源码为边界。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Standard differential gene expression (DGE) analysis — the workhorse of transcriptomics — asks only whether the mean expression of a gene differs between conditions.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.21.689847" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STcompare">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JEFworks-Lab/STcompare" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STcompare">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stcompare-318709d5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STcompare">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="Stereopy">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Stereopy">Stereopy</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Stereopy: modeling comparative and spatiotemporal cellular heterogeneity via multi-sample spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组分析过去多以单张切片为单位：一个 AnnData、一套预处理和一组结果。但真正的生物问题常涉及多条件、多时间点或连续三维切片。Stereopy 的贡献分两层。第一层是工程框架：用 MSData 管理多个样本，用 MSDataPipeLine（论文称 MSS，multi-sample scope）决定哪些样本独立处理、哪些样本合并处理，并追踪结果依赖。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Modern spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) technologies — Stereo-seq (Cell, 2022), Slide-seq (Science, 2019), MERFISH (Science, 2015), seqFISH+ (Nature, 2019) — generate large multi-sample datasets spanning multiple conditions, timepoi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-58079-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Stereopy">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/STOmics/Stereopy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Stereopy">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stereopy-00df8979/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Stereopy">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="STFlow">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STFlow">STFlow</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Scalable Generation of Spatial Transcriptomics from Histology Images via Whole-Slide Flow Matching</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STFlow 将“由 H&amp;E 图像预测空间转录组”从逐 spot 回归改写成整张切片表达矩阵的生成问题：先从符合计数稀疏性的先验采样一份表达猜测，再让一个局部空间 Transformer 反复根据图像、坐标和邻居当前表达修正它。这样某个 spot 的预测可以显式依赖邻近 spot 的表达状态，而不是把整张切片的联合分布拆成互不相关的单点预测。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Predicting spatially-resolved gene expression from routine H&amp;E histology images could democratize spatial transcriptomics by removing the need for expensive ST experiments.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/2506.05361" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STFlow">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Graph-and-Geometric-Learning/STFlow" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STFlow">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stflow-71aea22e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STFlow">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="briefings-in-bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Briefings in Bioinformatics" data-method="STIFT">

        <h2 aria-label="STIFT">STIFT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">STIFT: spatiotemporal transcriptomics integration through spatially informed multi-timepoint bridging</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STIFT 不把不同发育时间点只当作需要消除的 batches。它先用 DeST-OT 在每对相邻时间切片之间估计软匹配，把高概率匹配转成跨时间图边，再与每张切片内部的空间 KNN 图合并；最后用 graph attention autoencoder 重构表达，并用跨时点“亲属”构造 triplet loss，让 embedding 同时混合批次、保留空间邻域和时间连续性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STIFT addresses integration of spatial transcriptomics data collected across ordered developmental or regenerative time points. Existing spatial integration methods can remove batch effects across slices, but the paper argues that they ofte…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Briefings in Bioinformatics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bib/bbaf644" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STIFT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cuhklinlab/STIFT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STIFT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stift-3e441f10/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STIFT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="quantitative-biology" data-journal-label="Quantitative Biology" data-method="stIHC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="stIHC">stIHC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial transcriptomics iterative hierarchical clustering (stIHC): A novel method for identifying spatial gene co-expression modules</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">stIHC 的核心是：先把每个基因在组织上的表达模式变成平滑函数的系数向量，再用能处理 imbalanced clusters 的迭代层次聚类去找空间共表达模块。论文的模式证据和核心 R 源码支持这个主线；完整 benchmark、GO/anatomy 解释和真实数据 preprocessing 则依赖仓库外证据或未提供脚本。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics methods often detect spatially variable genes (SVGs), but the paper argues that clustering those genes into meaningful co-expression modules remains underdeveloped.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Quantitative Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/CatherineH1/stIHC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for stIHC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stihc-f3f9bf4f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：stIHC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Stochastic_Optimization_Optimal_Importance_Sampling">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Stochastic_Optimization_Optimal_Importance_Sampling">Stochastic_<wbr>Optimization_<wbr>Optimal_<wbr>Importance_<wbr>Sampling</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Stochastic Optimization with Optimal Importance Sampling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通随机梯度从原分布 \mathbb P 采样。若目标主要由罕见事件决定，有信息的样本极少，梯度方差会非常大。重要性采样可以改从 \mathbb P\mu 采样并乘似然比 \ell(x,\mu)，但最合适的 \mu 又依赖未知最优决策 \theta^\star 及其活跃约束。因此出现循环：不知道 \theta^\star 就无法校准采样器；采样器不好又难以学到 \theta^\star。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Importance sampling can sharply reduce rare-event gradient noise, but stochastic optimization creates a circular dependency: the best proposal depends on the unknown optimal decision and its active constraints, while efficiently learning th…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2504.03560" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Stochastic_Optimization_Optimal_Importance_Sampling">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stochastic-optimization-optimal-importance-sampling-307e24e8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Stochastic_Optimization_Optimal_Importance_Sampling">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="STORIES">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STORIES">STORIES</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">STORIES: learning cell fate landscapes from spatial transcriptomics using optimal transport</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STORIES 接收多个时间点的空间转录组切片，在基因表达空间里学习一个标量势能函数 J\theta(x)。细胞沿势能下降方向 -\nabla J\theta(x) 演化；模型用 Fused Gromov–Wasserstein（FGW）距离比较预测群体与下一时点实测群体，使预测既接近下一时点的基因表达，又尽量保存组织内部的相对空间结构。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatiotemporal atlases from technologies like Stereo-seq profile gene expression at single-cell resolution within tissues across multiple developmental time points.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02855-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STORIES">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cantinilab/stories" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STORIES">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stories-77d6ed0b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STORIES">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="SUICA">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SUICA">SUICA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SUICA: Learning Super-high Dimensional Sparse Implicit Neural Representations for Spatial Transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SUICA 不直接让坐标网络输出数万维、极稀疏的基因表达，而是先用带空间图的自编码器把每个 spot 压到低维稠密嵌入，再让隐式神经表示（INR）学习“坐标 → 嵌入”，最后用预训练并微调的解码器恢复基因表达。这个分解把高维稀疏重建拆成“空间映射”和“表达解码”两个更容易优化的问题。 本文解释基于本地论文 Markdown、五张主图、附录以及官方代码提交 4214c1f85774b90762af86c57f98f306712cfb64。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SUICA: Learning Super-high Dimensional Sparse Implicit Neural Representations for Spatial Transcriptomics Qingtian Zhu, Yumin Zheng, Yuling Sang, Yifan Zhan, Ziyan Zhu, Jun Ding, Yinqiang Zheng.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2412.01124" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SUICA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Szym29/SUICA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SUICA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/suica-275937c7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SUICA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SUM-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="SUM-seq">SUM-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell ultra-high-throughput multiplexed chromatin and RNA profiling reveals gene regulatory dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SUM-seq 的本质是：先用样本索引给每个细胞核建立“第一重身份”，再大胆过载液滴并加入“第二重身份”，最后用两重身份同时恢复 RNA 与 ATAC，从而把许多样本和大量细胞压缩到一次高通量多组学实验中。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Joint single-cell measurement of chromatin accessibility and gene expression can connect regulatory elements, transcription factors and target genes, but existing assays rarely combine high cell throughput, many-sample multiplexing and reas…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dbrg77/ISSAAC-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SUM-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sum-seq-d64709d6/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SUM-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="SVG_Benchmarking">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SVG_Benchmarking">SVG_<wbr>Benchmarking</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Systematic benchmarking of computational methods to identify spatially variable genes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组数据同时记录基因表达和空间坐标。一个核心任务是找出表达模式与空间位置显著相关的基因，即 spatially variable genes，简称 SVG。已有方法很多，但不同方法在模拟数据、真实组织、统计校准、计算规模和下游聚类任务中的表现并不一致。本文的目标不是提出一个新的 SVG 模型，而是系统比较 14 个已有 SVG 检测方法，并给出方法选择建议。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics produces gene-expression measurements tied to tissue coordinates, and a common downstream task is to identify spatially variable genes (SVGs).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pinellolab/SVG_Benchmarking" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SVG_Benchmarking">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/svg-benchmarking-6b79028e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SVG_Benchmarking">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/perturbation_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Systema">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Perturbation Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Systema">Systema</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Systema: a framework for evaluating genetic perturbation response prediction beyond systematic variation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Systema 不是新的扰动响应预测模型，而是一套重新审视预测结果的评估框架。它指出：如果许多被扰动细胞都沿着相似的方向偏离对照细胞，那么模型即使只预测这个共同方向，也可能在常用的 Pearson Delta 指标上得高分。Systema 因此把参考点从对照细胞中心移到扰动细胞中心，并加入“质心准确率”和粗粒度生物学查询，专门检查模型是否真的恢复了不同扰动之间的差异。 这一区分很重要。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Perturbation-response models are meant to predict how single cells will respond transcriptionally to genetic perturbations not observed during training.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-025-02777-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Systema">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mlbio-epfl/systema" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Systema">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/systema-97435208/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Systema">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="TACIT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TACIT">TACIT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deconvolution of cell types and states in spatial multiomics utilizing TACIT</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TACIT 先用专家签名把细胞投影成各类型 CTR，再借微簇排序和分段回归为每种类型寻找数据自适应阈值，最后用相关 marker 子空间中的 clean 邻居拆分多重阳性细胞；它无需训练集且可解释，但可靠性仍取决于预处理、签名和阈值稳定性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TACIT (Threshold-based Assignment of Cell Types from Multiplexed Imaging DaTa) is an unsupervised cell type annotation algorithm for spatial multi-omics data that requires no training data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-58874-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TACIT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/huynhkl953/TACIT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TACIT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tacit-76ef313c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TACIT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="TCAT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TCAT">TCAT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reproducible single-cell annotation of programs underlying T cell subsets, activation states and functions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TCAT 的实质是把大规模、多数据集共同出现的 T 细胞程序固化成一个参考基底，再用简单、可审计的非负固定参考拟合，把新细胞表示为多个谱系、功能和技术程序的相对混合；它牺牲了发现未知程序的能力，换取跨研究的一致性、稳定性和可解释性。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Reproducible single-cell annotation of programs underlying T cell subsets, activation states and functions — Nature Methods 22, 1964–1980 (2025). DOI: 10.1038/s41592-025-02793-1.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="TEDDY">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TEDDY">TEDDY</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TEDDY: A Family of Foundation Models for Understanding Single Cell Biology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序基础模型通常把一个细胞视为“句子”，把该细胞表达的 基因视为“词”。这类模型可以从大量无标签细胞中学习通用表示，但已有 研究发现：预训练模型在下游任务中不一定稳定优于专用模型，零样本嵌入 也未必比低成本方法更好。论文列举的代表包括 Geneformer（Nature, 2023）、scGPT（Nature Methods, 2024）和 Nicheformer（bioRxiv, 2024）；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell foundation models promise reusable representations for disease biology, but prior studies found that they often improve only modestly over task-specific classifiers and may not generalize across donors or unseen diseases (paper…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/teddy-c59c78bf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TEDDY">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="TEMI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TEMI">TEMI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TEMI: tissue-expansion mass-spectrometry imaging</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TEMI（tissue-expansion mass-spectrometry imaging）不改造质谱仪的激光光学，而是先把组织嵌入可膨胀水凝胶，在不使用蛋白酶、高温或去污剂的条件下进行两到三轮凝胶重嵌，使组织线性放大约 2.5–3.5 倍；然后把放大的组织重新冷冻切片，用常规 MALDI-MSI 扫描。原组织坐标中的有效采样间距随放大倍数缩小，因此同样的激光步长能分辨更细的化学结构。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics has revolutionized nucleic acid mapping, but high-resolution spatial profiling of lipids, metabolites, glycans, and proteins in intact tissues remains a major challenge.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02664-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TEMI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/temi-af423040/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TEMI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-cell-biology" data-journal-label="Nature Cell Biology" data-method="TemporalVAE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TemporalVAE">TemporalVAE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TemporalVAE: atlas-assisted temporal mapping of time-series single-cell transcriptomes during embryogenesis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TemporalVAE 的任务是监督式时间映射：参考图谱中的细胞已有胚胎日、Carnegie stage 或其他采样时间标签，模型学习“转录组 → 图谱时间”的关系，再给新胚胎、新平台或新物种的 query cells 预测与参考时钟对齐的时间。 这与 DPT、Monocle 或 RNA velocity 的无监督排序不同。TemporalVAE 的方向与时间尺度来自训练标签；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TemporalVAE tackles supervised temporal staging of single cells: given a time-series reference atlas, predict the biological time of query cells from their transcriptomes.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Cell Biology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41556-025-01787-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TemporalVAE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/StatBiomed/TemporalVAE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TemporalVAE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/temporalvae-83786bdc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TemporalVAE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="TESSA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TESSA">TESSA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TESSA: A unified model to detect trajectory-preserved and spatially-variable genes in spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组中的细胞/spot 不仅处在不同坐标，也可能处在分化、发育或肿瘤进展的不同阶段。一个基因可以随伪时间变化，却呈现斑块状或非单调的组织分布；只用空间距离的 SVG 方法未必能捕获它。反过来，只做伪时间差异分析又忽略组织位置。 TESSA 将这两种相关结构放入同一个方差分量模型：Stage 1 先找至少具有空间或轨迹效应的 unified TSVG（uTSVG），Stage 2 再分别判断它是 TVG、SVG，还是两者兼有。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables measurement of gene expression while preserving spatial context. A fundamental task is detecting spatially variable genes (SVGs) — genes whose expression patterns vary across tissue regions.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.06.674654" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TESSA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Cui-STT-Lab/TESSA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TESSA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tessa-38a5dd5d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TESSA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-reports-medicine" data-journal-label="Cell Reports Medicine" data-method="ThyroidCancerProgressionST">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ThyroidCancerProgressionST">ThyroidCancerProgressionST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A spatially resolved transcriptome landscape during thyroid cancer progression</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项研究要回答的不是“甲状腺癌有哪些差异基因”，而是这些分子与细胞状态在肿瘤组织中位于哪里，以及从癌旁组织（PT）、乳头状甲状腺癌（PTC）、局部晚期乳头状甲状腺癌（LPTC）到未分化甲状腺癌（ATC）时，肿瘤细胞、成纤维细胞和免疫细胞的空间关系如何改变。 作者对 17 个组织样本做 10x Visium 空间转录组：4 个 PT、5 个 PTC、4 个 LPTC、4 个 ATC，共得到 57,997 个空间 spot。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper builds a spatially resolved atlas of thyroid cancer progression from para-tumor thyroid (PT), papillary thyroid cancer (PTC), locally advanced PTC (LPTC), and anaplastic thyroid carcinoma (ATC).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Reports Medicine · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.xcrm.2025.102043" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ThyroidCancerProgressionST">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/thyroidcancerprogressionst-62718a2a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ThyroidCancerProgressionST">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="TIVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TIVelo">TIVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TIVelo: RNA velocity estimation leveraging cluster-level trajectory inference</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">许多 RNA velocity 方法先逐基因拟合剪接动力学，再把速度汇总成细胞流场；若一批基因的相图被反向拟合，汇总方向也会错。TIVelo 反过来做：先从簇图提出一条候选发育路径，用 unspliced RNA 领先 spliced RNA 的相位规律判断路径朝向；确定簇级父子方向后，再要求每个细胞的速度指向同簇或子簇中伪时间更晚的邻居。 它利用聚类、PAGA 和 diffusion pseudotime 作为结构先验。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity infers the direction and speed of cell developmental processes from a single-cell RNA-seq snapshot, by comparing unspliced (u) and spliced (s) RNA counts.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-61628-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TIVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cuhklinlab/TIVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TIVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tivelo-09075856/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TIVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="TopoVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TopoVelo">TopoVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Topological velocity inference from spatial transcriptomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统 RNA velocity 把细胞当作相互独立的观测：每个细胞的 unspliced/spliced counts 只由自身潜在时间和动力学参数解释。但发育组织中，接触信号、形态素、ECM 和局部组织结构都与命运变化相关。TopoVelo 把空间转录组构成一张图，用图神经网络让一个细胞的潜在状态和转录率同时受到空间邻居影响。 它输出两种容易混淆的“速度”： RNA velocity：每个细胞、每个基因的 ds/dt，位于表达空间；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell fate transitions are fundamentally spatiotemporal processes: transcription is regulated by signaling molecules from neighboring cells, extracellular matrix interactions, and gap junctions.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-025-02688-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TopoVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/welch-lab/TopoVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TopoVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/topovelo-e5a92b56/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TopoVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="electronic-journal-of-statistics" data-journal-label="Electronic Journal of Statistics" data-method="Transfer_Q_Learning_Finite_Horizon_MDP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Transfer_Q_Learning_Finite_Horizon_MDP">Transfer_<wbr>Q_<wbr>Learning_<wbr>Finite_<wbr>Horizon_<wbr>MDP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Transfer Q-learning for finite-horizon Markov decision processes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">目标任务只有少量轨迹，但我们拥有若干相关源 MDP 的离线轨迹。论文希望利用源数据更准确地估计目标任务各阶段的最优 Q^ 函数，并覆盖两种情形：目标任务也是离线数据，以及目标任务需要在线探索。 困难在于，强化学习的回归标签不是直接观测值。阶段 t 的 Bellman 标签依赖下一阶段的 Q^。如果直接把源任务自己的伪标签与目标数据混合，源任务使用的是 Q{t+1}^{(k)}，目标任务使用的是 Q{t+1}^{(0)}；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Chen, Li, and Jordan study how to estimate the target task&#x27;s optimal action-value functions in a time-inhomogeneous finite-horizon MDP when target trajectories are scarce but offline trajectories from related source MDPs are available.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Electronic Journal of Statistics · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1214/25-EJS2459" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Transfer_Q_Learning_Finite_Horizon_MDP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ElynnCC/TransferQLearning" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Transfer_Q_Learning_Finite_Horizon_MDP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/transfer-q-learning-finite-horizon-mdp-37ca5b45/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Transfer_Q_Learning_Finite_Horizon_MDP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="TRIO-AI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TRIO-AI">TRIO-<wbr>AI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TRIO-AI: Hybrid temporal graph, ODE, and VAE modeling for high-resolution cellular trajectory inference in liver injury</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TRIO-AI 不是一个在本工作区中可运行、可复核的软件实现，而是论文提出的一套三视角分析框架：Temporal GNN 用时间标签约束细胞图表示，Neural ODE 在聚合后的时间中心上描绘连续路径，Time-VAE 用条件潜空间中的低密度区域筛选候选过渡细胞。作者随后把低密度、稀有性、分支邻近性和时间不对称性合成 novelty score，并把 MPs3 解释为肝缺血再灌注损伤后的候选过渡巨噬细胞状态。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Full title: TRIO-AI: Hybrid temporal graph, ODE, and VAE modeling for high-resolution cellular trajectory inference in liver injury Authors: Hui Li, Jinlian Wang, Yankai Wen, Hongfang Liu, Cynthia Ju Institution: UTHealth Houston (McWilliam…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.64898/2025.12.17.694956" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TRIO-AI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/trio-ai-620458bf/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TRIO-AI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="TROUPE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TROUPE">TROUPE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring Cell Differentiation Dynamics with Unobserved Progenitors</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TROUPE 处理的不是普通表达矩阵轨迹，而是多棵带时间尺度的细胞谱系树：叶节点是实验末端采到的细胞，叶上有转录组细胞类型标签，边长代表两次分裂之间的时间。它要推断一个定量分化图，包括细胞类型之间的连续时间转换率、各类型的分裂/增长率，以及采样时已经消失、因而没有叶标签的祖细胞类型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Understanding cell differentiation is central to developmental biology. Cells progressively restrict their developmental potential — from totipotent progenitors that can become any cell type, to committed terminal fates.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2025</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="journal-of-machine-learning-research" data-journal-label="Journal of Machine Learning Research" data-method="Two_Timescale_GDA_Nonconvex_Minimax">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Two_Timescale_GDA_Nonconvex_Minimax">Two_<wbr>Timescale_<wbr>GDA_<wbr>Nonconvex_<wbr>Minimax</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Two-Timescale Gradient Descent Ascent Algorithms for Nonconvex Minimax Optimization</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究非凸极小极大优化： f 对外层变量 \mathbf{x} 可以是非凸的，但对内层变量 \mathbf{y} 要求凹或强凹，\mathcal{Y} 是有界凸集。普通 GDA 往往给两个变量相同量级的学习率；在超出凸—凹情形后，它可能出现极限环甚至发散。 TTGDA 每轮只做一次下降和一次投影上升： 但选择 \eta{\mathbf{x}}^{t}\ll\eta{\mathbf{y}}^{t}。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This JMLR 2025 optimization/ML-theory paper analyzes simple single-loop minimax algorithms for \min{\mathbf{x}}\max{\mathbf{y}\in\mathcal{Y}}f(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}) when f is nonconvex in \mathbf{x} but concave in \mathbf{y}.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Machine Learning Research · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2408.11974" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Two_Timescale_GDA_Nonconvex_Minimax">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/two-timescale-gda-nonconvex-minimax-7db5dbc3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Two_Timescale_GDA_Nonconvex_Minimax">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="UDA-seq">UDA-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">UDA-seq: universal droplet microfluidics-based combinatorial indexing for massive-scale multimodal single-cell sequencing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">UDA-seq 的关键不是发明一个新的单细胞分析模型，而是把“第二轮组合索引”放到标准液滴条形码之后：先允许一个液滴装入多个固定细胞/细胞核，再把它们完整释放到 96/384 孔板中加入孔特异条形码。最终用“液滴条形码 + 孔条形码”的组合识别单细胞，从而在尽量复用 10x 等成熟化学体系的同时显著提高通量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Droplet single-cell assays are convenient and robust but deliberately waste most droplets to avoid loading more than one cell. Existing droplet-plus-combinatorial-indexing approaches increase throughput, yet many use modality-specific pre-i…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lanjiangbig/UDA-seq-analysis" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for UDA-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/uda-seq-31fe42d3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：UDA-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="uMAIA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="uMAIA">uMAIA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Unified mass imaging maps the lipidome of vertebrate development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">uMAIA（unified Mass Imaging Analyzer）解决的是一个“多次质谱成像采集如何真正放到同一坐标系里比较”的问题：它先从每张 MALDI-MSI 原始谱中自适应地找峰并生成离子图像，再用网络流把不同切片中属于同一分子的峰连接成统一特征，最后用分层概率模型校正跨采集的强度畸变，从而支持 3D/4D 代谢图谱分析。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Mass spectrometry imaging (MSI) can map metabolites and lipids at micrometer resolution, but a single acquisition is only a two-dimensional section.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lamanno-epfl/uMAIA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for uMAIA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/umaia-bf742961/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：uMAIA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="Universal Log-Optimality">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Universal Log-Optimality">Universal Log-<wbr>Optimality</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Universal Log-Optimality for General Classes of e-processes and Sequential Hypothesis Tests</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文研究的是序贯假设检验，不是生物信息学问题。数据不断到来时，我们希望随时都能检查是否拒绝复合原假设 \mathcal P，同时保证即使反复查看结果，第一类错误率仍不超过 \alpha。 标准做法是构造非负的 e-process Wn，当 时拒绝原假设。相应的首次拒绝时间是 Ville 不等式保证 \sup{P\in\mathcal P}\PrP(\tau\alpha&lt;\infty)\leq\alpha。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Anytime-valid sequential tests can reject a composite null by thresholding an e-process at 1/\alpha, but validity alone does not say how quickly the process grows under an alternative or how many observations rejection will take.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2504.02818" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Universal Log-Optimality">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/universal-log-optimality-7064fcab/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Universal Log-Optimality">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="Valid_Selection_Among_Conformal_Sets">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Valid_Selection_Among_Conformal_Sets">Valid_<wbr>Selection_<wbr>Among_<wbr>Conformal_<wbr>Sets</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Valid Selection among Conformal Sets</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">假设我们针对同一个样本 X 有 K 个 conformal predictor。每个方法单独使用时，都能保证 直觉上，我们会想查看这 K 个预测集合，然后选最小的那个。但这样做把集合大小重新用于“模型选择”，被选中的集合不再是事先固定的方法，原有 coverage 通常会失效。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Each of several conformal predictors can have valid marginal coverage on its own, yet selecting the smallest prediction set after seeing all current set sizes can destroy that guarantee.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2506.20173" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Valid_Selection_Among_Conformal_Sets">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/valid-selection-among-conformal-sets-e8aa8e0f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Valid_Selection_Among_Conformal_Sets">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="VGFM">VGFM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Joint Velocity-Growth Flow Matching for Single-Cell Dynamics Modeling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞测序通常只能得到不同时间点的细胞群体快照，不能追踪同一个细胞从早到晚的真实轨迹。同时，细胞会增殖或死亡，所以不同时间点的细胞总量和分支比例也会变化。论文把这两个困难合在一起处理：既要学习细胞状态如何移动，也要学习细胞群体质量如何增长或衰减 。 VGFM 的目标是学习两个函数： v\theta(\mathbf{x},t)：速度场，控制细胞表达状态在状态空间中怎么移动。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VGFM addresses single-cell dynamics modeling from unpaired snapshots where both cell states and population mass change over time. The paper argues that destructive single-cell measurement prevents paired trajectories, while proliferation an…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2505.13413" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for VGFM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/DongyiWang-66/VGFM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for VGFM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/vgfm-8f5d5810/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VGFM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="VirtualCellChallenge">

        <h2 aria-label="VirtualCellChallenge">VirtualCellChallenge</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Virtual Cell Challenge: Toward a Turing test for the virtual cell</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">《Virtual Cell Challenge: Toward a Turing test for the virtual cell》不是一个新虚拟细胞模型的论文，也不是已经完成并公布排行榜的 benchmark-results paper。它是一篇前瞻性 challenge/position article：作者解释为什么需要社区竞赛，并给出 2025 年首届挑战的任务、数据生成方案、数据切分和三类评价指标。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Metric specification and weights. The article states the three metric families and says a combined score with minimum thresholds will be used, but it does not provide exact formulas, weights, or calibration rules [paper.md:50].</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2025</span>

        <h2 aria-label="VirtualCellReview2025">VirtualCellReview2025</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">AI-driven virtual cell models in preclinical research: technical pathways, validation mechanisms, and clinical translation potential</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇综述，不提出一个统一的“Virtual Cell 算法”，也没有配套代码仓库。它把虚拟细胞视为一个跨层级研究框架：将多模态组学、生成模型、图模型和机理约束组合起来，模拟细胞在药物、基因编辑或疾病条件下的状态变化，再用计算评估、CRISPR、类器官和器官芯片逐级验证。 因此，阅读重点不应是寻找一套可照抄的网络结构，而应问三个问题：不同方法分别模拟什么；什么证据足以证明预测可靠；模型怎样从细胞层面走到药物研发和监管语境。</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Preclinical drug development relies on a slow, expensive pipeline of animal experiments and in vitro assays. Meanwhile, single-cell omics and spatial transcriptomics are generating unprecedented volumes of molecular data at cellular resolut…</p>

        <h2 aria-label="Vitessce">Vitessce</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Vitessce: integrative visualization of multimodal and spatially resolved single-cell data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞与空间组学实验常常同时产生多种对象和数据：细胞或细胞核、空间 spot、分子坐标、基因表达、蛋白丰度、染色质可及性、显微图像、分割掩膜、聚类和细胞类型注释。真正做探索时，研究者需要不断在“物理空间、表达空间、降维空间和基因组位置”之间切换。 论文指出，当时的工具大多只覆盖其中一部分： Cellxgene（bioRxiv，2021）、Cirrocumulus/Cumulus（Nature Methods，2020）和 Pagoda2…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="wellDR-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="wellDR-seq">wellDR-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Coalescing single-cell genomes and transcriptomes to decode breast cancer progression</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">wellDR-seq 是一种基于 5,184 孔纳米芯片的单细胞 DNA+RNA 共测技术：它先在每个孔中裂解一个细胞，用 Tn5 给基因组 DNA 加标签，同时用 poly-dT 和模板转换反应把 RNA 变成带生物素的 cDNA；随后把所有孔合并，以生物素捕获分开 cDNA 和 DNA。因为 DNA 与 RNA 来自同一孔、共享可对应的二维细胞条形码，研究者可以在同一个细胞中直接连接拷贝数基因型和转录表型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;Coalescing single-cell genomes and transcriptomes to decode breast cancer progression&quot; Authors: Kaile Wang, Rui Ye, Shanshan Bai, et al. (Nicholas Navin lab, MD Anderson) Journal: Cell 188, 6355-6369 (2025) DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2025.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2025.08.012" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for wellDR-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/navinlabcode/wellDR-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for wellDR-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/welldr-seq-66af94c3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：wellDR-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2025" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="WISDEM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
