        <h2 aria-label="WISDEM">WISDEM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">WISDEM: a hybrid wireless integrated sensing detector for simultaneous EEG and MRI</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">同时记录 EEG 与 fMRI 可以把毫秒级神经电活动和全脑血氧动力学联系起来，但传统方案需要把头部电极用电缆接到 MRI 外的 EEG 设备。电缆会拾取射频脉冲和梯度切换伪影，接触电阻变化还会造成基线漂移。已有无线方案减少了电缆，却通常仍需要电池、微控制器、射频发射器和梯度传感器，而且只能在梯度稳定的短窗口记录 EEG。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">WISDEM is a wirelessly powered, two-in-one detector for continuous electrophysiology and MRI acquisition through a standard MRI console. It addresses the cable motion, baseline drift, RF/gradient interference, shielding, and synchronization…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2025</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02798-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for WISDEM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/wisdem-cc0b351d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：WISDEM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="APOLLO">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="APOLLO">APOLLO</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Partially Shared Multi-Modal Embedding Learns Holistic Representation of Cell State</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">APOLLO 通过为每个成对样本直接优化一个共享 latent 和各模态特异 latent，再固定这些表示训练新样本 encoder，把“多模态共同细胞状态”“单一模态额外信息”和“从一种模态可预测的另一种模态信息”显式分开；这种分解为解释和缺失模态预测提供了结构，但其生物含义仍受配对数据、潜空间维数、网络/损失选择与非线性可辨识性边界约束。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Partially Shared Multi-Modal Embedding Learns Holistic Representation of Cell State Authors: Xinyi Zhang, GV Shivashankar, Caroline Uhler Journal: Nature Computational Science (2026) DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.10.01.615977" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for APOLLO">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/uhlerlab/APOLLO" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for APOLLO">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/apollo-7c216c8e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：APOLLO">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Genetics" data-method="BANKSY">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="BANKSY">BANKSY</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">BANKSY 不把空间坐标直接塞进聚类，而是先为每个细胞或 spot 计算其局部邻域的表达均值和表达梯度，再把这些邻域特征与该点自身的表达拼接。这样，两个自身转录组相近、但处在不同组织微环境中的细胞，可以在新特征空间中被分开。 本文证据来自本地论文正文 outputnollmmathtables/paper/paper.md、主图 1–6，以及本工作区 R 包的 R/computation.R、R/reduction.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis Journal/year: Nature Genetics, 2024 DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-024-01664-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for BANKSY">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/prabhakarlab/Banksy" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for BANKSY">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/banksy-03c9163e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：BANKSY">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="biVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="biVI">biVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Biophysical modeling with variational autoencoders for bimodal, single-cell RNA sequencing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">biVI 是一个“在观测层加入机制约束”的 VAE：它用转录—剪接—降解模型规定 nascent/mature RNA 的联合分布，再利用预训练神经近似器解决 bursty 条件概率难以解析计算的问题，从而在保持 scVI 可扩展潜表示能力的同时，把细胞间差异解释为 burst size 或相对降解等模型条件下的调控变化。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell workflows can quantify paired RNA species—here, unspliced/nascent and spliced/mature counts—from the same cell. Standard multimodal VAEs can encode both measurements into a shared latent space, but often decode them with separat…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pachterlab/CGCCP_2023" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for biVI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/bivi-87d6ed16/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：biVI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CalicoST">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CalicoST">CalicoST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring allele-specific copy number aberrations and tumor phylogeography from spatially resolved transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CalicoST 把空间转录组中的两类信号——表达量反映的总拷贝数变化（RDR）和杂合 SNP 反映的等位基因失衡（BAF）——放进同一个“基因组 HMM + 空间 HMRF”模型中，从而同时推断等位基因特异性 CNA、空间肿瘤克隆、肿瘤比例以及肿瘤系统地理史。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Inferring allele-specific copy number aberrations and tumor phylogeography from spatially resolved transcriptomics. Nature Methods (2024). DOI: 10.1038/s41592-024-02438-9.</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-genetics" data-journal-label="Nature Genetics" data-method="CalPred">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CalPred">CalPred</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Calibrated prediction intervals for polygenic scores across diverse contexts</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">多基因评分（PGS）通常给每个人一个风险或性状点预测，但同一个 PGS 在不同年龄、性别、遗传主成分、收入或生活方式群体中的准确度可能不同。CalPred 不重新训练 SNP 权重；它在一组有真实表型的校准样本中学习两件事： PGS 与情境变量怎样改变预测均值； 均值预测留下的残差方差怎样随情境变化。 对定量性状，输出是个体化均值与预测区间；对疾病性状，输出是异方差 probit 模型下的个体疾病概率。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Polygenic scores (PGS) are commonly reported as point predictions or risks, but their accuracy is not constant across target individuals. Accuracy can vary by genetic ancestry, age, sex, socioeconomic context, BMI and other measured variabl…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Genetics · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41588-024-01792-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CalPred">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/KangchengHou/calpred" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CalPred">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/calpred-8e6d4aab/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CalPred">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CAST">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CAST">CAST</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Search and match across spatial omics samples at single-cell resolution</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">不同空间组学样本通常没有可直接比较的坐标系。即使它们来自相近的解剖位置，也可能因为个体差异、切片深度、组织形变、测量技术、分辨率、基因面板和批次效应而呈现完全不同的外观。 传统图像配准依赖染色图像或人工标记点。当染色方式、图像质量、组织大小或视野不同，配准容易失效。已有的转录组空间配准方法，例如 PASTE（Nature Methods, 2022），更适合分辨率较低、规模较小且技术相近的数据；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial omics studies increasingly contain multiple tissue slices, animals, conditions, technologies and molecular modalities, but their physical coordinate systems are not directly comparable.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/wanglab-broad/CAST" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CAST">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cast-f03f3587/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CAST">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="Cell2Sentence_ICML_2024">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="Cell2Sentence_ICML_2024">Cell2Sentence_<wbr>ICML_<wbr>2024</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cell2Sentence: Teaching Large Language Models the Language of Biology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">C2S 不是提出一种新的 Transformer 结构，而是提出一种新的数据接口： 因此，方法创新主要来自： 单细胞表达谱的文本化表示； 细胞与自然语言之间的双向任务设计； 使用自然语言预训练获得的语义结构来理解生物标签。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq profiles are usually represented as high-dimensional count vectors and modeled with biology-specific architectures. This makes it difficult to reuse the mature training, prompting, and generation infrastructure of large…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/vandijklab/cell2sentence" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Cell2Sentence_ICML_2024">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cell2sentence-icml-2024-01abb2ab/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Cell2Sentence_ICML_2024">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="cellDancer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="cellDancer">cellDancer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A relay velocity model infers cell-dependent RNA velocity</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">cellDancer 是一个“relay velocity model”：对每个基因单独训练一个 DNN，输入某个细胞的未剪接/已剪接表达量，输出该细胞的 \alpha,\beta,\gamma；再用 RNA 动力学方程预测下一时刻的表达状态；最后让这个预测位移尽可能指向局部邻居中最像“未来状态”的细胞。 可以理解为：</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">cellDancer addresses a core RNA-velocity limitation: conventional models infer one set of kinetic assumptions across all cells, but real scRNA-seq experiments often contain multi-stage or multi-lineage transitions with different transcripti…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/GuangyuWangLab2021/cellDancer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for cellDancer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/celldancer-ba49c10b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：cellDancer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CellRank 2">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellRank 2">CellRank 2</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellRank 2: unified fate mapping in multiview single-cell data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellRank 2 不是一种新的降维算法，也不直接从表达矩阵中“发现一棵谱系树”。它解决的是更具体的问题：给定单细胞数据以及一种或多种能够指示变化方向的证据，如何把这些证据统一写成细胞之间的转移概率，再用同一套马尔可夫链分析得到初始状态、终末状态、命运概率和与谱系相关的候选基因。 论文的核心设计是把任务拆成两层： kernel（核）层把 RNA velocity、伪时间、发育潜能、实验时间或预先计算的耦合等证据转换成转移矩阵；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Publication: Nature Methods, Vol 21, pp. 1196-1205, June 2024 (doi: 10.1038/s41592-024-02303-9) Authors: Philipp Weiler, Marius Lange, Michal Klein, Dana Pe&#x27;er, Fabian Theis Code Repository: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02303-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellRank 2">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/cellrank" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellRank 2">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellrank-2-5d1ee4de/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellRank 2">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="CellWhisperer_ICLR_2024">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellWhisperer_ICLR_2024">CellWhisperer_<wbr>ICLR_<wbr>2024</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multimodal learning of transcriptomes and text enables interactive single-cell RNA-seq data exploration with natural-language chats</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序数据通常包含数千到数百万个细胞，每个细胞约有 2 万个基因维度。传统分析既需要编程能力，也需要对具体组织、细胞类型和疾病背景有较强的生物学知识。CellWhisperer 希望把自然语言变成一个额外的分析接口，使研究者可以直接提出“显示肠道中的组织驻留 T 细胞”或“这些细胞是什么”等问题，并让答案与当前转录组数据相关联。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq datasets contain thousands to millions of cells and roughly 20,000 gene measurements per cell, so interpretation normally requires both programming skill and domain expertise.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CyLinter">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CyLinter">CyLinter</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Quality control for single-cell analysis of high-plex tissue profiles using CyLinter</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">高通量多重组织成像（如 CyCIF、CODEX、mIHC）可以在单张组织切片中测量几十种蛋白，并把图像转换成“单细胞空间特征表”：每一行是一枚细胞，包含空间坐标、分割面积和各通道信号强度。 问题在于，这张表并不只包含生物学。组织折叠、灰尘和纤维、抗体聚集、气泡、失焦、照明不均、拼接或配准错误、循环成像中的组织脱落，以及过分割/欠分割，都会改变细胞的数值特征。它们可能在 UMAP 中形成看似清晰的簇，也可能把不同细胞类型混到同一簇里。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">High-plex tissue imaging converts multichannel microscopy into single-cell spatial feature tables, but those tables inherit defects from tissue preparation, staining, acquisition, image stitching/registration, segmentation and feature extra…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/labsyspharm/cylinter" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CyLinter">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cylinter-8c7e8f8c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CyLinter">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="Descart">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Descart">Descart</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Descart: a method for detecting spatial chromatin accessibility patterns with inter-cellular correlations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Descart 面向 spatial ATAC-seq：它把物理相邻关系与染色质可及性相似关系融合成 spot/cell 图，再衡量每个 peak 的可及性向量是否沿图边保持一致。图上自相关高的 peak 被排在前面，作为 spatially variable（SV）peaks；同一图还被用于数据平滑、peak modules 和 gene–peak association。 它不是逐 peak 拟合空间概率分布，也不直接输出显著性检验。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Spatial ATAC-seq (spATAC-seq) captures both chromatin accessibility and tissue location simultaneously, enabling spatially resolved epigenomics.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-024-03458-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Descart">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/likeyi19/Descart" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Descart">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/descart-a0a71ba1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Descart">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="DHR">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DHR">DHR</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Fast, sensitive detection of protein homologs using deep dense retrieval</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DHR 的真正创新是把昂贵的全库同源搜索拆成“语言模型双编码器 + 对比学习 + 离线向量索引 + 小候选集 profile 精炼”。论文证明它在多个 benchmark 上很有竞争力；释放代码则同时暴露了需要复现者主动处理的分支版本、距离度量、冻结策略、长度截断和 JackHMMER 衔接差异。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Identifying evolutionarily related proteins (homologs) is foundational to bioinformatics — essential for function annotation, evolutionary analysis, MSA construction for structure prediction, and drug discovery.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-024-02353-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DHR">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ml4bio/Dense-Homolog-Retrieval" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DHR">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dhr-266934eb/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DHR">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="FICTURE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="FICTURE">FICTURE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">FICTURE: scalable segmentation-free analysis of submicron-resolution spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">FICTURE 不先把空间转录组切成“一个个细胞”，而是让每个亚微米像素从附近多个锚点中概率性地选择信息来源，再推断该像素属于哪些转录因子，从而得到连续、像素级的组织表达地图。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Submicron spatial-transcriptomics assays can place millions to billions of molecules at near-microscopic coordinates, but only a few transcripts are observed per square micrometer. Coarse grids increase counts at the cost of resolution.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/seqscope/ficture" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FICTURE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ficture-c62321f7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FICTURE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="FlowSig">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="FlowSig">FlowSig</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Inferring pattern-driving intercellular flows from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序和空间转录组通常产生两类互补结果： 细胞通讯分析给出可能发生的配体–受体作用； 基因表达模块（GEM）描述细胞内部协同变化的转录程序。 传统分析往往把二者分开。我们可能知道“哪些细胞在发信号”，也可能知道“哪些基因模块在变化”，但仍不知道：某个被接收的信号，是否通过一个细胞内转录程序，进一步驱动了另一个信号的输出？ FlowSig 把这个问题写成一个图结构学习问题。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics can reveal ligand–receptor communication and intracellular gene-expression programs, but these are usually analyzed as separate descriptions.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/axelalmet/flowsig" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for FlowSig">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/flowsig-e0b896c9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：FlowSig">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Foldseek">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Foldseek">Foldseek</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Fast and accurate protein structure search with Foldseek</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Foldseek 的核心技巧是把每个残基与空间近邻的三维关系压缩成 20 种 3Di 字母之一。一个蛋白结构由此变成“氨基酸序列 + 3Di 序列”，可以先用 MMseqs2 式 k-mer 预过滤排除绝大多数不相关结构，再只对少量候选做局部 Smith–Waterman 比对。它用少量结构信息损失，换来相对传统结构比对器四到五个数量级的速度提升。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Structure prediction methods (AlphaFold2, ESMFold) have generated hundreds of millions of protein structures, but searching these databases for structural similarity is prohibitively slow.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01773-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Foldseek">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/steineggerlab/foldseek" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Foldseek">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/foldseek-8b2f7cb8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Foldseek">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-research" data-journal-label="Cell Research" data-method="GeneCompass">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GeneCompass">GeneCompass</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">GeneCompass: deciphering universal gene regulatory mechanisms with a knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统单细胞基础模型通常只使用单一物种的数据，并把基因表示成相对排名或表达分箱，因此难以学习跨物种、跨细胞类型的普适基因调控规律。GeneCompass 的目标是把人和小鼠的单细胞转录组放入同一个表示空间，同时把已有的调控知识注入预训练过程。 论文称 scCompass-126M 收集了超过 1.2 亿个细胞，质控后使用 101,768,420 个细胞。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most single-cell foundation models learn from one species and encode either gene ranks or binned expression, limiting cross-species regulatory interpretation.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Research · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41422-024-01034-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GeneCompass">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xCompass-AI/GeneCompass" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GeneCompass">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/genecompass-6f89ff7c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GeneCompass">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="GeneTrajectory">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GeneTrajectory">GeneTrajectory</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Gene trajectory inference for single-cell data by optimal transport metrics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GeneTrajectory 要解决的问题不是“给每个细胞分配一个统一的伪时间”，而是：当同一批细胞同时经历分化、细胞周期等多个过程时，能否把参与不同过程的基因程序拆开，并分别给这些基因排序。 这一区别很重要。若分化轴和细胞周期轴彼此独立，细胞实际位于一个至少二维的状态空间中；强行压成一条细胞伪时间会把两个过程混在一起。GeneTrajectory 转而比较每个基因在整个细胞流形上的空间分布。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;Gene trajectory inference for single-cell data by optimal transport metrics&quot; Journal: Nature Biotechnology, 2024 DOI: 10.1038/s41587-024-02186-3 Authors: Rihao Qu, Xiuyuan Cheng, ..., Richard A.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-024-02186-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GeneTrajectory">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/KlugerLab/GeneTrajectory" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GeneTrajectory">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/genetrajectory-d99b1f92/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GeneTrajectory">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="GPTCelltype">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GPTCelltype">GPTCelltype</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Assessing GPT-4 for cell type annotation in single-cell RNA-seq analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序的细胞类型注释通常依赖专家比较 marker gene，并维护组织特异性的参考数据。本文考察：如果只把标准 Seurat/Scanpy 流程已经产生的 marker gene 或差异基因交给 GPT-4，它能否直接给出可靠的细胞类型标签。 GPTCelltype 是一个 R 软件包。它不训练新的神经网络，也不在本地建立参考图谱，而是把每个细胞群的基因列表组织成自然语言 prompt，调用 GPT-4 或 GPT-3.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell-type annotation in scRNA-seq remains expert-intensive: analysts inspect cluster markers, consult canonical marker knowledge, and often build or maintain tissue-specific reference workflows.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02235-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GPTCelltype">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Winnie09/GPTCelltype" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GPTCelltype">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gptcelltype-44d43be1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GPTCelltype">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="aaai" data-journal-label="AAAI" data-method="HOT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="HOT">HOT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Hierarchical Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport for Network Alignment</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">HOT（Hierarchical Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport）处理的是多网络节点对齐：给定 K 个相关网络，以及少量已知对应节点组成的 anchor sets，找出其余节点跨越所有网络的一致对应关系。输出不是若干互相独立的两两匹配矩阵，而是一个 K 阶耦合张量；张量元素 表示 K 个节点共同属于同一个对应组的概率质量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Hierarchical Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport for Network Alignment Venue: AAAI 2024 arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.04470 Authors: Zhichen Zeng, Boxin Du, Si Zhang, Yinglong Xia, Zhining Liu, Hanghang Tong Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>AAAI · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2310.04470" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for HOT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/zhichenz98/HOT-AAAI24" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for HOT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/hot-b3c64059/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：HOT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2024" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="InterpretableMLComputationalBiology_review">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="InterpretableMLComputationalBiology_review">InterpretableMLComputationalBiology_<wbr>review</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Applying interpretable machine learning in computational biology--pitfalls, recommendations and opportunities for new developments</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">IML 的可信度不来自方法名称，而来自完整证据链：解释器是否忠实、结果是否稳定、数值是否经过合适的生物后处理、全体结果是否透明，以及候选机制是否经外部或实验验证。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Faithfulness without clean ground truth. Biological mechanisms are rarely known completely, and synthetic benchmarks may miss the complexity of real systems. Stable explanations across seeds, baselines, hyperparameters and cohorts.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02359-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for InterpretableMLComputationalBiology_review">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/interpretablemlcomputationalbiology-review-3f78b56c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：InterpretableMLComputationalBiology_review">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="KPSpatial">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="KPSpatial">KPSpatial</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatiotemporal lineage tracing reveals the dynamic spatial architecture of tumour growth and metastasis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统单细胞谱系追踪能重建“哪些癌细胞来自共同祖先”，但组织解离会丢失这些细胞原来位于肿瘤内部、边缘还是转移灶的信息。空间转录组保留位置和微环境，却通常不能直接给出深层谱系。本文把两者结合，研究肿瘤亚克隆扩张、细胞状态可塑性、缺氧/纤维化/免疫抑制微环境以及转移如何在空间和时间上共同演化。 实验使用 KP-Tracer 小鼠：Cre 同时启动 Kras^{G12D}、敲除 Trp53 并激活 Cas9 谱系记录器。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Jones, Sun et al. &quot;Spatiotemporal lineage tracing reveals the dynamic spatial architecture of tumour growth and metastasis&quot; bioRxiv: 10.1101/2024.10.21.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.10.21.619529" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for KPSpatial">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mattjones315/KPSpatial-release" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for KPSpatial">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/kpspatial-60962d12/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：KPSpatial">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="LargeScaleCellNiches">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="LargeScaleCellNiches">LargeScaleCellNiches</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Quantitative characterization of cell niches in spatial atlases</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间组学可以告诉我们哪些细胞彼此相邻，但传统方法通常只按形态或表达相似性聚类，无法定量说明“哪些细胞互作或调控过程塑造了这个 niche”。NicheCompass 的目标是把 niche 定义为一组共享的空间基因程序（gene programs, GPs）活动模式：这些程序可以代表配体-受体、代谢物-传感器、转录调控，或串联的组合互作。 输入可以是单模态 RNA 空间数据，也可以是 RNA 加染色质可及性（ATAC）的多模态数据。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial omics can reveal communities of neighboring cells, but many existing approaches define niches from morphology or expression similarity without quantifying the cellular interaction events that create them.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/nichecompass-reproducibility" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for LargeScaleCellNiches">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/largescalecellniches-f8eb4f6c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：LargeScaleCellNiches">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="M3G">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="M3G">M3G</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Contrasting Multiple Representations with the Multi-Marginal Matching Gap</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">M3G（Multi-Marginal Matching Gap）不再把 k\geq3 个视图拆成许多两两对比，而是问：已知的正确 k 元组配对，与在当前表示空间里通过多边际最优传输找到的最佳重新配对，二者的代价还差多少？ 差距越大，说明编码器把某些错误组合做得比真实组合更紧；最小化这个差距，就迫使同一对象的全部视图作为一个整体变得一致。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Contrasting Multiple Representations with the Multi-Marginal Matching Gap Authors: Zoe Piran, Michal Klein, James Thornton, Marco Cuturi Venue: ICML 2024 (Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning) arXiv: 2…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2405.19532" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for M3G">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mlrapp/m3g" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for M3G">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/m3g-d98efd81/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：M3G">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MALDI-MSI-IMC">

        <h2 aria-label="MALDI-MSI-IMC">MALDI-<wbr>MSI-<wbr>IMC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Integration of mass cytometry and mass spectrometry imaging for spatially resolved single-cell metabolic profiling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">研究者希望同时知道两个问题： 组织中某个位置有哪些代谢物、丰度多高？ 这些代谢信号来自哪类细胞，例如癌细胞、巨噬细胞或 T 细胞？ MALDI 质谱成像（MALDI-MSI）可以直接测量组织中的代谢物，但像素通常比单个细胞大，而且本身不能给细胞做丰富的免疫分型。成像质谱流式（IMC）可以在 1 µm 像素上检测多种金属标记抗体并分割细胞，却不直接测量完整代谢谱。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Metabolite imaging and cellular immunophenotyping usually operate at different spatial resolutions and often on different tissue sections. Dissociation loses tissue context, while consecutive sections do not contain the same individual cell…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="MarsGT">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MarsGT">MarsGT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">MarsGT: Multi-omics analysis for rare population inference using single-cell graph transformer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MarsGT 要解决的问题是：配对 scRNA-seq 和 scATAC-seq 中，稀有细胞往往只有很小比例，且 dropout 会让它们的 RNA 或染色质信号不稳定。若分别处理两种矩阵，细胞、基因和调控峰之间的信息难以互相补足。 它把细胞、基因、峰当作三类节点；RNA 非零值形成 cell--gene 边，ATAC 非零值形成 cell--peak 边。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MarsGT is a multi-omics rare-cell discovery method that jointly models cells, genes and ATAC peaks as a heterogeneous graph transformer. It trains on rare-feature-biased subgraphs, assigns cells from learned embeddings, and estimates cluste…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mtduan/marsgt" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MarsGT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/marsgt-1f0af0a3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MarsGT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="MaxFuse">

        <h2 aria-label="MaxFuse">MaxFuse</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Integration of spatial and single-cell data across modalities with weakly linked features</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MaxFuse 解决的是跨模态单细胞/空间组学整合问题。这里的难点不是简单批次校正，而是两个数据集测到的特征本来就不同。例如，一个数据集是 CODEX 空间蛋白，只有几十个抗体标记；另一个数据集是 scRNA-seq，有全转录组。两者之间能直接对应的特征很少，而且蛋白和 RNA 的相关性也不一定强。论文把这种情况称为弱链接特征场景（weakly linked features）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Integration of spatial and single-cell data across modalities with weakly linked features DOI: 10.1038/s41587-023-01935-0 PMID: 37679544 Journal: Nature Biotechnology Method: MaxFuse Analysis type: paper+code MaxFuse is a cross-modal…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/shuxiaoc/maxfuse" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MaxFuse">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/maxfuse-d85aa478/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MaxFuse">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="scATAC" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MethSCAn">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">scATAC — Single-Cell Chromatin &amp; DNA Methylation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MethSCAn">MethSCAn</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Analyzing single-cell bisulfite sequencing data with MethSCAn</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MethSCAn 不直接把一个区域内读到的 0/1 甲基化状态做简单平均，而是先估计每个 CpG 位点在所有细胞中的“局部背景甲基化”，再计算单个细胞相对背景的残差；随后用滑动窗口寻找跨细胞差异最大的可变甲基化区域（VMR），构造更有信息量的细胞 × 区域矩阵，并用相似的窗口扫描和置换策略检测两组细胞之间的差异甲基化区域（DMR）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell bisulfite sequencing (scBS) measures DNA methylation at single-cell and single-base resolution, but each cell covers only a sparse and uneven subset of genomic CpGs.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/anders-biostat/MethSCAn" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MethSCAn">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/methscan-6e6fb33f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MethSCAn">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="mmVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="mmVelo">mmVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">mmVelo: A deep generative model for estimating cell state-dependent dynamics across multiple modalities</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">mmVelo 解决的问题是：单细胞 multiome 能同时测 RNA 和 ATAC，但这些测量仍然是静态快照；RNA velocity 可以给 RNA 层提供方向，却不能直接给 chromatin accessibility 一个动力学方程。mmVelo 的核心思想是先用多模态 VAE 学到共享细胞状态 zn，再用 RNA splicing kinetics 训练潜在状态转移 dn，最后把 zn+\rho dn 通过不同 decode…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity infers local transcriptome dynamics from spliced and unspliced RNA, but this kinetic observation does not directly exist for chromatin accessibility.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.12.11.628059" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for mmVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/nomuhyooon/mmVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for mmVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mmvelo-00ba9437/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：mmVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="Monae">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="Monae">Monae</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Modal-nexus auto-encoder for multimodality cellular data integration and imputation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA、ATAC、DNA methylation 等单细胞模态拥有不同特征空间，而且常由不同细胞测量，没有一一配对。Monae 同时解决两项任务：把不同模态细胞放进一个可比较的 latent space；再利用该细胞表示预测本模态 dropout 或另一个模态的整套特征。 它的关键思路是把信息分成两种视角。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multi-modality single-cell data (e.g., scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq) presents two fundamental challenges: Integration: Cells measured across modalities have heterogeneous feature spaces with no pairing information, making it difficult to create u…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-53355-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Monae">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/shapsider/monae" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Monae">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/monae-49424995/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Monae">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="multimil">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="multimil">multimil</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multimodal weakly supervised learning to identify disease-specific changes in single-cell atlases</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文中的 MultiMIL 是“多模态 cVAE + 多实例学习（MIL）”的组合：先用模态特异编码器和 Product-of-Experts（PoE）把每个细胞的 RNA/ADT/ATAC 整合为联合表示，再把同一患者的细胞当作一个 bag，用门控注意力加权成患者表示，最后预测疾病分类、连续表型或有序阶段。高注意力细胞被用作疾病相关细胞状态的候选。 本工作区的代码版本是 0.3.1，但它只包含独立 MIL 预测模块：输入 .</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Reproducibility Rating: 4/5 Version boundary: This workspace contains package version 0.3.1, whose src/multimil/ implements the MIL-only prediction module.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MultiomeBenchmarking">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MultiomeBenchmarking">MultiomeBenchmarking</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Benchmarking algorithms for single-cell multi-omics prediction and integration</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞多组学实验可以在同一个细胞中同时测量 RNA、蛋白丰度或染色质可及性，但成本高、数据稀疏、批次差异明显。因此研究者常用两类计算方法： 缺失模态预测：只有 RNA 时，预测蛋白丰度或 ATAC 峰可及性。 多组学整合：把不同模态、不同批次或模态不完整的数据映射到统一的低维空间。 问题在于，已有算法通常只在各自论文或少量竞赛数据上验证，数据集、预处理、指标和任务定义不一致，难以判断“哪种方法适合我的数据”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell multi-omics methods can jointly measure RNA with protein abundance or chromatin accessibility, but these assays remain expensive, sparse, and less common than RNA-only profiling.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/QuKunLab/MultiomeBenchmarking" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MultiomeBenchmarking">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multiomebenchmarking-a5b64d9b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MultiomeBenchmarking">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2024" data-code="no" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="MUSIC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="MUSIC">MUSIC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell multiplex chromatin and RNA interactions in ageing human brain</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文：Single-cell multiplex chromatin and RNA interactions in ageing human brain（Nature, 2024；DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07239-w） 传统单细胞 RNA 测序告诉我们细胞表达什么，单细胞 Hi-C 告诉我们 DNA 哪些位置接近，但多数方法把一次接触压成两个位点，也看不到同一复合物中的 RNA。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Wen et al., Nature 628, 648–656 (2024) DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07239-w Method: MUSIC, multinucleic acid interaction mapping in single cells MUSIC jointly measures, from the same nucleus, gene expression, multiplex DNA–DNA contacts, a…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07239-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MUSIC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/music-fde01358/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MUSIC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="OAMP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="OAMP">OAMP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multimodal data integration and cross-modal querying via orchestrated approximate message passing</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">OrchAMP / OAMP 解决的是单细胞多模态 atlas 构建和跨模态查询问题：参考数据中同一批细胞有 ATAC、RNA、protein 等多个模态，但新查询细胞可能只测到一个模态。方法把高维 RNA/ATAC 建模为低秩信号加噪声，把低维 protein 建模为对低维潜变量的带噪线性观测，并用 orchestrated approximate message passing 在多个模态之间同步去噪。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Multimodal data integration and cross-modal querying via orchestrated approximate message passing Method: OrchAMP / OAMP Venue and year: arXiv preprint, 2024 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2407.19030" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for OAMP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Sagnik-Nandy/OrchAMP" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for OAMP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/oamp-963afc07/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：OAMP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="OMAP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="OMAP">OMAP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multiomic characterization of RNA microenvironments by oligonucleotide-mediated proximity-interactome mapping</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA 的功能不仅由“直接结合它的分子”决定，也由它所在的局部细胞环境决定，例如同一核内区室中的蛋白、RNA 和染色质。传统反义寡核苷酸捕获通常在裂解后富集目标 RNA，容易引入裂解液中的非特异结合，并且常需要较多细胞；基因编码的邻近标记方法则可能存在游离或错误定位的酶，而且不容易用于原代样本和组织。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA function is shaped not only by direct binders but by proteins, transcripts and chromatin in the surrounding subcellular compartment. Antisense pulldown methods can accumulate lysate-induced background and often require large inputs, whi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02457-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for OMAP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SheqLab/Tsue_Kania_et_al_2024_OMAP_paper" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for OMAP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/omap-53ee531e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：OMAP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nucleic-acids-research" data-journal-label="Nucleic Acids Research" data-method="PANDA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PANDA">PANDA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Dual decoding of cell types and gene expression in spatial transcriptomics with PANDA</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Visium、早期 Spatial Transcriptomics 等测序型空间技术的一个 spot 往往包含多个细胞。常规反卷积把 spot 表达解释成若干固定细胞类型 signature 的线性混合，只输出每种细胞类型的比例。问题是同一类型的细胞会随肿瘤边界、皮层深度或发育阶段改变状态；用一个全局均值 signature 既可能降低比例估计，也无法回答“这个 spot 中的 B 细胞在表达什么”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies (e.g., Visium, ST) profile whole transcriptomes at spot level, but each spot captures a mixture of multiple cells from different cell types.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nucleic Acids Research · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkae876" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PANDA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Zhangxf-ccnu/PANDA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PANDA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/panda-6fcfccf4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PANDA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="Patho-DBiT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Patho-DBiT">Patho-<wbr>DBiT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Patho-DBiT enables spatial whole transcriptome sequencing in clinical FFPE tissues</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Patho-DBiT 的关键不是单纯提高 mRNA 数量，而是先在组织内给 FFPE 产生的各种 RNA 片段统一加上 poly(A) 尾，再用 DBiT 的二维微流控条形码标记空间位置。这样，同一套测序数据不仅能生成空间基因表达矩阵，还能追踪非编码 RNA、可变剪接、A-to-I RNA 编辑、spliced/unspliced dynamics 和 RNA 层 SNV。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Publication: Cell, November 2024 (Volume 187, Pages 6760-6779) DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2024.09.001 Data: GEO accession GSE274641 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2024.09.001" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Patho-DBiT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Zhiliang-Bai/Patho-DBiT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Patho-DBiT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/patho-dbit-85050756/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Patho-DBiT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PINNACLE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PINNACLE">PINNACLE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Contextual AI models for single-cell protein biology</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PINNACLE 通过“细胞类型特异 PPI + 细胞/组织元图 + 双向注意力桥”，把同一个蛋白质变成随细胞类型变化的表示；它最有价值的输出不是一个全局蛋白质排名，而是“蛋白质–细胞类型”联合假设。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most protein representation models assign one vector to each protein, even though protein expression, partners and function can vary across cell types and tissues.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/mims-harvard/PINNACLE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PINNACLE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pinnacle-d11c9a8b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PINNACLE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Quartet">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Quartet">Quartet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multi-omics data integration using ratio-based quantitative profiling with Quartet reference materials</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">同一批病人样本的 DNA、RNA、蛋白和代谢物，常常不是在同一天、同一仪器、同一实验室完成测量。直接比较这些绝对定量值时，批次、平台和实验流程带来的偏移，可能比真正的生物差异还大。于是会出现两个问题： 横向整合：同一种组学的多个批次能否合并，而不是按批次聚类？ 纵向整合：不同组学合在一起后，能否找回真实的样本分组和跨组学关系？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multi-omics integration has no easy ground truth when measurements are collected across laboratories, platforms, batches, and modalities. Absolute quantitative profiles can be dominated by technical offsets, confounding both within-omics ba…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/quartet-043e214e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Quartet">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="biorxiv" data-journal-label="bioRxiv" data-method="regvelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="regvelo">regvelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">RegVelo: gene-regulatory-informed dynamics of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RegVelo 用可学习 GRN 将各基因的转录率耦合进高维剪接 ODE，使速度、局部有效网络和网络扰动来自同一个生成模型；它显著增强了假设生成能力，但模型权重、数值求解、先验网络和 CellRank 下游共同限定了因果与复现解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RegVelo addresses a fundamental disconnect in single-cell biology between two crucial but isolated research areas: RNA velocity methods (scVelo, veloVI) that model cellular dynamics but assume gene independence and constant transcription ra…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>bioRxiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.12.11.627935" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for regvelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/regvelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for regvelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/regvelo-62d9538e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：regvelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
