      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="scDesign3">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scDesign3">scDesign3</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scDesign3 generates realistic in silico data for multimodal single-cell and spatial omics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scDesign3 是一个参考数据驱动的单细胞/空间组学模拟器：它把真实数据表示为特征矩阵 Y、细胞状态协变量 X 和可选实验设计协变量 Z，先为每个特征拟合条件边缘分布，再用 copula 建模特征间依赖，最后在给定或新生成的协变量上采样合成数据。论文主张这个统一概率模型可用于真实感模拟、拟合优度评估，以及构造带有已知条件变化的正/负控制数据；本地 R 包实现了这条核心模拟流水线。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scDesign3 is a reference-based statistical simulator for single-cell and spatial omics. It learns feature-wise marginal distributions and feature-dependence structure from real data, then generates synthetic data under chosen cell-state and…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01772-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scDesign3">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SONGDONGYUAN1994/scDesign3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scDesign3">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scdesign3-931b1b37/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scDesign3">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="scDiffusion">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scDiffusion">scDiffusion</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scDiffusion: conditional generation of high-quality single-cell data using diffusion model</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scDiffusion 不是直接在高维基因表达向量上做扩散，而是先把细胞表达压缩成 128 维潜在表示，再在潜在空间训练扩散模型；生成时用分类器梯度把采样过程“推向”指定细胞类型、器官/细胞类型组合或两个发育状态之间的中间状态。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scDiffusion is a latent-diffusion framework for conditional generation of single-cell RNA-seq data. It embeds normalized gene-expression profiles with a finetuned SCimilarity-like autoencoder, trains a skip-connected MLP denoiser over 128-d…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/EperLuo/scDiffusion" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scDiffusion">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scdiffusion-664249cc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scDiffusion">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="communications-biology" data-journal-label="Communications Biology" data-method="scGraphformer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scGraphformer">scGraphformer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scGraphformer: unveiling cellular heterogeneity and interactions in scRNA-seq data using a scalable graph transformer network</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序的细胞类型注释常先用 kNN 把细胞连成一张固定图，再做图神经网络传播。但 kNN 只保留局部邻居：远距离却生物学相关的细胞可能被遗漏，错误邻居也会成为先验。scGraphformer 的目标是从表达数据中学习所有细胞之间的关联，同时仍允许把 kNN 图作为可选的辅助信息，而不是强制依赖它。 输入是细胞×基因矩阵。论文先做质控、归一化和高变基因选择，得到 \hat X；每个细胞是一行特征，标签用于监督训练。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scGraphformer addresses supervised cell-type annotation from scRNA-seq data when a fixed kNN graph may miss long-range or subtle cell relationships.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Communications Biology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xyfan22/scGraphformer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scGraphformer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scgraphformer-017e5cd5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scGraphformer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scNanoSeq-CUT-Tag">

        <h2 aria-label="scNanoSeq-CUT-Tag">scNanoSeq-<wbr>CUT-<wbr>Tag</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scNanoSeq-CUT&amp;Tag: a single-cell long-read CUT&amp;Tag sequencing method for efficient chromatin modification profiling within individual cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞染色质修饰测序已经能够回答“某个细胞中哪些区域带有 H3K4me3、H3K27ac、H3K27me3 等标记”，但绝大多数方法使用短读长测序。短读长带来两个结构性限制： 在 LINE、LTR、着丝粒附近或其他低可比对区域中，短片段难以确定来自哪一个重复拷贝。 一个短片段通常只能看到一个局部位点，无法直接证明同一条原始 DNA 分子同时跨过两个相邻的修饰峰。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell short-read chromatin assays can identify cell types and regulatory states, but their fragments map poorly in repetitive/low-mappability sequence and rarely preserve evidence that two marked regions occur on the same original mol…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Guo-Yuqing/scNanoSeq-CUT-Tag" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scNanoSeq-CUT-Tag">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scnanoseq-cut-tag-3824b0fb/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scNanoSeq-CUT-Tag">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scPROTEIN">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scPROTEIN">scPROTEIN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scPROTEIN: a versatile deep graph contrastive learning framework for single-cell proteomics embedding</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">质谱单细胞蛋白组的基本测量单位常是肽段，而分析希望得到蛋白和细胞层面的结论。一个蛋白由多个肽段构成，不同肽段的离子化、共分离、碎裂和样本制备损失不同，因此同一蛋白的肽段测量质量也不同。若直接求和或取中位数，低质量肽段会与可靠肽段具有相同权重。 与此同时，单细胞蛋白组具有严重缺失、批次效应和高噪声。先 KNN 插补、再 ComBat 校正的串联流程会让一步产生的伪结构影响下一步。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: scPROTEIN: a versatile deep graph contrastive learning framework for single-cell proteomics embedding Authors: Wei Li, Fan Yang, Fang Wang, Yu Rong, Linjing Liu, Bingzhe Wu, Han Zhang, Jianhua Yao (Tencent AI Lab + Nankai University)…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02214-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scPROTEIN">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/TencentAILabHealthcare/scPROTEIN" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scPROTEIN">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scprotein-651aa6d8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scPROTEIN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-research" data-journal-label="Genome Research" data-method="scTIE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="scTIE">scTIE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Data integration and inference of gene regulation using single-cell temporal multimodal data with scTIE</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scTIE 面向同一细胞同时测得 RNA 表达和染色质可及性的时间序列 multiome 数据。它先用两个模态专属的自编码器把 RNA 与 ATAC 投影到共同低维空间，再反复用相邻时间点之间的最优传输（optimal transport, OT）更新“哪些早期细胞可能流向哪些晚期细胞”；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">During development, cells transition from pluripotent states to specialized cell types through a series of gene regulatory events. Understanding which transcription factors (TFs) and cis-regulatory elements (CREs) drive these transitions is…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Research · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/gr.277960.123" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scTIE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SydneyBioX/scTIE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scTIE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sctie-c261720a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scTIE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SDEvelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SDEvelo">SDEvelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multivariate stochastic modeling for transcriptional dynamics with cell-specific latent time using SDEvelo</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity 利用未剪接 RNA（U）到已剪接 RNA（S）的时间滞后推断细胞状态变化。经典模型对每个基因分别拟合 这种确定性逐基因建模有两个问题。第一，不同基因各自估计时间，随后再拼成一个细胞速度，跨基因时序可能不一致。第二，成熟细胞处于近稳态时仍有转录随机波动；强行用确定性场解释这些波动，可能在本应没有净迁移的细胞群中画出整齐而虚假的流线。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity infers cellular dynamics by comparing unspliced (pre-mRNA) and spliced (mature mRNA) abundances. When transcription is active, unspliced RNA accumulates faster than it is processed; when a gene is being silenced, spliced RNA ex…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-55146-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SDEvelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Liao-Xu/SDEvelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SDEvelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sdevelo-93f3d269/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SDEvelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SIMBA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SIMBA">SIMBA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SIMBA: single-cell embedding along with features</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SIMBA 要解决的是单细胞分析里的一个结构性问题：很多方法只学习细胞的低维表示，然后依赖聚类结果去找 marker 或做解释。这样会带来两个后果。第一，marker 发现会受聚类分辨率和聚类算法影响；第二，scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq、多模态分析、批次校正、多组学整合往往被写成不同任务，需要不同方法和不同解释流程。 SIMBA 的核心想法是：不要只把细胞嵌入到低维空间，而是把细胞和生物学特征一起嵌入。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SIMBA (single-cell embedding along with features) is a graph-embedding method for representing cells and biological features in the same latent space.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01899-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SIMBA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pinellolab/simba" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SIMBA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/simba-ca5fca8b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SIMBA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="SimpleMaskedDiffusionLanguageModels">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SimpleMaskedDiffusionLanguageModels">SimpleMaskedDiffusionLanguageModels</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Simple and Effective Masked Diffusion Language Models</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MDLM 把序列中的 token 随机变成 [mask]，训练一个双向 encoder-only denoiser 从带 mask 的序列恢复原 token；通过 SUBS 参数化，训练目标可以化简为一个带时间权重的 MLM loss，并且这个 loss 是一个有原则的扩散变分下界。 这意味着：它看起来像 BERT 的随机 mask 训练，但不是普通的启发式 MLM，而是来自扩散模型 NELBO 的训练目标。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Diffusion models can generate discrete data such as text and biological sequences, but prior discrete diffusion language models were reported to lag autoregressive (AR) language models in log-likelihood/perplexity .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kuleshov-group/mdlm" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SimpleMaskedDiffusionLanguageModels">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/simplemaskeddiffusionlanguagemodels-1f2f7727/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SimpleMaskedDiffusionLanguageModels">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="Single_cell_Masked_Autoencoder">Single_<wbr>cell_<wbr>Masked_<wbr>Autoencoder</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Cytometry masked autoencoder: An accurate and interpretable automated immunophenotyper</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">cyMAE（cytometry masked autoencoder）针对固定 30-marker panel 的 CyTOF 单细胞蛋白表达，解决人工 gating 慢、主观且难复现，以及聚类受批次效应影响的问题。它先用大量无标签细胞进行 masked cytometry modeling，再用少量标注数据微调。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">cyMAE is a masked-autoencoder transformer for automated immunophenotyping of fixed-panel single-cell CyTOF data. It learns marker co-occurrence from millions of unlabeled cells, then reuses the encoder for labeled cell annotation, marker im…</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nxn-substack" data-journal-label="nxn (Substack)" data-method="Single_cell_metadata_as_language">

        <h2 aria-label="Single_cell_metadata_as_language">Single_<wbr>cell_<wbr>metadata_<wbr>as_<wbr>language</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell metadata as language</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序数据给出每个细胞的基因转录本计数，而元数据记录组织、疾病状态、患者、批次、测量技术等外部信息。来自不同数据集的研究者往往使用不同的键和值，例如 Celltype 与 Cluster 可能表示相近概念，plasma 又可能是 B 细胞的子类。跨数据集整合前通常需要手工把这些字段映射到共同词汇表。 文章的核心观察是：虽然元数据没有统一格式，但它是人写来传递信息的、带有结构的语言。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell datasets often describe the same biological or technical concepts with incompatible metadata keys and values. The article argues that manual harmonization is required before integration, comparison, or modeling, even though meta…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>nxn (Substack) · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/vals/Blog" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Single_cell_metadata_as_language">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/single-cell-metadata-as-language-6d5c54df/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Single_cell_metadata_as_language">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="SorbitolIntolerance_Microbiome">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SorbitolIntolerance_Microbiome">SorbitolIntolerance_<wbr>Microbiome</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">High fat intake sustains sorbitol intolerance after antibiotic-mediated Clostridia depletion from the gut microbiota</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">山梨醇本来就很难被宿主小肠吸收，但健康肠道中的微生物会在结肠内继续分解它。抗生素暴露与高脂饮食共同阻碍梭菌纲（Clostridia）恢复，使微生物山梨醇脱氢酶（SDH）能力长期下降；未被清除的山梨醇积聚并通过渗透作用引起腹泻。治疗既可以直接补充能吃掉山梨醇的菌，也可以通过“丁酸—上皮 PPAR-γ—低氧—厌氧梭菌恢复”轴重建整个代谢生态位。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Lee et al., Cell 187:1191-1205 (2024) DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2024.01.029 Category: datasource/atlasesresources Type: Mechanistic biology study (not a computational methods paper) Biological problem: Sorbitol intolerance affects up to 30…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2024.01.029" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SorbitolIntolerance_Microbiome">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/connor-reid-tiffany/Metagenomics-of-Sorbitol-Intolerant-Mice" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SorbitolIntolerance_Microbiome">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sorbitolintolerance-microbiome-90a8741a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SorbitolIntolerance_Microbiome">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Spacia">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="Spacia">Spacia</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping cellular interactions from spatially resolved transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spacia 把每个接收细胞看成一个“袋子（bag）”，把它周围的多个候选发送细胞看成袋子里的“实例（instance）”，再用贝叶斯多实例学习同时回答两个问题： 哪些邻近细胞真正可能影响这个接收细胞？ 这些发送细胞中的哪些基因或通路，与接收细胞的表达变化相关？ 论文发表于 Nature Methods（2024），DOI：10.1038/s41592-024-02408-1。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Common CCC methods built for scRNA-seq—such as CellChat (Nature Communications, 2021), NicheNet (Nature Methods, 2020), and CellPhoneDB (Nature Protocols, 2020)—usually aggregate cells by type, rely on known ligand–receptor databases, or in…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/yunguan-wang/Spacia" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spacia">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spacia-e6076d31/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spacia">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SpaGFT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpaGFT">SpaGFT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Graph Fourier transform for spatial omics representation and analyses of complex organs</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpaGFT 不先假设空间基因一定是圆形热点、条带或梯度，而是把每个 spot、细胞或像素当作图节点，把分子表达当作图上的信号。相邻节点表达相似的组织结构，在图上变化缓慢，主要落在低频；快速交替或噪声更偏向高频。于是 SVG 识别、表达增强和功能组织单元（FTU）发现都能写成同一套图傅里叶运算。 论文 Figure 1 给出三条主线：从空间坐标构图并建立 Fourier modes（FM）；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Graph Fourier transform for spatial omics representation and analyses of complex organs Chang Y, Liu J, Jiang Y, Ma A, Yeo YY, Guo Q, McNutt M, Krull JE, Rodig SJ, Barouch DH, Nolan GP, Xu D, Jiang S, Li Z, Liu B, Ma Q.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-51590-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpaGFT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jxLiu-bio/SpaGFT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpaGFT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spagft-72a8e864/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpaGFT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="computational_tools" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Spapros">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Computational Tools</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>

        <h2 aria-label="Spapros">Spapros</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Probe set selection for targeted spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spapros 把“保留变化”当作主候选来源，把“细胞类型必须分得开”当作约束，再把探针可设计性和实验先验放进选择过程，因此比单纯 marker 排名或单纯方差排名更适合小型靶向空间转录组面板。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Targeted spatial transcriptomics measures only a limited, predefined gene panel. A good panel must recover known cell types, retain variation within cell types, avoid redundant or technically unsuitable genes, and contain genes for which sp…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/spapros" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spapros">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spapros-a60d5dd3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spapros">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="Spateo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Spateo">Spateo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatiotemporal modeling of molecular holograms</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spateo 不是一个单一的轨迹算法，而是一条面向三维、跨时间空间转录组的分析工具链。它先把连续二维切片对齐成三维点云和表面，再在复杂组织内部建立连续坐标轴；随后用空间加权回归估计配体—受体及下游转录调控的局部关联；最后利用不同发育阶段之间的形变学习“morphic vector field”，计算组织迁移、扩张、旋转、弯曲等形态量，并把这些量同基因表达相关联。 论文用 E9.5 和 E11.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Existing spatial transcriptomics (ST) methods are fundamentally 2D, yet tissues, organs, and embryos are inherently 3D entities with complex spatial organization.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2024.10.011" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Spateo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/aristoteleo/spateo-release" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Spateo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spateo-85a978f6/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Spateo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2024" data-code="no" data-journal="military-medical-research" data-journal-label="Military Medical Research" data-method="SpatiotemporalMultiomics_Aging_Review">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SpatiotemporalMultiomics_Aging_Review">SpatiotemporalMultiomics_<wbr>Aging_<wbr>Review</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatiotemporal multi-omics: exploring molecular landscapes in aging and regenerative medicine</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这是一篇综述，不是一篇提出单一算法或新平台的原始研究。它真正有用的地方，是把转录组、蛋白组、代谢组和表观基因组放进同一个判断框架：一个实验中的“时间”，究竟来自不同时间点的破坏性取样，还是来自对分子进行标记并追踪其命运？ 单细胞测序可以区分细胞类型，却通常要把组织解离，因而丢掉邻域和形态。空间组学保留位置，但一张切片只是一个静态瞬间。连续活细胞成像有真正的时间轴，却难以同时观察大量不同 RNA、蛋白或代谢物。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Review: Chu et al., Military Medical Research 11 (2024) DOI: 10.1186/s40779-024-00537-4 · PMCID: PMC11129507 This narrative review organizes spatially resolved transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics and epigenomics around one decisive qu…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Military Medical Research · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s40779-024-00537-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatiotemporalMultiomics_Aging_Review">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatiotemporalmultiomics-aging-review-62a8aa29/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatiotemporalMultiomics_Aging_Review">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="STAMP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STAMP">STAMP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Interpretable spatially aware dimension reduction of spatial transcriptomics with STAMP</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STAMP 把每个细胞或 spot 表示成若干“主题”的混合比例，同时为每个主题学习一个稀疏的基因模块；空间邻接关系用于推断主题比例，Gamma–Poisson 生成模型用于解释计数，因而低维表示既有空间结构，也能直接通过贡献基因理解。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics combines high-dimensional gene counts with tissue coordinates, but common dimension-reduction choices force an awkward tradeoff.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JinmiaoChenLab/scTM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STAMP">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stamp-8736edb8/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STAMP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Starfysh">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Starfysh">Starfysh</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Starfysh integrates spatial transcriptomic and histologic data to reveal heterogeneous tumor-immune hubs</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Starfysh 面向 spot-level 空间转录组：它从原始计数、细胞类型 marker 列表以及可选的配对 H&amp;E 图像中，推断每个 spot 的细胞状态比例、总细胞密度和状态特异表达。它不要求单细胞参考表达矩阵，因此论文称其为 reference-free；但它仍依赖 marker 知识，不能理解为完全无先验的细胞类型发现。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics (ST) technologies such as Visium capture gene expression at multi-cellular resolution, where each spot contains mixtures of multiple cell types.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-024-02173-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Starfysh">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/azizilab/starfysh" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Starfysh">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/starfysh-7e2b2a92/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Starfysh">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="STT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STT">STT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial transition tensor of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STT 可以理解为“多吸引子版本的 RNA velocity + 空间约束随机游走 + Markov coarse-graining”：它用 unspliced/spliced 数据为每个 attractor 学一个局部动力学 tensor，再通过 membership、GPCCA 和空间 kernel 把局部基因表达/剪接动力学连接到全局细胞命运转移。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STT targets cell-state transition inference from single-cell and spatial transcriptomics when multiple stable cell states coexist. The paper argues that common RNA velocity and trajectory tools can miss such multistability because they ofte…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cliffzhou92/STT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stt-cfd9302c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="TFvelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TFvelo">TFvelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TFvelo: gene regulation inspired RNA velocity estimation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">经典 RNA velocity 用未剪接 RNA u 与已剪接 RNA s 的相位差估计 ds/dt。但 intronic reads 稀疏，有些数据根本没有 spliced/unspliced 分层，而且逐基因剪接模型没有显式利用调控上下文。TFvelo 的核心替换是：对目标基因 g，把候选转录因子表达的加权和当作转录驱动，用总 RNA 表达也能建立速度模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Given: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset with n cells and p genes, with or without splicing annotations (unspliced/spliced counts). Find: The RNA velocity vg = \frac{dyg}{dt} for each gene g in each cell, and the resulting cell trajectory and p…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-45661-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TFvelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/xiaoyeye/TFvelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TFvelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tfvelo-f38d997e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TFvelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="TIGON">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TIGON">TIGON</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reconstructing growth and dynamic trajectories from single-cell transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TIGON 接收多个真实采样时刻的单细胞转录组快照，把每个时刻的细胞看成状态空间中的一团“有质量的密度”，再学习两个随状态和时间变化的函数：细胞状态的速度场 \mathbf v(x,t)，以及允许群体质量增加或减少的净增长率 g(x,t)。它用 Wasserstein–Fisher–Rao（WFR）动态非平衡最优传输把离散快照连接起来，因此不必像平衡最优传输那样强迫总细胞质量守恒。 论文：Sha et al.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Time-series single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) provides snapshots of cellular systems at discrete time points, but the destructive nature of sequencing prevents tracking individual cell trajectories.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2024</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="TopACT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TopACT">TopACT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multiscale topology classifies cells in subcellular spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TopACT 解决的是一个由“分辨率过高”造成的反常问题：Stereo-seq、Visium HD 等技术的单个测量 spot 比细胞小，每个 spot 只有细胞转录组的一小部分，不能直接做可靠分类；若先把 spot 固定合并成大 bin，又会丢掉单细胞位置并漏掉稀疏细胞。TopACT 对每个位置逐级扩大邻域，选择第一个让参考分类器达到置信阈值的尺度，从而在尽量小的空间范围内给出细胞类型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Multiscale topology classifies cells in subcellular spatial transcriptomics Authors: Katherine Benjamin et al. (Oxford Mathematics + BGI Research) Journal: Nature 630(8018), 2024-06-19 DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-024-07563-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TopACT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://gitlab.com/kfbenjamin/topact" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TopACT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/topact-08a73826/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TopACT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="TransformerReview">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TransformerReview">TransformerReview</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Transformers in single-cell omics: a review and new perspectives</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Nature Methods 文章是一篇综述与观点文章，不提出一个可复现的统一算法。它整理的核心问题是：Transformer 在语言中依赖自然序列，而单细胞表达矩阵本质上没有类似词序的天然顺序；因此，决定模型成败的第一步往往不是注意力层本身，而是如何把稀疏、连续、带批次效应的组学测量转换成 token。 全文可沿四条轴阅读： 输入表示：一个 token 代表基因、细胞、通路还是其他分子特征？表达量如何进入 token？</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Sequentialization: Non-sequential single-cell data must be artificially ordered for transformers — current solutions are acknowledged as &quot;probably preliminary.&quot; The field lacks a principled natural ordering.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02353-z" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TransformerReview">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/single-cell-transformer-papers" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TransformerReview">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/transformerreview-c2bd44af/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TransformerReview">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2024" data-code="no" data-journal="journal-of-machine-learning-research" data-journal-label="Journal of Machine Learning Research" data-method="VCG-LinMDP">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="VCG-LinMDP">VCG-<wbr>LinMDP</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Learning Dynamic Mechanisms in Unknown Environments: A Reinforcement Learning Approach</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文研究一个动态机制设计问题：卖方在一个未知的有限时域 MDP 中，连续多轮为多个策略性买方分配资源。每一步只有卖方选择动作；卖方与买方各自获得随机收益，买方可以不诚实地报告收益。算法不仅要学到总社会福利最大的策略，还要为每个买方计算动态 VCG 价格，使机制在长期上近似满足效率、个体理性和诚实性。 它不是生物信息学论文，而是强化学习、算法经济学与机制设计的交叉理论工作。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This theoretical paper asks whether a seller can learn a dynamic Vickrey-Clarke-Groves mechanism when both rewards and state transitions are unknown.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Machine Learning Research · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2202.12797" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for VCG-LinMDP">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/vcg-linmdp-c768455e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VCG-LinMDP">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="VeloCycle">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="VeloCycle">VeloCycle</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Statistical inference with a manifold-constrained RNA velocity model uncovers cell cycle speed modulations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Nature Methods 论文提出 VeloCycle，用单细胞 RNA-seq 中未剪接和已剪接 RNA 的计数，在细胞周期这一 1D 周期流形上估计细胞周期速度。传统 Seurat/scanpy 细胞周期打分通常给出 G1、S、G2/M 这类离散标签，不能直接回答“这个条件下细胞周期是不是更快、在哪个阶段变慢、差异是否可信”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) captures static snapshots — yet biological processes like the cell cycle are fundamentally dynamic. The cell cycle is the most pervasive periodic process in biology and is central to cancer, developmen…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-024-02471-8" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for VeloCycle">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lamanno-epfl/velocycle" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for VeloCycle">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/velocycle-96ecb319/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VeloCycle">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2024" data-code="no" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="VirtualCellAI_Priorities">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="VirtualCellAI_Priorities">VirtualCellAI_<wbr>Priorities</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">How to build the virtual cell with artificial intelligence: Priorities and opportunities</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Cell Perspective 不是一个已经发布的软件方法或可运行模型，而是一篇关于 AI virtual cell，AIVC 的路线图论文。作者把 AIVC 定义为一种多尺度、多模态、基于大型神经网络的细胞模型，用来表示和模拟分子、细胞和组织在不同状态下的行为。因此，下文讲的是论文提出的概念架构和优先事项，不是代码实现说明。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Cell Perspective defines an AI virtual cell (AIVC) as a multi-scale, multi-modal, large-neural-network-based model for representing and simulating molecules, cells, and tissues across diverse states .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2024.11.015" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for VirtualCellAI_Priorities">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/virtualcellai-priorities-eeb1d278/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VirtualCellAI_Priorities">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2024" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="Zman-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Zman-seq">Zman-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Time-resolved single-cell transcriptomics defines immune trajectories in glioblastoma</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通单细胞转录组只拍到细胞状态的静态快照。伪时间或 RNA velocity 可以从表达数据推测先后关系，却无法直接回答“这个免疫细胞进入肿瘤多久了”。Zman-seq 的关键创新是把时间信息在测序前写进细胞：用连续的荧光抗 CD45 抗体脉冲标记血液中的白细胞，随后用单细胞 FACS index sorting 同时记录每个细胞的荧光印记和孔位，再把孔位与 MARS-seq 表达谱连接起来。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Immune cells circulating in the bloodstream continuously infiltrate solid tumors, where they encounter an immunosuppressive microenvironment and transition from functional effector states to dysfunctional, tumor-tolerant states.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2024</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2023.11.032" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Zman-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kenxie7/ZmanR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Zman-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/zman-seq-90ea14c4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Zman-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="AcrNET">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="AcrNET">AcrNET</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">AcrNET: predicting anti-CRISPR with deep learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">AcrNET 用深度学习预测一个蛋白序列是否是 anti-CRISPR protein。它不是只看原始序列，而是把序列 one-hot、RaptorX 结构/可及性特征、POSSUM/PSSM 进化特征和 ESM-1b Transformer 特征融合起来，输出 Acr / Non-Acr 置信度。论文还声称可以进一步预测 Acr 类型，但当前公开代码只验证到二分类模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">AcrNET addresses anti-CRISPR protein prediction. Anti-CRISPRs inhibit bacterial CRISPR-Cas immunity and are useful for gene-editing safety, gene-drive control, and phage therapy, but discovery is difficult because Acr proteins are diverse…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btad259" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for AcrNET">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/banma12956/AcrNET" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for AcrNET">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/acrnet-dad345ef/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：AcrNET">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="CCLA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CCLA">CCLA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single cell multi-omics reveal intra-cell-line heterogeneity across human cancer cell lines</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Nature Communications 2023 论文研究一个常被忽略的问题：常用癌症细胞系是否真的足够同质，还是内部也存在会影响实验解释的转录和表观遗传异质性。作者构建 CCLA 资源，对 42 个细胞系做 scRNA-seq，对 39 个细胞系做 scATAC-seq，并进一步分析 CNV、染色质可及性、ecDNA、谱系追踪和缺氧刺激如何影响细胞系内部状态 。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This Nature Communications 2023 paper builds CCLA, a single-cell multi-omics resource for human cancer cell lines, to test whether commonly used in vitro models contain intra-cell-line heterogeneity that is invisible to bulk assays.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-43991-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CCLA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/liushang17/CCLA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CCLA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ccla-62f82d21/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CCLA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="communication_interaction" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="COMMOT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Cell-Cell Communication</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="COMMOT">COMMOT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Screening cell-cell communication in spatial transcriptomics via collective optimal transport</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">COMMOT 要解决的是空间转录组里的细胞-细胞通讯推断问题。传统基于 scRNA-seq 的通讯方法多半只看配体和受体表达，或者在细胞群层面打分；但真实通讯有两个关键约束：第一，配体和受体只能在有限空间范围内发生作用；第二，一个配体可能结合多个受体，一个受体也可能被多个配体竞争，所以不同分子和不同细胞之间的通讯不能完全独立地打分。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">COMMOT (COMMunication analysis by Optimal Transport) is a method and Python package for inferring cell-cell communication (CCC) from spatial transcriptomics or spatially annotated single-cell data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-022-01728-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for COMMOT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/zcang/COMMOT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for COMMOT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/commot-4e809b0a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：COMMOT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="DeepMAPS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DeepMAPS">DeepMAPS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell biological network inference using a heterogeneous graph transformer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">论文：Single-cell biological network inference using a heterogeneous graph transformer（Nature Communications, 2023；DOI: 10.1038/s41467-023-36559-0）。DeepMAPS 把“整合细胞”和“推断细胞类型特异网络”放进同一条路径：先把特征和细胞组成二部异质图，再以 HGT 同时学习基因（或蛋白）和细胞表示；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell multi-omics technologies (scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq, CITE-seq) capture multiple regulatory layers simultaneously, but existing integration tools — Seurat v3/v4 (Cell, 2021), MOFA+ (Genome Biology, 2020), Harmony (Nature Methods, 20…</p>
        </div>

        <h2 aria-label="MaCroDNA">MaCroDNA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Accurate integration of single-cell DNA and RNA for analyzing intratumor heterogeneity using MaCroDNA</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MaCroDNA 用共同基因上的 copy-number 与 expression Pearson 相关性作为边权，把 scRNA-seq 细胞和 scDNA-seq 细胞构成二部图，再求最大权匹配。若 RNA 细胞更多，就反复释放 DNA 节点、逐轮匹配尚未分配的 RNA 细胞；最终可把每个 RNA 细胞映射到一个 DNA 细胞及其预先定义的肿瘤克隆。</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MISAR-seq">

        <h2 aria-label="MISAR-seq">MISAR-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Simultaneous profiling of spatial gene expression and chromatin accessibility during mouse brain development</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MISAR-seq 把组织切片划成 50×50 µm 的二维网格，在每个网格中同时测量 ATAC 可及性和 RNA 表达。它的价值不只是把两张独立空间图叠在一起，而是让同一个位置的调控元件开放程度与转录输出可以直接配对，从而观察小鼠胚胎脑发育过程中“染色质先准备、基因后表达”的时空调控关系。 整套方法包含两部分：实验端用 Tn5、逆转录和两轮正交微流控条形码在同一切片上生成配对 ATAC/RNA 文库；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Brain development requires coordinated gene regulation across multiple molecular layers — chromatin accessibility determines which genes can be expressed, while transcription determines which genes are expressed.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01884-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MISAR-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gpenglab/MISAR-seq" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MISAR-seq">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/misar-seq-dac31b7b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MISAR-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="MultiVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MultiVelo">MultiVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multi-omic single-cell velocity models epigenome-transcriptome interactions and improves cell fate prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MultiVelo 对每个基因分别拟合一条三维轨迹 (c,u,s)：c 是聚合到基因的染色质可及性，u 是未剪接 RNA，s 是已剪接 RNA。它先估计染色质与转录何时开关、各反应速率多快，再把每个细胞投影到该轨迹上的最近位置；ODE 在该位置的导数就是该细胞—基因的多组学 velocity。 这种时间与速度来自横截面细胞群的模型推断，不是同一细胞的纵向实测，也不是对所有基因共同拟合一个统一生物钟。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">During cellular differentiation, chromatin accessibility (epigenome) and gene expression (transcriptome) change in a temporally coordinated but imperfectly synchronized manner.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-022-01476-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MultiVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/welch-lab/MultiVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MultiVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/multivelo-4b901951/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MultiVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <h2 aria-label="scHyena">scHyena</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scHyena: Foundation Model for Full-Length Single-Cell RNA-Seq Analysis in Brain</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）同时存在两个困难：测序 dropout 产生大量零值，以及每个细胞包含约两万基因，直接使用全基因序列会带来很高的计算成本。常见流程会选取高度可变基因（HVG），但 HVG 对参数、批次和数据集敏感，可能丢失细胞信息。论文提出 scHyena，用 Hyena 的长卷积替代二次复杂度的 self-attention，以处理完整基因向量（论文第 1 节，行 20-40）。 连续表达值的线性适配器。</p>

        <p class="atlas-card__title">scKINETICS: inference of regulatory velocity with single-cell transcriptomics data</p>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scKINETICS 把细胞速度写成 x&#x27;=Ax，用 ATAC/motif 证据限制 A 的可学边，用 cluster-specific covariance 给 A 一个协表达先验，用 local manifold 给不可观测 velocity 加 truncated-normal bounds，再用 target-wise EM 学出 cluster-specific Ac。</p>

        </footer>
