      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/technology_platforms" data-year="2023" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-cardiovascular-research" data-journal-label="Nature Cardiovascular Research" data-method="scMultiomics_Cardiovascular_Review">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Technology Platforms</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scMultiomics_Cardiovascular_Review">scMultiomics_<wbr>Cardiovascular_<wbr>Review</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Current and future perspectives of single-cell multi-omics technologies in cardiovascular research</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 2023 年 Nature Cardiovascular Research 综述不是提出一个新算法，而是回答三个连续问题：心脏和血管组织为什么需要单细胞分辨率；RNA、染色质、蛋白、空间和扰动技术各自能回答什么；怎样把这些观测连接到心血管发育、心肌病、心肌梗死和动脉粥样硬化机制。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Heart tissue dissociation: Cardiomyocytes and other cell types are damaged by enzymatic dissociation, forcing reliance on snRNA-seq with its cytoplasmic RNA bias. No universal solution exists.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Cardiovascular Research · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s44161-022-00205-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scMultiomics_Cardiovascular_Review">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scmultiomics-cardiovascular-review-740fdc75/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scMultiomics_Cardiovascular_Review">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="scPoli">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scPoli">scPoli</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Population-level integration of single-cell datasets enables multi-scale analysis across samples</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">人口规模的单细胞图谱把多个研究、样本、个体和技术条件放在一起。数据整合既要去除批次差异，又要保留细胞类型和状态等生物信号；同时，建好的参考图谱还应能快速接收新查询数据。传统 CVAE 使用随条件数量增长的 one-hot 条件向量，难以解释每个样本的作用；一些参考映射方法在加入新数据时必须重新训练或共享参考细胞。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Population-scale single-cell atlases mix samples, studies and technical conditions. Standard conditional generative models use one-hot condition vectors that grow with the number of conditions and are difficult to interpret; reference metho…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/scPoli_reproduce" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scPoli">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scpoli-408807ed/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scPoli">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SCS">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCS">SCS</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SCS: cell segmentation for high-resolution spatial transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SCS 用染色图像中容易识别的细胞核作为训练信号，让 Transformer 学会从稀疏的高分辨率空间转录组 spot 判断“这个 spot 是否属于细胞”以及“它的细胞中心在哪个方向”。随后，所有预测属于细胞的 spot 沿预测方向流动并汇聚到共同的 sink，从而形成包含细胞质的完整细胞分割。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">After reading this summary, you will understand: Core Problem: Why traditional segmentation fails for subcellular spatial transcriptomics Novel Solution: How SCS integrates imaging and sequencing data using transformers Biological Impact: H…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-023-01939-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SCS">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/chenhcs/SCS" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SCS">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scs-bdb24284/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SCS">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="scTour">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scTour">scTour</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scTour: a deep learning architecture for robust inference and accurate prediction of cellular dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA-seq、snRNA-seq、scATAC-seq 等数据通常只给出细胞在某一时刻的静态测量，但发育和分化研究关心的是“细胞沿什么顺序变化、往哪个方向走、未观测到的状态会是什么样”。论文认为已有方法有几个限制：很多 pseudotime 方法需要用户指定起始细胞；RNA velocity 依赖 spliced/unspliced mRNA 或代谢标记信息；批次效应会影响轨迹和速度可视化；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scTour is a deep-learning method for inferring and predicting cellular dynamics from single-cell abundance matrices. The paper targets four limitations of prior trajectory and RNA-velocity methods: many pseudotime methods require a known st…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-023-02988-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scTour">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/LiQian-XC/sctour" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scTour">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sctour-d2051c92/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scTour">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="SEACells">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SEACells">SEACells</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SEACells infers transcriptional and epigenomic cellular states from single-cell genomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据很稀疏。逐细胞分析保留了分辨率，却容易被掉零和采样噪声支配；传统聚类通过聚合增强信号，却会把一个连续分化轨迹或同一大类中的细微状态压成少数平均值。SEACells 选择中间尺度：把非常相似的几十个细胞聚成一个 metacell，使聚合计数更稳定，同时让 metacell 数远多于传统簇数。 这里的 metacell 不是新的生物细胞，也不是简单地把 UMAP 切成网格。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SEACells compresses sparse single-cell measurements into finer-grained, biologically coherent metacells. It builds an adaptive cell-affinity graph in a modality-appropriate embedding, applies kernel archetypal analysis, assigns each cell to…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-023-01716-9" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SEACells">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dpeerlab/SEACells" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SEACells">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/seacells-5f335007/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SEACells">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="domain_clustering" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SiGra">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Domain Clustering</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SiGra">SiGra</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SiGra: single-cell spatial elucidation through an image-augmented graph transformer</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">若一个细胞自身的表达很稀疏，周围细胞的表达、它的位置关系、以及该处的细胞形态/染色信号可以提供互补证据。SiGra 不是简单地把邻居平均，而是让图 Transformer 学习“哪个邻居、哪一种模态更有用”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics can be noisy, sparse, and low coverage, obscuring domain boundaries and marker genes. Common single-cell workflows such as Seurat v4 and Scanpy use expression but not the full spatial-image modality; stLearn uses his…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/QSong-github/SiGra" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SiGra">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/sigra-6b9aa7d9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SiGra">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SLAT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SLAT">SLAT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spatial-linked alignment tool (SLAT) for aligning heterogeneous slices</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SLAT（Spatially-Linked Alignment Tool）不是先把两张切片做刚性配准，再寻找最近点；它先把每张切片表示成“细胞/spot 为节点、空间近邻为边”的图，用共享的图编码器把分子特征和多尺度空间邻域压进同一个嵌入，再用对抗训练让两张图中可比部分的嵌入分布接近，最后按嵌入余弦相似度和可选的空间候选约束输出细胞对应关系。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SLAT (Spatial Linked Alignment Tool) addresses a critical challenge in spatial transcriptomics: aligning heterogeneous spatial slices from different conditions, technologies, or developmental stages.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-43105-5" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SLAT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gao-lab/SLAT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SLAT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/slat-cfad1996/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SLAT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="STalign">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STalign">STalign</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">STalign: Alignment of spatial transcriptomics data using diffeomorphic metric mapping</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STalign 把稀疏空间坐标转换成可注册的组织密度图，直接优化全局 affine 与平滑可逆的 LDDMM 变换，并用背景/artifact mixture 和可选 landmark 处理部分重叠；它的强项是跨样本、跨平台和 atlas 的结构配准，边界是依赖共享形态、非凸初始化、栅格尺度与非一一细胞解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STalign addresses a practical bottleneck in spatial transcriptomics: comparing tissue sections across samples, platforms, and atlases requires spatial coordinates to be aligned first.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-43915-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STalign">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JEFworks-Lab/STalign" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STalign">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stalign-0090ee94/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STalign">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="iscience" data-journal-label="iScience" data-method="tGPT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="tGPT">tGPT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Generative pretraining from large-scale transcriptomes for single-cell deciphering</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞转录组规模迅速扩大，数据稀疏、批次效应明显，传统方法难以直接整合数千万细胞。tGPT 把每个细胞的高表达基因按表达量降序排列，只保留基因排序而不使用表达数值。 对序列 G=(G1,\ldots,Gn)，模型最大化 L(G)=\sumi\log P(Gi\mid G{i-k},\ldots,G{i-1};\theta). 输入为 [ , G1, G2, ...</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">tGPT is a decoder-only transformer foundation model for single-cell transcriptomes. It converts each cell into a descending rank sequence of expressed protein-coding genes and autoregressively predicts the next gene, enabling pretraining ov…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>iScience · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/deeplearningplus/tGPT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for tGPT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tgpt-d7f016c5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：tGPT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="segmentation_annotation" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="TOSICA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Segmentation &amp; Annotation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TOSICA">TOSICA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Transformer for one stop interpretable cell type annotation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞参考图谱建好后，常见任务是把已有的细胞类型标签稳定地迁移到新批次或新研究的 query 数据。传统流程往往是降维、聚类、找 marker、人工命名；不同研究会因 marker 和命名标准不同而得到不一致的注释。已有深度模型虽然可自动化，但其隐藏层通常难以回溯到具体的生物过程。TOSICA（Nature Communications, 2023）希望同时给出标签和“为什么是这个标签”的路径/调控子层解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TOSICA (Transformer for One-Stop Interpretable Cell-type Annotation) addresses supervised reference-to-query annotation when standard marker/manual workflows are slow and deep latent models lose a direct biological interpretation.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2023</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/JackieHanLab/TOSICA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TOSICA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tosica-ad5f4a06/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TOSICA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2023" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="veloVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="veloVI">veloVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Deep generative modeling of transcriptional dynamics for RNA velocity analysis in single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">veloVI 仍然使用 RNA velocity 的经典转录—剪接—降解常微分方程，但不再为每个基因独立地用 EM 拟合一条确定轨迹。它用变分自编码器从整细胞的 spliced/unspliced 表达学习共享潜变量，再为每个“细胞—基因”解码 induction/repression 时间与四种转录状态的概率；ODE 把这些时间变成期望 RNA abundance，混合似然将其与观测连接。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Deep generative modeling of transcriptional dynamics for RNA velocity analysis in single cells Nature Methods, 2023. DOI: 10.1038/s41592-023-01994-w. veloVI is a variational-inference framework for RNA velocity.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2023</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-systems" data-journal-label="Cell Systems" data-method="Belayer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Spatially Variable Genes</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Belayer">Belayer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Belayer: Modeling discrete and continuous spatial variation in gene expression from spatially resolved transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Belayer 面向具有明确层状结构的空间转录组，例如大脑皮层、皮肤和视网膜。它不把每层内的表达强行视为常数，也不要求整张组织上的表达处处平滑，而是用“分段线性”模型同时表达两类变化：层内沿相对深度连续上升或下降，跨层边界则允许发生不连续跳变。 方法的两个输出彼此依赖：一是每个 spot 的层标签/层边界，二是每个基因在每层中的截距和斜率。斜率大的基因表示层内梯度明显，边界两侧拟合值差大的基因表示离散层转换明显。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) data from layered tissues — such as the cerebral cortex (6 layers), skin (3 layers), and retina (10 layers) — exhibit both discrete changes in gene expression at layer boundaries (due to cell type tr…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Systems · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2022.09.002" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Belayer">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/belayer" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Belayer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/belayer-8097cfa0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Belayer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="CellRank">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CellRank">CellRank</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">CellRank for directed single-cell fate mapping</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CellRank 不把二维 UMAP 上的速度流线当作发育路线，而是在高维表达邻域中建立一个有方向的马尔可夫链：RNA velocity 决定“更可能往哪个邻居走”，表达相似性限制“只能沿细胞流形走”；随后用 GPCCA 把数千个细胞粗粒化成初始、中间和终末宏状态，再计算每个细胞最终被不同终末状态吸收的概率。 输入是单细胞表达矩阵、KNN 图和 RNA velocity（也可换成其他方向信息）；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Computational trajectory inference from single-cell RNA-seq can reconstruct developmental pathways, but it traditionally requires prior knowledge of the biological direction (e.g., specifying a root cell).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-021-01346-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CellRank">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/cellrank" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CellRank">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cellrank-91fc27a4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CellRank">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="ChromatinVelocity">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ChromatinVelocity">ChromatinVelocity</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Chromatin Velocity reveals epigenetic dynamics by single-cell profiling of heterochromatin and euchromatin</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">传统单细胞 ATAC-seq 主要读取开放染色质，但对紧缩的异染色质覆盖不足。论文指出，异染色质可占基因组很大比例，并且和细胞身份、基因组稳定性、癌症耐药等过程有关。因此，作者想解决两个问题： 如何在单细胞水平同时读取开放染色质和紧缩染色质？ 如何像 RNA velocity 那样，从染色质状态推断细胞沿发育或重编程路径的“未来方向”？ 论文提出两个连在一起的方法： scGET-seq：把普通 Tn5 与工程化的 TnH 联合使用。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell ATAC-seq profiles accessible chromatin, but it largely misses compacted heterochromatin, which the paper notes can encompass up to half of the genome and carries important regulatory and genomic information .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-01031-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ChromatinVelocity">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/leomorelli/scGET" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ChromatinVelocity">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/chromatinvelocity-f3798a28/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ChromatinVelocity">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="CNA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CNA">CNA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Co-varying neighborhood analysis identifies cell populations associated with phenotypes of interest from single-cell transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CNA（co-varying neighborhood analysis）面向多样本单细胞数据。它关心的问题不是单个细胞如何聚类，而是“哪些细胞状态在不同样本之间丰度变化，并且这种变化是否和样本级表型相关”。样本级表型可以是疾病状态、临床指标、基因型、年龄、性别、季节、祖源或实验条件。论文指出，常见做法先把细胞聚成离散簇，再检验每个簇的丰度是否和表型相关；这种做法依赖预先给定的聚类结构和分辨率，可能把连续或跨簇的生物信号切碎或抹平。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Co-varying neighborhood analysis (CNA) is designed for multi-sample single-cell datasets where the biological question is about a sample-level attribute: disease status, clinical phenotype, genotype, season, age, sex, ancestry, experimental…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-01066-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CNA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/immunogenomics/cna" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CNA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cna-9ba6abba/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CNA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="science-advances" data-journal-label="Science Advances" data-method="DeepVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="DeepVelo">DeepVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">DeepVelo: Single-cell transcriptomic deep velocity field learning with neural ordinary differential equations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeepVelo 解决的是单细胞转录组动态建模问题。普通 scRNA-seq 只能观察到很多细胞在某一时刻的表达快照，不能连续追踪同一个细胞随时间变化。RNA velocity 能估计短时间的瞬时变化，但论文认为它不足以描述更长时间尺度的发育轨迹；线性 ODE 或稀疏向量场方法又可能低估非线性调控关系。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">DeepVelo addresses the problem that most single-cell RNA-seq experiments provide static snapshots, while RNA velocity gives only short-horizon instantaneous changes.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Science Advances · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.abq3745" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for DeepVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/aicb-ZhangLabs/deepvelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for DeepVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/deepvelo-e2135cc1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：DeepVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="dynamo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="dynamo">dynamo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping transcriptomic vector fields of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Dynamo 的贡献是把有实验假设的局部 RNA 速度拟合成可微连续场，再用动力系统工具提出调控、轨迹和扰动假设；结论的可信度上限始终由输入速度、状态空间表示、场重建和外推范围共同决定。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq provides dense snapshots of cell states but not direct time series of the same cells. RNA velocity partially addresses this by estimating short-term state changes from splicing kinetics, yet it often produces relative ve…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2021.12.045" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for dynamo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/aristoteleo/dynamo-release" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for dynamo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dynamo-964547a9/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：dynamo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-systems" data-journal-label="Cell Systems" data-method="Fast-Higashi">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Fast-Higashi">Fast-<wbr>Higashi</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Ultrafast and interpretable single-cell 3D genome analysis with Fast-Higashi</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Fast-Higashi 把每条染色体上“基因组区间 × 基因组区间 × 单细胞”的 scHi-C 数据看成三阶张量，用一个跨染色体共享的细胞因子解释细胞差异，同时为每条染色体学习可回溯到具体接触区域的“元相互作用（meta-interaction）”；为处理极稀疏接触图，它在小批次基因组区间上先做 partial random walk with restart（partial RWR），再用无需反向传播的交替分解求解。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell Hi-C (scHi-C) technologies can map the 3D genome structure in individual cells, enabling study of chromatin compartments (A/B), TADs, and loops at single-cell resolution.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Systems · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2022.09.004" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Fast-Higashi">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ma-compbio/Fast-Higashi" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Fast-Higashi">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/fast-higashi-73eda661/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Fast-Higashi">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="GLUE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GLUE">GLUE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multi-omics single-cell data integration and regulatory inference with graph-linked embedding</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GLUE 同时学习两类坐标：细胞坐标 \mathbf u 回答“这个细胞处于什么状态”，特征坐标 \mathbf v 回答“这个基因/峰/甲基化特征指向什么生物方向”；引导图先把特征坐标定向，再用 \mathbf Vk^\top\mathbf u 重建各模态，于是不同模态的细胞坐标获得可比的语义。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Most single-cell multi-omics datasets measure different molecular layers in different cells, so integration must align unpaired samples whose feature spaces are also different.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gao-lab/GLUE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GLUE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/glue-cd814d6a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GLUE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="MIOFlow">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MIOFlow">MIOFlow</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Manifold Interpolating Optimal-Transport Flows for Trajectory Inference</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MIOFlow 不把不同时间点的细胞强行一一配对。它先学习一个尽量保留数据流形距离的低维空间，再学习一个随时间变化的向量场，使起始细胞群沿该向量场移动后，在各观测时刻与对应的细胞群分布接近。 这里的“轨迹”是模型在群体分布约束下生成的可能路径，不是同一细胞被真实追踪得到的谱系。单细胞测序会破坏细胞，因此论文输入是若干独立的时间快照 X0,\ldots,X{T-1}。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Single-cell RNA sequencing is destructive — you cannot track the same cell over time. Researchers collect snapshot populations at multiple timepoints and want to reconstruct continuous individual cell trajectories, inclu…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2206.14928" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MIOFlow">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/KrishnaswamyLab/MIOFlow" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MIOFlow">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mioflow-24a0e542/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MIOFlow">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="MIRA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MIRA">MIRA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">MIRA: joint regulatory modeling of multimodal expression and chromatin accessibility in single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MIRA 要解决的问题是：同一个单细胞里同时测到 RNA 表达和染色质可及性后，研究者不只想把细胞画到一个共同 UMAP 上，还想知道发育分支点由哪些调控因子推动，以及某个基因的表达到底是否主要由其附近染色质开放解释。论文明确指出，已有 joint analysis 方法能把两种模态投影到共享潜空间，但缺少系统对比转录和可及性的工具来解释发育命运决定中的调控回路 。 MIRA 的核心可以分成两层。 第一层是细胞级 topic model。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">MIRA is a multimodal single-cell regulatory analysis method for matched scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq cells. The paper argues that prior joint-embedding methods can visualize or cluster multimodal cells, but do not rigorously contrast expression…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-neuroscience" data-journal-label="Nature Neuroscience" data-method="MouseCortex-Multimodal-Atlas">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="MouseCortex-Multimodal-Atlas">MouseCortex-<wbr>Multimodal-<wbr>Atlas</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Multimodal profiling of the transcriptional regulatory landscape of the developing mouse cortex identifies Neurog2 as a key epigenome remodeler</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">E14.5 小鼠皮层正处于神经发生中期：神经干细胞（NSC）产生中间祖细胞（IPC），再分化为不同成熟程度的投射神经元（PN）。论文关心的核心不是“哪些基因随分化变化”，而是调控事件的先后和因果关系：远端增强子何时开放、它连接哪个基因、转录因子结合后是否同时改变 DNA 甲基化与三维接触，以及这些候选元件在活体中能否真正驱动表达。 为此，研究组合了五类证据：scRNA-seq 描述表达轨迹；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: How do multiple epigenetic layers and transcription factors coordinate to drive neural lineage specification in the mammalian cerebral cortex?</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Neuroscience · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41593-021-01002-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MouseCortex-Multimodal-Atlas">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/BonevLab/Noack_et_al_NatNeuro2021" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MouseCortex-Multimodal-Atlas">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/mousecortex-multimodal-atlas-192d5834/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MouseCortex-Multimodal-Atlas">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="PASTE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PASTE">PASTE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Alignment and integration of spatial transcriptomics data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">空间转录组（ST）的一张切片给出两类观测：每个 spot 的基因表达向量，以及该 spot 在本切片内的二维坐标。相邻切片来自同一块三维组织，但组织放到芯片上的平移、旋转、覆盖范围、spot 数量和测序深度都可能不同。因此，两张切片的原始坐标没有共同坐标系，单靠图像刚体配准或按表达最近邻匹配都不够。 PASTE 提供两个相关但不同的任务： 成对对齐：求两张切片 spot 之间的概率耦合，再把连续切片变换到共同坐标系，用于三维堆叠。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression while preserving 2D spatial coordinates of tissue spots, enabling mapping of cell types and gene expression patterns within tissues.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-022-01459-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PASTE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/raphael-group/paste" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PASTE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/paste-98eb777c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PASTE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="scATAC" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-reports-methods" data-journal-label="Cell Reports Methods" data-method="PeakVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">scATAC — Single-Cell Chromatin &amp; DNA Methylation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PeakVI">PeakVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">PeakVI: A deep generative model for single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PeakVI 把极度稀疏的单细胞 ATAC 峰矩阵看成“是否至少观察到一次开放事件”的二值结果。它用变分自编码器学习细胞的生物学状态，同时把测序深度和区域本身易被检测的程度拆成两个技术因子；因此同一个模型既能给出用于聚类和整合的低维表示，也能给出逐细胞、逐区域的去噪开放概率。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: PeakVI: A deep generative model for single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis Authors: Tal Ashuach, Daniel A. Reidenbach, Adam Gayoso, Nir Yosef Journal: Cell Reports Methods 2, 100182 (2022) DOI: 10.1016/j.crmeth.2022.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Reports Methods · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.crmeth.2022.100182" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PeakVI">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/scverse/scvi-tools" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PeakVI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/peakvi-b7e9f1dc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PeakVI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="journal-of-molecular-biology" data-journal-label="Journal of Molecular Biology" data-method="RNA_ODE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="RNA_ODE">RNA_<wbr>ODE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Dynamical Systems Model of RNA Velocity Improves Inference of Single-cell Trajectory, Pseudo-time and Gene Regulation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA-ODE 的关键贡献是把“瞬时 RNA velocity”提升为“可模拟的动态系统”：先学习 dx/dt=f(x;θ)，再用模拟出来的未来轨迹推断细胞状态转移、发育方向和调控关系。概念上它把 velocity 信息用得更彻底；但就当前获取的代码而言，公开包只覆盖了核心 ODE/lineage/部分 GRN 功能，论文中若干下游分析仍缺少可核查实现。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity estimates the instantaneous direction of transcriptome change in each single cell, but it does not directly answer finite-time questions such as where a cell will go later, which state transitions are likely, or how perturbing…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Molecular Biology · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/RuishanLiu/VelocytoAnalysis" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for RNA_ODE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/rna-ode-a25c2156/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：RNA_ODE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="scBERT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scBERT">scBERT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scBERT as a large-scale pretrained deep language model for cell type annotation of single-cell RNA-seq data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序的细胞类型注释容易受到 marker 基因列表不完整、批次效应以及忽略基因间相互作用的影响。scBERT 借鉴 BERT 的预训练-微调范式，在大量无标签细胞上学习表达模式，再把表示迁移到新的注释数据。 原始 AnnData -&gt; Panglao 基因空间对齐 -&gt; 过滤/归一化 -&gt; 离散表达 token -&gt; Performer 预训练 -&gt; 加载 checkpoint -&gt; 监督分类 -&gt; 细胞类型 代码把查询…</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scBERT is a large-scale pretrained deep language model for annotating cell types in single-cell RNA-seq. It addresses curated-marker dependence, batch effects and missing gene-gene interaction information by pretraining a bidirectional Perf…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/TencentAILabHealthcare/scBERT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scBERT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scbert-71766ff3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scBERT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="sciPENN">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="sciPENN">sciPENN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A multi-use deep learning method for CITE-seq and single-cell RNA-seq data integration with cell surface protein prediction and imputation</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">sciPENN 的方法核心是：用一个带 RNN hidden embedding、蛋白均值/分位数 head 和可选 label head 的神经网络，从 CITE-seq 中学习 RNA 到蛋白的映射；再通过 measured-protein mask 实现 censored loss，使多个蛋白面板不完全重叠的 CITE-seq 数据集可以联合训练，并进一步完成缺失蛋白补全、scRNA-seq 蛋白预测、不确定性估计和标签转移。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">sciPENN targets CITE-seq/scRNA-seq integration when researchers want protein-level information but only have RNA for some cells or have multiple CITE-seq references with partially overlapping antibody panels.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-022-00545-w" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for sciPENN">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jlakkis/sciPENN" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for sciPENN">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scipenn-ed4e7447/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：sciPENN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="scJoint">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scJoint">scJoint</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scJoint integrates atlas-scale single-cell RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data with transfer learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scJoint 不是把 RNA 计数和 ATAC 峰矩阵直接拼在一起，也不是要求同一细胞有成对测量。它先把 ATAC 峰转换为按基因汇总的活性分数，使 RNA 与 ATAC 拥有同一组基因特征；随后让两种模态共用一个线性编码器，在 RNA 标签监督、低维表示约束和跨模态余弦对齐的共同作用下学习 64 维空间。第一轮训练后，用 RNA 邻居给 ATAC 传标签；第二轮再用这些伪标签和中心损失收紧同类细胞，最后重新做一次 KNN 标签迁移。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq) reveals chromatin accessibility — which genomic regions are &quot;open&quot; in each cell — providing complementary epigenomic information to gene expression (scRNA-seq).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-01161-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scJoint">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SydneyBioX/scJoint" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scJoint">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scjoint-d33e3459/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scJoint">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="journal-of-computational-biology" data-journal-label="Journal of Computational Biology" data-method="SCOT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCOT">SCOT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SCOT: Single-Cell Multi-Omics Alignment with Optimal Transport</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">当 RNA、染色质可及性或 DNA 甲基化分别测在不同细胞上时，两张数据矩阵既没有逐细胞对应，也可能没有可直接比较的特征。SCOT（Single-Cell alignment using Optimal Transport）不尝试比较“某个基因”和“某个 ATAC peak”的数值，而是假设同一细胞群在不同模态中保留相似的细胞—细胞几何结构：若两个 RNA 细胞在本模态流形上相近，它们对应的 ATAC 细胞也应在 ATAC 流形上相近。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Single-cell multi-omics data integration is essential for understanding joint regulatory mechanisms (e.g., how chromatin accessibility governs gene expression), but most sequencing assays cannot be applied simultaneously…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of Computational Biology · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1089/cmb.2021.0446" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SCOT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/rsinghlab/SCOT" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SCOT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scot-64da306e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SCOT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="scPretrain">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scPretrain">scPretrain</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">scPretrain: Multi-task self-supervised learning for cell type classification</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序的细胞类型标注通常依赖少量人工标注细胞，但未标注细胞更多，并且包含有用的基因表达模式。仅用标注数据训练容易过拟合，也容易把平台、器官、物种和批次效应当成细胞类型信号。scPretrain 的目标是先利用多个未标注数据集学习可迁移的细胞表示，再用少量新数据集标注进行微调。 把每个未标注数据集的 K-means 聚类结果当作“伪标签”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell type annotation is commonly trained only on labelled cells, although unlabelled cells are more abundant and carry information about gene activity.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/ruiyi-zhang/scPretrain" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scPretrain">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scpretrain-20b8118a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scPretrain">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="iclr" data-journal-label="ICLR" data-method="TOGL">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TOGL">TOGL</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Topological Graph Neural Networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">其中，x^{(v)} 可以是原始节点属性，也可以是前面 GNN 层产生的隐藏表示；\widetilde x^{(v)} 继续送入后续 GNN；hG^{(1)} 是周期信息的图级表示，默认在分类前拼接。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Standard message-passing GNNs are provably no more powerful than the Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL[1]) graph isomorphism test (Xu et al. 2019, ICLR).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>ICLR · 2022</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="UniTVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="UniTVelo">UniTVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">UniTVelo: temporally unified RNA velocity reinforces single-cell trajectory inference</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">UniTVelo 解决的是单细胞 RNA velocity 推断问题：给定每个细胞中 spliced 和 unspliced mRNA 的计数，推断细胞沿发育、分化或状态转变方向的动态轨迹。论文沿用 RNA velocity 的一阶动力学系统，将 unspliced RNA u(t)、spliced RNA s(t)、转录率 \alpha(t)、剪接率 \beta 和降解率 \gamma 联系起来。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">UniTVelo targets RNA velocity inference from single-cell spliced and unspliced mRNA counts. The goal is to infer directed developmental or state-transition trajectories, but existing RNA velocity models can fail when genes have weak directi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/StatBiomed/UniTVelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for UniTVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/unitvelo-002e689e/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：UniTVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2022" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="VeloVAE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="VeloVAE">VeloVAE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Variational Mixtures of ODEs for Inferring Cellular Gene Expression Dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VeloVAE 把每个细胞的 unspliced/spliced 计数看成 RNA 转录—剪接—降解 ODE 在某个未知发育时间的观测。编码器从全基因的 (u,s) 同时推断共享细胞时间 t 和连续细胞状态 c；解码器不自由生成表达，而是把 t,c 代入解析 ODE 解重建 (u,s)。因此潜变量具有明确动力学含义，也能用细胞状态调节转录率来表示分叉。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Each cell i is represented by a vector Xi(t) \in \mathbb{R}^d parametrized by time t, governed by some differential equation plus noise. Only the vector xi := Xi(ti) is observed at an unknown time ti.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2022</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1101/2022.07.08.499381" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for VeloVAE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/welch-lab/VeloVAE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for VeloVAE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/velovae-85cd44c4/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VeloVAE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2021" data-code="no" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="D3PM">

        <h2 aria-label="D3PM">D3PM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Structured Denoising Diffusion Models in Discrete State-Spaces</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">D3PM（Discrete Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models）把扩散模型从连续高斯噪声空间推广到离散类别空间：它不把文本 token 或量化图像像素先嵌入连续空间，而是直接用一系列类别转移矩阵 \boldsymbol {Q} {t} 来逐步破坏离散数据，再训练神经网络学习反向去噪过程。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">D3PM extends denoising diffusion probabilistic models to categorical data such as text tokens and quantized image pixels. Continuous DDPMs typically corrupt data with Gaussian noise, but discrete data needs a categorical corruption process…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="dyngen">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="dyngen">dyngen</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Spearheading future omics analyses using dyngen, a multi-modal simulator of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">dyngen 是一个用于生成动态单细胞组学数据的模拟器。论文的核心问题是：很多单细胞计算方法需要“真实答案”来评估，例如细胞在发育轨迹上的真实位置、真实 RNA velocity、每个细胞中每条调控边的真实活性；但真实实验数据通常无法提供这些 ground truth。合成数据如果能尽量模拟底层生物过程，就可以用于方法开发和定量 benchmarking。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">The paper introduces dyngen, a simulator for dynamic single-cell omics data with known ground truth. The motivation is that real single-cell data rarely provide exact truth for trajectory position, RNA velocity, or cell-specific regulatory…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dynverse/dyngen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for dyngen">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/dyngen-9f49d3d3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：dyngen">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell-systems" data-journal-label="Cell Systems" data-method="Hotspot">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Hotspot">Hotspot</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Hotspot identifies informative gene modules across modalities of single-cell genomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Hotspot 不负责学习“什么叫细胞相似”。它接收一个已有的细胞—细胞相似性图，然后问两个问题：某个基因是否沿这张图呈现非随机的局部结构；两个基因是否在图的相同区域共同变化。第一个问题用于筛选信息基因，第二个问题用于把这些基因组织成模块。 这个分工解释了 Hotspot 为什么能跨模态使用。图可以来自转录组低维空间、组织中的物理坐标，也可以来自谱系树；被检验的量仍然可以是基因表达。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Hotspot identifies informative gene modules across modalities of single-cell genomics Authors: David DeTomaso, Nir Yosef Journal: Cell Systems, 2021 DOI: 10.1016/j.cels.2021.04.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell Systems · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2021.04.005" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Hotspot">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/yoseflab/hotspot" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Hotspot">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/hotspot-c8f6f98b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Hotspot">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="PRESCIENT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PRESCIENT">PRESCIENT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Generative modeling of single-cell time series with PRESCIENT enables prediction of cell trajectories with interventions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PRESCIENT 把多个真实时间点的单细胞转录组“快照”看成同一随机动力系统在不同时间的群体分布：它学习一个神经网络表示的势能地形，在这个地形上反复推进带噪声的细胞状态，使模拟群体尽量接近真实观测群体；训练好后，可以从任意细胞状态出发模拟未来轨迹，也可以先修改基因表达再预测终末命运分布。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Time-series scRNA-seq observes different cells at each time point, so it gives population snapshots rather than continuous lineages. Pseudotime methods order cells without physical-time dynamics; FateID (Nature Methods, 2018) predicts fate…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/gifford-lab/prescient" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PRESCIENT">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/prescient-6fbfd0cd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PRESCIENT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
