      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="PseudotimeDE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PseudotimeDE">PseudotimeDE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">PseudotimeDE: inference of differential gene expression along cell pseudotime with well-calibrated p-values from single-cell RNA sequencing data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PseudotimeDE 解决的是单细胞 RNA-seq 里一个很常见但容易被低估的问题：已经推断出细胞伪时间之后，怎样判断某个基因是否沿伪时间发生差异表达。论文的核心判断是，伪时间不是一个没有误差的真实协变量，而是从同一批表达数据里估计出来的随机量；如果后续 DE 检验把每个细胞的伪时间当成固定值，就可能得到不校准的 p 值，从而影响 FDR 控制或损失检出能力。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PseudotimeDE tests for genes whose expression changes along inferred pseudotime in scRNA-seq data. The paper argues that this downstream DE task is statistically fragile because most pseudotime methods return point estimates without uncerta…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/SONGDONGYUAN1994/PseudotimeDE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PseudotimeDE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/pseudotimede-7329a08f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PseudotimeDE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="scArches">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scArches">scArches</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Mapping single-cell data to reference atlases by transfer learning</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">已有参考图谱通常由许多批次训练而成，但新实验到来时，研究者未必能重新取得全部参考原始数据，也不希望每来一个批次就从头训练。scArches 的目标是：只拿到参考模型参数和新查询数据，就把查询细胞放进参考潜空间，同时尽量不改写参考图谱已经学到的结构。 输入包括：与参考模型使用相同特征空间的查询表达矩阵、查询的 study/batch 条件标签，以及训练好的参考模型。输出是查询细胞在参考潜空间中的坐标；</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Mapping single-cell data to reference atlases by transfer learning Authors: Lotfollahi et al. (13 authors), Theis Lab Journal: Nature Biotechnology 40(1), 2021-08-30 DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-021-01001-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scArches">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/scarches" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scArches">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scarches-fc2c2098/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scArches">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-machine-intelligence" data-journal-label="Nature Machine Intelligence" data-method="scDEC">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scDEC">scDEC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Simultaneous deep generative modelling and clustering of single-cell genomic data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scATAC-seq 的峰计数矩阵既高维又稀疏。常见流程先降维，再在所得坐标上运行 K-means 或 Louvain；这样“什么表示适合重构数据”和“什么表示适合区分细胞群”由两个互不反馈的步骤决定。scDEC 把连续表示和离散簇标签一起放入生成模型，使编码器在训练表示的同时直接输出聚类概率。 这里尤其不能被名字误导：本论文的 scDEC 不是经典 DEC 中基于 Student-t 分布和 KL 目标分布迭代的算法。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Simultaneous deep generative modelling and clustering of single-cell genomic data Authors: Qiao Liu, Shengquan Chen, Rui Jiang, Wing Hung Wong Journal: Nature Machine Intelligence (2021) DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Machine Intelligence · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s42256-021-00333-y" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scDEC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kimmo1019/scDEC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scDEC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scdec-a959a807/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scDEC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2021" data-code="no" data-journal="arxiv" data-journal-label="arXiv" data-method="SlicedMMOT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SlicedMMOT">SlicedMMOT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Sliced Multi-Marginal Optimal Transport</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">给定 P 个概率分布 \mu1,\ldots,\muP，多边最优传输（multi-marginal optimal transport, MMOT）要在所有边缘分布固定的联合耦合 \pi\in\Pi(\mu1,\ldots,\muP) 中寻找最低代价： 论文关注的不是任意代价，而是带权二次重心代价。令 \betap\ge0、\sump\betap=1，则 这个代价衡量每个样本相对联合加权中心的离散程度。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multi-marginal optimal transport (MMOT) provides a geometrically principled way to compare P &gt; 2 probability measures simultaneously — a natural requirement in multi-task learning, multi-modal alignment, and multi-condition biological analy…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>arXiv · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2102.07115" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SlicedMMOT">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/slicedmmot-07a783b7/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SlicedMMOT">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="aaai" data-journal-label="AAAI" data-method="TabTransformer">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TabTransformer">TabTransformer</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TabTransformer: Tabular Data Modeling Using Contextual Embeddings</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TabTransformer 的核心不是简单地“把 Transformer 用在表格上”，而是只让类别列作为 token 进入自注意力层，使某个类别值的表示依赖同一行其他列的取值；连续列绕过 Transformer，最终与类别上下文嵌入一起交给 MLP。论文同时提出 MLM 和 RTD 两种无监督预训练任务，用未标注表格先训练列嵌入与 Transformer，再用少量标注数据微调。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Tabular data is the most common data type in real-world ML applications (recommender systems, advertising, finance), yet tree-based ensemble methods like GBDT (XGBoost, Chen &amp; Guestrin, KDD 2016; CatBoost, Prokhorenkova et al.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>AAAI · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2012.06678" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TabTransformer">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/lucidrains/tab-transformer-pytorch" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TabTransformer">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/tabtransformer-afa0e217/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TabTransformer">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="totalVI">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="totalVI">totalVI</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Joint probabilistic modeling of single-cell multi-omic data with totalVI</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">totalVI 的本质是：用一个联合 VAE 学习 RNA+蛋白共同的细胞状态，同时把蛋白观测拆成“背景概率 + 背景均值 + 前景均值”。这样它不仅能做 embedding，还能把蛋白背景校正、缺失蛋白预测、差异表达和 RNA-蛋白相关性都写成同一个概率模型上的后验查询。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">CITE-seq measures RNA and cell-surface proteins in the same single cells, but the two modalities have different noise sources and technical biases.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/YosefLab/scvi-tools" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for totalVI">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/totalvi-87065ea2/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：totalVI">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="pnas" data-journal-label="PNAS" data-method="VeloAE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="VeloAE">VeloAE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Representation learning of RNA velocity reveals robust cell transitions</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VeloAE 的本质是：把 RNA velocity 从嘈杂的高维基因空间，搬到一个由图平滑编码器和注意力解码器学习出的低维空间中，再在该空间估计速度和转移方向。论文和代码都支持核心 autoencoder、AttComb、latent regression 和 velocity projection；但复现论文时必须处理好 GCN/GAT 版本差异、scVelo 委托的 transition graph，以及缺失的本地补充材料。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity uses spliced and unspliced RNA to infer short-term cell-state transitions, but transition estimates can be unstable in high-dimensional gene space because unspliced counts are sparse/noisy and different genes may imply contradi…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PNAS · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/qiaochen/VeloAE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for VeloAE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/veloae-b14e1527/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VeloAE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2021" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="VeTra">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="VeTra">VeTra</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">VeTra: a tool for trajectory inference based on RNA velocity</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VeTra 面向单细胞 RNA-seq 的轨迹推断问题。传统轨迹推断常根据细胞之间的转录组相似性来排序，但相似性本身通常不能决定轨迹方向，因此很多方法需要用户提供起点、终点、marker 基因或实验先验 。当细胞过程存在复杂分支时，如果方法预设线性、分叉或环形等固定拓扑，也可能限制新结构的发现 。 RNA velocity 的优势是给每个细胞一个局部运动方向和速度，能在不依赖先验的情况下提示细胞状态转移方向 。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">VeTra is a trajectory-inference method for single-cell RNA-seq that uses RNA velocity direction rather than only transcriptomic similarity. The paper&#x27;s goal is to infer lineage trajectories and pseudotime without requiring predefined topolo…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2021</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btab364" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for VeTra">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/wgzgithub/VeTra" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for VeTra">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/vetra-1e4fb980/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：VeTra">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="2020" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="CoordinatedCellularNeighborhoods">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Atlases &amp; Resources</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="CoordinatedCellularNeighborhoods">CoordinatedCellularNeighborhoods</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Coordinated Cellular Neighborhoods Orchestrate Antitumoral Immunity at the Colorectal Cancer Invasive Front</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇工作的核心不是再做一次“细胞分群”，而是把空间组织提升为一个新的分析单位：细胞邻域（cellular neighborhood, CN）。每个细胞根据其周围 10 个最近细胞的类型组成获得一个 CN 标签；随后，研究者比较不同患者中“哪些细胞类型位于哪些 CN、这些组合如何共同变化、CN 内细胞处于什么功能状态、不同 CN 的功能状态是否相关”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Multiplexed imaging can identify cell types, marker states, and pairwise contacts while retaining spatial coordinates, but those views do not directly describe how tissue-scale regions are organized and coordinated.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2020.07.005" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for CoordinatedCellularNeighborhoods">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/nolanlab/NeighborhoodCoordination" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for CoordinatedCellularNeighborhoods">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/coordinatedcellularneighborhoods-251a016a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：CoordinatedCellularNeighborhoods">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="integration_multimodal" data-year="2020" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="cTPnet">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Integration &amp; Multi-modal</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="cTPnet">cTPnet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Surface protein imputation from single cell transcriptomes by deep neural networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">很多单细胞研究只有 scRNA-seq，没有同一个细胞上的表面蛋白测量。但在免疫学、造血、肿瘤研究里，CD3、CD4、CD8、CD19、CD34、CD38 这类表面蛋白往往比对应 RNA 更直接地定义细胞类型、分化阶段和治疗靶点。论文提出的问题是：能否利用已有 CITE-seq/REAP-seq 这类“同一细胞同时测 RNA 和表面蛋白”的数据，训练一个模型，把新的 scRNA-seq-only 数据映射成表面蛋白丰度 。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq is widely available, but matched surface-protein measurements are often missing even when surface markers are the most interpretable features for immune cell state, cell type, and therapeutic targeting .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/zhouzilu/cTPnet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for cTPnet">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/ctpnet-8a756dd5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：cTPnet">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2020" data-code="no" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="ElevenGrandChallenges_singlecell_review">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ElevenGrandChallenges_singlecell_review">ElevenGrandChallenges_<wbr>singlecell_<wbr>review</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Eleven grand challenges in single-cell data science</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Genome Biology 2020 文章不是提出一个新的算法，也不是发布一个软件包或标准 benchmark。它是一篇单细胞数据科学的路线图/综述型文章。摘要明确说，作者梳理了 11 个未来关键挑战，对每个挑战给出研究动机、已有工作和开放问题 。 因此，这里的“方法”不是某个可运行模型，而是一套问题分类框架： 单细胞测序已经从小规模实验进入大规模数据阶段。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Eleven grand challenges in single-cell data science is a Genome Biology 2020 review/perspective article that organizes open computational problems in single-cell data science. It is not a new algorithm or software release.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/S13059-020-1926-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ElevenGrandChallenges_singlecell_review">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/elevengrandchallenges-singlecell-review-8688342b/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ElevenGrandChallenges_singlecell_review">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2020" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="ProteinVelocity">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="ProteinVelocity">ProteinVelocity</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Protein velocity and acceleration from single-cell multiomics experiments</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity 能用单细胞 RNA-seq 中的未剪接 RNA（unspliced RNA, u）和已剪接 RNA（spliced RNA, s）推断细胞状态的未来方向。但在多组学实验中，同一个细胞还可以测到蛋白/ADT 丰度。Gorin、Svensson 和 Pachter 的核心问题是：当前蛋白水平是否能反推出细胞在更早时刻的转录状态，从而把单时间点数据扩展成“过去—现在—未来”的动态解释。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">This paper addresses a limitation of RNA velocity: unspliced/spliced RNA dynamics can extrapolate a future transcriptomic direction, but they do not directly use paired protein measurements to infer where a cell came from.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-020-1945-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for ProteinVelocity">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pachterlab/GSP_2019" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for ProteinVelocity">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/proteinvelocity-42e91e15/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：ProteinVelocity">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2020" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="scVelo">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="scVelo">scVelo</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Generalizing RNA velocity to transient cell states through dynamical modeling</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">scVelo 的关键贡献不是把速度箭头画得更平滑，而是放弃“数据必须已经看到稳态”的强假设，直接为每个基因拟合转录、剪接和降解动力学，同时估计每个细胞处于诱导还是抑制阶段以及它在该基因轨迹上的潜在时间。得到基因空间的速度后，方法再用速度与邻近细胞表达差的方向一致性构造转移图，并据此投影到 UMAP、识别起点/终点和整合 gene-shared latent time。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">RNA velocity, introduced by La Manno et al. (Nature, 2018), estimates the rate of gene expression change from the ratio of unspliced to spliced mRNA in scRNA-seq data.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-020-0591-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for scVelo">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/scvelo" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for scVelo">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scvelo-f8858c2f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：scVelo">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2020" data-code="no" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="SHARE-seq">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SHARE-seq">SHARE-<wbr>seq</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Chromatin Potential Identified by Shared Single-Cell Profiling of RNA and Chromatin</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SHARE-seq 是一种 split–pool combinatorial barcoding 技术：在同一固定细胞/细胞核内分别标记开放染色质和 mRNA，再给两类分子连接相同的三轮细胞条形码，最终分开建 ATAC 与 RNA 文库。论文利用真实的一对一配对测量寻找 peak–gene 关联、定义 DORC，并把当前 DORC 可及性与其他细胞的 RNA 状态匹配，得到“chromatin potential”向量。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Cell differentiation is regulated across multiple layers of gene regulation, including chromatin accessibility and gene expression. A longstanding hypothesis in developmental biology posits that changes in chromatin state (e.g.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2020.09.056" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SHARE-seq">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/share-seq-1905ff68/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SHARE-seq">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2020" data-code="yes" data-journal="journal-of-the-royal-statistical-society-series-b" data-journal-label="Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B" data-method="SuSiE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Machine Learning Algorithm</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SuSiE">SuSiE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A simple new approach to variable selection in regression, with application to genetic fine mapping</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SuSiE 的核心是：用若干个“只能选择一个变量、但保留全部选择不确定性”的贝叶斯单效应模型相加，再通过 IBSS 反复对其他效应残差化。这个结构让高度相关变量可以作为一个可信集合被诚实报告；代价是需要给出 L、依赖模型与 LD 质量，并仍可能落入局部最优。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Genetic fine mapping aims to identify which specific genetic variants (SNPs) causally affect a trait of interest (e.g., gene expression, disease risk).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series B · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1111/rssb.12388" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SuSiE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/stephenslab/susieR" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SuSiE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/susie-77f43cfc/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SuSiE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2020" data-code="yes" data-journal="pmlr" data-journal-label="PMLR" data-method="TrajectoryNet">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="TrajectoryNet">TrajectoryNet</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">TrajectoryNet: A Dynamic Optimal Transport Network for Modeling Cellular Dynamics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">TrajectoryNet 把不同时间点采到的细胞群看作一系列概率分布，用一个连续归一化流（continuous normalizing flow, CNF）学习随时间变化的速度场。最大似然负责让模型在观测时间点匹配数据分布，能量、密度、RNA velocity 和生长项则分别约束路径短、路径贴近数据流形、方向符合局部速度、群体质量允许增减。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) captures static snapshots of gene expression across cells, but cells are destroyed during measurement, making it impossible to track individual cell trajectories over time.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>PMLR · 2020</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2002.04461" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for TrajectoryNet">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/krishnaswamylab/TrajectoryNet" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for TrajectoryNet">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/trajectorynet-4ba98ded/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：TrajectoryNet">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="scATAC" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="cisTopic">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">scATAC — Single-Cell Chromatin &amp; DNA Methylation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="cisTopic">cisTopic</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">cisTopic: cis-regulatory topic modeling on single-cell ATAC-seq data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 ATAC-seq 的矩阵极稀疏：行是候选调控区域，列是细胞，一个“0”既可能代表该区域在该细胞中关闭，也可能只是测序深度不足而没有读到。传统流程往往先降维/聚类细胞再找差异区域，或者先按已知 motif/cistrome 聚合区域再聚类细胞。前者把细胞状态与调控区域发现割裂，后者依赖预定义注释，难以发现新的 enhancer 组合。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;cisTopic: cis-regulatory topic modeling on single-cell ATAC-seq data&quot; Authors: Carmen Bravo González-Blas, Liesbeth Minnoye, et al. (Aerts lab, KU Leuven) Journal: Nature Methods, 2019 DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-019-0367-1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for cisTopic">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/aertslab/cistopic" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for cisTopic">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/cistopic-2edefbc3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：cisTopic">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="protein_sequence_models" data-year="2019" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="Fragoza2019_PPI_SNV">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Protein &amp; Sequence Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Fragoza2019_PPI_SNV">Fragoza2019_<wbr>PPI_<wbr>SNV</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Extensive disruption of protein interactions by genetic variants across the allele frequency spectrum in human populations</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这项工作不是训练一个变异致病性预测器，而是构建并验证一个实验 atlas：从 ExAC、HGMD 和 COSMIC 选择 2,009 个错义 SNV，逐个制备经过测序确认的突变克隆，再用酵母双杂交测试它们对 2,185 条蛋白互作的影响。最终得到 4,797 个“SNV—互作”测量，并用人细胞中的 PCA、蛋白稳定性实验、酶活实验和 CRISPR 小鼠把“互作边被破坏”逐步连接到分子和个体表型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Each human genome carries 13,500 missense coding variants, yet the fraction that meaningfully alters protein function has been notoriously difficult to pin down. Prior estimates ranged from 1.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-11959-3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Fragoza2019_PPI_SNV">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/fragoza2019-ppi-snv-a95bdfbd/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Fragoza2019_PPI_SNV">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="neurips" data-journal-label="NeurIPS" data-method="GTN">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="GTN">GTN</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Graph Transformer Networks</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">GTN 的“Transformer”不是今天常说的 self-attention Transformer。它学习的是图结构变换：对异构图的多种边类型做可微的软选择，再通过邻接矩阵相乘把若干关系组合成 meta-path 图，最后在这些自动生成的图上做 GCN 节点分类。核心贡献是把“专家手工选 meta-path → 再训练 GNN”的两阶段流程改成端到端学习。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Graph Transformer Networks Authors: Seongjun Yun, Minbyul Jeong, Raehyun Kim, Jaewoo Kang, Hyunwoo J. Kim Venue: NeurIPS 2019 arXiv: 1911.06455 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>NeurIPS · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1911.06455" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for GTN">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/seongjunyun/Graph_Transformer_Networks" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for GTN">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/gtn-ed6d015a/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：GTN">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Monocle 3 / MOCA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Monocle 3 / MOCA">Monocle 3 / MOCA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">The single-cell transcriptional landscape of mammalian organogenesis</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇论文首先是一张小鼠器官发生单细胞图谱：作者用 sci-RNA-seq3 测量 E9.5–E13.5 的 61 个胚胎，得到约 205 万个细胞，定义 38 个主要 cell types、655 个 subtypes，并分析 AER、肢芽间充质和骨骼肌等发育系统。其次，它用一个新版本 Monocle 3 在 152 万高质量细胞上重建 10 个主要轨迹与 56 个子轨迹。 因此，Monocle 3 不是这篇论文全部实验流程的代名词。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Mouse organogenesis (E9.5–E13.5) is the 4-day window in which most major organ systems emerge from three germ layers. Understanding the transcriptional programs driving this transformation requires profiling cells at the right depth and at…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-019-0969-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Monocle 3 / MOCA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cole-trapnell-lab/monocle3" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Monocle 3 / MOCA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/monocle-3-moca-71547058/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Monocle 3 / MOCA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="genome-biology" data-journal-label="Genome Biology" data-method="PAGA">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="PAGA">PAGA</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">PAGA: graph abstraction reconciles clustering with trajectory inference through a topology preserving map of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">PAGA 不直接把所有细胞强行拟合成一棵轨迹树。它先在单细胞 kNN 图上划分群体，再统计群体之间跨边是否足够多，得到一个加权的群体图 G^。这个图可以同时表示连续连接、分支、环和断开的区域；沿高置信群体路径再结合 DPT，才得到细胞级顺序和基因变化。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq data captures a spectrum of cellular states that are simultaneously discrete (distinct cell types) and continuous (differentiation gradients).</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Genome Biology · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s13059-019-1663-x" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for PAGA">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/paga" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for PAGA">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/paga-0cedbe37/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：PAGA">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Palantir">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Palantir">Palantir</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Characterization of cell fate probabilities in single-cell data with Palantir</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Palantir 不先把细胞硬切成几条分支，而是把单细胞状态流形变成一个大体沿伪时间向前的 Markov 链。对每个细胞，它计算随机游走最终被各终末状态吸收的概率；这些概率就是 branch/fate probabilities，其 Shannon 熵被定义为 differentiation potential（DP）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: Characterization of cell fate probabilities in single-cell data with Palantir Authors: Manu Setty, Vaidotas Kiseliovas, Jacob Levine, Adam Gayoso, Linas Mazutis, Dana Pe&#x27;er Journal: Nature Biotechnology 37(4), 2019 DOI: 10.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41587-019-0068-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Palantir">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/dpeerlab/Palantir" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Palantir">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/palantir-39f3b482/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Palantir">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="scATAC" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="SCALE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">scATAC — Single-Cell Chromatin &amp; DNA Methylation</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="SCALE">SCALE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SCALE method for single-cell ATAC-seq analysis via latent feature extraction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 ATAC-seq 的每一列是一个染色质可及峰，每一行是一个细胞。与 RNA 计数相比，它有两个更尖锐的问题：维度可达数万至近十万峰，但每个细胞只观测到极少数开放位点；同时，一个位点在单细胞中接近“观测到/未观测到”的二元状态。于是，大量 0 既可能是真正关闭，也可能是测序深度不足导致的漏检。 传统 PCA 偏向连续、近高斯结构；依赖细胞间相关性的聚类在大量并列 0 时也容易失真。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq) measures open chromatin accessibility at single-cell resolution, revealing which genomic regions are accessible to transcription factors in individual cells.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-12630-7" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SCALE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/jsxlei/SCALE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SCALE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/scale-f7d7a79c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SCALE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-communications" data-journal-label="Nature Communications" data-method="STREAM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STREAM">STREAM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell trajectories reconstruction, exploration and mapping of omics data with STREAM</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STREAM 是一个用于单细胞轨迹推断、可视化和参考映射的工具。它关注的问题是：给定一次性测量到的单细胞转录组、qPCR 或染色质可及性数据，如何从中重建细胞分化过程中的分支轨迹、分叉点和伪时间，并且把这些结果以研究者容易理解的方式展示出来。 论文认为当时很多轨迹方法有三个不足。第一，主要面向 scRNA-seq，对 scATAC-seq 这类表观组数据支持不足。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STREAM is a trajectory-inference and visualization framework for single-cell omics data. The paper targets a gap in earlier pseudotime tools: many were designed mainly for transcriptomic data, offered limited branch-aware visualization, and…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Communications · 2019</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-019-09670-4" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for STREAM">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/pinellolab/STREAM" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for STREAM">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/stream-10f32bb0/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：STREAM">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2019" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="WOT">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="WOT">WOT</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Optimal-Transport Analysis of Single-Cell Gene Expression Identifies Developmental Trajectories in Reprogramming</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">这篇 Cell 2019 论文提出 Waddington-OT（WOT），目标是从时间序列单细胞 RNA-seq 数据中重建细胞发育/重编程轨迹。核心困难是：scRNA-seq 会破坏细胞，所以同一个细胞及其后代不能被连续观测；实验只能在不同时间点采样一批不同的细胞。因此，研究者需要把离散的“快照”连接成连续的“电影”。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Optimal-Transport Analysis of Single-Cell Gene Expression Identifies Developmental Trajectories in Reprogramming introduces Waddington-OT (WOT), a framework for reconstructing probabilistic developmental trajectories from time-course single…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2019</span>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="2018" data-code="yes" data-journal="cell" data-journal-label="Cell" data-method="MAGIC">

        <h2 aria-label="MAGIC">MAGIC</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Recovering Gene Interactions from Single-Cell Data Using Data Diffusion</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞 RNA 测序通常只捕获每个细胞真实转录本的一小部分。低表达基因即使真实存在，也常被观测为零，进而破坏基因–基因关系。MAGIC（Markov affinity-based graph imputation of cells）的基本假设是：细胞状态受调控网络约束，位于一个低维流形上；相似状态的细胞应共享表达信息。 因此 MAGIC 不为每个零单独拟合一个概率模型。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Recovering Gene Interactions from Single-Cell Data Using Data Diffusion Authors: van Dijk et al. Journal: Cell 174, 716–729 (2018) DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2018.05.061 Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Cell · 2018</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2018.05.061" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for MAGIC">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/KrishnaswamyLab/MAGIC" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for MAGIC">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/magic-afe98eb1/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：MAGIC">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2018" data-code="yes" data-journal="bmc-genomics" data-journal-label="BMC Genomics" data-method="Slingshot">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Slingshot">Slingshot</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Slingshot: cell lineage and pseudotime inference for single-cell transcriptomics</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Slingshot 不直接在单细胞之间连一棵容易受噪声影响的树，而是先在低维空间的细胞簇之间建立最小生成树（MST），把从起始簇到叶簇的路径解释为谱系；随后为每条谱系拟合相互约束的主曲线，用细胞在曲线上的弧长作为伪时间。它把“全局分支拓扑”和“谱系内连续排序”拆成两个问题。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Biological problem: Single-cell RNA-seq data from differentiating cell populations forms a continuum rather than discrete states. Recovering the underlying temporal ordering (pseudotime) and the branching structure of cell fate decisions is…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>BMC Genomics · 2018</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1186/s12864-018-4772-0" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Slingshot">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/kstreet13/slingshot" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Slingshot">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/slingshot-19e4f29d/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Slingshot">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="svg_patterning" data-year="2018" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="SpatialDE">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="SpatialDE">SpatialDE</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">SpatialDE: identification of spatially variable genes</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SpatialDE 解决的是：给定每个 spot/细胞的空间坐标和每个基因的表达，哪些基因的表达相似性会随空间距离而变化？它不要求先把组织切成离散区域，也不只寻找总体方差大的基因，而是为每个基因比较“含空间协方差的高斯过程模型”和“只有独立噪声的常数模型”。论文发表于 2018 年 Nature Methods（DOI 10.1038/nmeth.4636）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial resolution of gene expression is crucial for determining the functions and phenotypes of cells in multicellular organisms. Spatial expression variation can reflect: Cell-cell communication between adjacent cells Position-specific st…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2018</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.4636" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SpatialDE">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Teichlab/SpatialDE" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for SpatialDE">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/spatialde-6cd51db5/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SpatialDE">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2018" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature" data-journal-label="Nature" data-method="Velocyto">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span><span class="atlas-code-mark">code</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Velocyto">Velocyto</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">RNA velocity of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">普通单细胞 RNA 测序给出的通常是某一时刻的静态表达量。对于发育、分化、再生这类动态过程，仅靠静态表达矩阵很难判断一个细胞下一步会往哪个状态走。La Manno 等人在 Nature 2018 提出 RNA velocity：利用同一份 scRNA-seq 数据中未剪接 mRNA（unspliced/nascent）和已剪接 mRNA（spliced/mature）的相对关系，估计每个细胞表达状态的时间导数，也就是“速度” 。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Single-cell RNA-seq usually captures a static snapshot of each cell. That makes it difficult to infer where a differentiating cell is going next, especially in development or regeneration. La Manno et al.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature · 2018</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-018-0414-6" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Velocyto">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/velocyto-team/velocyto.R" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Velocyto">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/velocyto-8638cb10/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Velocyto">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="machine_learning_algorithm" data-year="2017" data-code="yes" data-journal="biometrics" data-journal-label="Biometrics" data-method="JointGGMSpatialTemporal">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="JointGGMSpatialTemporal">JointGGMSpatialTemporal</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">On Joint Estimation of Gaussian Graphical Models for Spatial and Temporal Data</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">JointGGMSpatialTemporal 的核心思想是：把 GGM 边是否存在表示成贝叶斯潜变量 γ，并用空间/时间 MRF 先验让相关图中的同一条边共享信息，从而在多组、空间或时间结构数据中获得更稳定的网络估计。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Title: On Joint Estimation of Gaussian Graphical Models for Spatial and Temporal Data Journal/year: Biometrics, 2017 DOI: 10.1111/biom.12650 Code: https://github.</p>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2017" data-code="yes" data-journal="nature-methods" data-journal-label="Nature Methods" data-method="Monocle2">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Monocle2">Monocle2</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Reversed graph embedding resolves complex single-cell trajectories</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">单细胞转录组一次只测到一个细胞的一个快照。轨迹推断要从不同细胞的表达状态重建一个假想的连续过程，并给细胞分配伪时间和分支。Monocle 2 的关键变化不是单纯换一种降维，而是把“低维表示”和“低维空间中的主图”放进同一个目标函数联合学习。 论文称这类方法为 reversed graph embedding（RGE，反向图嵌入）：普通降维学习从高维表达 x 到低维坐标 z；RGE 同时要求低维图经过函数 fG 映回高维后能重建数据。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: &quot;Reversed graph embedding resolves complex single-cell trajectories&quot; Authors: Xiaojie Qiu, Qi Mao, Ying Tang, Li Wang, Raghav Chawla, Hannah A. Pliner, Cole Trapnell Journal: Nature Methods 14(10), 2017 | DOI: 10.1038/nmeth.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2017</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.4402" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Monocle2">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/cole-trapnell-lab/monocle-release" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for Monocle2">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/monocle2-0039e079/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Monocle2">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2016" data-code="yes" data-journal="bioinformatics" data-journal-label="Bioinformatics" data-method="destiny">

        <h2 aria-label="destiny">destiny</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">destiny: diffusion maps for large-scale single-cell data in R</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">destiny 处理的不是“给细胞分几个群”，而是如何从大量异步采样的单细胞测量中恢复连续、弯曲甚至分支的状态流形。论文发表于 2016 年，目标是给 R 用户提供一个可扩展的 diffusion map 实现，并针对单细胞数据加入三项实用能力：只计算 k 近邻以支持几十万细胞、显式处理检测下限和缺失值、把新数据投影到已有扩散图。 输入是已经预处理和归一化的细胞×特征矩阵（基因表达、蛋白标记等），或用户提供的距离矩阵。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Paper: Angerer et al. (2016) Bioinformatics 32(8):1241–1243 DOI: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btv715 Type: Software application note Code: https://github.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Bioinformatics · 2016</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btv715" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for destiny">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/theislab/destiny" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for destiny">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/destiny-d1a54153/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：destiny">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Diffusion pseudotime (DPT) 解决的是单细胞快照数据中如何重建发育顺序和分支的问题。输入是细胞 x 基因表达矩阵，输出是以某个 root cell 为起点的 pseudotime、branch labels、未决/decision cells，以及由基因动态支持的生物学解释。</p>

        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>

          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Edgotyping 的核心是把“mutation 是否破坏蛋白”拆成“是否引起 folding-quality-control signal、丢失哪些 protein partners、丢失哪些 DNA targets”。它证明 interaction-specific disease mechanisms 很常见，但每个 QW/E/QN 标签都受当时 interaction map 和 assay context 限制，必须作为可测…</p>
        </div>

      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="dynamics_fate_trajectory" data-year="2014" data-code="no" data-journal="nature-biotechnology" data-journal-label="Nature Biotechnology" data-method="Monocle v1">

          <span class="atlas-chip">Dynamics, Fate &amp; Trajectory</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="Monocle v1">Monocle v1</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">The dynamics and regulators of cell fate decisions are revealed by pseudotemporal ordering of single cells</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Monocle 1 的出发点是一个实验事实：即使细胞在同一时刻被收集，它们也可能处在完全不同的分化阶段。若只按 0、24、48、72 小时分组取平均，早开始和晚开始分化的细胞会混在一起，关键调控开关被平滑掉。Monocle 因此不把采样时刻当作细胞内部时间，而是根据表达相似性将单细胞重新排列，定义“pseudotime”。 论文的输入是已经定量的单细胞表达矩阵；该研究使用人骨骼肌成肌细胞的 FPKM。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Understanding cell differentiation requires knowing the precise sequence and timing of transcriptional changes. Skeletal muscle differentiation — one of the most studied systems in cell biology — had been characterized at the transcriptomic…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Biotechnology · 2014</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/nbt.2859" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for Monocle v1">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/monocle-v1-77a6db4c/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：Monocle v1">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>

        <h2 aria-label="SNF">SNF</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Similarity network fusion for aggregating data types on a genomic scale</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">SNF 先为每一种数据类型建立一个样本相似网络，然后让这些网络通过局部邻域反复交换信息，最后得到一个融合网络；这个融合网络既保留多个数据类型共同支持的相似性，也能保留某个数据类型独有但可信的互补信息。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Modern cancer cohorts often contain several matched genomic data types for the same patients, such as mRNA expression, DNA methylation, and miRNA expression.</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>Nature Methods · 2014</span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-doi" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/nmeth.2810" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open DOI for SNF">DOI <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/snf-d9119f5f/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：SNF">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="datasource/atlases_resources" data-year="" data-code="yes" data-journal="" data-journal-label="" data-method="nPOD">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">

        <h2 aria-label="nPOD">nPOD</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">Single-cell multiome and spatial profiling reveals pancreas cell type-specific gene regulatory programs driving type 1 diabetes progression</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">1 型糖尿病（T1D）不是只在确诊后发生的 beta 细胞丢失。自身抗体阳性（AAB+）阶段已经出现免疫和细胞状态变化，但以往研究常只分析纯化胰岛、单一组学或长期 T1D，难以区分哪些变化发生在什么细胞、何时出现、由哪些调控元件支持以及位于何种组织邻域。 本文分析 32 位 nPOD 全胰腺供体：11 位非糖尿病（ND）、9 位 ND AAB+、7 位近期 T1D（病程 5 年）。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Strengths: Complete code repository with well-organized notebooks covering all major analyses Clear documentation of preprocessing steps and parameter choices Multiple modalities (snRNA-seq, snATAC-seq, multiome, spatial) with consistent pr…</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span></span>
          <span class="atlas-card__links"><a class="atlas-code-link" href="https://github.com/Gaulton-Lab/nPOD" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Open code for nPOD">Code <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square" aria-hidden="true"></i></a><a class="atlas-details-link" href="{{ '/paper-atlas/npod-fae1c7e3/' | relative_url }}" aria-label="完整解读：nPOD">完整解读 <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a></span>
        </footer>
      </article>
      <article class="atlas-card" data-category="representation_models" data-year="" data-code="no" data-journal="" data-journal-label="—" data-method="STORM">
        <div class="atlas-card__chips">
          <span class="atlas-chip">Representation Models</span>
        </div>
        <h2 aria-label="STORM">STORM</h2>
        <p class="atlas-card__title">A Multimodal Foundation Model of Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology for Biological Discovery and Clinical Prediction</p>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="zh" lang="zh-CN">
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">STORM 是一个把 H&amp;E 病理形态、空间转录组表达和组织空间邻域放进同一表示空间的多模态基础模型。它先在配对的 H&amp;E-ST 数据上做空间掩码预训练，再把学到的表示用于空间域发现、从 H&amp;E 预测虚拟 ST，以及患者预后和免疫治疗反应建模。</p>
        </div>
        <div class="atlas-card__summary-panel" data-atlas-summary="en" lang="en" hidden>
          <p class="atlas-card__summary">Spatial transcriptomics (ST) maps gene expression in tissue context but is costly and low-throughput; H&amp;E is routine and morphologically rich but lacks molecular resolution .</p>
        </div>
        <footer>
          <span>—</span>

        </footer>
